831174302000023--.name:
Hey, $MyPCName$!
Did you hear that the royal audience was canceled?

831174302000025--.name:
Seriously!! The more I think about it, the angrier I get.
It's been days since the earthquake. How does it make sense to suddenly cancel the royal audience now?

831174302000026--.name:
They're definitely up to something. I can smell it!
I'm going to find out what they're hiding.

831174302000027--.name: Ask how he plans to find out.

831174302000028--.name:
W-well... I'll go around asking people, of course!
Anyway! I'm going to be busy from now on, so if you're curious, go grab that $npcTitle:11000169[gender:0]$$pp:나,이나$
and ask him yourself or whatever~

831174302000029--.name:
I told you, I'm busy...
If you want to know why the royal audience was canceled, go ask that armory guard over there!

831174302000030--.name: Pardon? What did you just say?

831174302000031--.name: Ask if he knows the real reason the royal audience was canceled.

831174302000033--.name:
I don't know whether there's another reason the royal audience was canceled...
But instead of asking an ordinary guard like me, you'd get answers faster by visiting
$npc:11000492[gender:0]$ in $map:02000140$.

831174302000035--.name:
He's the royal administrator in charge of the palace's affairs.
He oversaw all the preparations for this royal audience, so he should know much more
about why it was canceled.

831174302000036--.name:
I don't know whether there's another reason the royal audience was canceled...
But instead of asking an ordinary guard like me, you'd get answers faster by visiting
$npc:11000492[gender:0]$ in $map:02000140$.

831174302000037--.name:
Whew...
You were looking for me? What can I do for you?

831174302000038--.name: Ask if he knows the real reason the royal audience was canceled.

831174302000039--.name:
Ah... So that's why you came all this way too, $MyPCName$.
To get straight to the point... We had no choice but to cancel because <font color="#ffd200">we could not guarantee
the safety of the enormous crowd gathering for the royal audience</font>.

831174302000040--.name:
Of course, I understand how disappointed the many people who made the difficult journey
from far away must be after such a sudden cancellation.
Even so, I hope you can understand the palace's position: we cannot proceed with an event
when doing so risks great loss of life.

831174302000041--.name: Ask for details about the danger.

831174302000042--.name:
Ah... The <font color="#ffd200">recent earthquake is undoubtedly the greatest danger</font>.
An earthquake this large has never struck near $map:02000001$ before, and
its exact cause has yet to be determined.

831174302000043--.name:
If another earthquake struck during the royal audience, would we not face an
irreversible tragedy?
In any case, $MyPCName$, since you traveled so far to attend, <font color="#ffd200">as the person responsible for
preparing the event, I apologize on behalf of the palace</font>.

831174302000044--.name:
I would be grateful if you could trust that this was <font color="#ffd200">an unavoidable decision made for everyone's safety</font>
and generously consider the palace's position.

831174302000045--.name:
Say, young traveler.
Did you also come for the royal audience, only to hear it had been canceled?

831174302000047--.name:
I thought so...
I carried this heavy load over quite a long distance to get here,
so when I suddenly heard the royal audience was canceled, I came here furious.

831174302000048--.name:
But seeing $npc:11000492[gender:0]$ calmly explain the palace's position and even bow his head
in apology gradually eased my anger.
The traveling merchants are always <font color="#ffd200">praising Tria's royal administrator for being upright
and diligent</font>. I see those weren't just empty rumors.

831174302000049--.name:
There must be many others like us who came here angry over the cancellation,
yet he patiently explains everything without ever losing his smile...
He even introduced me to merchants who would buy the goods I'd brought to sell at the event...
Where else in the world could you find a person like that?

831174302000050--.name:
Ah, I've been rambling on. This is no time for that...
If I want to reach the buyer $npc:11000492[gender:0]$ introduced me to before sunset,
I must leave right now. Ah... But what should I do about this...
I'm sorry, but could you do me a favor?

831174302000052--.name:
I don't have time to return to the inn and check out now.
I'll give you my room key. Would you take it to $npc:11000390[gender:0]$ in $map:02000033$$pp2:로,으로$
and check out for me?

831174302000053--.name: Why did you turn back before you got there?

831174302000054--.name: Say he forgot to give you $item:30000163$$pp:를,을$.

831174302000055--.name: Say you went the wrong way.

831174302000056--.name:
Goodness... You nearly made the trip for nothing.
Here it is. Make sure you take good care of it.

831174302000057--.name:
Are you already getting forgetful at your age?
You put it in your bag earlier. Have another look through it!

831174302000058--.name:
Goodness... Your bag is full.
You ought to keep it organized.

831174302000059--.name: Honestly... Young people these days seem to have an even worse sense of direction than I do.

831174302000060--.name:
Welcome.
How may I help you?

831174302000061--.name: Hand over the room key from $npc:11000179[gender:0]$ and ask to check out for him.

831174302000062--.name:
Normally, the guest must come in person... But he has probably left already...
I suppose it can't be helped.
Between the guests leaving after hearing the royal audience was canceled and those arriving
without knowing about the cancellation, things have been absolutely hectic.

831174302000063--.name:
While we were waiting for the royal audience, even the hectic rush felt exciting.
Now... It's nothing but disappointment and more work.

831174302000081--.name:
Whew... It's you from earlier.
Did $npc:11000492[gender:0]$ tell you why the royal audience was canceled?

831174302000083--.name:
Ah... I see...
If $npc:11000492[gender:0]$ said so, then it must be true.
He's not the sort of person who would deceive anyone... Whew...
If the royal audience hadn't been canceled... None of this would have happened...

831174302000085--.name:
Ah, well... A thief...!
N-no... It's nothing.
Why am I telling all this to someone I barely know...?

831174302000086--.name: Persuade him that you can help if he explains the situation.

831174302000087--.name:
I... Well, the truth is...
<font color="#ffd200">Every weapon in the armory has disappeared.</font>
When the royal audience was canceled, we stored all the new weapons intended for the event
in this armory...

831174302000088--.name:
I hardly ever left my post, and the lock was secured...
I have no idea when or how it happened.
If anyone discovers the weapons were stolen, I'll certainly be expelled from the Royal Guard…

831174302000089--.name:
Would you help me recover the stolen weapons without anyone finding out?
I've heard rumors that <font color="#ffd200">stolen goods are being traded among Tria's merchants...</font>
The <font color="#ffd200">stolen weapons</font> may be among them.

831174302000090--.name:
Would you discreetly question <font color="#ffd200">$npc:11000004[gender:0]$</font>$pp:를,을$,
the most active weapons dealer in $map:02000001$?

831174302000091--.name:
Would you visit <font color="#ffd200">$npc:11000004[gender:0]$</font>$pp:를,을$, the most active weapons dealer in $map:02000001$,
and discreetly ask about the stolen goods?

831174302000092--.name:
What do you want to know?
I don't know much besides weapons.

831174302000093--.name: Ask whether any recently traded weapons seemed likely to be stolen.

831174302000094--.name:
Why would you say something that could get me in serious trouble?
I only sell weapons I forge myself with my own hammer.
Other than iron ore for making weapons, I don't trade in finished weapons.

831174302000095--.name:
My only recent transaction was <font color="#ffd200">buying iron ore from $npc:11000170[gender:0]$$pp:가,이$,
who offered it to me cheaply</font>.

831174302000096--.name: Why do you keep bothering me?

831174302000097--.name: Press her on whether the iron ore she sold to $npc:11000004[gender:0]$ was stolen.

831174302000098--.name:
S-stolen...? Don't accuse an innocent person!
I just... heard that someone was selling iron ore cheaply...
In any case, I paid a fair price for the goods before selling them to the merchants.

831174302000099--.name: Ask who sold her the iron ore.

831174302000100--.name:
W-well...
It's a little difficult to say...

831174302000103--.name:
Whew... The truth is...
While passing through $map:02000083$$pp:를,을$, I found a flyer advertising an <font color="#ffd200">urgent iron ore sale</font>.

831174302000104--.name:
I was already on my way to $map:02000001$$pp2:로,으로$, so I thought the timing was perfect.
Iron ore is essential for making the Royal Guard's armor, shields, and weapons,
so it fetches a higher price in $map:02000001$.

831174302000105--.name:
Anyway... I went to the entrance of <font color="#ffd200">$map:02000141$</font> listed on the flyer.
When I showed it to them, they led me to <font color="#ffd200">$npc:11000173[gender:0]$</font>.
The place felt ominous...
It didn't feel like I could simply turn around and leave.

831174302000106--.name:
I didn't know at the time. It was only after reaching $map:02000001$ that I learned
<font color="#ffd200">$npc:11000173[gender:0]$$pp:가,이$ is a notorious fence</font>.
I swear to heaven, I didn't know the goods were stolen when I made the deal.

831174302000107--.name: Confirm the location where she bought the iron ore.

831174302000108--.name:
<font color="#ffd200">$map:02000141$</font>...
Enter between the tall buildings in <font color="#ffd200">$map:02000083$</font>.
Here... Show them the <font color="#ffd200">urgent iron ore sale</font> flyer I used,
and they'll let you in.

831174302000109--.name:
You must never tell them I sent you.
If they find out, they'll hunt me down and make me pay. Understand?

831174302000110--.name:
All right, all right... I didn't know the goods were stolen at first either.
I was simply passing through <font color="#ffd200">$map:02000083$</font>$pp:를,을$ when I saw a flyer for an
<font color="#ffd200">urgent iron ore sale</font> and went to find <font color="#ffd200">$npc:11000173[gender:0]$</font>$pp:를,을$.

831174302000111--.name:
It was only after reaching $map:02000001$ that I heard
<font color="#ffd200">$npc:11000173[gender:0]$$pp:가,이$ is a notorious fence</font>.
I absolutely did not know the goods were stolen from the start.

831174302000114--.name: Say she forgot to give you $item:30000103$$pp:를,을$.

831174302000115--.name: Say you went the wrong way.

831174302000117--.name:
You put it in your bag earlier.
Look carefully one more time.

831174302000118--.name:
Your bag looks awfully heavy...
Why don't you organize it?

831174302000119--.name: Oh... I thought... You scared me.

831174302000120--.name:
Hey~! You there~!
Where are you going?

831174302000121--.name: Show him the flyer and say you are headed to $map:02000141$.

831174302000122--.name:
Yo, man~!
You're way too late. All the iron ore has already been sold~

831174302000123--.name:
Only members of the broker organization can enter $map:02000141$$pp:는,은$ now~
Just go home, wash your feet, and get some sleep~ Yo~! Heh heh.

831174302000124--.name:
Oh, right! I still owe you the iron ore transaction records I promised.
Let's see...

831174302000125--.name:
Hmm... Haina... $npcName:11000492[gender:0]$... Elcanto... Kims... $npcName:11000526[gender:0]$... Burto...
$npc:11000171[gender:0]$... Hmm? Aha...

831174302000126--.name:
<font color="#ffd200">Month O, Day XX / $npc:11000171[gender:0]$ / 300 kg of iron ore</font>
Here's the very record you're looking for!
$npcName:11000171[gender:0]$$pp:는,은$ is the boss of a scrapyard in $map:02000084$.

831174302000127--.name:
Take this to <font color="#ffd200">$map:02000084$</font>$pp2:로,으로$ and confront <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11000171[gender:0]$</font>$pp:를,을$.
You should be able to learn what you want to know.
I should retrace my steps and get out of here now. If fate allows, we'll meet again!

831174302000128--.name: Shh! Why are you still here?

831174302000129--.name: Say he forgot to give you $item:30000105$$pp:를,을$.

831174302000130--.name: Say you went the wrong way.

831174302000131--.name:
You should have kept track of it from the start. At this rate, you'll expose me too.
Here, take this and get going.

831174302000132--.name:
I thought I saw you put it in your bag earlier... Isn't it there?
Look carefully.

831174302000133--.name:
How do you carry such a heavy bag around?
Organize it before they catch you and clean you out.

831174302000134--.name:
This place is a little confusing.
Don't wander off somewhere strange. Just follow the corridor straight out.

831174302000135--.name:
What do you want?!
If you're not here to sell scrap, stop loitering and get out.

831174302000136--.name: Show him the iron ore transaction record.

831174302000137--.name:
W-what is this...? Wh-where did you get it...?
Why did you come looking for me with that?

831174302000138--.name: Ask where he obtained the iron ore he gave to $npc:11000173[gender:0]$.

831174302000139--.name:
If I tell you...?
Will you pretend my deal with $npc:11000173[gender:0]$$pp:와,과$ never happened?

831174302000142--.name:
The truth is...
It was <font color="#ffd200">iron ore made by melting down weapons intended for a Royal Guard ceremony</font>...
There was so much of it that I secretly skimmed off a tiny amount and handed it
over to $npc:11000173[gender:0]$.

831174302000143--.name:
We received a <font color="#ffd200">special order from a royal official</font> to melt them all down,
since the cancellation of the royal audience meant they were no longer needed.

831174302000144--.name: Ask which royal official placed the order.

831174302000145--.name:
I don't know that either.
Only the porters came, claiming they were from the palace. They unloaded a mountain of weapons and left.

831174302000146--.name: Ask where the rest of the iron ore is.

831174302000147--.name: We loaded all of it onto a truck from $map:02000001$.

831174302000148--.name:
Then I can't tell you anything.
Give me the document you brought and promise to leave me out of this.
Then I'll tell you where the iron ore came from.

831174302000150--.name:
Why, why, why?!
I told you everything. Why are you calling me again?

831174302000151--.name: Ask about the truck that came from $map:02000001$.

831174302000152--.name:
That? It was a Goldus delivery truck.
The driver said a client had sent them to our scrapyard to collect the iron ore.

831174302000153--.name: Ask where the iron ore was delivered.

831174302000154--.name:
How would I know?
The delivery driver who transported it would know.
They came from <font color="#ffd200">$map:02000001$</font>, so go ask a <font color="#ffd200">delivery driver</font> there.

831174302000155--.name: Ask a <font color="#ffd200">delivery driver</font> in <font color="#ffd200">$map:02000001$</font> about the rest.

831174302000156--.name: Pardon? What did you say brought you here?

831174302000157--.name: Ask about the iron ore collected from $map:02000084$.

831174302000158--.name:
Ah... We handle hundreds of deliveries every day,
so I can't remember every single one…

831174302000159--.name:
You said the goods were collected from $map:02000084$, correct?
I'll check the shipping ledger. Please wait a moment.

831174302000160--.name:
I found the shipping record while you were visiting $map:02000140$.
From $map:02000084$... Twelve freight containers...
Contents: iron ore... Hmm...
There is no recipient name, only a delivery address.

831174302000162--.name:
The address...
It says <font color="#ffd200">125 Royal Road, Queenstown</font>.

831174302000163--.name:
<font color="#ffd200">$map:02000064$</font>$pp:는,은$ is only a short walk from $map:02000001$.
If the route seems too confusing, check the <font color="#ffd200">minimap</font> for the location
of the portal leading to $map:02000064$$pp2:로,으로$.

831174302000164--.name:
Are you lost?
Can I help you?

831174302000165--.name: Give him the address and ask where it is.

831174302000166--.name:
Ah, you've come to the right place.
It's the <font color="#ffd200">warehouse building directly behind me</font>.
The <font color="#ffd200">palace has been renting the building</font> for some time now.

831174302000167--.name: Ask why the palace rented the building.

831174302000168--.name:
Ah, I heard the royal warehouse filled up with preparations for the royal audience.
Even after the event was canceled, a delivery truck still comes and goes with container cargo
at least once every two days.

831174302000170--.name:
Well... I've never seen anyone identify themselves as the manager.
Whenever delivery trucks come and go, I check their identification and access passes,
then open the door for them myself.

831174302000171--.name: Ask him to let you look inside the warehouse just once.

831174302000172--.name:
I'm afraid I can't do that. I can only open the warehouse to people carrying
an access pass certified by the palace.

831174302000173--.name:
A neatly arranged ledger lies on the desk.
Leafing through it reveals…

831174302000174--.name:
<font color="#ffd200">Month 0, Day 0, 23:00</font>
Royal Warehouse 1 / 2 crates of gold bars / Raymon, 19,300 mesos
<font color="#ffd200">Month 0, Day 0, 22:00</font>
Royal Armory / 8 t of new weapons / Trade pending

831174302000175--.name:
Royal Armory... New weapons...
This appears to be <font color="#ffd200">a record connected to the $map:02000001$ armory theft</font>.

831174302000176--.name:
Royal Armory... New weapons...
This appears to be <font color="#ffd200">a record connected to the $map:02000001$ armory theft</font>.

831174302000177--.name:
$MyPCName$.
You were gone so long that I thought you'd forgotten my request.

831174302000180--.name: Tell him to examine the ledger.

831174302000181--.name:
Hmm...? This is identical to <font color="#ffd200">$npc:11000492[gender:0]$'s handwriting</font>...
And it has <font color="#ffd200">$npc:11000492[gender:0]$'s signature</font> too...
Hmm…

831174302000182--.name:
Royal Armory... New weapons... Trade pending...?
Th-these are the <font color="#ffd200">weapons that vanished from the armory</font>!!
Then could <font color="#ffd200">$npc:11000492[gender:0]$</font> have?!!

831174302000183--.name:
Come to think of it... The date recorded in this ledger...
$npc:11000492[gender:0]$ called me to $map:02000140$$pp2:로,으로$, so I left my post briefly.
He said another guard would relieve me... Was that a scheme to rob the armory...?

831174302000184--.name:
According to this ledger, it wasn't only the armory... I truly... can't believe it.
How could $npc:11000492[gender:0]$ do such a thing...?

831174302000185--.name:
Ah... I found it.
$npc:11000492[gender:0]$'s home address is <font color="#ffd200">674 Flower Park, $map:02000119$</font>.
Try looking there.

831174302000187--.name:
You're welcome.
But this is an old address, so it may be difficult to find. If you get confused,
look for a house in Flower Park renovated with a red roof.

831174302000188--.name:
$npc:11000492[gender:0]$'s home address is <font color="#ffd200">674 Flower Park, $map:02000119$</font>.
It's an old address, so it may be difficult to find.
If you get confused, look for a house in Flower Park renovated with a red roof.

831174302000189--.name:
The house is empty, and even the door was left unlocked.
Its excessively tidy appearance feels strangely unnatural.

831174302000190--.name:
The spotless room appears empty, but there must be a clue somewhere
that can help trace $npc:11000492[gender:0]$'s whereabouts.

831174302000191--.name:
The spotless room appears empty, but there must be a clue somewhere
that can help trace $npc:11000492[gender:0]$'s whereabouts.

831174302000193--.name: Search the area around $npc:11000492[gender:0]$ for anything that might serve as a clue.

831174302000194--.name: Search the area around $npc:11000492[gender:0]$ for anything that might serve as a clue.

831174302000195--.name:
$MyPCName$!!
Just before the Royal Guard investigation began, $npc:11000492[gender:0]$—no, that man—
disappeared, and everything is in chaos.
Weren't you looking for $npc:11000492[gender:0]$?

831174302000197--.name:
What? $npc:11000492[gender:0]$... You're saying he's dead? Ah... This is terrible...
We can't stand around here. We must tell $npc:11000119[gender:0]$ immediately.

831174302000198--.name:
Please, hurry to $npc:11000119[gender:0]$ and give a detailed account of the entire investigation,
including the notebook you just found.
I'm counting on you.

831174302000200--.name: Say he forgot to give you $item:30000023$$pp:를,을$.

831174302000201--.name: Say you forgot what he asked you to do.

831174302000202--.name: Ah, you're right. Here it is.

831174302000203--.name:
I thought you put it safely in your bag earlier...
Please check your bag once more.

831174302000204--.name:
Your bag looks awfully heavy...
Perhaps you should organize it.

831174302000205--.name:
Please give $npc:11000119[gender:0]$ a detailed account of the entire investigation,
including the notebook you just found.

831174302000206--.name:
$MyPCName$!
I heard that you investigated the armory theft at $npc:11000169[gender:0]$'s request.

831174302000207--.name:
We began investigating $npc:11000492[gender:0]$ as soon as we received $npc:11000169[gender:0]$'s report,
but he has vanished without a trace. He left nothing behind.

831174302000209--.name:
What? Is that true? $npc:11000492[gender:0]$ is dead...?
Before we could uncover the truth behind the armory theft... One disaster after another.
And now we have no leads... This is troubling...

831174302000210--.name: Say you pursued the person suspected of murdering Nelph, but failed to catch them.

831174302000217--.name:
The <font color="#ffd200">$npc:21000055$</font> coming here from nearby <font color="#ffd200">$map:02000017$</font>
run wild through the neighborhood and steal everything the residents own.
This time, it seems they slipped <font color="#ffd200">$item:30000019$</font>$pp:를,을$ out of my pocket.

831174302000218--.name:
They have a habit of hiding stolen goods among the branches in the forest,
so I think you could find it by shaking and searching the trees...
But I can't leave my post...

831174302000219--.name:
I'm sorry, but would you search the <font color="#ffd200">trees</font> in <font color="#ffd200">$map:02000017$</font>
and find my <font color="#ffd200">$item:30000019$</font>$pp:를,을$?

831174302000220--.name:
I'm sorry, but would you search the <font color="#ffd200">trees</font> in <font color="#ffd200">$map:02000017$</font>
and find my <font color="#ffd200">$item:30000019$</font>$pp:를,을$?

831174302000221--.name:
If those creatures had used this $item:30000019$$pp2:로,으로$ to get inside the building,
I would have lost my job as a guard. Thank you so much.

831174302000222--.name:
How can I ever repay this debt...?
If you ever need my help, please come find me.

831174302000223--.name: Ask him to let you enter $map:02000020$.

831174302000226--.name:
Hmm... All right.
If you meant harm, you wouldn't have returned my <font color="#ffd200">$item:30000019$</font>$pp:를,을$…

831174302000227--.name:
I'll unlock <font color="#ffd200">$map:02000020$</font> for you.
But... You must take a quick look and come right back out.

831174302000228--.name:
I'll unlock <font color="#ffd200">$map:02000020$</font> for you.
But... You must take a quick look and come right back out.

831174302000230--.name: Thank him for opening the warehouse.

831174302000231--.name:
Don't mention it. You helped me first, $MyPCName$.
But this stays a secret between the two of us.

831174302000234--.name:
Ah, $MyPCName$.
It's this letter left by $npc:11000492[gender:0]$... Whew...
It was mixed in with the mail I collected from the mailbox recently.

831174302000235--.name:
He probably put it in the mailbox just before leaving $map:02000001$$pp:를,을$. Whew...
Honestly, I still can't believe it.
That $npc:11000492[gender:0]$ would do such things despite his mother...

831174302000236--.name: Ask whether there is a special story behind $npc:11000492[gender:0]$ and his mother.

831174302000237--.name:
Well... After his mother remarried and left him as a child, Nelph secretly resented her
for never contacting him again.

831174302000910--.name:

The $npc:21000266$ fill their bellies with water from the falls in $map:02000113$,
so my <font color="#ffd200">$item:30000072$</font> must still be swimming around inside them.
Hurry to <font color="#ffd200">$map:02000113$</font>$pp2:로,으로$ and bring back my <font color="#ffd200">$item:30000072$</font>
that the <font color="#ffd200">$npc:21000266$</font> ate~

831174302002469--.name:
You really recovered $item:30000072$$pp:를,을$?
Go on, let's see it.

831174302002471--.name:
Ohh~ My precious little darlings... You must have been so frightened~ trapped inside that pitch-black belly...
It's all right, it's all right. You're home again, so don't be afraid~

831174302002480--.name:
$MyPCName$!
You told me that to bring $npc:11000057[gender:1]$$pp:를,을$ back to us,
we must go to $map:02000220$$pp2:로,으로$, correct?

831174302002481--.name:
I have thought long and hard about it ever since.
As $npc:11000031[gender:0]$ said... in a sense, for the living to enter $map:02000220$$pp2:로,으로$
may defy and disrupt the natural order of life.
But... restoring $npc:11000057[gender:1]$$pp:를,을$ to her true self is also the first step toward setting right
a world now engulfed in chaos.

831174302002482--.name:
It will not be easy, of course... but someone must do it, not only to save $npc:11000057[gender:1]$,
but also this crumbling world.
I understand that a living person must risk their life to enter $map:02000220$$pp2:로,으로$.
Overcoming the divide between the living world and the realm of souls can never be easy...

831174302002483--.name:
Only someone with extraordinary mental strength and resolve can cross that divide
and return safely to life in this world.

831174302002484--.name:
$MyPCName$.
And so I must ask something terribly difficult and shameless of you.
Will you risk your life and enter $map:02000220$$pp2:로,으로$
for the sake of this world?

831174302002486--.name:
Thank you. Your steadfast heart and unwavering spirit will become a light for this world.
Go directly to $map:02000023$$pp2:로,으로$, meet $npc:11000031[gender:0]$$pp:를,을$,
relay what I have told you, and follow his guidance.

831174302002487--.name:
Go directly to $map:02000023$$pp2:로,으로$, meet $npc:11000031[gender:0]$$pp:를,을$,
relay what I have told you, and follow his guidance.

831174302002490--.name: If that is Her Majesty's decision... then following her will is the right thing to do...

831174302002491--.name:
$MyPCName$!
The Great Chieftain has finally returned.
Go to $map:02000078$$pp2:로,으로$!

831174302002492--.name:
$MyPCName$!
The Great Chieftain has finally returned.
Go to $map:02000078$$pp2:로,으로$!

831174302002493--.name:
Ah, are you $MyPCName$, the one who sent Murpagos's eagle?
I heard you've been waiting quite some time for me. So, what is it?

831174302002494--.name: Say you want to learn about <font color="#ffd200">Yamarcha</font>.

831174302002495--.name:
<font color="#ffd200">Yamarcha</font>?
Hmm... Why do you ask?

831174302002496--.name: Explain <font color="#ffd200">$npc:11000069[gender:1]$'s disappearance</font> and how you learned of <font color="#ffd200">Yamarcha</font>.

831174302002497--.name:
<font color="#ffd200">$npc:11000522[gender:0]$</font>?
You mean the one who killed Winn Stilton and shattered the Blue Lapenta?
You're saying he reappeared and <font color="#ffd200">abducted $npc:11000069[gender:1]$$pp:를,을$</font>?

831174302002498--.name: Say that the circumstances point to that conclusion.

831174302002499--.name:
Hmph... $npc:11000522[gender:0]$...
Could he be... searching for $map:02000229$$pp:를,을$...?

831174302002500--.name: Ask what kind of place $map:02000229$$pp:가,이$ is.

831174302002501--.name:
It is the temple of the <font color="#ffd200">Yamarcha</font> tribe, who fell prey to a demon's temptation, sold their souls, and became slaves of darkness.
It is also where the bloody <font color="#ffd200">War of Wolves</font> took place...

831174302002502--.name:
Go to $map:02000170$$pp2:로,으로$ and speak with $npc:11000078$$pp:를,을$.
You cannot discuss the fall of the <font color="#ffd200">Yamarcha</font> tribe without the War of Wolves...
Tell $npc:11000078$$pp:가,이$ I sent you, and he will explain in greater detail...

831174302002503--.name:
Go to $map:02000170$$pp2:로,으로$ and speak with $npc:11000078$$pp:를,을$.
You cannot discuss the fall of the <font color="#ffd200">Yamarcha</font> tribe without the War of Wolves...
Tell $npc:11000078$$pp:가,이$ I sent you, and he will explain in greater detail…

831174302002505--.name: Say the Great Chieftain sent you.

831174302002506--.name:
Oh... my eternal friend, $npc:11000134[gender:0]$$pp:가,이$...?
Very well. What is it?

831174302002507--.name: Ask him to tell you about $map:02000229$.

831174302002508--.name:
$map:02000229$...?
It is a place already forgotten, and one that must remain forgotten.
Do not seek to learn any more.

831174302002509--.name: Explain <font color="#ffd200">$npc:11000069[gender:1]$'s disappearance</font> and how you learned of <font color="#ffd200">Yamarcha</font>.

831174302002510--.name:
...... This man called $npc:11000522[gender:0]$...
You believe he may be after $map:02000229$$pp:를,을$...?

831174302002511--.name:
$map:02000229$...
The scent of wolves' blood still lingers there...

831174302002512--.name:
The wolves of the Bayar Mountains... protect the tribes that worship the Wolf God.
We white wolves... protect the Murpagos tribe, while the red wolves... protect the Yamarcha tribe.

831174302002513--.name:
It happened in an instant... <font color="#ffd200">Turka</font> took control of the Yamarcha tribe...
And to protect Murpagos and Perion... we were forced to fight the red wolves
who guarded Yamarcha...
And here in $map:02000170$, that war has still not ended...

831174302002515--.name:
A demon...
A being who steals the goodness from ordinary hearts, nurtures their evil, and turns them
into slaves of darkness... one capable of manipulating and controlling the hearts of all living things...

831174302002516--.name:
The Shadow World... a descendant of the Demon King sealed within it...
If $npc:11000522[gender:0]$ is searching for $map:02000229$$pp:를,을$...
then he must be seeking traces of <font color="#ffd200">Turka</font>...

831174302002517--.name:
Even after the <font color="#ffd200">Yamarcha</font> tribe vanished, some greed-corrupted humans sought traces of <font color="#ffd200">Turka</font>,
hoping to gain the power of darkness even if it meant selling their souls to <font color="#ffd200">Turka</font>.
There had been no such fools for some time... but now, again... Hmm...

831174302002518--.name:
If he would destroy the Blue Lapenta despite knowing it would endanger the entire world...
then selling his soul would mean nothing to $npc:11000522[gender:0]$...
If someone like him makes a pact with <font color="#ffd200">Turka</font> and gains the power of darkness... it would be horrifying...

831174302002519--.name: Ask for details about the pact with Turka.

831174302002520--.name:
They swear obedience to Turka and receive the power of darkness.
In exchange for power beyond anything an ordinary human could possess, they become the Demon King's slaves.
And... in the end, they are destroyed once they are no longer needed...

831174302002521--.name: Say you will go to $map:02000229$$pp2:로,으로$ yourself and search for $npc:11000522[gender:0]$$pp:를,을$.

831174302002522--.name:
You intend to go... now?
The entrance to $map:02000229$$pp:는,은$ lies in the red earth beneath the center of $map:02000170$.

831174302002523--.name:
A mysterious bag lies behind the altar.
Whose could it be...? Could it be... a clue left by $npc:11000522[gender:0]$?
Let's see what's inside.

831174302002524--.name:
A mysterious bag lies behind the altar.
Whose could it be...? Could it be... a clue left by $npc:11000522[gender:0]$?
Let's see what's inside.

831174302002525--.name:
W-wait! You are... $MyPCName$!!
I never imagined I would meet you again here...

831174302002527--.name: Say that of course you remember him.

831174302002529--.name:
Yes... It has been quite some time... I'm grateful you still remember an old man like me.
You've grown so dependable since last we met.
I heard you left for Victoria Island. So, how have you been?

831174302002530--.name: Tell him everything you've been through.

831174302002531--.name:
Ho ho... To have endured all that and grown so much... I'm truly proud of you.
So... what brings you all the way here?

831174302002535--.name:
Goodness... An abduction...?
$npc:11000064[gender:0]$$pp:는,은$ went to rescue $npc:11000069[gender:1]$$pp:를,을$, who had been dragged into the land of darkness,
even though he himself was still badly injured...!!

831174302002536--.name: Ask him to explain exactly what happened.

831174302002537--.name:
I first crossed paths with $npc:11000064[gender:0]$$pp:와,과$...
near $map:02000238$, at the edge of the cliffs in $map:02000117$.
He lay unconscious and covered in blood, looking as though he might die at any moment.
I couldn't simply leave him there...

831174302002538--.name:
For days on end... $npc:11000064[gender:0]$$pp:는,은$ would not awaken.
I don't know how much time passed before he finally regained consciousness... Ho ho...
Even now, I haven't forgotten the very first words he uttered.

831174302002540--.name:
<font color="#ffd200">I can't die like this... I won't die...</font>
I could tell at once that he had to survive... that there was something he absolutely had to do
while still alive.

831174302002542--.name:
<font color="#ffd200">Clear his name and reveal the truth...!</font>
He said he could tell me no more.
If I learned the whole truth, I too might be placed in danger...

831174302002544--.name:
$npc:11000064[gender:0]$$pp:는,은$ said that, if no one else, $npc:11000069[gender:1]$ had to know he was innocent.
But as a fugitive, he could not simply approach $npc:11000069[gender:1]$$pp:를,을$...
So they devised a plan: they exchanged notes hidden inside a book at $map:02000221$,
a place they had visited together since childhood.

831174302002545--.name:
Then $npc:11000069[gender:1]$$pp:가,이$ sent word that she wanted to help $npc:11000064[gender:0]$ in person...
After many twists and turns, the two finally met again. While searching $map:02000229$
for evidence that could clear his name...
the ones who had pursued $npc:11000064[gender:0]$$pp:를,을$ from the land of darkness caught up with them... Hah...
He survived, fortunately... but it seems they took $npc:11000069[gender:1]$$pp:를,을$ away.

831174302002546--.name:
Last night, $npc:11000064[gender:0]$$pp:는,은$ left this letter behind, asking that it be delivered
to a friend called $npc:11000529[gender:0]$$pp:라는,이라는$, and then departed.
I never thought he would go off alone... so recklessly...
He will need people who believe in him and can lend him their strength.

831174302002547--.name:
I will search for another way to help him. Could you deliver
this $item:30000340$$pp:를,을$ to his friend $npc:11000529[gender:0]$$pp:라는,이라는$?

831174302002548--.name:
Ah... You closely resemble someone I know... I mistook you for them.
So, what brings you all the way here?

831174302002550--.name:
Hmm?
Why did you turn back before leaving? Have you changed your mind?

831174302002552--.name: Say you briefly went the wrong way.

831174302002553--.name:
Ah... Is that so?
Here. Make sure you take it this time.

831174302002554--.name:
Ho ho... What am I to do with someone so absentminded?
Check your bag once more.

831174302002555--.name:
Carrying such a heavy bag must make your shoulders ache...
Now I finally understand why, despite becoming so much stronger and more dependable,
you haven't grown any taller since then... Why not empty your bag a little and travel light?

831174302002556--.name:
That is understandable...
The $npc:11000064[gender:0]$$pp:와,과$ you thought you knew and the $npc:11000064[gender:0]$ I described
must seem like entirely different people... No wonder you are still reeling from the shock.

831174302002557--.name:
Hmm? $MyPCName$. It's been a while.
I've heard rumors that $npc:11000044[gender:0]$ asked you to search for $npc:11000069[gender:1]$$pp:를,을$.
But what brings you here?

831174302002559--.name:
Wait... This is...
Did you meet $npc:11000064[gender:0]$$pp:를,을$? Did you?

831174302002560--.name: Say that you didn't meet him in person.

831174302002561--.name:
I knew it... That bastard... He's alive!! I knew it!!
But... why did he disappear again after leaving only a letter?

831174302002562--.name: Tell him to read the letter.

831174302002563--.name:
Ghh... That bastard...
It says he's going alone to <font color="#ffd200">Katramus</font>, known as the <font color="#ffd200">Tower of Slaves</font> in the land of darkness,
to search for $npc:11000069[gender:1]$$pp:를,을$...
Reckless fool!! No matter how urgent it is, he can't go back to that dangerous place alone...!!!

831174302002565--.name:
Hmm...! $MyPCName$, I'm sorry. There isn't time for a long explanation.
I need to find <font color="#ffd200">Katramus</font> and help $npc:11000064[gender:0]$$pp:를,을$ first!

831174302002566--.name:
Ah... Wait.
Are you going to report... everything to $npc:11000044[gender:0]$?

831174302002567--.name:
Well... the decision is yours... but personally, I'd like you to refrain from reporting
that $npc:11000064[gender:0]$$pp:가,이$ is alive and well.
It won't be too late to decide after meeting $npc:11000064[gender:0]$$pp:를,을$ and hearing the whole story
from him first.

831174302002568--.name:
In any case, I trust you'll make a wise decision.
I must go.

831174302002569--.name: What is it? Do you want to help $npc:11000064[gender:0]$$pp:를,을$ too?

831174302002572--.name:
Really? Then I'll meet you at <font color="#ffd200">Katramus</font>.
I hear its entrance is in a place called $map:03000057$$pp:라는,이라는$ in the land of darkness.

831174302002573--.name:
You asked me earlier what <font color="#ffd200">Katramus</font> is, didn't you?
Go there yourself... See it, hear it, experience it... and you'll understand.

831174302002574--.name: Hmm... In that case, I have nothing more to say.

831174302002575--.name:
You... What in the world happened?
What about $npc:11000069[gender:1]$? Did you find her?

831174302002576--.name: Say that you found no trace of her.

831174302002577--.name: Leave out the part about $npc:11000064[gender:0]$ and say that $npc:11000069[gender:1]$$pp:가,이$ appears to be in the land of darkness.

831174302002578--.name: Tell him everything you've learned about $npc:11000064[gender:0]$$pp:와,과$ and $npc:11000069[gender:1]$.

831174302002579--.name:
Damn it!! What have you been doing all this time?!!!!
Hah... $npc:11000069[gender:1]$... Where in the world are you...?

831174302002580--.name:
What? The land of darkness?
Why? Why is Eve there? How did you find out?

831174302002581--.name: Say you heard it from an anonymous witness.

831174302002582--.name: An anonymous witness? Who is that?

831174302002583--.name: Say you cannot reveal their identity because they are anonymous.

831174302002584--.name:
$MyPCName$... I'm disappointed.
To make such a speculative report based solely on someone's word, without any grounds or evidence...

831174302002585--.name:
What? $npc:11000064[gender:0]$$pp:가,이$?
I knew it... That wretch... stubbornly clung to life!!!
$MyPCName$, you may leave now. From here on, I will do as I see fit.

831174302002586--.name:
<font color="#909090">...The land of darkness... I don't know who it is, but...
This is clearly bait meant for me... using Eve as bait...</font>

831174302002587--.name:
Wait! $MyPCName$!
I have a favor to ask of you.

831174302002589--.name:
$map:02000229$... Foolish beings still remain there, awaiting <font color="#ffd200">Turka</font>
while craving the power of evil like a sweet poison.
Even the faintest traces of evil, once they begin to gather, can grow beyond all control!
Eliminate every foolish being in $map:02000229$ that hungers for the power of evil.

831174302002590--.name:
And... one more thing...
At the deepest reaches of $map:02000229$ dwells <font color="#ffd200">Machar</font>, king of the red wolves...
His soul, which followed Yamarcha, was also enslaved and bound by darkness...
His body left hardened... as rigid as stone...

831174302002591--.name:
We had no choice but to wage war... but before that, he and I were the closest of friends...
Use this $item:30000076$ to free his soul, trapped within that hardened body
and tormented in the bonds of darkness.

831174302002594--.name: Say you forgot what he asked you to do.

831174302002595--.name:
I see. Here, take it.
I'm counting on you...

831174302002596--.name:
I thought I saw you put it in your bag earlier...
Have you checked it carefully? Look once more.

831174302002597--.name:
Your bag... looks very heavy...
Perhaps you should organize it a little?

831174302002598--.name:
Burn Machar's preserved body with $item:30000076$ and free his soul,
which must be suffering while bound in darkness.

831174302002599--.name:
Something that had been hidden by the darkness seemed to appear behind the altar
when the purifying flames rose.

831174302002600--.name:
Now... ask me anything you want to know.
I'll answer honestly.

831174302002601--.name: Ask how he came to search all the way to Katramus.

831174302002602--.name:
After you gave me $item:30000340$$pp:를,을$ last time, I went straight to the land of darkness.
Well... I can't go into detail, but some Humblis agents operate in the land of darkness as well...
so finding <font color="#ffd200">Katramus</font> wasn't particularly difficult.

831174302002603--.name:
As it happened, the Lumina Liberation Force was conducting a major operation to rescue the people
imprisoned and enslaved in <font color="#ffd200">Katramus</font>.
So I joined them and searched every corner of <font color="#ffd200">Katramus</font>.

831174302002604--.name:
And... right in front of $map:02000296$... I found $npc:11000064[gender:0]$$pp:를,을$!!
We hadn't seen each other in a long time... but I recognized him at once.

831174302002606--.name:
Ahem!! How did I feel...? We met, that's all. We're grown men...
Whatever he was thinking... neither of us said a word.
Well... we're the kind of friends who don't need words.
In any case... after all sorts of trouble, we rescued $npc:11000069[gender:1]$ and the three of us returned together.

831174302002608--.name:
He was injured while trying to rescue $npc:11000069[gender:1]$$pp:를,을$ in Katramus...
He's quietly recovering somewhere the Dark Wind won't find him.
$npc:11000069[gender:1]$$pp:가,이$ is staying close and caring for him... so he'll recover soon.
More importantly... there's something we need to investigate right now!

831174302002610--.name:
Not long ago... I secretly received an <font color="#ffd200">anonymous distress message</font>.
The sender said the Dark Wind was pursuing them, and that if we protected them, they would reveal
all of <font color="#ffd200">$npc:11000044[gender:0]$'s secrets</font>.

831174302002611--.name:
I've already sent Humblis agents to <font color="#ffd200">$map:02000279$</font>$pp2:로,으로$, where the message originated,
but I want you to go help them find whoever sent it.
We must find that person before the Dark Wind does!
We'll learn whether the message is true once we meet them...!

831174302002612--.name:
Not long ago... I secretly received an anonymous distress message.
The sender said the Dark Wind was pursuing them, and that if we protected them, they would reveal
all of <font color="#ffd200">$npc:11000044[gender:0]$'s secrets</font>.
Go to <font color="#ffd200">$map:02000279$</font>$pp2:로,으로$, where it originated, and find whoever sent the message!

831174302002614--.name: Say that $npc:11000529[gender:0]$ asked you to come help.

831174302002615--.name:
Your timing is perfect.
The railway station is larger than expected, and we were at a loss...

831174302002616--.name:
The Humblis agents have divided the area among themselves to search it.
Take the <font color="#ffd200">restricted area</font> you see behind me.
Don't forget. We must find that person before the Dark Wind does! No matter what...

831174302002617--.name:
The Humblis agents have divided the area among themselves to search it.
Take the <font color="#ffd200">restricted area</font> you see behind me.
Don't forget. We must find that person before the Dark Wind does! No matter what...

831174302002619--.name: Ask if he is the one who sent Humblis the anonymous distress message.

831174302002620--.name:
Ah...! Humblis...!!
Did $npc:11000529[gender:0]$$pp:가,이$ send you? Hah... I'm saved... I'm saved!!!

831174302002621--.name:
Hah... I truly thought $npc:11000044[gender:0]$ would catch me and make me disappear without a trace.
Those thugs who chased me all the way here were hired by $npc:11000044[gender:0]$$pp:가,이$ too.

831174302002623--.name:
W-well... because if I remain alive... the whole truth will come to light...
My name is <font color="#ffd200">$npc:11000526[gender:0]$</font>! I am the head of the Barota Trading Company.

831174302002625--.name:
After $npc:11000492[gender:0]$$pp:가,이$ died, I tried to stow away to escape $npc:11000044[gender:0]$$pp:를,을$,
but a pickpocket robbed me of everything. From then on, I lived as a homeless man in the back alleys.
Some time later... one of the pickpockets who stole my wallet was found dead in $map:02000138$.
Because my identification was in that wallet, everyone believed I was the one who had died.

831174302002626--.name:
I feel sorry for the pickpocket who lost his life...
but for me, it was fortunate that I could evade $npc:11000044[gender:0]$'s pursuit for a time...
But... I had greatly underestimated $npc:11000044[gender:0]$$pp:를,을$...
He knew from the beginning that the dead man wasn't me, and he had continued tracking
my movements.

831174302002627--.name:
After being hunted for so long, I had nowhere left to run... I knew I would truly be killed soon
if things continued this way, so I asked Humblis for help, prepared to spend the rest of my life in prison.

831174302002629--.name:
That man... joined forces with <font color="#ffd200">Turka</font>, who commands the Shadow Legion in the land of darkness,
and is a <font color="#ffd200">traitor</font> who obeys his orders!!
He was behind not only the <font color="#ffd200">Royal Armory theft</font>, but also the murder of
<font color="#ffd200">$npc:11000492[gender:0]$</font>$pp:를,을$...!!

831174302002630--.name:
In any case, I'll reveal the whole truth about everything that happened, so please help me escape
$npc:11000044[gender:0]$'s grasp!

831174302002631--.name: Say you will gather the Humblis agents outside the restricted area.

831174302002632--.name:
You have to return quickly!! Before something happens while you're gone...
Oh, and I have a ledger recording every transaction I made with $npc:11000044[gender:0]$$pp:와,과$.
In $map:02000226$ at the Barota Trading Company headquarters...
I hid the ledger behind the wall clock there.

831174302002633--.name:
No one should have found it yet... Hurry and retrieve it before someone destroys it.
It's decisive evidence that will expose $npc:11000044[gender:0]$'s true nature!

831174302002634--.name:
Oh, and I have a ledger recording every transaction I made with $npc:11000044[gender:0]$$pp:와,과$.
You'll find $map:02000226$$pp:가,이$ at our trading company headquarters in $map:02000139$.
I hid the ledger behind the wall clock there.

831174302002635--.name: What about the person? Did you find them?

831174302002637--.name:
What...? The person who sent the distress message was $npc:11000526[gender:0]$...
That's difficult to believe without seeing him with my own eyes!!

831174302002638--.name:

While Captain <font color="#ffd200">Winn Stilton</font> was still alive...
one day, the captain said there was somewhere he wanted me to accompany him, and we set out.
He brought me here... to a small, shabby building in the abandoned city once called Kerning Dome,
before it became the present-day $map:02000146$.
When we opened the rusted door... there was an enormous, sturdy safe.

831174302002946--.name:
The captain opened the safe himself... and inside... was the <font color="#ffd200">Blue Lapenta</font>.
It was shining... so beautifully...
But then $npc:11000044[gender:0]$$pp:가,이$ suddenly burst in with people
consumed by greed and madness...

831174302002947--.name:
They were all fools who had sold their souls to <font color="#ffd200">Turka</font> and borrowed the power of evil
to satisfy the desires growing within their hearts.
Unable to overcome his ambition to become captain of the Dark Wind, $npc:11000044[gender:0]$ had also
made a pact with <font color="#ffd200">Turka</font>.

831174302002948--.name:
<font color="#ffd200">Turka</font> learned that Captain <font color="#ffd200">Winn Stilton</font> was the <font color="#ffd200">guardian of the Blue Lapenta</font>,
then approached <font color="#ffd200">$npc:11000044[gender:0]$</font> and exploited his ambition...
The captain fought to protect the Blue Lapenta to the very end... But... the combined power
of the dark desires held by fools like <font color="#ffd200">$npc:11000044[gender:0]$</font>$pp:를,을$ was overwhelming...

831174302002949--.name:
In the end, the <font color="#ffd200">Blue Lapenta</font> was shattered by the enormous demonic desire
formed as countless smaller ambitions gathered together.
And... Captain Winn Stilton fell at the hands of <font color="#ffd200">$npc:11000044[gender:0]$</font>...

831174302002950--.name:
I don't remember what happened after that.
When I opened my eyes and came to, I was already in the land of darkness... deep within that darkness.

831174302002951--.name:
We can discuss the details later!
Right now... finding the missing $npc:11000044[gender:0]$$pp:를,을$ is more urgent.

831174302002952--.name:
In fact, $map:02000146$$pp:는,은$ is where the dimensional fractures caused by the shattering of the
<font color="#ffd200">Blue Lapenta</font> were most severe.
There are many invisible paths connecting it to the land of darkness,
and those paths interconnect like a maze.

831174302002953--.name:
$npc:11000044[gender:0]$$pp:는,은$ will surely use these passages to enter the land of darkness and seek aid from

With support from the Guardians, our agents have already begun searching some sectors.

831174302002954--.name:
I'm going to join $npc:11000069[gender:1]$$pp:와,과$ in the search.

831174302002964--.name:
$npc:11000044[gender:0]$$pp:는,은$ will return.

831174302002965--.name:
Someday... the moment will come when my bitter fate with $npc:11000044[gender:0]$$pp:와,과$ begins anew.

831174302002972--.name:
Sincerity... $npc:11000064[gender:0]$'s eyes held a warm heart and genuine sincerity.

It is also an essential virtue for any guardian entrusted with protecting the <font color="#ffd200">Lapenta</font>.

831174302002973--.name:
I'm certain... Winn Stilton intended for $npc:11000064[gender:0]$ to inherit the role of
<font color="#ffd200">guardian of the Blue Lapenta</font>.
If the day ever comes when the shattered <font color="#ffd200">Blue Lapenta</font> can be restored...
I intend to honor his wishes and entrust $npc:11000064[gender:0]$ with <font color="#ffd200">protecting the Blue Lapenta</font>.

831174302002974--.name:
I am so relieved that the truth has come to light, even now...

831174302002976--.name:

831174302002977--.name:
Perhaps something even more frightening than the Demon King... is human desire,
born from ambitions too great for people to overcome themselves.
When the small, seemingly harmless desires of everyday life gather and merge,
they are reborn as an uncontrollable force of evil.

831174302002978--.name:
The Demon King merely... controls and wields the evil power gathered in this way...
Perhaps what truly strengthens him is the selfish desire stirring within our own hearts...

831174302002990--.name:
As I thought... I judged you well.
Everything I say from this point on, and every order I give you, is classified.
Remember that.

831174302002991--.name:
For some time now, the Secret Order has been selecting several highly skilled former spies
and attempting to infiltrate the land of darkness.

831174302002993--.name:

will not help us much.

831174302002994--.name:
Know your enemy and know yourself, and you will win every battle!
To catch a tiger, you must enter its den!

831174302002995--.name:
Your first mission is to <font color="#ffd200">deliver this $item:30000217$$pp:를,을$ to Special Agent

831174302003022--.name:

Unbelievable.

831174302003091--.name:

831174302003095--.name:

831174302003099--.name:

831174302003100--.name:

831174302003101--.name:

831174302003104--.name:

Coming to the land of darkness was the best decision I ever made.

831174302003106--.name: Consider yourself lucky to have made my acquaintance today!

831174302003107--.name:
Keep it secret that I gave you $item:20000046$ for free!

831174302003108--.name:
It looks like the investigation wasn't easy.
So, did you learn anything?

831174302003110--.name: $map:03009021$... Most of the $item:20000046$ distributed throughout Maple World must be manufactured there.

831174302003111--.name:
$MyPCName$. We need to tear out the roots before cutting off the branches.
Before we stop the distribution of $item:20000046$, we must clear out $map:03009021$!

831174302003112--.name:
This is the land of darkness.
That means we're outsiders here, and everyone other than you and me is an enemy.

831174302003113--.name:
If our undercover agents move together, we'll draw the enemy's attention and every mission assigned to us will fail.
We can't travel to $map:03009021$ together, either.

831174302003116--.name:
Good...! Best of luck.
Remember: even if something goes wrong, you must never reveal that we're undercover agents dispatched by the Guardians—not even with your dying breath.

831174302003117--.name: Remember: even if something goes wrong, you must never reveal that we're undercover agents dispatched by the Guardians—not even with your dying breath.

831174302003119--.name: Are you... with the <font color="#ffd200">Lumina Liberation Force</font>...?

831174302003120--.name: Ask what the Lumina Liberation Force is.

831174302003121--.name:
So you're not... I thought maybe...
You just wanted $item:20000046$ and came to steal it...
If you've seen everything you came to see, please leave.

831174302003123--.name:
You don't need to know!
We don't trust anyone except the <font color="#ffd200">Lumina Liberation Force</font>!

831174302003124--.name:
I told you to leave...
If the overseers swarm in and find us together, I don't want to be falsely accused of being one of your accomplices!

831174302003125--.name:
Oh! You made it back safely!
The mission...? Did you complete it?

831174302003126--.name: Hand over $item:30000216$ and report that the mission is complete.

831174302003127--.name:
Well done!
Did you notice anything unusual?

831174302003129--.name:
Hmm... So there were slaves forced to manufacture $item:20000046$ under the overseers' control...
I'd heard rumors that slaves were there, but I still don't know any details.
And this... <font color="#ffd200">Lumina Liberation Force</font> is entirely new to me...

831174302003130--.name:
Hmm... I'll have to investigate.
I'll report to $npcName:11000076[gender:0]$ and take care of the rest. Get some rest and stand by!

831174302003131--.name:
$npcName:11000076[gender:0]$ has ordered us to conduct a full investigation into the <font color="#ffd200">Lumina Liberation Force</font> you mentioned last time.
I've looked into it, but there's still almost no information about them... They're probably a new organization that's little known even within the land of darkness.

831174302003132--.name: We need to determine whether they're a civilian organization allied with the Guardians or a new criminal organization expanding its influence in the land of darkness.

831174302003133--.name:
First, go to <font color="#ffd200">$npc:11000564[gender:0]$</font>, who has the most contact with people, and find out whether they know anything about the <font color="#ffd200">Lumina Liberation Force</font>.
They're known as a fairly reliable source of information in the land of darkness...

831174302003134--.name:
Go to <font color="#ffd200">$npc:11000564[gender:0]$</font>, who has the most contact with people, and find out whether they know anything about the <font color="#ffd200">Lumina Liberation Force</font>.
They're known as a fairly reliable source of information in the land of darkness...

831174302003135--.name: Hm? What did you just say?

831174302003136--.name: Ask whether he knows anything about the Lumina Liberation Force.

831174302003137--.name:
Ah... the <font color="#ffd200">Lumina Liberation Force</font>...
Hardly anyone knows about them... You're pretty well informed, aren't you?
How much do you know?

831174302003138--.name: Say you've only heard their name.

831174302003139--.name:
Heh. Is that so?
Then it seems I know a little more than you do.

831174302003140--.name:
Ahem. A customer who came to buy poisonous herbs told me about it recently...
Apparently, somewhere in the land of darkness, there's a place called the <font color="#ffd200">Tower of Slaves</font>.
They say the Shadow Legion locks people abducted from Maple World, along with anyone in Shadow World who rebels against the Demon King, inside a <font color="#ffd200">tower with no exit</font> and uses them as slaves...

831174302003141--.name:
But... apparently some people escaped from the Tower of Slaves recently.
They formed the <font color="#ffd200">Lumina Liberation Force</font> to rescue the others still imprisoned as slaves!
Rumor has it they even succeeded in rescuing several slaves during a transfer.

831174302003142--.name: That's why a rumor has spread among the slaves that the <font color="#ffd200">Lumina Liberation Force</font> will come to rescue them someday.

831174302003143--.name:
I hear the Shadow Legion commander is on edge because of the Lumina Liberation Force.
So both the Tower of Slaves and the slave transports are guarded far more heavily than before.

831174302003144--.name: Ask whether there's a way to meet the Lumina Liberation Force.

831174302003145--.name:
Who knows? I certainly don't.
Unless I were part of the Lumina Liberation Force... The Shadow Legion could wipe them out in an instant if they were caught, so unless they're fools, why would they leave an easy trail?

831174302003146--.name: The customer who came to buy poisonous herbs and told me about the Lumina Liberation Force had been pursuing them for the bounty. They found the group's last meeting place at $map:03000134$, but couldn't find another trace after that.

831174302003147--.name: Well... Maybe the Lumina Liberation Force left clues in a code only they could recognize... but there's no way to know.

831174302003148--.name: Ask where the Lumina Liberation Force's last meeting place at $map:03000134$ was.

831174302003149--.name:
What was it called... the Solar Energy Research Center at $map:03000134$, I think?
I heard they used the rooftop room as their meeting place.

831174302003150--.name:
You can't find the Solar Energy Research Center at $map:03000134$?
Everyone who's anyone knows that place... You must still be unfamiliar with the land of darkness.

831174302003151--.name:
On the road from $map:03000134$ to $map:03000092$, there's a building with solar panels on its roof.
That's the Solar Energy Research Center.

831174302003152--.name:
Who are you?
How did you find this place and get inside?

831174302003154--.name:
What...? Where did you get this...? Has our information been compromised?
Who are you, exactly? Are you alone?

831174302003155--.name: Say you came alone because you wanted to learn about the Lumina Liberation Force.

831174302003156--.name: Where did you hear about us, and how?

831174302003158--.name:
There are already people tracking us... We'll have to be even more careful.
Surely... you're not one of them, are you?

831174302003159--.name: Say that if you were, you wouldn't have come here alone.

831174302003161--.name:
If you want to know about the Lumina Liberation Force, first tell me who you are and where you came from.
As you already know, there's no such thing as <font color="#ffd200">unconditional trust</font> in the land of darkness.

831174302003162--.name: Tell him truthfully that you're carrying out a secret mission for the Guardians.

831174302003163--.name:
A secret mission for the Guardians...
Does that mission include rescuing those enslaved in the land of darkness?

831174302003164--.name: Say you haven't received any such orders yet.

831174302003165--.name:
Just as I thought... Do they not even care...?
Or do they still not know...? Hmm...

831174302003166--.name:
The members of the Lumina Liberation Force, myself included, were slaves imprisoned in the <font color="#ffd200">Tower of Slaves</font>.
Most of the slaves were abducted from Maple World by the Shadow Legion.
At first... we waited, believing the Guardians would rescue us...
But as more and more time passed, we came to understand the truth.

831174302003167--.name:
We had simply been <font color="#ffd200">abandoned and forgotten</font>...
So we decided to escape and return home through our own strength.
We planned and prepared for a long time...
And before we finally succeeded... we lost many companions.

831174302003168--.name:
As we watched our companions fall one after another, we made a vow.
We would rescue every last person imprisoned in the <font color="#ffd200">Tower of Slaves</font> with our own hands!
And that was how the <font color="#ffd200">Lumina Liberation Force</font> began.

831174302003169--.name: Say you want to help the Lumina Liberation Force.

831174302003170--.name:
Hmm... I still don't trust you completely.
But... I think I can give you one chance.
Go see $npc:11000615[gender:0]$.

831174302003171--.name:
Hmm... I still don't trust you completely.
But... I think I can give you one chance.
Go see $npc:11000615[gender:0]$.

831174302003172--.name:
You want to help us?
Without asking for anything in return?

831174302003174--.name:
Fine... Whether it's a sense of duty as a Guardian or mere curiosity...
As long as you don't side with the Shadow Legion and betray us...

831174302003175--.name:
Go to $map:03000135$ and help $npc:11000614[gender:0]$.
He's been searching day and night for his younger sister, who was abducted from Victoria Island along with him...
I don't know whether he's made any progress. Go give him a hand.

831174302003176--.name:
Go to $map:03000135$ and help $npc:11000614[gender:0]$.
He's been searching day and night for his younger sister, who was abducted from Victoria Island along with him...
I don't know whether he's made any progress. Go give him a hand.

831174302003177--.name: Did you need something from me...?

831174302003178--.name: Say that, as a Guardian, you came to help at $npc:11000615[gender:0]$'s request.

831174302003179--.name:
Ah... $npc:11000615[gender:0]$ sent you...? He isn't the sort to make such a request of just anyone...
He must think highly of you, $MyPCName$.

831174302003180--.name:
We can learn the details of how you came to be here in time.
It's not a place I'd like to remain for long, though...

831174302003181--.name: Ask whether he's found any clues that could lead to his sister.

831174302003182--.name:
I haven't found a clue... but I think I've discovered a way to obtain one.
It may be a little reckless, though...

831174302003183--.name: Ask how he can find a clue.

831174302003184--.name:
Do you see those clockwork rabbits rolling clocks around?
They're called $npc:40000022$... The Shadow Legion directs them to tempt ordinary people and lure them into the land of darkness.

831174302003185--.name:
My sister and I were deceived by their promise to <font color="#ffd200">take us somewhere fun</font>. That's how we came here, and we were separated just before being imprisoned in the Tower of Slaves.
Perhaps... those creatures know what happened to my sister and where she is.

831174302003186--.name:
The $npc:40000022$ are suspicious by nature and hate exposing their identities, so I understand they keep everything on them without discarding so much as a scrap of paper.
If we acquire and search their belongings, I think we may find a clue that will lead us to my sister.

831174302003187--.name:
The $npc:40000022$ are suspicious by nature and hate exposing their identities, so I understand they keep everything on them without discarding so much as a scrap of paper.
If we acquire and search their belongings, I think we may find a clue that will lead us to my sister.

831174302003188--.name:
$item:30000211$!
Please... let there be a clue inside that can lead me to my sister...

831174302003189--.name: If only I can find my sister...

831174302003190--.name: Ask whether he plans to return home.

831174302003191--.name:
I'll... send my sister home.
It will surely be safer there than here...
As for me... I'll stay, finish what I have to do, and then return.

831174302003192--.name: Ask what he still has to do here.

831174302003193--.name:
There's <font color="#ffd200">a friend I must find</font>. <font color="#ffd200">$npc:11000064[gender:0]$</font>...
We planned our escape from the <font color="#ffd200">Tower of Slaves</font> together, but just before we fled, the Shadow Legion commander dragged him away. He never returned.

831174302003194--.name: Some rumors say he defied the Shadow Legion and lost his life. Others say they persuaded him to join their ranks...

831174302003195--.name: Ask how he became friends with $npc:11000064[gender:0]$.

831174302003196--.name:
He saved my life after I was separated from my sister. I was running wild trying to find her and nearly got myself killed by the Shadow Legion.
He always listened to me and comforted me...
But now that I think about it, he never once spoke about himself.

831174302003197--.name: If he truly lost his life, I want to at least find his body and help him rest in peace...

831174302003198--.name: Ask what he'll do if his friend was persuaded to join the Shadow Legion.

831174302003199--.name:
I can't believe it... but if... if it's really true...
I'll take his life... with my own hands...

831174302003200--.name:
I've gone on for too long. In any case, thank you for your help.
Will you... continue supporting the <font color="#ffd200">Lumina Liberation Force</font>?
As a Guardian... I mean.

831174302003201--.name: Say you'll report on the Lumina Liberation Force and request support.

831174302003202--.name:
If the Guardians stepped in to support the Liberation Force, we could rescue the innocent people imprisoned in the Tower of Slaves much sooner...
I hope you'll hurry.

831174302003203--.name:
If the Guardians stepped in to support the Liberation Force, we could rescue the innocent people imprisoned in the Tower of Slaves much sooner...
If this delay continues... distrust and resentment toward both the Guardians and $npcName:11000075[gender:1]$ $npcTitle:11000075[gender:1]$ will only grow.

831174302003204--.name:
$MyPCName$!
You showed no sign of returning, and I was worried something had happened to you!
Why did it take you so long to come back?

831174302003205--.name: Tell him everything about the Lumina Liberation Force.

831174302003206--.name:
Ah... To think the missing people were living here as slaves...
At this moment... I'm so ashamed as a Guardian that I can barely hold my head up.
They're people I... should have rescued first...

831174302003207--.name: Also report what $npc:11000614[gender:0]$ told you about $npc:11000064[gender:0]$.

831174302003208--.name:
What?
<font color="#ffd200">$npc:11000064[gender:0]$</font> was in the <font color="#ffd200">Tower of Slaves</font>...?

831174302003209--.name:
$npc:11000064[gender:0]$ destroyed the Blue Lapenta, killed the former captain of the Dark Wind, and fled... Yet he was imprisoned in the Tower of Slaves...
What in the world happened here during that time...? Could he also have been deceived by the Demon King, used, and then discarded?

831174302003210--.name: Whew... This mystery only grows deeper...

831174302003211--.name: Go to $map:02000146$ at once and report to $npcName:11000076[gender:0]$ about both the <font color="#ffd200">Lumina Liberation Force</font> and <font color="#ffd200">$npc:11000064[gender:0]$</font>.

831174302003212--.name: Go to $map:02000146$ at once and report to $npcName:11000076[gender:0]$ about both the <font color="#ffd200">Lumina Liberation Force</font> and <font color="#ffd200">$npc:11000064[gender:0]$</font>.

831174302003213--.name:
It's been a while, $MyPCName$!
Have you come to report on the <font color="#ffd200">Lumina Liberation Force</font>?

831174302003214--.name: Report everything about the Lumina Liberation Force, the Tower of Slaves, and $npc:11000064[gender:0]$.

831174302003215--.name:
Slaves... To think we've only just learned of such a thing... How shameful...
And what could $npc:11000064[gender:0]$, who is practically responsible for this entire crisis, have done there to end up imprisoned in the Tower of Slaves...?

831174302003216--.name:
We can't simply ignore $npc:11000064[gender:0]$, nor the innocent citizens imprisoned as slaves.
I'll assess the situation, report to my superiors, and issue operational orders soon.

831174302003217--.name: Until then, if the <font color="#ffd200">Lumina Liberation Force</font> needs support, you have my permission to assist them unofficially.

831174302003218--.name: Thanks to the help you gave $npc:11000614[gender:0]$ before, we discovered where his younger sister is.

831174302003220--.name:
$map:03009023$...
It's a temporary holding area on the top floor of the Tower of Slaves for slaves awaiting transfer elsewhere.
The Lumina Liberation Force is commencing <font color="#ffd200">Operation Rescue $map:03009023$</font> now.
$MyPCName$, will you join us?

831174302003222--.name:
This operation requires thorough preparation to succeed.
Remember that every member must understand and follow the plan perfectly.
First, deliver this $item:30000213$ to $npc:11000614[gender:0]$.

831174302003225--.name: Say you forgot where to go.

831174302003226--.name:
$MyPCName$! One mistake is more than enough.
Don't forget that dozens of lives depend on this operation.

831174302003227--.name:
You're already carrying $item:30000213$... Hmm...
Keep your wits about you, $MyPCName$!

831174302003228--.name:
Your bag is full.
You'd better organize it first.

831174302003230--.name:
Ah, $MyPCName$! Have you heard the news?
Thanks to you, we found out where my younger sister is.

831174302003232--.name:
Wait, this is...
The operation is finally beginning!

831174302003233--.name:
Hmm... I've confirmed my orders.
Would you deliver this $item:30000213$ to $npcName:11000616[gender:0]$ at $map:03000136$?

831174302003236--.name: Say you forgot where to go.

831174302003237--.name:
Ah, you left this behind.
Here it is. It's important, so don't lose it, and make sure it reaches its destination.

831174302003238--.name:
Check your bag again.
$item:30000213$ should be there.

831174302003239--.name:
Your bag seems too heavy.
You should organize it first.

831174302003243--.name:
Ah... It seems the order for <font color="#ffd200">Operation Rescue $map:03009023$</font> has been issued.
Hmm... Let's see...

831174302003244--.name:
Hmm. The schedule seems rather tight for completing my assignment...
Would you help me?

831174302003246--.name:
My orders are to cut $map:03000146$ off from the surrounding regions and prepare to stop any Shadow Legion reinforcements...
First, could you obtain some <font color="#ffd200">$item:30000214$</font> and <font color="#ffd200">$item:30000215$</font>?

831174302003247--.name:
Take <font color="#ffd200">$item:30000214$</font> from the <font color="#ffd200">$npc:40000020$</font> roaming nearby. You'll find <font color="#ffd200">$item:30000215$</font> inside the <font color="#ffd200">yellow barrels</font>.
I'll continue with the other preparations in the meantime...

831174302003248--.name: Take <font color="#ffd200">$item:30000214$</font> from the <font color="#ffd200">$npc:40000020$</font> roaming nearby. You'll find <font color="#ffd200">$item:30000215$</font> inside the <font color="#ffd200">yellow barrels</font>.

831174302003249--.name:
Well done!
This amount of $item:30000215$ should be enough to make the grenades needed for the operation.

831174302003250--.name: There shouldn't be any problem with $item:30000214$, since we only need to install it along the routes connected to $map:03000146$...

831174302003251--.name:
$MyPCName$, take the <font color="#ffd200">$item:30000214$</font> and <font color="#ffd200">install it along the routes leading from $map:03000146$ to the other regions</font>.
I'll install it along the routes leading into $map:03000146$ from the other regions.

831174302003254--.name: Say you forgot where to go.

831174302003255--.name:
$MyPCName$!
If you lost the $item:30000214$, you'll have to take as much as you need from the $npc:40000020$ again.

831174302003256--.name:
You seem to be mistaken.
You're carrying the $item:30000214$ right now, $MyPCName$.

831174302003257--.name:
Your bag is full.
You should organize it first.

831174302003258--.name: $MyPCName$, take the $item:30000214$ and install it along the routes from $map:03000146$ to $map:03000136$ and $map:03000145$.

831174302003259--.name: Ah, you're back sooner than I expected. Did you install everything properly?

831174302003261--.name:
Good. It isn't a perfect solution...
But it should delay the enemy from requesting reinforcements or moving between regions!

831174302003262--.name: Now return to $map:03009022$ and tell $npcName:11000613[gender:0]$ that our operational preparations here are complete.

831174302003263--.name: Return to $map:03009022$ and tell $npcName:11000613[gender:0]$ that our operational preparations here are complete.

831174302003264--.name:
$MyPCName$, I've been waiting for you.
Did you deliver $item:30000213$ to all the members?
Now we only need a readiness report from $npc:11000616[gender:0]$...

831174302003265--.name: Say that every task assigned to $npc:11000616[gender:0]$ has been completed.

831174302003267--.name:
Then now... it's time to begin <font color="#ffd200">Operation Rescue $map:03009023$</font>.
$MyPCName$! Are you ready?

831174302003269--.name: Good. Then go to $map:03009023$ and join the Lumina Liberation Force in rescuing the innocent people imprisoned there!

831174302003270--.name: Go to $map:03009023$ and join the Lumina Liberation Force in rescuing the innocent people imprisoned there!

831174302003271--.name:
$MyPCName$!! We found her... my younger sister, <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11000807[gender:1]$</font>...
I was so worried that I might never see her again...!

831174302003272--.name:
She's much thinner and weaker than when we were separated...
But thankfully, she isn't seriously ill or injured.
Once she recovers, I'm going to send her back to Maple World.

831174302003274--.name:
She's at $map:03009024$, a temporary shelter the Lumina Liberation Force prepared for those we've rescued, on the top floor of the northeastern tower at $map:03000135$.
I told my sister about you, and she said she wanted to meet you before returning home... Would you go see <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11000807[gender:1]$</font>?

831174302003275--.name: I told my sister about you, and she said she wanted to meet you before returning home... Would you go see <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11000807[gender:1]$</font>?

831174302003276--.name:
H-hello... $MyPCName$...
My brother said... you're a wonderful person... Thank you... for rescuing me...

831174302003277--.name:
After I was separated from my brother... I was so frightened... and everything was so difficult...
Terrible things happened on the top floor of the <font color="#ffd200">Tower of Slaves</font>...
Especially the Shadow Legion commander... He was so... so...

831174302003278--.name: Even now, whenever I see the color red... I remember that commander, and my heart feels like it's freezing...

831174302003279--.name: Ask what the color red has to do with it.

831174302003280--.name:
That commander... always wore a red cloak...
One day, he dragged someone up from a lower floor of the Tower of Slaves...
And in front of all of us... Sob...

831174302003281--.name:
That person... was in so much pain... I can still... hear the screams...
The Shadow Legion soldiers said that if we resisted... or disobeyed them... we'd suffer just like that person.

831174302003282--.name: Ask what the person looked like.

831174302003283--.name:
I don't remember clearly...
But I think he had blond hair... old goggles... and a torn red cloak...

831174302003284--.name: Ask what happened to that person.

831174302003285--.name:
The Shadow Legion commander... told his subordinates to take him to <font color="#ffd200">$map:02000213$</font>. He said the man would be useful to the shadowmancer...
I never saw him again after that.

831174302003286--.name:
I was... dragged from place to place with the others imprisoned on the top floor...
Then we were rescued at $map:03009023$...
My brother said the Lumina Liberation Force are our great benefactors.
Please tell the other members of the Lumina Liberation Force... how truly grateful I am.

831174302003287--.name:
My brother said the Lumina Liberation Force are our great benefactors.
Please tell the other members of the Lumina Liberation Force... how truly grateful I am.

831174302003288--.name:
$MyPCName$, thank you for risking your life to help make <font color="#ffd200">Operation Rescue $map:03009023$</font> a success.
I hear $npcName:11000614[gender:0]$'s sister returned safely, too?

831174302003290--.name:
Sigh... To think she endured something so terrible at such a young age...
I'm sorry we couldn't rescue her sooner...

831174302003291--.name: We must find a way for her to leave this terrible place and return safely to Maple World as soon as possible.

831174302003292--.name:
By the way, that man $npcName:11000807[gender:1]$ saw on the top floor...
I wonder if he might be $npcName:11000064[gender:0]$, the man the Guardians are searching for.

831174302003293--.name:
Officially or not, this operation brought the Lumina Liberation Force into contact with you, a member of the Guardians, and earned us your help...
So if the Guardians operating in the land of darkness ever need our assistance, we'll help.

831174302003294--.name: But the Lumina Liberation Force will only support work that genuinely serves Maple World's innocent, ordinary citizens and does not demand anyone's sacrifice.

831174302003295--.name: The Lumina Liberation Force has agreed to help and support the Guardians only in work that serves Maple World's innocent, ordinary citizens and does not demand anyone's sacrifice.

831174302003298--.name:
That happened...?!
I'm glad you rescued the citizens safely, but if something like that was happening, you should have reported to me first and followed my orders!
What would you have done if things had gone wrong?
