1023143105004493-JobChange_02-.name: Ugh... I can't make sense of this.

1023143105004494-JobChange_02-.name: For now, I should report what happened here…

1023143105004474-JobChange_02-.name: I feel two powers raging within my body. One of them is the power of the Munakra. And the other...

1023143105004475-JobChange_02-.name: Is the power of the lapenta?!

1023143105004478-JobChange_02-.name: The two powers I feel right now. You feel them, too?

1023143105004479-JobChange_02-.name: Yes, I felt them as well.

1023143105004480-JobChange_02-.name: I think we absorbed some of the lapenta's power here.

1023143105004482-JobChange_02-.name: How could we just absorb it like this? I'm so confused...

1023143105004484-JobChange_02-.name: You have a responsibility. Your friends are waiting for your report.

1023143105004486-JobChange_02-.name: I should go back to $map:02020041$ for now.

1023143105004498-JobChange_02-.name: Huh. If you're right, then this lapenta energy is related to that incident...

1023143105004499-JobChange_02-.name: Hm. Perhaps we should put a pin in this conversation for now.

1023143105004500-JobChange_02-.name: But why? It was just—$MyPCName$! I didn't see you there!

1023143105004501-JobChange_02-.name: There's something different about you. Did you change your hair? No, that's not it...

1023143105004502-JobChange_02-.name: My, my. There certainly is something different about $male:him,female:her$.

1023143105004503-JobChange_02-.name: What exactly happened to you, hm? You appear to be radiating lapenta energy.

1023143105004504-JobChange_02-.name: <font color="#909090">(You tell the story of what happened in the cave.)</font>

1023143105004505-JobChange_02-.name: Interesting. You actually made direct contact with the energy.

1023143105004508-JobChange_02-.name: $MyPCName$, when your power met the lapenta energy, both forces resonated with each other. That's the only explanation I can give you.

1023143105004509-JobChange_02-.name: I suspect that the resonance brought about many changes in you. Of course, you could say that more certainly than I.

1023143105004513-JobChange_02-.name: So that's what happened to me.

1023143105004514-JobChange_02-.name: It does seem like you're stronger than you were before. Much stronger.

1023143105004515-JobChange_02-.name: That's right! Even I can feel it, $MyPCName$.

1023143105004516-JobChange_02-.name: <font color="#909090">(You do feel lighter than you did before. And full of vigor!)</font>

1023143105004517-JobChange_02-.name: In that case... Let's see what this crazy continent has to throw at me!

1023143105004518-JobChange_02-.name: Hm... $MyPCName$? Can I speak with you a moment?

1023143105004523-JobChange_02-.name: Ambient lapenta energy... Was this continent summoned by the blackshard explosion?

621020511003052-ShadowCataclysm-.name: The empress is looking for you. Please see her straight away.

621020511003053-ShadowCataclysm-.name: The empress is looking for you. Please see her straight away.

621020511003054-ShadowCataclysm-.name: It is good to see you again, my loyal subject.

621020511003055-ShadowCataclysm-.name: I've finally received news from one of our scouting parties. My agents have discovered the source of my earlier foreboding deep within the Land of Darkness.

621020511003056-ShadowCataclysm-.name: Followers of the ancient and powerful Demon King have lifted the earth and bent space itself, revealing deep pockets of darkness that we didn't even know existed.

621020511003057-ShadowCataclysm-.name: New enemies are coming from this darkness. The average adventurer stands no chance against such monsters...

621020511003058-ShadowCataclysm-.name: But we can't afford to ignore the darkness. Not anymore. Someone needs to face the enemy head on and uncover their plot.

621020511003059-ShadowCataclysm-.name: Who is this new Penumbran Host? What are they after? $MyPCName$, only a hero of your caliber could hope at succeeding in such a task.

621020511003060-ShadowCataclysm-.name: Please venture into the Land of Darkness beyond the $map:02000146$. Learn what, exactly, is happening in that evil place. Should you accept this mission, I would like to offer you a gift.

621020511003061-ShadowCataclysm-.name: Please venture into the Land of Darkness beyond the $map:02000146$. Learn what, exactly, is happening in that evil place. Should you accept this mission, I would like to offer you a gift.

621020511003062-ShadowCataclysm-.name: What do you say? Will you walk the Land of Darkness in the name of your empress?

621020511003063-ShadowCataclysm-.name: The Land of Darkness won't know what hit it.

621020511003064-ShadowCataclysm-.name: Thank you for taking this seriously, as always. I want you to have this. You will need it to overcome the darkness.

621020511003065-ItemSocketSystem-.name: It's been too long. How have you been?

621020511003066-ItemSocketSystem-.name: I've heard some interesting rumors that might interest you. Something that could increase your power significantly. Do you want to learn more?

621020511003067-ItemSocketSystem-.name: I've heard some interesting rumors that might interest you. Something that could increase your power significantly. Do you want to learn more?

621020511003068-ItemSocketSystem-.name: It seems there are gemstones that you can place in your equipment to make it more powerful. These gemstones vary in color and shape, which will tell you what kind of bonuses the gemstone will give you.

621205211003077-ItemSocketSystem-.name: Some gemstones can be upgraded to grant exceptional power. You'll need gemstone motes to do so, which you can get by dismantling your unneeded gemstones.

621020511003069-ItemSocketSystem-.name: But you can't use gemstones on every piece of equipment! Only gear with sockets have room for gemstones. It may be challenging to find such equipment...

621020511003070-ItemSocketSystem-.name: There's still so much we don't know about gemstones. If you happen to find any, please try them out and let me know what you find!

621020511003071-ItemSocketSystem-.name: Oh, here is an item with a gemstone slot and a spare gemstone. Try it for yourself. It's sure to be a good experience!

201153011005083-PirateOcean-.name: Excuse me! I've been sent to ask you to see the empress. She's waiting for you at $map:52000087$.

201153011005085-PirateOcean-.name: Excuse me! I've been sent to ask you to see the empress. She's waiting for you at $map:52000087$.

207133011005238-PirateOcean-.name: In these troubling times, we've come to rely on your wisdom and courage more and more. That's why I've called you here. I want your advice.

207133011005239-PirateOcean-.name: So far, none of our scouting missions have uncovered any information about $npc:11001851[gender:1]$ and her forces of darkness. I'd put more people on the investigation, but my army is busy securing and repairing $map:02000001$.

207133011005240-PirateOcean-.name: But you... you are astonishingly resourceful. Do you have any suggestions for how we could proceed?

207133011005243-PirateOcean-.name: You're right, of course. We should be searching far beyond the borders of $map:02000001$, but we still have a problem with manpower…

207133011005244-PirateOcean-.name: We could ask sailors and explorers for help.

207133011005245-PirateOcean-.name: I've given that some thought, but it's dangerous work. It would be difficult to ensure that we only hire people who are up to the task, and I won't send unprepared novices to their doom.

207133011005246-PirateOcean-.name: We could ask sailors and explorers for help.

201153011005098-PirateOcean-.name: Explorers! Of course! They've seen more of Maple World than anyone else. It's possible they've encountered signs of the darkness in their travels.

201153011005099-PirateOcean-.name: I'll check in with the sailors at $map:02000062$.

201153011005100-PirateOcean-.name: Very good. I leave this in your capable hands, $MyPCName$.

201153011005101-PirateOcean-.name: I'm so very glad I asked for your thoughts on this matter. I hope your meeting in $map:02000062$ goes well.

201153011005102-PirateOcean-.name: Well, if it isn't $MyPCName$. You've got a reputation for yourself, you know.

201153011005103-PirateOcean-.name: You're looking pretty fit. Have you ever considered joining the Adventurer's Guild?

201153011005106-PirateOcean-.name: All right. How can I help?

201153011005107-PirateOcean-.name: I've seen captains with twenty years at sea who were more green than you. I think you'd fit right in. Now, about your membership dues...

201153011005109-PirateOcean-.name: You're looking pretty fit. Have you ever considered joining the Adventurer's Guild?

201153011005110-PirateOcean-.name:
It's the life of a sailor for me! Row the oars! Put your backs into it!
<font color="#909090">(He's humming to himself...)</font>

201153011005112-PirateOcean-.name: Ah! When did you get here?

202134311005205-PirateOcean-.name:
It's the life of a sailor for me! Row the oars! Put your backs into it!
<font color="#909090">(He's humming to himself...)</font>

202134311005207-PirateOcean-.name: Ah! When did you get here?

202134311005208-PirateOcean-.name:
It's the life of a sailor for me! Row the oars! Put your backs into it!
<font color="#909090">(He's humming to himself...)</font>

202134311005210-PirateOcean-.name: Ah! When did you get here?

201153011005113-PirateOcean-.name: All kinds of rumors make their way here. This is a hub for explorers and adventurers, after all. So, ask me your questions.

201153011005114-PirateOcean-.name: Have you heard anything about the forces of darkness?

201153011005115-PirateOcean-.name: Of course I have! Did you know that they attacked both $map:02000001$ and $map:02000100$? That's some pretty fresh information right there.

201153011005116-PirateOcean-.name: You don't say. Have you anything about $npcName:11001851[gender:1]$?

201153011005117-PirateOcean-.name: I'm sure I heard that name before. Isn't $npcName:11001851[gender:1]$ the one who led the attack on the caravan some time ago?

201153011005118-PirateOcean-.name: Well, it sounds like you already know more about this than I do. But you aren't out of luck just yet. It turns out that the world's greatest explorer, $npcName:11003080[gender:0]$, is in town. I bet he knows something.

201153011005120-PirateOcean-.name: He's in the $map:52000095$, next room over. You can visit him if you want, just... don't do anything to upset him. His ship was sunk by pirates, and he's still recovering.

201153011005121-PirateOcean-.name: $npcName:11003080[gender:0]$ is in the $map:52000095$, next room over. You can visit him if you want, just... don't do anything to upset him. His ship was sunk by pirates, and he's still recovering.

201153011005122-PirateOcean-.name:
M-my ship... no...!
<font color="#909090">(He's trembling in his sleep.)</font>

201153011005123-PirateOcean-.name: Wake up, $npcName:11003080[gender:0]$. You're having a nightmare!

201153011005124-PirateOcean-.name: Ah! Oh... Oh, it was just a dream…

201153011005125-PirateOcean-.name: Thanks for waking me. Better to be awake and in pain then reliving those memories... So, what can I do for you?

201153011005126-PirateOcean-.name: Have you seen the forces of darkness in your journeys?

201153011005127-PirateOcean-.name: I've seen lots of strange and dark things. Can you be a little more specific?

201153011005129-PirateOcean-.name: I can't say I know the name. Sorry I couldn't be... Now, wait a minute. There is one thing, but it may not be helpful...

201153011005131-PirateOcean-.name: There's a good friend of mine, $npcName:24003002[gender:1]$. She's a lovely lady—well, siren, if I'm being specific—who lives on $map:02000391$. Last time I was out her way, she told me a great disaster was looming over Maple World.

201153011005132-PirateOcean-.name: I wanted to ask her more, but I had to set sail before low tide. I promised I'd be back soon... and the very next day, pirates sunk my ship. I've been holed up here licking my wounds ever since.

201153011005133-PirateOcean-.name: Sirens have a strange power. The ocean speaks to them. These forces of darkness you mentioned... Could be that they're the ones who cause the disaster in $npcName:24003002[gender:1]$'s prophecy.

201153011005135-PirateOcean-.name: The sea route to $map:02000391$ isn't exactly straightforward. Even if you got there, the sirens don't exactly have a glowing opinion of humans. If only I could go with you...

201153011005136-PirateOcean-.name: There's got to be a way for me to meet her.

201153011005137-PirateOcean-.name: Well... Take this compass. Show it to $npcName:24003002[gender:1]$ and tell her you're my friend. She'll help you get along with the others. As for actually getting to $map:02000391$, you'll need $npcName:11003082[gender:0]$'s help.

201153011005138-PirateOcean-.name: $npcName:11003082[gender:0]$ used to be $npc:23000015$'s navigator, but he gave up the pirating lifestyle. Now he's in hiding somewhere in $map:02000182$. Tell him I sent you.

201153011005139-PirateOcean-.name: Thanks for all of your help.

201153011005140-PirateOcean-.name: Don't mention it. To tell the truth, $npcName:24003002[gender:1]$'s words have been weighing on me. If you can help stop this disaster, then I wish you all the luck in the world.

201153011005141-PirateOcean-.name: $npc:11003082[gender:0]$ is in hiding somewhere in $map:02000182$. Tell him I sent you. He'll get you to $map:02000391$.

201153011005142-PirateOcean-.name: <font color="#909090">(This log cabin looks suspicious. You hear something drop inside.)</font>

201153011005143-PirateOcean-.name: <font color="#909090">(Go inside the cabin. $npcName:11003082[gender:0]$ might be inside.)</font>

201153011005144-PirateOcean-.name: <font color="#909090">(Go inside the cabin. $npcName:11003082[gender:0]$ might be inside.)</font>

201153011005147-PirateOcean-.name: Yes, but whatever it is, I didn't do it! And I got no money, so don't bother robbing me, neither!

201153011005149-PirateOcean-.name: $npcName:11003080[gender:0]$ sent you! I heard he got sunk. Glad to hear he's still kicking around.

201153011005150-PirateOcean-.name: I know the pirate that scuttled $npcName:11003080[gender:0]$. He thinks $npcName:24003002[gender:1]$ is real pretty, but $npcName:24003002[gender:1]$ only talks to $npcName:11003080[gender:0]$. This made him real mad…

201153011005152-PirateOcean-.name: $npc:23000015$! Vicious, bad, mean! He sent his men to $map:02000391$ to drag $npcName:24003002[gender:1]$ away!

201153011005154-PirateOcean-.name: Don't be crazy! Pirates are strong. And plenty. $npcName:24003002[gender:1]$ can take care of herself. And if not... she has a real mean sister!

201153011005155-PirateOcean-.name: Even if she doesn't need my help, I need hers.

201153011005156-PirateOcean-.name: What'd I just say about being crazy? I tried telling her what happened to $npcName:11003080[gender:0]$, I barely got out of $map:02000391$ alive. My ship's all tore up now...

201153011005157-PirateOcean-.name: If we go now, pirates attack us, and we sink. Glub glub glub.

201153011005158-PirateOcean-.name: Get ready to sail. In the meantime, I'll get rid of the pirates.

201153011005159-PirateOcean-.name:
Fine! But you help, too. Get $itemPlural:30000725$ from $npcPlural:21000232[gender:0]$. Need to keep ship ship-shape!
The things on the ship are not enough. I need more.

201153011005160-PirateOcean-.name: <font color="#909090">(Why can't anyone ever just say, "Sure, hop on my boat?")</font>

201153011005161-PirateOcean-.name: Beat up pirates in $map:02000182$. Get $itemPlural:30000725$. Do this, then we worry about surviving the trip...

201153011005162-PirateOcean-.name: Beat up pirates in $map:02000182$. Get $itemPlural:30000725$. Do this, then we worry about surviving the trip...

201153011005163-PirateOcean-.name: This is good. Enough to get us through if we sink again. While you were gone, I fixed up ship. Good to go!

201153011005164-PirateOcean-.name: We sail to $map:02000391$ when you're ready.

201153011005165-PirateOcean-.name: There'll be lots of pirates at $map:02000391$. Hope you get to $npcName:24003002[gender:1]$ in one piece.

201153011005167-PirateOcean-.name: I steer the ship. That's plenty! The rest is up to you.

201153011005169-PirateOcean-.name: Where do I go to board the ship?

201153011005170-PirateOcean-.name: Outside cabin. There's the boat. Walk through the black door. Or I can push you through it!

201153011005174-PirateOcean-.name: She wants you to come to $map:02000388$. Lots of pirates. Wants to steal their ship.

201153011005175-PirateOcean-.name: Why don't they use your ship?

201153011005176-PirateOcean-.name: Seas too rough there. My ship will sink. Needs a bigger ship. But this is too much! $npcName:24003001[gender:1]$ just wants to teach a lesson for flirting with $npcName:24003002[gender:1]$!

201153011005178-PirateOcean-.name: You're scary, too! Do what you want. I'm not going.

201153011005180-PirateOcean-.name: $map:02000063$. In cave, behind waterfall. Good luck...

201153011005181-PirateOcean-.name: $map:02000388$ is in $map:02000063$. In cave, behind waterfall. Good luck...

202145711005212-PirateOcean-.name: $npcName:24003001[gender:1]$ said you'd get lost. Gave me a charm. It will make you dizzy, but you'll get there.

201153011005182-PirateOcean-.name: $npcName:24002931$... is agitated. But in time, he will grow calm again, thanks to you.

201153011005183-PirateOcean-.name: Clear away these mists and let us parley.

201153011005185-PirateOcean-.name: What is it we're doing here?

201153011005186-PirateOcean-.name: O great waves, lend us your strength! Sweep away these dark mists!

201153011005187-PirateOcean-.name: I shall use sea magic to cleanse this place of evil mists. Then it will be safe to speak with $npcName:24002931$. Shall we begin?

201153011005189-PirateOcean-.name: Clear away these mists and let us parley.

201153011005191-PirateOcean-.name: What is it we're doing here?

201153011005192-PirateOcean-.name: O great waves, lend us your strength! Sweep away these dark mists!

201153011005193-PirateOcean-.name: I shall use sea magic to cleanse this place of evil mists. Then it will be safe to speak with $npcName:24002931$. Shall we begin?

201153011005195-PirateOcean-.name: I can smell the sea on you. Did you find what you were after?

201153011005197-PirateOcean-.name: See, I knew he would help you!

201153011005198-PirateOcean-.name: <font color="#909090">(The vision $npcName:24002931$ showed you... The great disaster...)</font>

201153011005199-PirateOcean-.name: You don't mind if I go around telling everyone you're an honorary member of the Adventurer's Guild, do you? We could use the buzz!

201153011005200-PirateOcean-.name: <font color="#909090">(The other divine creatures... The Mage of Light...)</font>

201153011005201-PirateOcean-.name: Hold on, let me get my camera. I'm going to get your picture and post it on... Um, $MyPCName$? Are you listening?

201153011005202-PirateOcean-.name: <font color="#909090">(What does it mean? You need to contemplate this...)</font>

201153011005204-PirateOcean-.name: Did you get hit in the head or something? You're totally spacing out.

201153011005206-PirateOcean-.name: Better, but still in no shape to get out of bed. He's still in the $map:52000095$ if you want to check in on him.

201153011005207-PirateOcean-.name: I think $npcName:11003080[gender:0]$ is getting better, but he's still in no shape to get out of bed. He's still in the $map:52000095$ if you want to check in on him.

201153011005208-PirateOcean-.name: I've been counting the minutes 'til your return! Not much else to do in here, after all. Did $npcName:11003082[gender:0]$ give you a lift? How is $npcName:24003002[gender:1]$? Did she tell you about the looming disaster?

201153011005209-PirateOcean-.name: Not so fast! One question at a time, please.

201153011005210-PirateOcean-.name: Right, right! I'm used to finding answers for myself. Feels strange, relying on someone else to tell me what's going on... Okay, tell me how it went.

201153011005212-PirateOcean-.name: You met $npcName:24002931$? The $npcName:24002931$?! That's the guardian of the sea! Do you know what any sailor worth his salt would give to be in your shoes?!

201153011005213-PirateOcean-.name: What did you two talk about? Was it what you were looking for? They say there's nothing $npcName:24002931$ doesn't know.

201153011005214-PirateOcean-.name: It... wasn't what I was looking for.

201153011005215-PirateOcean-.name: Oh. Well, that's too bad. You should've asked for winning lottery numbers instead, I suppose...

201153011005216-PirateOcean-.name: Also, $npcName:24003002[gender:1]$ says you need to get better so you can visit again.

201153011005217-PirateOcean-.name: I'll do my best. $npcName:24003002[gender:1]$ is a pal, a real pal. But how big was $npcName:24002931$, anyway? I wonder if she'll let me meet him someday...

201153011005218-PirateOcean-.name: A real pal, huh? $npcName:24003002[gender:1]$ will be disappointed...

201153011005219-PirateOcean-.name: What was that? Sorry, I think I got overexcited. I better get some rest... Thanks for letting me live vicariously through you, even if just for a little bit.

201153011005220-PirateOcean-.name: I've had a lot of time to look back on my life. And... I feel sad. If I had a strong friend like you, just think of all the amazing new places I could have discovered.

201153011005221-PirateOcean-.name: We should go adventuring together when you're better.

201153011005222-PirateOcean-.name: Count on it! We do that, and I'll put your name in the next edition of $npcName:11003080[gender:0]$'s World Tour!

201153011005223-PirateOcean-.name: Well, I'd better be on my way.

201153011005224-PirateOcean-.name: Of course, of course. Official business and all that. Sorry you didn't find what you want, but I'm glad we got the chance to meet.

201153011005225-PirateOcean-.name: Of course, of course. Official business and all that. Sorry you didn't find what you want, but I'm glad we got the chance to meet.

201153011005226-PirateOcean-.name: I'm pleased to see you. Did you learn anything new about our enemies?

201153011005227-PirateOcean-.name: I didn't find anything about the forces of darkness.

201153011005228-PirateOcean-.name: That's unfortunate. My own people have been busy repairing the damage from the last battle...

201153011005229-PirateOcean-.name: <font color="#909090">(The empress was definitely in $npcName:24002931$'s vision...)</font>

201153011005230-PirateOcean-.name: All we can do is keep searching. I have faith that we'll find some new evidence soon.

201153011005231-PirateOcean-.name: <font color="#909090">(But it was just a vision. You must proceed carefully.)</font>

201153011005232-PirateOcean-.name: I'll contact you the moment we have new information, of course.

201153011005233-PirateOcean-.name: <font color="#909090">(You can't tell anyone for now. Certainly not the empress.)</font>

201153011005234-PirateOcean-.name: Thank you for always doing your best, $MyPCName$.

201153011005235-SnowKingdom-.name: I have a new mission for you, $MyPCName$. In fact, you were requested by name.

201153011005236-SnowKingdom-.name: $npc:11000076[gender:0]$ sent a report that the forces of darkness have been sighted in the tundra of northern Victoria Island. He would like your help in assessing the situation.

201153011005237-SnowKingdom-.name: I'm inclined to agree with him. $MyPCName$, will you help $npcName:11000076[gender:0]$ in hunting down the forces of darkness?

201153011005239-SnowKingdom-.name: Are we sure it's really them this time?

201153011005240-SnowKingdom-.name: Thank you. $npc:11000076[gender:0]$ has set up a $map:52000080$ in $map:02000261$.

201153011005241-SnowKingdom-.name: $npcName:11000076[gender:0]$ witnessed it with his own eyes. I'm sure his report is accurate—but he's not used to fighting in the snow.

201153011005242-SnowKingdom-.name: I'll give him some backup, then.

201153011005243-SnowKingdom-.name: $npc:11000076[gender:0]$ has set up a $map:52000080$ in $map:02000261$. I'm counting on both of you to track down the forces of darkness.

201153011005244-SnowKingdom-.name: I see you received my summons!

201153011005246-SnowKingdom-.name: Ah... It's just a scratch. Anyway, thanks for coming.

201153011005247-SnowKingdom-.name: My men are in sorry shape. We aren't trained for arctic combat, and we took a beating in our last battle. We need to regroup, but I don't want to risk losing the trail. That's why you're here.

201153011005249-SnowKingdom-.name: We were scouting out the $map:02000260$ after hearing some suspicious rumblings, and we encountered monsters in a hidden cave. We were about to pursue, but...

201153011005251-SnowKingdom-.name: He appeared from nowhere. I don't know who he is, but he attacked both the monsters and my soldiers, demanding that no one interfere in his fight. The way he wielded that sword...

201153011005252-SnowKingdom-.name: I'm not sure where his allegiance lies. He didn't seriously injure any of my men, and it was clear that he was no friend to the forces of darkness...

201153011005253-SnowKingdom-.name: Is that how your arm got hurt?

201153011005254-SnowKingdom-.name: It is. Even the slightest wound can turn deadly in this cold, so I need to stay here and make sure my men are attended to. But while we're stuck here, our latest clue is getting away...

201153011005255-SnowKingdom-.name: I'll check out this cave of yours.

201153011005256-SnowKingdom-.name: I knew I could count on you. The ice cave is hidden behind some snowcapped trees on the mountainside of $map:02000260$. Be sure to search the place thoroughly.

201153011005257-SnowKingdom-.name: I knew I could count on you. The ice cave is hidden behind some snowcapped trees on the mountainside of $map:02000260$. Be sure to search the place thoroughly.

201153011005258-SnowKingdom-.name: <font color="#909090">(There's a cold wind coming from behind the trees. This must be the place $npcName:11000076[gender:0]$ spoke of.)</font>

201153011005259-SnowKingdom-.name: <font color="#909090">($npcName:11000076[gender:0]$'s ice cave should be just beyond this tree.)</font>

201153011005262-SnowKingdom-.name: I had a run-in with the forces of darkness.

201153011005263-SnowKingdom-.name: Then there's something here that has their interest. Did anything else happen?

201153011005265-SnowKingdom-.name: And yet you're uninjured. Even against you, I doubt he could have been defeated so easily...

201153011005266-SnowKingdom-.name: He saved me from an ambush.

201153011005267-SnowKingdom-.name: Then he is an enemy of the forces of darkness, after all. He must know something that we don't...

201153011005268-SnowKingdom-.name: This swordsman could be a valuable ally. Unfortunately, he doesn't seem interested in accepting our help...

201153011005269-SnowKingdom-.name: Not everyone is a team player.

201153011005270-SnowKingdom-.name: Well, there's little to be done about that. More to the point, were you able to explore the deep end of the ice cavern? We couldn't get very far.

201153011005271-SnowKingdom-.name: There's a narrow valley at the end, but the cold is too bitter to go further.

201153011005272-SnowKingdom-.name: Hmm... They say the cold of this place is legendary. Now we know why. It's said that only the citizens of the snow kingdom could... That's it!

201153011005273-SnowKingdom-.name: The cold seems to have slowed my wits! The snow kingdom vanished a while ago, but some of its citizens still belong to the empire. That includes $npcName:11003060[gender:0]$ over there!

201153011005274-SnowKingdom-.name: Isn't that the weapon merchant from $map:02000001$...?

201153011005275-SnowKingdom-.name: Correct. He's come to help keep us supplied. But before he came to the capital, he lived in the snow kingdom that used to be here. There's a chance he know a way to get past the bitter cold.

201153011005277-SnowKingdom-.name: I think that would be for the best. I'll leave this to you.

201153011005278-SnowKingdom-.name: $npcName:11003060[gender:0]$ may be our only hope for continuing the investigation.

201153011005280-SnowKingdom-.name: I was hoping you could help me with something...

201153011005282-SnowKingdom-.name: Don't play games with me. I've seen you wandering around $map:02000001$ before! I never forget a potential customer.

201153011005283-SnowKingdom-.name: I was hoping you could help me with something...

201153011005284-SnowKingdom-.name: ...That passage leads to the $map:52000083$, and the cold that stopped you is the magic of $npc:11003069[gender:1]$…

201153011005286-SnowKingdom-.name: I volunteered to help the captain for a reason. I wanted a chance to see my queen again. But that snowstorm... I'm not strong enough to get through it. Each snowflake felt like the tears of $npc:11003069[gender:1]$, grieving the loss of her kingdom and $npc:11003075[gender:0]$…

201153011005287-SnowKingdom-.name: Must you really go in there? If $npc:11003069[gender:1]$ is using this kind of magic, then she wants to be alone.

201153011005288-SnowKingdom-.name: All the more reason for me to go.

201153011005290-SnowKingdom-.name: The forces of darkness are here, too. Your queen is in danger.

201153011005291-SnowKingdom-.name: Then... then there's no other option. Do you promise you'll save her?

201153011005292-SnowKingdom-.name: I will, but first I need to get through the blizzard.

201153011005294-SnowKingdom-.name: Normally, you'd need enough magic power to match $npc:11003069[gender:1]$ if you wanted to get through the blizzard. Luckily for us, I know of a special potion that should do the trick.

201153011005295-SnowKingdom-.name: Yetis aren't usually good with potions. Our sense of smell is too weak to find herbs, you see. But $npcName:11003063[gender:0]$ is special. He can find herbs with his skinny little fingers and use them to make all kinds of medicine.

201153011005297-SnowKingdom-.name: $map:02000263$. He's a little guy. Ask him to make you a bottle of $item:20000451$.

201153011005298-SnowKingdom-.name: $map:02000263$. He's a little guy. Ask him to make you a bottle of $item:20000451$.

201153011005301-SnowKingdom-.name: Wh-what? Who're you? What do you want? Do you even know what you're asking?

201153011005302-SnowKingdom-.name: I need to get through $npc:11003069[gender:1]$'s blizzard and make sure she's okay.

201153011005303-SnowKingdom-.name: $npcName:11003060[gender:0]$ sent you, didn't he? Always sniveling about queen this and royal duty that.

201153011005304-SnowKingdom-.name: Is it wrong for him to be worried?

201153011005305-SnowKingdom-.name: He's worrying over nothing! Stubborn oaf…

201153011005306-SnowKingdom-.name: Sure, she was a fine queen, when times are good. But it all fell apart overnight! The kingdom vanished, and the king and queen with it. The cold wasn't the worst part... The worst part is how we all scattered.

201153011005307-SnowKingdom-.name: So she wants to hole herself up and mope, when we're the ones who suffered because of her? Fine by me! I'll be happy if I never see her again!

201153011005308-SnowKingdom-.name: I'm not asking you to see her. I just need your help.

201153011005309-SnowKingdom-.name: Not interested! That potion is a pain in the tush to make. It's hard to get the ingredients.

201153011005310-SnowKingdom-.name: The forces at work here are a threat to all of Maple World!

201162411005083-SnowKingdom-.name: If they're such a big threat, why are they wasting their time in the remains of some has-been kingdom?

201162411005084-SnowKingdom-.name: That's what I need to find out. Can you make the $item:20000451$?

201162411005085-SnowKingdom-.name: Prickly-cold $itemPlural:30000723$. Grow under the flowers in $map:02000263$. Sandpaper-rough $item:30000724$, freshly plucked at $map:02000264$. Get me those things and I'll make you the potion.

201162411005086-SnowKingdom-.name: Come back before I change my mind.

201162411005087-SnowKingdom-.name: Prickly-cold $itemPlural:30000723$. Grow under the flowers in $map:02000263$. Sandpaper-rough $item:30000724$, freshly plucked at $map:02000264$. Get me those things and I'll make you the potion.

201162411005088-SnowKingdom-.name: Another few minutes and I was going to wander off. Hand over the stuff.

201162411005090-SnowKingdom-.name: Those'll do. Go stand over there. Need room to work.

201162411005091-SnowKingdom-.name: The $item:20000451$ is complete. It will let you endure the blizzard. But remember, potions don't last forever. This one especially!

201162411005092-SnowKingdom-.name: Drink it right before you enter $map:52000082$. If you use it too soon, it'll wear off and you'll wind up a popsicle.

201162411005095-SnowKingdom-.name: How long does the potion last?

201162411005096-SnowKingdom-.name: Good thing I made a big batch. Here's a refill. Remember, it won't last long, so hurry!

201162411005097-SnowKingdom-.name: It's in your bag. I'm not a charity, you know! Only one potion at a time!

201162411005098-SnowKingdom-.name: Your bag is crammed full of garbage. Make some room.

201162411005099-SnowKingdom-.name: Not long. That's all I can say. If I were you, I'd drink it right before going into $map:52000082$.

201162411005100-SnowKingdom-.name: You and that swordsman saved me. I'll never forget your kindness... But how did you make it through the blizzard?

201162411005101-SnowKingdom-.name: I had help from some yetis.

203155711005213-SnowKingdom-.name: The yetis look like big oafs, but they're actually very resourceful. $npcName:11003069[gender:1]$ and $npcName:11003075[gender:0]$ were fond of them. I was hoping to get help from one of them...

203155711005214-SnowKingdom-.name: If he were here, $npcName:11003069[gender:1]$ might have made a different choice. I tried sending for him, but I never got a response. $map:02000001$ must be terribly far away…

203155711005215-SnowKingdom-.name: A yeti in $map:02000001$... Do you mean $npcName:11003060[gender:0]$?

203155711005216-SnowKingdom-.name: Yes! He sells weapons there. Before the kingdom fell, he was the gatekeeper of $map:52000086$ for a very, very long time. I'm surprised you know him!

203155711005217-SnowKingdom-.name: He's in $map:52000080$ at this very moment.

203155711005218-SnowKingdom-.name: Then... he did come! We still have a chance to protect $npcName:11003069[gender:1]$ from that specter. $npcName:11003060$ may be able to stop her from opening the $map:52000085$...!

203155711005219-SnowKingdom-.name: I... sure. We could probably make that happen.

201162411005112-SnowKingdom-.name: We need to get $npcName:11003060[gender:0]$ and go to the $map:02000381$! But... I can hardly walk in this state...

201162411005113-SnowKingdom-.name: Let me go in your place.

201162411005114-SnowKingdom-.name: But... This is for $npc:11003069[gender:1]$... I can't ask an outsider…

201162411005115-SnowKingdom-.name: I needed to go to $map:02000381$ with $npcName:11003060[gender:0]$ anyway.

201162411005116-SnowKingdom-.name: But... What business could you have there...?

201162411005117-SnowKingdom-.name: I need to investigate the specter for myself.

201162411005118-SnowKingdom-.name: I understand. I'll open a path to $npcName:11003060[gender:0]$. It's the least I can do to thank you...

201162411005119-SnowKingdom-.name: It's no problem. You should get some rest.

201162411005120-SnowKingdom-.name: Thank you. Let me know when you're ready...

201162411005123-SnowKingdom-.name: O winds of the blizzard, open a path through the heavens...!

201162411005124-SnowKingdom-.name: My magic might make you a little dizzy. I wish I could go with you, but this spell can only move one person at a time... Let me know when you're ready.

201162411005126-SnowKingdom-.name: I'll open a path to $npcName:11003060[gender:0]$. Let me know when you're ready.

201162411005129-SnowKingdom-.name: O winds of the blizzard, open a path through the heavens...!

201162411005130-SnowKingdom-.name: My magic might make you a little dizzy. I wish I could go with you, but this spell can only move one person at a time... Let me know when you're ready.

201162411005132-SnowKingdom-.name: W-well? Is the queen all right?

201162411005133-SnowKingdom-.name: I need you're help. We have to get to the $map:02000381$.

201162411005134-SnowKingdom-.name: I-is that where the queen is? What is going on?

201162411005136-SnowKingdom-.name: Then we really do have to hurry. Something big is going on.

201162411005137-SnowKingdom-.name: The $map:02000382$ is the only way to reach the $map:52000086$. The snow kingdom is lost, but its secret treasure is still there. Our wise ancestors locked it up so that its power couldn't be used against the world...

201162411005138-SnowKingdom-.name: The Frozen Crystal... It's in a vault in the $map:02000383$, locked away by perfect yeti engineering. Only the queen can open up the path through the $map:02000382$ to get there.

201162411005139-SnowKingdom-.name: The vault itself can only be opened by both the king and queen together. And they'd never do so willingly, since they know how dangerous the treasure is.

201162411005140-SnowKingdom-.name: But now the kingdom is gone... and so is the king. And this specter promised the queen that he could somehow reunite her with $npc:11003075[gender:0]$…

201162411005141-SnowKingdom-.name: If $npcName:11003075[gender:0]$ is alive, then the vault can be opened?

201162411005142-SnowKingdom-.name: Yes. That's why we have to stop $npc:11003069[gender:1]$ at the shrine. I don't think she'll like us thwarting her plan to meet $npc:11003075[gender:0]$ again...

201162411005143-SnowKingdom-.name: That seems pretty selfish of her.

201162411005144-SnowKingdom-.name: For as long as our kingdom was around, every queen had her king, and every king was made for his queen. They are two halves to the whole. To be separated from each other is unbearable... I'm sure $npc:11003075[gender:0]$ would do the same thing in her shoes.

201162411005145-SnowKingdom-.name: That's why I have to protect her! She already lost too much. Even if it's her fault that we have no kingdom or king, she's suffered enough...

201162411005146-SnowKingdom-.name: There's a path on the slope over $map:02000260$ that leads to the $map:02000381$. The $map:02000382$ is there... somewhere. I'll meet you in the mountains.

201162411005147-SnowKingdom-.name: I'm not sure how to get there...

201162411005148-SnowKingdom-.name: All right... Close your eyes for a minute. The winds of the tundra will guide you there.

201162411005150-SnowKingdom-.name: How do I get there again?

201162411005151-SnowKingdom-.name: Can't you just take me there?

201162411005152-SnowKingdom-.name: There's a path on the slope over $map:02000260$ that leads to the $map:02000381$. Halfway up, you'll see a bunch of trees near the stairs. Search the snow wall and you'll see a small cave that shines with blue light. Go in there.

201162411005153-SnowKingdom-.name: All right... Close your eyes for a minute. The winds of the tundra will guide you there.

201162411005154-SnowKingdom-.name: I can't say I wasn't expecting this... but I can't just give up.

201162411005155-SnowKingdom-.name: We have no idea how much danger the Frozen Crystal is in or what dangers $npcName:11003069[gender:1]$ will meet at the $map:02000383$.

206165611005231-SnowKingdom-.name: $MyPCName$... I appreciate everything you've done for me... But are you sure you've got time to fix the problems of a kingdom that already fell?

206165611005232-SnowKingdom-.name: I'm pretty sure the forces of darkness are here, so this is my business, too.

206165611005233-SnowKingdom-.name: Then... will you go to the $map:02000383$ with me? I need to keep looking for $npc:11003069[gender:1]$.

206165611005235-SnowKingdom-.name: Thank you. Let me know when you're ready to leave.

201162411005157-SnowKingdom-.name: Let me know when you're ready to leave.

201162411005158-SnowKingdom-.name: The $map:52000086$... It's hidden by a veil of frost beyond $map:02000263$. But the door should appear to us, now that $npc:11003069[gender:1]$ opened the way.

201162411005160-SnowKingdom-.name: Give me a moment. I'll find the door...

206165611005236-SnowKingdom-.name: Found it. At the top of $map:02000263$. The door to the $map:52000086$ is there.

206165611005237-SnowKingdom-.name: I'm not sure how to get there...

201162411005165-SnowKingdom-.name: All right... Close your eyes for a minute. The winds of the tundra will guide you there.

201162411005167-SnowKingdom-.name: How do I get there again?

201162411005168-SnowKingdom-.name: Can't you just take me there?

201162411005169-SnowKingdom-.name: Find the tallest, steepest part of $map:02000263$. The door to the $map:52000086$ is there.

201162411005170-SnowKingdom-.name: All right... Close your eyes for a minute. The winds of the tundra will guide you there.

201162411005171-SnowKingdom-.name: It seems you've been busy. Good to have you back.

201162411005172-SnowKingdom-.name: I've been buried in mission briefings and paperwork this entire time. I wish I could have been out there in the field, with you...

201162411005173-SnowKingdom-.name: (Fill him in on everything that happened.)

201162411005174-SnowKingdom-.name: I never thought I'd hear the names $npcName:11003075[gender:0]$ and $npcName:11003069[gender:1]$ again. Everyone thought they vanished along with their kingdom.

201162411005175-SnowKingdom-.name: I suspect this specter is allied with the forces of darkness. There's a plot brewing. And how does the $npcName:11003062[gender:0]$ fit into all of this...?

201162411005176-SnowKingdom-.name: I have no idea what became of him.

201162411005177-SnowKingdom-.name: He's certainly a match for either of us in a fight. It seems you're especially worried about him...

201162411005178-SnowKingdom-.name: <font color="#909090">(He knew something about the specter...)</font>

201162411005179-SnowKingdom-.name: Anyway, all sorts of powerful beings are coming out from the woodwork. It's as if the enemy is moving their pieces into position. Meanwhile, we don't even know what game we're supposed to be playing...

201162411005180-SnowKingdom-.name: Ah, one last thing. We've been recalled to $map:02000001$. My troops and I will be departing soon.

201162411005181-SnowKingdom-.name: Why don't you speak with $npcName:11003060[gender:0]$ before we go? I think he has something to tell you.

203155711005221-SnowKingdom-.name: I've been buried in mission briefings and paperwork this entire time. I wish I could have been out there in the field, with you...

203155711005222-SnowKingdom-.name: (Fill him in on everything that happened.)

203155711005223-SnowKingdom-.name: I never thought I'd hear the names $npcName:11003075[gender:0]$ and $npcName:11003069[gender:1]$ again. Everyone thought they vanished along with their kingdom.

203155711005224-SnowKingdom-.name: I suspect this specter is allied with the forces of darkness. There's a plot brewing. And how does the $npcName:11003062[gender:0]$ fit into all of this...?

203155711005225-SnowKingdom-.name: I have no idea what became of him.

203155711005226-SnowKingdom-.name: He's certainly a match for either of us in a fight. It seems you're especially worried about him...

203155711005227-SnowKingdom-.name: <font color="#909090">(Something about his swordsmanship... It was somehow familiar...)</font>

203155711005228-SnowKingdom-.name: All sorts of powerful beings are coming out from the woodwork. It's as if the enemy is moving their pieces into position. Meanwhile, we don't even know what game we're supposed to be playing...

203155711005229-SnowKingdom-.name: Ah, one last thing. We've been recalled to $map:02000001$. My troops and I will be departing soon.

203155711005230-SnowKingdom-.name: Why don't you speak with $npcName:11003060[gender:0]$ before we go? I think he has something to tell you.

201162411005182-SnowKingdom-.name: Why don't you speak with $npcName:11003060[gender:0]$ before we go? I think he has something to tell you.

201162411005185-SnowKingdom-.name: I'm fine now. $npc:11003069[gender:1]$ took care of me.

201162411005186-SnowKingdom-.name: The queen was real quiet for a while. When she finally spoke up, she thanked me for all the help. She's grateful to you, too. Honestly, I was dumbstruck at being thanked by the queen herself!

201162411005187-SnowKingdom-.name: I don't know what happened to the king. I don't even know if that guy was really $npc:11003075[gender:0]$... I can't imagine how the queen feels about this. It's enough to break a yeti's heart.

201162411005188-SnowKingdom-.name: You should be proud. You did good work.

201162411005189-SnowKingdom-.name: Thanks... But I couldn't've done it without you. I'll be doing my best to cheer my queen up from now on.

201162411005191-SnowKingdom-.name: You're right! I don't got to do this alone. There's no point feeling bad about the kingdom we lost. Now we got to appreciate those of us who stuck around.

201162411005193-SnowKingdom-.name: And I'm rooting for you, too! Don't be a stranger. Come visit me at my stall in $map:02000001$ sometime, okay?

201162411005194-SnowKingdom-.name: You're going back to $map:02000001$ after all this?

201162411005195-SnowKingdom-.name: Hey, a yeti's got to make a living! And adventurers like you count on me for my fine craftsmanship. I'll be able to find plenty of time to visit here.

201162411005196-SnowKingdom-.name: <font color="#909090">(You should return to $map:02000001$ and check in with the empress.)</font>

201162411005197-SnowKingdom-.name: Well, I'd better get my stuff together. See you back in $map:02000001$!

201162411005198-SnowKingdom-.name: Well, I'd better get my stuff together. See you back in $map:02000001$!

201162411005199-SnowKingdom-.name: $npc:11000076[gender:0]$ tells me that your performance on this latest mission has been exemplary.

201162411005201-SnowKingdom-.name: We may not have learned more about $npc:11001851[gender:1]$, but I'd call this mission a success. The forces of darkness are expanding their operations all over Maple World.

201162411005202-SnowKingdom-.name: $npc:11003075[gender:0]$ was once a benevolent king. To hear what's become of him, I can't help but think that the forces of darkness were behind the collapse of his kingdom.

201162411005203-SnowKingdom-.name: We need to keep our ears to the ground. If any new disasters crop up, I'll let you know as well.

201162411005204-SnowKingdom-.name: I will remember the service you've rendered. Thank you, $MyPCName$.

519030511005528-Quest2017-.name: Not so fast, $npcName:11000119[gender:0]$. $npcName:11000076[gender:0]$'s knights are already... indisposed, and your guards are needed to protect $map:02000001$.

519030511005529-Quest2017-.name: $map:02000076$'s militia is strong. They wouldn't ask for our help if the situation wasn't dire, minister. We can't turn our backs on them!

519030511005530-Quest2017-.name: Let us say we do send our forces to help $map:02000076$. Would that not make $map:02000001$ a tempting target? Would you leave the empress exposed to these fiends?

519030511005531-Quest2017-.name: (There has to be a way to help...!)

519030511005532-Quest2017-.name: You're right, minister. Still, we must do something. What if we sent a small, elite team to aid $map:02000076$ while the bulk of our forces stayed here?

519030511005533-Quest2017-.name: Absolutely not. The last thing we need is you taking your best men and gallavanting off into the woods. Your place is here, by Her Imperial Majesty's side!

519030511005534-Quest2017-.name: <font color="#909090">(Court politics! This isn't what you signed up for. It's time to take matters into your own hands. Speak with $npc:11000075[gender:1]$.)</font>

519030511005535-Quest2017-.name: <font color="#909090">(Court politics! This isn't what you signed up for. It's time to take matters into your own hands. Speak with $npc:11000075[gender:1]$.)</font>

519030511005536-Quest2017-.name: Hmm... Both the minister and the captain bring up good points.

519030511005539-Quest2017-.name: $npcName:11000119[gender:0]$ wants to send an elite team. Let me be that team.

519030511005540-Quest2017-.name: If it were anyone else, I'd call it bravado. But you... You just might be up to the task.

519030511005541-Quest2017-.name: $MyPCName$, we are in your debt. Go now to $map:02000076$ and do what you can to help those people.

519030511005542-Quest2017-.name: The scout's portal is still open. Are you ready to go?

519030511005545-Quest2017-.name: Tell $npcName:11000001[gender:0]$ and $npcName:11000015[gender:1]$ that we will send reinforcements as soon as we have the soldiers to spare. Good luck.

519030511005546-Quest2017-.name: I'm sure you'll be fine. Imperial portals are famous for being a smooth ride. No portal sickness or your next teleportation is free!

519030511005547-Quest2017-.name: I was jok—Ah, never mind. I'm ready.

519030511005548-Quest2017-.name: Tell $npcName:11000001[gender:0]$ and $npcName:11000015[gender:1]$ that we will send reinforcements as soon as we have the soldiers to spare. Good luck.

519030511005549-Quest2017-.name: I haven't seen a fight like that in a long time. You have our thanks.

519030511005550-Quest2017-.name: I believe $npcName:11000015[gender:1]$ would like to speak with you.

519030511005551-Quest2017-.name: I was concerned when you were the only reinforcements we received from $map:02000001$, but it seems the empress knows what she's doing. We're lucky to have you.

519030511005552-Quest2017-.name: It's too early for us to let our guard down, though. We need to be ready for another attack, and we have to make sure we have enough food and supplies.

519030511005554-Quest2017-.name: Probably. In the meantime, I'm going to survey the town. See where we were hit hardest.

519030511005555-Quest2017-.name: Thorough as always, Captain. I leave this in your hands.

519030511005556-Quest2017-.name: The militia will take things from here. $npc:11000001[gender:0]$, you need to get some rest.

519030511005557-Quest2017-.name: The militia will take things from here. $npcName:11000001[gender:0]$, you need to get some rest.

519030511005558-Quest2017-.name: $MyPCName$, if you wouldn't mind, I have a request for you.

519030511005559-Quest2017-.name: This is something of a personal request. I would like you to bring back a certain young man...

519030511005561-Quest2017-.name: His name is $npcName:11000502[gender:0]$, and he's... my son. He was hurt in the fighting, so he should still be at $map:02000027$.

519030511005562-Quest2017-.name: He may not be eager to see me. I was... hard on him earlier.

519030511005564-Quest2017-.name: He spotted the enemy while patrolling $map:02000054$, but he decided to try fighting them himself rather than coming back and reporting their position. Maybe I was being unreasonable, but we can't allow such sloppiness in the militia!

519030511005565-Quest2017-.name: It's because of his actions that many of our friends were hurt. He was too busy chasing glory to bother doing the right thing. Still, I wonder if I wasn't too harsh...

519030511005566-Quest2017-.name: All I want is a nice, quiet conversation with my boy. Will you bring $npcName:11000502[gender:0]$ to me?

519030511005568-Quest2017-.name: All I want is a nice, quiet conversation with my boy. Will you bring $npcName:11000502[gender:0]$ to me? He should be in $map:02000027$.

519030511005570-Quest2017-.name: You don't look like you're here as a patient. So, what can I do for you?

519030511005571-Quest2017-.name: I'm looking for someone in particular.

519030511005572-Quest2017-.name: As you can see, the hospital is empty today. Pretty amazing, considering that we were just under attack. It's all thanks to my patented first aid kits, you know.

519030511005574-Quest2017-.name: I haven't seen that troublemaker all day, and thank goodness for that. I'm always patching up some scrape or bruise on that scamp.

519030511005575-Quest2017-.name: Do you know where I might find $npcName:11000502[gender:0]$?

519030511005576-Quest2017-.name: $npcName:11000961[gender:1]$ is his friend, though I can't say I understand why. She should be on patrol near the hills.

519030511005662-Quest2017-.name: Please... beat up the monsters here and get the $itemPlural:20000050$ they stole. We can use it to help all the injured folk back home.

519030511005690-Quest2017-.name: You can feel it in the air. People are gossiping, wondering where the shadows are going to strike next. And the attacks aren't random, either. They're stirring up memories of a time that most of us would rather forget…

519030511005691-Quest2017-.name: We cannot simply protect $map:02000001$ while the rest of the empire burns. That is why we have turned our attention to the $map:02000146$. Strange things have happened there. In the present and in the past...

519030511005692-Quest2017-.name: $npc:11000076[gender:0]$ is in command of the elite force garrisoned there. It seems he's too busy to file a report with us. I'd like you to go there and find out if it's somehow connected to these recent attacks.

519030511005709-Quest2017-.name: As you can see, things are bad here. We've been gathering samples from the undead monsters for study, but it turns out that they don't take kindly to being harvested.

519030511005710-Quest2017-.name: Even with the reinforcements from $map:02000100$ and $map:02000076$, it's been difficult to collect all of the $itemPlural:20000047$ our scientists need.

519191811006156-Quest2017-.name: I suggest you speak with $npcName:11000264[gender:0]$ in the $map:02000026$. He's the resident expert on darkness and what have you.

519030511005712-Quest2017-.name: Meet with $npcName:11000264[gender:0]$ in the $map:02000026$. He can bring you up to speed on his research. Ah, and collect some $itemPlural:20000047$ for him on the way, if you'd be so kind.

519030511005713-Quest2017-.name: Ahem! Thanks, but no thanks. I haven't got time to entertain the likes of you.

519030511005715-Quest2017-.name: This is a welcome surprise. You're actually competent!

519030511005716-Quest2017-.name: I just happened to need this right now. And you brought a lot of it. Impressive.

519030511005717-Quest2017-.name: It wasn't that hard to get.

519030511005722-Quest2017-.name: Ah, I love people who are easy to rile up. You're the complete opposite of you-know-who.

519030511005724-Quest2017-.name: Hmph. I thought we could have a little fun, but it seems you aren't much for teasing. We already have one too many dour faces here…

519030511005726-Quest2017-.name: The sole representative of the lofty academy of $map:02000023$. A man who loves to meddle in my many experiments. A man with a handsome face and an ice-cold personality...

519030511005727-Quest2017-.name: I think he likes you. Maybe you can keep him from mixing his hocus pocus in with my experiments.

519030511005728-Quest2017-.name: And you've brought a fresh batch of $itemPlural:20000047$. Excellent. We could make great use of your talents right about now.

519030511005729-Quest2017-.name: This place used to be the $map:52000115$, a great monument to the Seven Heroes. After the passage to the Land of Darkness opened, however, people have taken to calling it the $map:02000146$.

519030511005730-Quest2017-.name: This gate is the source of the shadow magic that is spreading across Victoria Island. And now we're even finding $item:20000047$ on the monsters here…

519030511005731-Quest2017-.name: The way to the Land of Darkness was sealed years ago. For it to reappear like this...

519030511005732-Quest2017-.name: The fairfolk of $map:02000023$—and many other groups throughout Maple World—fought so hard to close the passage, and now it is all for naught. This represents a threat to everyone everywhere.

519030511005733-Quest2017-.name: That is why we are trying to understand the nature of this darkness. Simply fighting without understanding will lead us nowhere.

519030511005734-Quest2017-.name: Let's shed some light on this darkness, then.

519030511005735-Quest2017-.name: Very clever. Now, if you're done with your wordplay, I need to borrow $MyPCName$. My analysis is complete.

519030511005736-Quest2017-.name: $MyPCName$, over here. We need to talk.

519030511005738-Quest2017-.name: Yes, yes, you're so great. And?

519030511005739-Quest2017-.name: I'm just making sure we're on the same page about my greatness.

519030511005740-Quest2017-.name: I've gone through enough of these samples to confirm that a blue glowing substance appears whenever I break down $item:20000047$. It's the weirdest thing...

519030511005743-Quest2017-.name: One fool even went into the Land of Darkness himself to see if he could find more of the stuff. He had to check into the hospital after meddling with some crystals there.

519030511005745-Quest2017-.name:

519030511005746-Quest2017-.name: Magic doesn't provide easy answers, but I do have something to show you. Have you prepared the $itemPlural:20000016$ I asked for?

519030511005749-Quest2017-.name: No, no. Surely it didn't slip my mind…

519030511005751-Quest2017-.name: Hey, I need your help. You'll come through for your old friend, won't you?

519030511005752-Quest2017-.name: The $itemPlural:20000016$ he's talking about are made from the $itemPlural:20000045$ that grow here. Most everything is killed by the dark magic in this place, but those fungi thrive. I've often thought they could be used to make an antidote for shadow poisoning...

519030511005753-Quest2017-.name: It was a moot point until recently, since the mushrooms don't take to farming. But one day, $npcName:11000032[gender:0]$ trotted in with an armful of $itemPlural:20000045$. It seems he used his magic to create a garden of the things. Of course magic was the answer...

519030511005755-Quest2017-.name: It's easy for $npcName:11000032[gender:0]$ to blast the beasties with his magic, but most of the schmucks here can't fight to save their lives. So I figured, if he didn't care enough to help out, I might as well get on with my own research...

519030511005756-Quest2017-.name: But since he needs his pills right now, I need the $itemPlural:20000045$ right now. Go fetch them for me and I'll whip up some $itemPlural:20000016$ in a jiffy!

519030511005762-Quest2017-.name: Find some other idiot to do it.

519030511005763-Quest2017-.name: That's the spirit! Simply place the $itemPlural:20000045$ into an open mixer. Child's play.

519030511005765-Quest2017-.name: If you don't get more hands-on in the lab, you'll never make a proper scholar.

519030511005767-Quest2017-.name: Great. Throw your $itemPlural:20000045$ into an open mixer and go wild. If you lost them somehow, you can pick more from the garden.

519030511005768-Quest2017-.name: Just throw your $itemPlural:20000045$ into an open mixer and go wild. If you lost them somehow, you can pick more from the garden.

519030511005769-Quest2017-.name: That looks about right. You did fine, $MyPCName$.

519030511005770-Quest2017-.name: Satisfactory. $npcName:11003143[gender:0]$ has his... quirks, but his work is reliable. I was relieved to find such a competent researcher here.

519030511005771-Quest2017-.name: I'm preeetty sure he hates you.

519030511005772-Quest2017-.name: That's hardly unexpected. Scientists and magicians often don't get along. Most scientists I've met can't stand the thought of a mage such as myself dabbling in their precious research.

519030511005773-Quest2017-.name: $npcName:11003143[gender:0]$ is no exception to this rule. He was shocked when I gave him the blueprints for the mixer... But $npcName:11003143[gender:0]$ and I are scholars, and in that, I consider him a worthy companion.

519030511005774-Quest2017-.name: Now, I need to file my report. $MyPCName$, won't you join me?

519030511005776-Quest2017-.name: To $map:52000133$, of course. $npc:11000031[gender:0]$ will be eager to learn what we've found. And the people here will be relieved to know that one of the Seven Heroes is keeping an eye on things.

519030511005779-Quest2017-.name: I'll open a portal, then. Please close your eyes.

519030511005780-Quest2017-.name: Are you sure? $npc:11000031[gender:0]$ will be eager to see you...

519030511005782-Quest2017-.name: I'll open a portal, then. Please close your eyes.

519030511005783-Quest2017-.name: It seems $npcName:11000032[gender:0]$ has brought me a welcomed guest. I'm glad you're here, $MyPCName$.

519030511005784-Quest2017-.name: $MyPCName$, $npcName:11000032[gender:0]$ has kept me informed of your many adventures. It is good to see you.

519030511005785-Quest2017-.name: You may not be aware of this, but as one of the Seven Heroes, $npcName:11000031[gender:0]$ holds quite a lot of influence beyond these walls. His power rivaled even the Mage of Light, $npcName:11001812[gender:0]$, at his peak.

519030511005786-Quest2017-.name: Oh, I'm just an old mage trying to make himself useful in his final years. However, I've still got the curiosity of an academy freshman. $npcName:11000032[gender:0]$, your report?

519030511005789-Quest2017-.name: I'm glad you decided to join me. I'm sure you'll find my report fascinating.

519030511005790-Quest2017-.name: I've focused my research on the $item:20000047$ of the monsters inhabiting the $map:02000146$. This DNA exudes a blue, glowing substance. In all of my cross-referencing, I can't find mention of such a substance anywhere.

519030511005791-Quest2017-.name: The $itemPlural:20000045$ near the $map:02000146$ give off a similar blue light. I originally believed this light was the mushrooms' life force acting to shield it from the poison of the area, but now I have a different hypothesis.

519030511005792-Quest2017-.name: The $itemPlural:20000045$ are organisms of darkness. Their glow actually spreads dark magic, allowing it to take root in other creatures. I've prepared an experiment to demonstrate.

519030511005793-Quest2017-.name: Please come with me to my lab.

519030511005796-Quest2017-.name: It's not far, but let's teleport to save time.

519030511005797-Quest2017-.name: All right. Let me know when you're ready.
