519030511005802-Quest2017-.name: All right. Let me know when you're ready.

519030511005803-Quest2017-.name: $npcName:11000032[gender:0]$ believes that the power of darkness is spreading. The fall of the $map:52000115$ and the opening of the $map:02000146$ may be the beginning of something terrible…

519030511005804-Quest2017-.name: (But why did the crystal react to you like that?)

519030511005805-Quest2017-.name: $MyPCName$, are you all right? You seem flustered.

519030511005807-Quest2017-.name: Don't fret. Such incidents are common in this kind of research. $npcName:11000032[gender:0]$ will get to the bottom of this mystery.

519030511005808-Quest2017-.name: Now, I have some distressing news: $map:02000023$ is under attack by our dark enemy. Fortunately, we've managed to hold them off for now.

519030511005810-Quest2017-.name: I've raised a simple magical barrier to protect $map:02000023$. Well, I say simple, but I'm pouring a lifetime of magic into it to keep the thing up. I'm afraid I'm quite stuck here as long as I have to maintain the shield.

519030511005811-Quest2017-.name: The students and faculty of $map:52000101$ should be more than enough to keep $map:02000023$ relatively safe. But we can't rely on this barrier forever. We need to strengthen our position and prepare a counterattack.

519030511005812-Quest2017-.name: $MyPCName$, you've faced these invaders in $map:02000100$ and $map:02000076$. This may be your chance to gather vital information on who they are and how they work.

519030511005814-Quest2017-.name: I expected nothing less. One of our more promising students is heading up our research efforts. I believe she'll be most happy to get your help.

519030511005815-Quest2017-.name: Thank you for agreeing to help. One of our more promising students is heading up our research efforts. I believe she'll be most happy to get your help.

519030511005816-Quest2017-.name: You're late! Some of us have things to do, you know.

519030511005817-Quest2017-.name: Hold it right there. What is that smell?! Zombie drool... Bat musk... And shadow poison! You were with $npcName:11000032[gender:0]$ in this state?!

519030511005819-Quest2017-.name: Don't question my sense of smell! Ugh. We need to do something about this, and fast.

519030511005820-Quest2017-.name: The springs here are enchanted to wash away dark magic. Go dunk yourself in it until all the curses wash out.

519030511005821-Quest2017-.name: What's the hold up? Go! Now! I am not spending another second in your presence until you're squeaky clean!

519030511005822-Quest2017-.name: What's the hold up? Go! Now! I am not spending another second in your presence until you're squeaky clean!

519030511005823-Quest2017-.name: I suppose that will do. You don't want dirty hands contaminating your spells and experiments, after all!

519030511005824-Quest2017-.name: Unless you have Professor $npcName:11000032[gender:0]$'s naturally perfect hygiene, the least you can do is splash water on that filthy face of yours from time to time!

519030511005825-Quest2017-.name: The headmaster gave me an absurdly simple job. Honestly, I have more important work to do. That's why I'm sending you to do it, instead.

519030511005826-Quest2017-.name: ...I'll try not to mess it up.

519030511005827-Quest2017-.name: The headmaster built his barrier using the academy's standing stones and totems as a foundation. Even for one of the Seven Heroes, it's hard to keep up that kind of magic for long. That's why we need to make sure the totems are in good shape.

519030511005828-Quest2017-.name: Most of the students of the academy have been sent to make sure the totems are still standing. Some of them never came back. That's the problem.

519030511005829-Quest2017-.name: And you want me to go find them.

519030511005830-Quest2017-.name: You're getting it now. $npcName:11000284[gender:1]$ was the first to lose contact, so I want you to find her first. She has a tendency to lose things, so hopefully that's all it is. Honestly, that girl...

519030511005832-Quest2017-.name: Excuse me, but why do you think it's my job to keep track of my idiot peers? $npcName:11000029[gender:1]$ is always trailing behind her like a sad little puppy. She was sent to $map:02000023$ to distribute supplies, so why don't you try asking her?

519191811006160-Quest2017-.name: I'm not your personal teleport scroll. Do it yourself.

519191811006161-Quest2017-.name: Do you want my help or not?

519191811006162-Quest2017-.name: Fine! Close your eyes and I'll send you straight there... if I feel like it.

519030511005833-Quest2017-.name: Why are you still here? Hurry to $map:02000023$.

519030511005836-Quest2017-.name: I'm sorry, but I don't have any $npcNamePlural:11000284[gender:1]$ for sale.

519030511005838-Quest2017-.name: Oh, you mean that $npcName:11000284[gender:1]$! S-sorry. I'm new to this 'shopkeeping' thing…

519030511005839-Quest2017-.name: But why are you looking for $npcName:11000284[gender:1]$?

519030511005841-Quest2017-.name: That makes sense. I'm sure she's still working on the job she was given in $map:02000006$.

519030511005842-Quest2017-.name: She's a little slow, but it's because she wants to do her best. I'm sure she's being really, really thorough! Since you're going there anyway, can you give her this?

519030511005844-Quest2017-.name: It's a packed lunch with all her favorite foods. Sometimes she gets so focused on her work, she forgets to eat.

519030511005846-Quest2017-.name: Thanks a lot! $npcName:11000284[gender:1]$ is definitely still in $map:02000006$. Please let her know I'm rooting for her!

519030511005850-Quest2017-.name: I had a feeling this might happen, so I packed an extra. Please be more careful this time. I put my heart into making this lunch!

519030511005851-Quest2017-.name: Look inside your bag. It's there. You aren't trying to get extra lunches, are you?

519030511005852-Quest2017-.name: Um... I think you need to make some space in your bag. It's already full!

519030511005853-Quest2017-.name: She's in $map:02000006$. When she's stumped on a problem, she likes to stand by the water and think. I'd look for her there.

519030511005854-Quest2017-.name: I'd love to chat, but I'm on academy business.

519030511005856-Quest2017-.name: This is $npcName:11000029[gender:1]$'s cooking! Thank you for delivering it.

519030511005857-Quest2017-.name: Well, you're still here. You're no ordinary delivery $male:boy,female:girl$, are you?

519030511005858-Quest2017-.name: I was sent to check up on you.

519030511005859-Quest2017-.name: Oh no, really? This is bad. I volunteered to help the headmaster, and now I'm just causing more trouble for everyone else. I'm too much of a dummy to solve this problem...

519030511005861-Quest2017-.name: The totem was already destroyed when I got here. And the forest was crawling with dark monsters! I thought that witch, $npcName:11000304[gender:1]$, might help me, since she's lived here so long...

519030511005862-Quest2017-.name: But instead of telling me what to do, she gave me a riddle. I tried to solve it on my own…

519030511005864-Quest2017-.name: $npcName:11000304[gender:1]$ runs the $map:02000073$, but she doesn't open her door for just anyone. You need to prove that you've got the forest's best interests at heart.

519030511005865-Quest2017-.name: And how can I do that?

519030511005866-Quest2017-.name: Drive the $npcPlural:33000006$ away. They don't belong to this forest. If you show up at her shop covered in the dark magic of her defeated enemies, $npcName:11000304[gender:1]$ will have to listen to you!

519030511005867-Quest2017-.name: Drive the $npcPlural:33000006$ away. They don't belong to this forest. If you show up at her shop covered in the dark magic of her defeated enemies, $npcName:11000304[gender:1]$ will have to listen to you!

519030511005868-Quest2017-.name: Oh, yes, you're coated in it. The icky sticky aura of the shadows. What business brings you to my door, child?

519030511005869-Quest2017-.name: That fairfolk fool sent you to me, didn't she? Did my riddle unwind her puny mind? Heheh...

519030511005870-Quest2017-.name: We need to reinforce the magic barrier!

519030511005871-Quest2017-.name: And I have given her the answer. All she needs to do is solve the riddle.

519030511005872-Quest2017-.name: I'll solve it. How does it go?

519030511005873-Quest2017-.name:
Listen carefully, for I shan't repeat myself!
"Two divine creatures lost their hearts when darkness fell. End their pain and redeem the forsaken soul."

519030511005875-Quest2017-.name: That is the same expression the fairfolk child made. Heheheh...

519030511005877-Quest2017-.name: Certainly, my dear. Here is the clue: Begone from this place before I use your eyes in my stew! Eheheheh!

519030511005878-Quest2017-.name: If you're still puzzling over my riddle, why not get help from the fairfolk girl? Between the two of you, you've got one whole wit!

519030511005881-Quest2017-.name: That's the same thing she told me. Eccentric old bat!

519030511005882-Quest2017-.name: To be honest, I thought this would be a piece of cake. But none of my solutions worked, and when I went to $npcName:11000304[gender:1]$ for help, she mocked me for only getting it half right.

519030511005883-Quest2017-.name: Why did I volunteer to do this? I was happy before. I had decent grades... But now I feel like a total idiot…

519030511005885-Quest2017-.name: There's a place called $map:02000089$ near here. It's the home of $npcName:11000285[gender:0]$, a great turtle who was separated from his love. The forsaken soul was... Well, I thought it was something in the $map:02000074$.

519030511005886-Quest2017-.name: So I did a favor for $npcName:11000285[gender:0]$ and I searched everywhere for anything with a hint of magic in the $map:02000074$. And since then... nothing. No clues, no ideas, just nothing.

519030511005888-Quest2017-.name: No! I did my best, and look where it got me? I just want to give up.

519030511005890-Quest2017-.name: You stay here and sort out your thoughts. I'm going to take a look around the $map:02000074$.

519030511005891-Quest2017-.name: You stay here and sort out your thoughts. I'm going to take a look around the $map:02000074$.

519030511005893-Quest2017-.name: I was about to ask you the same.

519030511005894-Quest2017-.name: I come here when I need to focus. It's a reprieve from all the idiots who stomp around the campus. They're afraid of the ghosts, you see...

519030511005896-Quest2017-.name: Ha! I wouldn't be much of a mage if I were afraid of a little haunting or two.

519030511005897-Quest2017-.name: I answered your question. So what are you doing here?

519030511005899-Quest2017-.name: $npcName:11000304[gender:1]$ was quite right to call you fools. I can't believe you couldn't solve such an obvious riddle on your own...

519030511005901-Quest2017-.name: Yes. And you should feel ashamed that you don't!

519030511005902-Quest2017-.name: If you tell me, I'll let $npcName:11000032[gender:0]$ know you're doing a great job.

519030511005903-Quest2017-.name:
<font color="#909090">(Her cheeks take on a deep blush.)</font>
W-well! Not that I care, but I might as well tell you. <font size='20'>Just don't forget to tell Professor $npcName:11000032[gender:0]$...</font>

519030511005904-Quest2017-.name: One of the lost hearts is $npcName:11000285[gender:0]$, but everything else was wrong. The other heart is the $npcName:22000038$ that lives near $npcName:11000285[gender:0]$. When the darkness first arrived, it drove the girant mad.

519030511005905-Quest2017-.name: To end their pain... You must defeat the $npcName:22000038$ to put it out of its misery. $npcName:11000285[gender:0]$ can still be reasoned with, so you should find some peaceful way to ease his suffering.

519030511005906-Quest2017-.name: And the heart of the forsaken one... There's something here. Take care of the $npcName:22000038$ and $npcName:11000285[gender:0]$ first. Then come back here and see if anything has changed.

519030511005907-Quest2017-.name: I admit, you know your stuff.

519030511005908-Quest2017-.name: As if I care what you think. Hurry to $map:02000089$, defeat the $npcName:22000038$, and figure out what $npcName:11000285[gender:0]$ wants.

519030511005909-Quest2017-.name: As if I care what you think. Hurry to $map:02000089$, defeat the $npcName:22000038$, and figure out what $npcName:11000285[gender:0]$ wants.

519030511005910-Quest2017-.name: You have endured a difficult battle. Please, rest your body and spirit in my spring.

519191911006156-Quest2017-.name: Why have you come to see me? Are you friends with the fairfolk child?

519191911006157-Quest2017-.name: I want to ease your pain.

519191911006158-Quest2017-.name: There is only one thing in the whole world that could do such a thing. I wish to return to the old days, when my love was still by my side and her flowers bloomed…

519191911006159--.name: But that is a wish that can never come true. I will ask of you the same thing that I asked of $npcName:11000284[gender:1]$.

519191911006160--.name: Can you tell me the short version?

519030511005916-Quest2017-.name: My love passed away not long ago, but she returned to me as the flower blossoming on my shell. I planted the seeds of the flower with care, since her spirit lives on with them. But then the monsters came, trampling everything in sight...

519030511005917-Quest2017-.name: Can you save my dying flowers?

519030511005918-Quest2017-.name: $MyPCName$... Have you ever been in love?

519030511005921-Quest2017-.name: Then you understand. I had someone I loved who was dearer to me than life itself. But…

519030511005922-Quest2017-.name: The day the Shadow Gate opened, the lake where we slept boiled like the sea in a raging storm, and she breathed her last breath.

519030511005923-Quest2017-.name: I carried her as far as I could, not knowing where I was going or why. When I returned to my senses, my tears had become this spring, and a flower had blossomed in my love's place.

519030511005924-Quest2017-.name: With every blossoming, I planted another flower seed. These seeds soon grew into flowers themselves. A final beauty, left behind by my love that I might remember her. But now, these monsters trample her flowers...

519030511005925-Quest2017-.name: Can you save my dying flowers?

519030511005926-Quest2017-.name: Perhaps you will not understand, then. I had someone I loved more than life itself. But…

519030511005927-Quest2017-.name: The day the Shadow Gate opened, the lake where we slept boiled like the sea in a raging storm, and she breathed her last breath.

519030511005928-Quest2017-.name: I carried her as far as I could, not knowing where I was going or why. When I returned to my senses, my tears had become this spring, and a flower had blossomed in my love's place.

519030511005929-Quest2017-.name: With every blossoming, I planted another flower seed. These seeds soon grew into flowers themselves. A final beauty, left behind by my love that I might remember her. But now, these monsters trample her flowers...

519030511005930-Quest2017-.name: Can you save my dying flowers?

519030511005931-Quest2017-.name: Can you save my dying flowers?

519030511005932-Quest2017-.name: I am touched by the kindness of your acts. Thank you.

519030511005933-Quest2017-.name: $npcName:11000284[gender:1]$ came to me for a reason. But what about you? What are you looking for?

519030511005935-Quest2017-.name: A forsaken heart... That reminds me of a mage from days long past. He dabbled in forbidden magic so that he could be with the one he loved. This led to his banishment…

519030511005936-Quest2017-.name: He lived out his days as a hermit, but he felt no resentment towards the people who banished him. He didn't want his sacrifices to go to waste. Even in the end, he wished for his power to someday be used for good.

519030511005937-Quest2017-.name: When he passed away, he bound a fragment of his soul to that place. When someone with a good heart seeks his help, this fragment will open and reveal his power.

519030511005938-Quest2017-.name: I need to get back to the $map:02000074$!

519030511005939-Quest2017-.name: You have a good spirit and you wield righteous power. I am certain the forsaken heart will open for you…

519030511005940-Quest2017-.name: You have a good spirit and you wield righteous power. I am certain the forsaken heart will open for you…

519030511005941-Quest2017-.name: <font color="#909090">($npcName:11003255[gender:1]$ is gone, but she left a note.)</font>

519030511005942-Quest2017-.name: "$MyPCName$—It seems like you've solved the riddle. Congratulations. You're not a complete idiot. There's some sort of magic coming from the box under this note. When you're done sorting this mess out, let $npcName:11000284[gender:1]$ know."

519030511005943-Quest2017-.name: "P.S., I solved the riddle easily because I'm great. Not because that other student is incompetent."

519030511005944-Quest2017-.name: <font color="#909090">(Is she trying to show off, or is that her twisted way of defending $npcName:11000284[gender:1]$? You can puzzle out Kate's twisted motives after you've checked out the magic box.)</font>

519030511005945-Quest2017-.name: <font color="#909090">(Is she trying to show off, or is that her twisted way of defending $npcName:11000284[gender:1]$? You can puzzle out Kate's twisted motives after you've checked out the magic box.)</font>

519030511005946-Quest2017-.name: Did you see it? There was a strange light in the sky!

519030511005947-Quest2017-.name: After the flash of gold in the sky, I started feeling some pretty strong magical vibrations. They felt like the headmaster's barrier! Did you figure out the riddle?

519030511005948-Quest2017-.name: (Fill her in on everything that's happened.)

519030511005949-Quest2017-.name: A wooden box is the new totem... Well, I guess I can't complain if it works.

519030511005950-Quest2017-.name: Thanks for all your help. I would have been sunk if it weren't for you.

519030511005951-Quest2017-.name: Do you need to report back to the others?

519030511005952-Quest2017-.name: Um... If it's all the same to you, I want to study this new totem for a bit. Do you mind reporting in for me?

519030511005954-Quest2017-.name: Professor $npcName:11000033[gender:0]$. He's the magical texts teacher. He should be waiting near the $map:02000035$ in $map:02000023$. While you're there, maybe tell him that my homework is going to be a tiiiiiny bit late...

519030511005955-Quest2017-.name: Please report to Professor $npcName:11000033[gender:0]$ in my place. He should be waiting near the $map:02000035$ in $map:02000023$. While you're there, maybe tell him that my homework is going to be a tiiiiiny bit late...

519030511005956-Quest2017-.name: Do you have business with me?

519030511005958-Quest2017-.name: I'm glad she was able to complete her task... even if she had help. It's unfortunate about her homework, though.

519030511005959-Quest2017-.name: You're helping $npcName:11003146[gender:1]$ maintain the barrier, are you not? If that's the case, there's something I need taken care of quickly. You seem like the $male:man,female:woman$ for the job.

519030511005961-Quest2017-.name: The barrier is busy defending against attacks from the outside, of course. However, it seems to be taking attacks from the inside, as well. We need to find the source of these attacks and snuff it out.

519030511005962-Quest2017-.name: While reviewing my histories of magic, I came upon references to an old temple called $map:02000312$. The dark fairies worked to create something called a "shadow seed" in that place.

519030511005963-Quest2017-.name: When the shadow seed is planted in a living creature, the subject loses its identity and becomes a monster filled with bloodlust. Eventually, the subject becomes a shadow itself…

519030511005965-Quest2017-.name: That kind of magic tends to cling to a place. If a mage had the power and inclination, they could harness that power and do some real harm to $map:02000023$ without ever leaving the barrier. According to my research, the temple should be somewhere in $map:02000024$.

519030511005966-Quest2017-.name: I have a shipment from the $map:52000103$ that I must attend to. $MyPCName$, will you go to $map:02000024$ and see if you can find this $map:02000312$?

519030511005967-Quest2017-.name: One of my students, $npcName:11000876[gender:0]$, is already there. Between the two of you, I'm sure you'll puzzle out some way to uncover $map:02000312$.

519030511005968-Quest2017-.name: One of my students, $npcName:11000876[gender:0]$, is already there. Between the two of you, I'm sure you'll puzzle out some way to uncover $map:02000312$.

519030511005969-Quest2017-.name: Help has finally come! I knew the professor wouldn't forget me.

519030511005970-Quest2017-.name: Professor $npcName:11000033[gender:0]$ said he'd send someone along to help me, but he didn't say it would be you! Wow!

519030511005971-Quest2017-.name: When I first got here, I tried asking $npcName:11000293$, the old tree sprite, about $map:02000312$, but he just smiled and said he doesn't remember. I think I know how to jog his memory, though…

519030511005972-Quest2017-.name: What do you have in mind?

519030511005973-Quest2017-.name: We've gotta feed him something sweet! Whenever I can't remember what I'm doing, that's what I do. The boxes around here should have $itemPlural:20000052$ for $npcName:11000293$, but the monsters won't let him at them.

519030511005974-Quest2017-.name: What a good plan. I will get those leaves.

519030511005975-Quest2017-.name: I'll leave it to you! Once you have the $itemPlural:20000052$, take them straight to $npcName:11000293$. And don't forget to defeat the noisy monsters. We want our tree sprite friend to be distraction-free!

519030511005976-Quest2017-.name: I'll leave it to you! Once you have the $itemPlural:20000052$, take them straight to $npcName:11000293$. And don't forget to defeat the noisy monsters. We want our tree sprite friend to be distraction-free!

519030511005978-Quest2017-.name: I am $MyPCName$, and I have your $itemPlural:20000052$.

519030511005979-Quest2017-.name: Oh... My $itemPlural:20000052$... I was just thinking of these. I couldn't get to them because of all the monsters...

519030511005980-Quest2017-.name: You can thank me by telling me about $map:02000312$.

519030511005981-Quest2017-.name: You must be a friend of that other. $npcName:11000876[gender:0]$. Fine. I will try to remember.

519030511005982-Quest2017-.name: So sweet. I love to eat the leaves. And swim. Swim, swim, swim in the cold water with a belly full of sweets.

519030511005983-Quest2017-.name: The water here is so fun. Fun to jump from the high waterfall. The high... waterfall...

519030511005984-Quest2017-.name: I remember! There is a cave. Behind the waterfall. Tiny dark fairies go in and out!

519030511005985-Quest2017-.name: I remember! There is a cave. Behind the waterfall. Tiny dark fairies go in and out!

519030511005986-Quest2017-.name: I assume your search for $map:02000312$ was a success.

519030511005987-Quest2017-.name: Yes, and $npcName:23000039[gender:1]$ was waiting when I got there.

519030511005988-Quest2017-.name: That is unexpected. I was certain the temple would be empty...

519030511005989-Quest2017-.name: (Tell him about the battle and the shadow seeds.)

519030511005990-Quest2017-.name: Incredible. This $npcName:23000039[gender:1]$ is mentioned in many of $map:02000001$'s records.

519030511005991-Quest2017-.name: My worst fears have been confirmed. Someone is using the dark magic of that place against us.

519030511005992-Quest2017-.name: The headmaster needs to learn of this immediately.

519030511005993-Quest2017-.name: Harnessing the power of a forgotten evil to attack the barrier from within... This is far more insidious than any of the attacks coming from the outside. It would be best if you deliver your report in person.

519030511005994-Quest2017-.name: Okay. Beam me back to the academy!

519030511005995-Quest2017-.name: Hm? No, no, you should make your own way back there. You... do know how to get back to $map:52000101$, don't you?

519030511005996-Quest2017-.name: Would you believe me if I said no?

519030511005997-Quest2017-.name: That is inconvenient. I'd tell you how to proceed, but the mage in charge of the express is quite firm that such details should not be given out freely. All I can give you is a hint...

519030511005998-Quest2017-.name: Sure. This seems like a great time for another riddle.

519030511005999-Quest2017-.name: Seek out the littlest mage in $map:02000023$. She will open the way to $map:52000101$.

519030511006000-Quest2017-.name: It should be no difficulty for someone of your caliber to find the littlest mage in $map:02000023$. I wish you luck.

519030511006001-Quest2017-.name: <font color="#909090">(There's a mischievous twinkle in the cat's eye.)</font>

519030511006002-Quest2017-.name: Ahem. Pardon me, Madame Kitty, but do you know where I can board the Ellinel Express?

519030511006003-Quest2017-.name: Ah, my dear $MyPCName$. I was wondering how long it would take for you to figure it out.

519030511006004-Quest2017-.name: Those foolish fairfolk! Do I look like a conductor to you? Do you see any trains here? And yet they insist on calling my service the "Ellinel Express..."

519030511006005-Quest2017-.name: You have a lot of opinions for a cat.

519030511006006-Quest2017-.name: As if we would deal in something so antiquated as a train. We use tidy dimensional portals to get around. We are mages, after all.

519030511006007-Quest2017-.name: Anyway, are you sure you want to use my portal? It's perfectly safe! Unless you're a trespasser, in which case you'll get dumped into a purgatory dimension for all eternity.

519030511006009-Quest2017-.name: Well, it was nice knowing you. Just jump into the portal next to me. You'll wind up... somewhere.

519030511006010-Quest2017-.name: Well, it was nice knowing you. Just jump into the portal next to me. You'll wind up... somewhere.

519030511006011-Quest2017-.name: You're no help at all. Professor $npcName:11000032[gender:0]$ is getting... irritable.

519030511006013-Quest2017-.name: Focus, you two! What happened to the children?

519030511006014-Quest2017-.name: I'll tell you right away, Professor! As for you, $MyPCName$... We'll talk later.

519030511006015-Quest2017-.name: One of Professor $npcName:11000032[gender:0]$'s potions is... missing. Someone left this note in their place.

519030511006016-Quest2017-.name: "I'm taking this to save $map:02000023$. Signed, Team $MyPCName$"

519030511006018-Quest2017-.name: I recognize that childish handwriting. It's $npcName:11001165[gender:0]$. It seems he's started a fanclub for you, $MyPCName$.

519030511006020-Quest2017-.name: We showed the note to his adopted brother, $npcName:11001167[gender:0]$, and then he ran off, too. He's going to need help.

519030511006021-Quest2017-.name: $npcName:11003146[gender:1]$... Do you know exactly which potion the child took?

519030511006022-Quest2017-.name: He left the store room a mess, Professor. I'd need to go through the whole inventory checklist to see…

519030511006023-Quest2017-.name: This is troubling. I had a sample of shadow reagents in that room. If the children took that, mistaking it for a potion...

519030511006024-Quest2017-.name: I'll find them before it comes to that.

519030511006025-Quest2017-.name: Professor $npcName:11000032[gender:0]$ and I will go through our inventory. $MyPCName$, find those kids and bring them home. $npcName:11001167[gender:0]$ should still be in $map:02000101$.

519030511006026-Quest2017-.name: Professor $npcName:11000032[gender:0]$ and I will go through our inventory. $MyPCName$, find those kids and bring them home. $npcName:11001167[gender:0]$ should still be in $map:02000101$.

519030511006027-Quest2017-.name: I can't believe him... That troublemaker...

519030511006028-Quest2017-.name: $npcName:11001167[gender:0]$, I presume? I'm here to help.

519030511006029-Quest2017-.name: Y-you're $MyPCName$! I can't believe it. Please, I'm counting on you!

519030511006030-Quest2017-.name: Ever since you got here, $npcName:11001165[gender:0]$ has been obsessed with being as great as you. It was all fun and games at first, but then he started talking about taking the fight to the forces of darkness...

519030511006031-Quest2017-.name: Then he said he saw a suspicious shadow while playing hide and seek. I warned him to be careful, since $map:02000101$ really is in danger, but that just made him more excited...

519030511006032-Quest2017-.name: I'm worried he and his friends went into the forest where they were playing. $npcName:11001172[gender:1]$ will be okay, since she can use some healing magic, but the others...

519030511006033-Quest2017-.name: I'll search to the north. $MyPCName$, could you search to the south? And if you find them, give them a good talking to!

519030511006034-Quest2017-.name: I'll search to the north. $MyPCName$, could you search to the south? And if you find them, give them a good talking to!

Outside of our world, there are countless other planes of existence. Between these different worlds, binding it all together is a great divine being, who has sent an emissary to each of these worlds.

713175511006251-Quest2017_2-.name: These emissaries are born with hearts full of both good and evil. When the time comes, they choose one of the two paths. These emissaries are called the Innocent.

713175511006252-Quest2017_2-.name: And you think Maple World's Innocent is...

713175511006253-Quest2017_2-.name: I'm not certain, but I think you're on the right track. A man whose magical abilities are endless... Who has vast knowledge of lost civilizations... 713175511006254-Quest2017_2-.name: If $npcName:11000032[gender:0]$ were simply a talented mage, then I think things would have happened quite a bit differently during the incident...

713175511006255-Quest2017_2-.name: Normally, a mage as skilled as $npcName:11000032[gender:0]$ should have been able to ward himself against the power of darkness. But that isn't what happened, is it?

713175511006256-Quest2017_2-.name: According to my records, the Innocents walk a fine line between good and evil. Eventually, each Innocent must choose between the light and the dark, but choosing one doesn't mean that the other simply goes away. I think that the shadow poison caused $npcName:11000032[gender:0]$'s evil side to temporarily awaken.

713175511006257-Quest2017_2-.name: If our enemy tried to turn $npcName:11000032[gender:0]$'s nature against us, then it is clear that they know more about the Innocents than we do.

713175511006258-Quest2017_2-.name: $npcName:11000032[gender:0]$ is beloved and respected in $map:02000023$. For now, I'd appreciate it if you kept what happened between him and $npcName:11000031[gender:0]$ a secret.

713175511006269-Quest2017_2-.name: Can't you take care of it yourself?

713175511006270-Quest2017_2-.name: There's a hollow section in the trunk of the $map:02000128$. A certain mushroom grows there in the $map:02000012$. I need that mushroom to make a reagent.

713175511006271-Quest2017_2-.name: Gather mushrooms from the $map:02000012$ of the $map:02000128$. Be sure to gather plenty, as I'm not sure exactly how much I need.

713175511006272-Quest2017_2-.name: If you want to do the research while I go out to get the mushrooms, fine. Be my guest. I'm sure the monsters there will find me quite delicious...

713175511006273-Quest2017_2-.name: Fine, I'll go! Just tell me what to do.

713175511006274-Quest2017_2-.name: Gather mushrooms from the $map:02000012$ of the $map:02000128$. Be sure to gather plenty, as I'm not sure exactly how much I need.

713175511006276-Quest2017_2-.name: Thanks to the $item:30000179$ and mushrooms you've brought me, the ritual to reawaken $npcName:11000032[gender:0]$ is going well. I'm afraid this last ingredient may be a tad... challenging.

713175511006278-Quest2017_2-.name: There's a certain root that only grows in the $map:02000206$. It thrives on chaos, and it actually has the power to purify dark magic. But there's a problem...

713175511006279-Quest2017_2-.name: A powerful monster of the forest, $npcName:23000025[gender:0]$, absorbed the $itemPlural:30000190$. The only way to retrieve the root is to defeat him.

713175511006280-Quest2017_2-.name: Can I rely on you to defeat $npcName:23000025[gender:1]$ of the $map:02000206$?
