1226205419008344--.name: Argh! Just how many deliveries did they split their data into? I'm all for digital security, but this is overkill.

1226205419008345--.name: If I was handling this mission as a Shadow Walker, I'd have already gotten the information we need with nothing but my eye-gouging spoon and some creatively-placed electrical clamps.

1226205419008346--.name: <font color="#909090">(Just what kind of organization are the Shadow Walkers running?)</font>

1226205419008347--.name: Just a little further! Extrapolating from the data we've collected, there's just one more location we need to hit!

1226205419008348--.name: Time to go in for the kill! Err, metaphorically speaking. It looks like there's a computer connected directly to this last array. That's even better. Next stop, $map:02000269$!

1226205419008349--.name: Once you get the final data chunk, we'll be able to reconstruct their airships' trade routes. Plus, we'll be able to harvest any juicy communications between Barrota and one of their customers.

1226205419008350--.name: Great! I'll be back in a flash!

1226205419008351--.name: Oh... Are you in a hurry to complete our mission? That's too bad, I was hoping to spend more time with you. Well, fly safe!

1226205419008352--.name: Did you forget something? Or are you here to see me? I'd love to play with you, but this place is a little too public.

1226205419008353--.name: Whew... We've finally got all the data! I'll pore over any information regarding the trade routes and see if I can't learn something.

1226205419008354--.name: The new president of Barrota Trading Company is something else. I've never seen such a sophisticated approach to data security. I'm not sure if I should be amazed or worried.

1226205419008355--.name: They didn't make this mission easy.

1226205419008356--.name:
Yes, you've been through quite the ordeal. How about a little reward for your efforts?
<font color="#909090">(She kisses you on the cheek.)</font>

1226205419008358--.name: Oh my, you've turned bright red. Do you have a fever? Come back to my quarters and I'll take care of you.

1226205419008359--.name: Excuse me. I just remembered, I have to... go to... place...

1226205419008360--.name: Haha. Why are you running away? Well, thanks for all your help!

1226205419008362--.name: I've reached out to our contact in the Barrota Trading Company, and he's agreed to smuggle us the ledger documenting the company's business transactions, and more importantly, cargo manifests.

1226205419008363--.name: It may be that the missing airships were attacked by someone after the goods they were carrying.

1226205419008364--.name: But we'll need the ledger to prove that hypothesis.

1226205419008365--.name: Your job will be to meet with our contact at $map:02000139$. I'll monitor the situation from above, just in case there are any complications.

1226205419008366--.name: Oh! And you don't need to worry about getting there. I've already arranged travel for you!

1226205419008367--.name:
Guardian Six, this is the bridge. Begin pre-flight checks. Destination $map:02000139$. $MyPCName$ will be aboard momentarily.
<font color="#909090">(She gestures you toward the flight deck.)</font>

1226205419008368--.name: $MyPCName$, you're back already? Where's the ledger?

1226205419008370--.name: You're $MyPCName$, right? What brings you here?

1226205419008371--.name: I'm here as a representative of the Maple Alliance.

1226205419008372--.name: So you're the one the Green Hoods sent! Well, I'm glad it's a familiar face, considering everything that's been going on.

1226205419008374--.name: Sigh... Where do I start? The Barrota Trading Company got a new president after what happened to $npcName:11000526[gender:0]$. The position's been vacant for a long time, so initially people were pretty happy.

1226205419008375--.name: But the new president is a complete mystery. I've certainly never seen them, and I don't even know their name. And as if that weren't weird enough, the whole company's gotten so secretive.

1226205419008376--.name: We're doing a crazy amount of business in arms sales right now, with the times we live in. It might even be our main source of revenue. But every single transaction gets entered into a single paper ledger by hand.

1226205419008378--.name: There's local records, but the ledger is the only document with the whole picture. Whatever secrets they're hiding are gonna ruin this company someday. That's why I took the ledger, only it's protected by some kind of magic.

1226205419008379--.name: I figure if there's anyone with Victoria Island's best interest at heart, it's the alliance. That's why I reached out. Please, find someone who can unseal this magicked ledger.

1226205419008380--.name: Does taking the ledger place you in any danger?

1226205419008381--.name: I'll be fine. I intercepted the ledger while it was in transit from the president's office to somewhere else. There's no way anyone would know it was me who swiped the ledger.

1226205419008382--.name: You never know. You should be careful.

1226205419008383--.name: Thanks for the concern. Well, I'm putting my trust in you!

1226205419008384--.name: So this is the secret ledger! Unghh. Solvay was right, the cover won't budge!

1226205419008385--.name: We'll need a skilled wizard in order to get past the magical seal on this book. I don't supposed you happen to know any, $MyPCName$?

1226205419008386--.name: $npcName:11000033[gender:0]$ in $map:02000023$ might be able to help us.

1226205419008387--.name: Oh wow! I'm glad you actually know someone. Researching where to find skilled wizards could've taken a while.

1226205419008388--.name: Is that... something you can just research?

1226205419008389--.name: Thanks, $MyPCName$. I'll charter a transport to $map:02000023$ right now.

1226205419008390--.name: Well, did you have any luck? I'm getting a little nervous, because Condor has started talking about busting the ledger open with a sword.

1226205419008394--.name: Well, this is new. It's usually me who comes to you for help. Tell me what the problem is, and I'll see if I can't help.

1226205419008395--.name: This ledger has been sealed by magic. I was hoping you could help me get it open.

1226205419008396--.name: Where did you get this? I sense this book is enchanted with an extremely complex spell.

1226205419008398--.name: Oh, I was simply curious. $MyPCName$, I'm sorry to say but I'm afraid protection magic is not my specialty.

1226205419008399--.name: However, I do know an expert in the subject.

1226205419008401--.name: Why, it's someone with whom you are well acquainted. The class president of Ellinel Magic Academy!

1226205419008402--.name: You're in luck, $MyPCName$. It just so happens that she's here in $map:02000023$.

1226205419008403--.name: I believe she would have no trouble overcoming magic like this.

1226205419008405--.name: More often than not, just outside the $map:02000109$. She said she goes there to think. You should start your search there.

1226205419008406--.name: She can usually be found outside of $map:02000109$. You should look there.

1226205419008407--.name: Well, if it isn't $MyPCName$. What brings you here?

1226205419008408--.name: I came looking for some help with a magic problem.

1226205419008409--.name: Well, you've certainly come to the right wizard for that!

1226205419008410--.name: Are you really an expert in protection magic?

1226205419008411--.name: There's little magic I wouldn't consider myself an expert in.

1226205419008413--.name: I can't just sit around all day helping just anyone, but I suppose I can make time for you.

1226205419008414--.name: So what is this magical problem you need my help with?

1226205419008415--.name:
I need to get this book open so I can see what's inside.
<font color="#909090">(You hand her the ledger.)</font>

1226205419008416--.name: What is this book? The charm-work on this seal is meticulous... I can see why a lesser wizard would have trouble opening it. Of course, for me it would be childsplay.

1226205419008417--.name: That's great! Go ahead and open it.

1226205419008418--.name: Patience! You can't break a seal like this just by waving a magic wand. Undoing a protection charm is extremely intricate work.

1226205419008419--.name: This charm isn't particularly difficult to undo so much as it is a chore. I'll need a number of reagents for my work, including several vials of the $itemPlural:30001033$.

1226205419008421--.name: As any capable student of magic would know, $item:30001033$ can be found in the springs of the $map:02000090$. Now, hurry along.

1226205419008422--.name: You know, it would probably save us a lot of time if you could teleport me there.

1226205419008423--.name: Of course I could teleport you there! I'm a first-rate wizard.

1226205419008425--.name:
Sigh. Well, if I must do everything myself. Ready?
<font color="#909090">(She raises her staff in the air and magical energies begin to flow forth.)</font>

1226205419008426--.name: You should be more grateful that I'm helping you.

1226205419008427--.name: Did you bring what I asked for? Ah yes, this should be enough.

1226205419008428--.name: Great! What say we crack open this bad boy?

1226205419008429--.name: You can't rush good magic! This is just one of the reagents needed. We still have a long way to go before we can see what's inside this book of yours.

1226205419008430--.name: The particular charm we are dealing with has two components that must be defeated.

1226205419008432--.name: $MyPCName$, you really should expand your magical knowledge if you want to get anywhere... Very well, I'll explain. Just remember to tell Professor $npcName:11000032[gender:0]$ how big a help I've been to you with this matter.

1226205419008434--.name: Good. Now, as I've said, the protection charm on this book has two components. The first is the seal preventing the book from being opened.

1226205419008435--.name: Unfortunately, once we finally get the book open, we encounter a problem with the content of the book: the second component of the charm. Do you know what that is?

1226205419008436--.name: No! Remember, this is a magical problem, not a logistical one. Try again.

1227104719008723--.name: ...At any point in your entire life, has there ever been a time where an answer became less wrong when repeated?

1226205419008437--.name: That's right. The second component of the book's protective charm is a vanishing spell. Opening the book does us no good if we can't see the words inside it.

1226205419008439--.name: Good! Now, naturally, the reagent we'll need to outwit the charm is...?

1226205419008441--.name: It's $item:30001034$, of course! There should be plenty at $map:02000019$. Go and bring some back.

1226205419008442--.name: Would you mind teleporting me there?

1226205419008443--.name: ...I suppose. But next time you see Professor $npcName:11000032[gender:0]$, you should let him know how nice I've been to you.

1226205419008444--.name: There's no reading what's in this book without $item:30001034$. I suggest you go get some.

1226205419008447--.name: Perfect! There's one more thing I need you go get.

1226205419008448--.name: Now, there's one more thing I need you to get.

1226205419008449--.name: Didn't you say there were only two components to the protective charm?

1226205419008451--.name: Then don't we have everything we need to remove the charm?

1226205419008452--.name: I said I needed it, I never said it was for the spell. Do you want to be able to read your book or not?!

1226205419008453--.name: Relax, I'll get it! Just tell me what you need.

1226205419008458--.name: They have other applications! Now, are you going to get them or not?

1226205419008461--.name: If you want to see what's on this ledger, you'll bring me $itemPlural:30000232$!

1226205419008463--.name: I'm going to use the cherries to conjure up a cake for Professor $npcName:11000032[gender:0]$…

1226205419008465--.name: Even though I came back to work with him, Professor $npcName:11000032[gender:0]$ has been different ever since the incident with Pathos.

1226205419008466--.name: I just want things to go back to the way they were before... Agh, why am I even talking about this with you?

1226205419008469--.name: ...Thanks. Now let's remove that protection charm!

1226205419008471--.name: Essentially, what we're doing is reversing each part of the charm. With a little incantation, the $item:30001033$ shows me how they sealed the book. I just perform the spell backwards and it'll pop right open! And then we coat the pages with $item:30001034$ to render the text visible.

1226205419008473--.name: <font color="#909090">(You open the book with ease, and its text slowly reveals itself before you.)</font>

1226205419008474--.name: Surprised? You should've expected nothing less from such a skilled Wizard.

1226205419008475--.name: Thanks! I'd better get this back to the Sky Fortress.

1226205419008477--.name: Remember, if Professor $npcName:11000032[gender:0]$ asks about me, tell him how indispensable I've been!

1226205419008478--.name: $MyPCName$, you're back! Did you find someone who could unseal Barrota's secret ledger?

1226205419008479--.name:
I did!
<font color="#909090">(You hand her the ledger.)</font>

1226205419008480--.name: Fantastic! Good work, I'll take it from here.

1226205419008481--.name: ...Huh? I was expecting to spend hours combing through the numbers looking for suspicious transactions... But I guess when your ledger is magically sealed, you can just leave the shady business out in the open.

1226205419008483--.name: It looks like Barotta's been skimming goods from their munitions deals and re-selling them! But there's no mention of who they're selling to. And most of these goods are banned for export.

1226205419008484--.name: Top-of-the-line infantry armor from Nerman Forge... Lightweight alloys used in airship and weapons construction... and a large number of floatstones.

1226205419008485--.name: Considering the quantity of goods being offloaded, they could easily form a small airship fleet.

1226205419008486--.name: Hm... It looks like shipments have been going missing on a regular basis. But they've been able to cover their losses because of the high price of their goods.

1226205419008487--.name: Why are shipments getting lost so frequently? I'll report our findings to the captain and continue my investigation.

1226205419008488--.name: $MyPCName$, thank you for all your hard work! I'll let you know what I learn when my analysis is complete.

1226205419008490--.name: I suppose I have an assignment you could help with.

1226205419008492--.name: As per the captain's orders, the Lumiknights will investigate the $map:52010053$ for any anomalies in the region.

1226205419008493--.name: As we've detected a large number of monsters nearby, I would like you to fulfill your duty as a guardian of Maple World and secure the area.

1226205419008494--.name: Me? What happened to dispatching the Lumiknights?

1226205419008495--.name: While the existence of the Lumiknights has been declassified, it is still advantageous to operate in secret. To that end, we avoid large-scale public operations.

1226205419008496--.name: Therefore, I'd like you to accompany me to discreetly investigate the crash site.

1226205419008497--.name: Sure. But why do you need my help? You seem plenty capable with your magic floating sword and all.

1226205419008498--.name: You speak of Deireadh, the unbreakable sword. I had it forged by a blademelder I met in the firelands during my travels through the astral plane.

1226205419008499--.name: The blade is sentient, and its magical enchantments allow it access to the secrets of the universe... which has proven to be something of a burden.

1226205419008500--.name: As a consequence of this, Deireadh has developed a sort of death wish. But being indestructible, it must content itself with the demise of others. You can see how this would be a problem.

1226205419008501--.name: Thankfully, it is bound to my will. But should I give the order for it to strike, it may be difficult to stop the blade before it has unleashed unspeakable devastation and bloodshed.

1226205419008502--.name: ...Okay then, so I guess I'll be taking care of any monsters at our destination.

1226205419008503--.name: Excellent. Now, shall we descend to the crash site?

1226205419008504--.name: What are you waiting for? There's work to be done at the crash site.

1226205419008505--.name: You're as skilled as I had heard. It's good I brought you with me.

1226205419008506--.name: The monsters here seem even more aggressive than usual. I believe something here is causing it.

1226205419008507--.name: It's faint, but I sense... darkness.

1226205419008509--.name: This energy is unlike the darkness we usually encounter. But it's hard to say any more without a more concentrated sample.

1226205419008510--.name: I need a conduit to the darkness. Please bring me any debris you suspect may be tainted by darkness to inspect.

1226205419008511--.name: You're not going to help me look?

1226205419008512--.name: That would be inadvisable. Ever since I was cursed to feed on darkness by the bloodwitch of the distant Eastwilds, I find it quite difficult to control myself around the stuff. I'd hate to eat myself into a frenzy.

1226205419008513--.name: On second thought, I'll see what I can find on my own.

1226205419008514--.name: Excellent. I'll leave it to you.

1226205419008515--.name: Please bring me any objects you suspect may be tainted with the darkness, so I may inspect them.

1226205419008516--.name: Ah, yes. I sense a concentrated darkness coming from your general direction.

1226205419008517--.name: Let me see what you've found.

1226205419008518--.name: Should you be inspecting these... considering what you said earlier?

1226205419008519--.name: Hmm? I don't know what you mean. Now, let's have a look.

1226205419008525--.name: The samples you found are infused with dark energy, but... I'm at a loss for words.

1226205419008526--.name: It's like nothing I've ever sensed...

1226205419008528--.name: This is... no ordinary darkness. It belongs to an ancient evil. Perhaps one not seen since the time of the two goddesses.

1226205419008529--.name: Could it be remnants of the goddess of darkness?

1226205419008530--.name: Unfortunately, no. There is no aura of divinity to this dark energy.

1226205419008531--.name: I need to report our findings to the captain and the Lumiknights' high command immediately.

1226205419008532--.name: $MyPCName$, thank you for your help. Let's return to the ship.

1226205419008533--.name: It appears everyone has finished their investigations.

1226205419008534--.name: We should gather and discuss our discoveries.

1226205419008535--.name: I'm convening an officers' meeting. Everyone should join me in the briefing room. That includes you, $MyPCName$.

1226205419008536--.name: Everyone, follow me to the briefing room. That includes you, $MyPCName$.

1226205419008537--.name: First I want to thank you all for making this investigation your top priority, despite your other responsibilities.

1226205419008538--.name: Oh it was no trouble. $MyPCName$ did all the heavy-lifting.

1226205419008539--.name: That's right! My analysis of the Barrota ledger is nearly complete thanks to $MyPCName$'s efforts.

1226205419008540--.name: $male:He's,female:She's$ certainly proven $male:himself,female:herself$ to be a sleuth worthy of the Imperial Vanguard.

1226205419008541--.name: Yes, yes, $MyPCName$ was indispensable to my investigation as well. Now, we have important matters to discuss.

1226205419008542--.name: My findings thus far have left me deeply concerned.

1226205419008543--.name: That makes the two of us, Mason. I've had a pit in my stomach ever since all this began.

1226205419008544--.name: Let's begin by going over each faction's findings.

1226205419008545--.name: Condor, why don't you tell us what the Imperial Vanguard has learned?

1226205419008546--.name: Ahem. Allow me to direct your attention to this photograph.

1226205419008547--.name: We investigated the rumors of missing airships circulating Victoria Island with little to show for it, except ominous tales of an ancient foe, and this blurry picture of a weird-necked bird.

1226205419008548--.name: Uh... That's not like any bird I've ever seen. I think maybe you're looking at it upside down.

1226205419008549--.name: I'm not an idiot! I've looked at it from all angles, and this way makes the most sense. Look, you hold it right-side-up and it's a bird-monster. You turn it this way, and—

1226205419008551--.name: That's no bird! In fact, that looks like a—it can't be…

1226205419008552--.name: I suspect you've reached the same conclusion that I have.

1226205419008553--.name: We discovered traces of dark energy at the crash site. However, it was quite unlike the sort of darkness the Lumiknights generally encounter. Still, it felt familiar…

1226205419008554--.name: That menacing aura, combined with your own discoveries could very well mean... Well, I'll reserve judgment until everyone's had an opportunity to speak.

1226205419008555--.name: All right. Nairin, what was the result of the Green Hoods' investigation?

1226205419008556--.name: After a great deal of effort, $MyPCName$ unsealed the secret ledger of the Barrota Trading Company which we received from Solvay.

1226205419008557--.name: It seems the newly-appointed president of the company was skimming from trade deals with the alliance to resell highly controlled armaments. Infantry armor, lightweight alloys, a tremendous number of floatstones, and so on.

1226205419008558--.name: We haven't determined who the buyer was, but it's clear a great deal of military hardware was illegally traded. What's worse, several tons of the goods are missing. There's a good chance they were lost aboard the missing ships.

1226205419008559--.name: That explains the insane amount of effort Barrota's invested into scrambling their data transmissions across multiple communications arrays.

1226205419008560--.name: Of course, I had no trouble reassembling the data containing their trade routes. And I've learned something quite interesting.

1226205419008561--.name: A few of Barrota's airships have documented departures, but no record of ever arriving. More missing ships!

1226205419008562--.name: Between these and the vessels we already knew about, all our missing airships were at some point within the vicinity of Orbis... Sooo, I think we can rule out coincidence.

1226205419008564--.name: Wasn't Orbis that city that was obliterated during the War of Light and Darkness?

1226205419008565--.name: Oh, the city's still there, it's just uninhabitable. There's a crater at its heart that's still burning to this day.

1226205419008566--.name: In other words, there's no way pirates would have set up some kind of a base there to plunder passing ships. Unless they like watching their skin slough off like hot cheese, hehe.

1226205419008567--.name: But that's assuming our culprits are human... What if the beings attacking these ships were ones that thrive in fire?

1226205419008571--.name: Captain! I've just got word from our analysts that they've finished reconstructing the data from the black box!

1226205419008572--.name: Perhaps now we can finally get to the bottom of this.

1226205419008573--.name: I think we have all of the information we need.

1226205419008574--.name: Have them display the footage on the viewscreen!

1226205419008579--.name: They're processing the footage now, Captain.

1226205419008583--.name: That's it! No wonder they looked so familiar.

1226205419008584--.name: This explains the peculiarities I sensed within the darkness at the crash site.

1226205419008585--.name: It seems at long last we know the face of the enemy.

1226205419008586--.name: I believe we've learned all we need.

1226205419008587--.name: $npcName:11003536[gender:0]$, using all of the data we've gathered thus far, construct a search profile and feed it to our scanners. If need be, we'll scour the world for the Crimson Balrogs.

1226205419008589--.name: The Crimson Balrogs can't hide for long.

1226205419008591--.name: Captain, we're getting radar pings. Dozens... no, hundreds of signals!

1226205419008594--.name: After all these years in hiding, why would they suddenly draw attention to themselves with a full-scale assault? I don't know what we're walking into down there, but we have an opportunity today to end a dire threat to this world.

1226205419008595--.name: How dare they threaten my homeland! Give me a ship, and I'll lay waste to them all!

1226205419008597--.name: Get a hold of yourself, $npcName:11003534[gender:0]$. We will meet this threat with a united front.

1226205419008598--.name: We have our mission. Prepare yourselves to engage the enemy.

1226205419008599--.name: We have our mission. Set a course for Perion, maximum speed!

1226205419008600--.name: Set a course for Perion, maximum speed!

1226205419008601--.name: You arrived in the nick of time. I'm in your debt.

1226205419008603--.name: Allow me to properly introduce myself. I'm $npcName:11000144[gender:0]$.

1226205419008604--.name: You have the gall to show your face here after all this time?!

1226205419008605--.name: It's been a while, $npcName:11003534[gender:0]$. I see you're just as fiery as always.

1226205419008606--.name: Where have you been? And why have you come back now? Is this some stunt to reclaim your lost glory?!

1226205419008607--.name: Why don't we listen to what he has to say...?

1226205419008608--.name: I understand everyone has a lot of questions. I promise I will do my best to answer them.

1226205419008610--.name: That would be me. I am Captain $npcName:11003582[gender:0]$, commander of the Sky Fortress. It seems you are one of $npcName:11003534[gender:0]$'s acquaintances...

1226205419008611--.name: $npcName:11000144[gender:0]$ is the former captain of the Royal Knights. One day, out of the blue, he resigned his post and disappeared. I never expected to see him again.

1226205419008612--.name: Current circumstances aside, it's a pleasure to meet you.

1226205419008613--.name: Tell me, $npcName:11000144[gender:0]$, what do you know of the group that attacked Perion, and what were you doing there?

1226205419008614--.name: They call themselves the Crimson Balrogs. Once, they were the servants of Balrog himself. And as for why I was there... That's a bit of a story.

1226205419008615--.name: Why did the Crimson Balrogs attack Perion?

1226205419008616--.name: That is a complicated question. To answer it properly, I'll have to start at the beginning. First, allow me to dispel a common misconception. "Balrog" is not a proper name but rather a title. Simfernals are the species of demons to which the current Balrog and his ilk belong. They value strength above all else.

1226205419008618--.name: Since ancient days, it has been my family's duty to oppose the Balrog. My ancestors were hand-picked by the goddess of light to fight beside her and defend Maple World. Together they battled the immortal demon Infernog, the first Balrog. Unable to destroy Infernog, they drained his blood—the source of his power—and sealed him in another dimension.

1226205419008619--.name: They hid his blood away in Perion's holy mountain, and for a long time the world was peaceful. But after the two goddesses vanished, Infernog's son Beelzebog took up the mantle of Balrog and began wreaking havoc. Time and time again the Balrog laid siege to the world, and each time my ancestors defeated him.

1226205419008620--.name: For centuries the Crimson Balrogs, the order of Simfernals and lesser demons who serve the Balrog, obeyed without question. But each of Balrog's failures lessened their resolve. Eventually, they abandoned Balrog, and hatched a plan to restore their original master.

1226205419008621--.name: If the Crimson Balrogs are to summon Infernog to this world, they'll need his blood. They've searched for it for years without success, until now... I don't know how they found it, but they did. And that is why they attacked Perion.

1226205419008624--.name: What are your thoughts on Tristan's story?

1226205419008625--.name: It's... a lot to take in.

1226205419008626--.name: I'll say. I'm not sure I've ever heard someone talk so much in my life.

1226205419008627--.name: So the Crimson Balrogs went to Perion seeking Infernog's blood? Considering he was only sealed away with the aid of the goddess of light the last time around, we can't afford to let him return.

1226205419008628--.name: Yes, that's the long and short of it.

1226205419008630--.name: Now, can we move on, or are there any other questions?

1226205419008631--.name: I understand everything you've said so far, but there's one question you haven't answered.

1226205419008632--.name: That's right! What were you doing in Perion?

1226205419008633--.name: I was tracking the Crimson Balrogs. When I realized they were heading to Perion, I knew immediately what that meant.

1226205419008634--.name: But how did you know to track them in the first place?

1226205419008639--.name: His family has been fighting off the Balrog for centuries, and magical energies are like fingerprints. It's no surprise that in time they learned to sense his particular brand of evil.

1226205419008641--.name: I'd imagine that sensing Balrog's former servants was not a wholly different talent. Having encountered traces of their evil aura, I can tell you it's quite distinct.

1226205419008642--.name: Now that we've discussed the finer points of aura-tracing, can we please move on to the threat at hand? I was too late to stop the Crimson Balrogs' from recovering their master's blood. We have to stop them before they attempt to summon him!

1226205419008643--.name: Don't worry. We'll make the necessary preparations. The Sky Fortress and her crew are more than equipped to deal with any threat.

1226205419008644--.name: For we are the hand of the alliance, the invincible shield of the sky!

1226205419008645--.name: $MyPCName$, there's a matter we must discuss with everyone.

1226205419008646--.name: I'll explain everything in the briefing room.

1226205419008647--.name: Ask the officers to meet us there.

1226205419008651--.name: Join me in the briefing room.

1226205419008653--.name: Join me in the briefing room.

1226205419008654--.name: Forgive me, my liege. I was carrying out an order from Madria.

1226205419008655--.name: No matter. Preparations for the unveiling of Madrakan are far more important than this meeting.

1226205419008656--.name: Grr...! Arrogant child, how dare you fail to heed your master's call? Black Mage... is this how you manage your subordinates?

1226205419008657--.name: You would presume to lecture me after being abandoned by your own followers?!

1226205419008658--.name: I've heard enough of your sniveling. You are pathetic.

1226205419008659--.name: It's no wonder his henchmen left him. Weak leaders don't inspire much confidence.

1226205419008660--.name: Why you insolent, feeble human! You dare insult a demon lord?! I am Beelzebog, the mighty Balrog!

1226205419008661--.name: Have you really come all this way just to defend what's left of your pride?

1226205419008662--.name: Or perhaps you came in the hopes I would put you out of your misery?

1226205419008664--.name: You're just as arrogant now as you were as the Mage of Light.

1226205419008665--.name: However... I did not come here to fight.

1226205419008666--.name: As much as it would please me to rend the flesh from your bones and tear you limb from limb, I came here to make a deal.

1226205419008680--.name: Ah, it seems you've managed to awaken the demon lord sleeping within that cowardly shell.

1227205319008725--.name: As much as it would please me to rend the flesh from your bones and tear you limb from limb, I came here to make a deal.

1227205319008726--.name: A deal? I admit I'm curious.

1227205319008727--.name: ...It is as you say. The Crimson Balrogs have forsaken me—both my own kin and those that serve them.

1227205319008728--.name: I'm well aware of your species' fascination with power. It's no surprise your minions would refuse to follow one who has been defeated even by mere adventurers.

1227205319008729--.name: I know it's not like they really have any other demon lords to serve, but I'm surprised it took them this long to leave you.

1227205319008731--.name: That's right! I see you are well informed.

1227205319008732--.name: We speak of Infernog, the Balrog of ancient days, and the demon that sired me.

1227205319008733--.name: Are you saying he's returned to this plane of existence?

1227205319008734--.name: No. If my father had escaped his prison, Maple World would already be in flames.

1227205319008735--.name: ...And my father would have ended me for my failures.

1227205319008736--.name: However, his return is near. Haven't you seen the signs?

1227205319008737--.name: Come to think of it, the Crimson Balrogs have been awfully busy lately. And not just expanding their territory.

1227205319008738--.name: It seems they've found a way to awaken the immortal demon lord.

1227205319008740--.name: So much for your plan, Black Mage. Between the alliance's shiny new plaything, and my father's inevitable encounter with her...

1227205319008741--.name: Do you really think you can prevent the light of destruction from being unleashed?

1227205319008743--.name: Well Beelzy, I'm sure you have a wonderful solution to the problem.

1227205319008745--.name: Black Mage, I have a plan to eliminate both of our mutual problems at once.

1227205319008746--.name: Together we can see to it that meddlesome ship is destroyed, and my father's return does not come to pass!

1227205319008747--.name: I am one of only two living souls who know the whereabouts of that which is required to restore Infernog.

1227205319008748--.name: My followers scramble about on nothing but desperate rumor. We can use this.

1227205319008749--.name: Hmm. That idea's not half bad. A few careful whispers here and there, and we can lead the Crimson Balrogs into a confrontation with the alliance's airship.

1227205319008750--.name: Against the might of the Crimson Balrogs, the defenses of their "Sky Fortress" will crumble.

1227205319008751--.name: Precisely! And when the alliance and those traitors have tired themselves out with battle, I will arrive to obliterate both!

1227205319008752--.name: With the might of the alliance broken and my father's return thwarted, you will have two less annoyances to contend with. And I... I will once more reign supreme as lord of the Simfernals!

1227205319008753--.name: Gahaha! This is the only course, Black Mage. If Infernog is restored, he will attack Maple World as before... When he descends on Tria, what do you think will happen to the Empress?

1227205319008754--.name: If Infernog hurts Ereve... None of us will be safe.

1227205319008755--.name: None of us will escape the light of destruction! This arrangement will save us that fate.

1227205319008757--.name: This is your idea of a fair exchange?

1227205319008758--.name: The return of the immortal demon lord is your problem and yours alone.

1227205319008759--.name: If Infernog is allowed to interfere with my plan, that will spell the immediate extinction of your species.

1227205319008760--.name: The only reason any of you still live is because I've ignored your presence. You are insects crawling in the dirt. Insignificant.

1227205319008761--.name: But if you insist on making yourself a nuisance, then perhaps it's time I exterminated every last one of your kin—starting with you.

1226205419008708--.name: If you halt my father's return... I will give you my Lapenta Shard…

1226205419008709--.name: It may be but a single fragment of the Lapentas entrusted to the divine beasts, but even you cannot resist its power…

1226205419008710--.name: I'm the only one who knows where the shard is hidden. If you kill me, you'll get nothing!

1226205419008711--.name: Ahaha... The great and terrible Balrog begging for his life. Now there's a novel sight. How amusing.

1226205419008712--.name: Very well. I will accept your tribute.

1226205419008713--.name: Bella, let's make a game of it. Search for our friend's hidden Lapenta Shard. If you find it before our work is done, there'll be no more reason to keep him alive.

1226205419008715--.name: Oh Beelzy, I'm jealous of how the Black Mage dotes on you. Hehe.

1226205419008716--.name: <font color="#909090">(Balrog glares, his eyes full of murderous rage.)</font>

1226205419008717--.name: My liege, should I ask Turka to handle this?

1226205419008718--.name: No. Turka has lost my faith.

1226205419008719--.name: Corrupting Katvan was not part of my plan. It was Turka's carelessness that allowed the "Sky Fortress" to fall into the hands of the alliance.

1226205419008720--.name: Bella, I'll leave you to Balrog's care for a while. You will carry out his plan.

1226205419008721--.name: The destruction of the Sky Fortress should prove an amusing diversion. And while you're clipping their wings, make sure they come to regret ever taking to the skies.

1226205419008722--.name: Yes, Black Mage. It will be as you command.

112150219008763--.name: Ah, $MyPCName$, we have news. Please join us in the $map:52010052$.

112150219008765--.name: What are you trying to say?

112150219008766--.name: Thank you all for joining me. Our analysts have been tracking the movement of the Crimson Balrogs and they believe they are closing in on the site where our foe intends to restore Infernog.

112150219008767--.name: It's time we discussed our plan to infiltrate their stronghold and recover Infernog's blood.

112150219008769--.name: My apologies, Captain, but I have urgent news.

112150219008771--.name: Err... I know you're new here, but traditionally the captain leads the briefings.

112150219008772--.name: What now, Tristan? Not content with your little role on our task force? Maybe it's a promotion you're after. Always had to be the center of attention. I know, why don't you take my job?

112150219008773--.name: You know, your insecurity is kind of cute. You remind me of my grandpa.

112150219008775--.name: It's time we talked about contingency plans.

112150219008776--.name: Without the goddess of light to seal him away again, it will be very difficult to dispatch Infernog. We'll need to find another way to contain him or drive him from Maple World. Otherwise, the world as we know it is over.

112150219008777--.name: What did you have in mind?

112150219008778--.name: Why are we talking about contingency plans? I thought the whole point of this meeting was to stop him from being released in the first place?

112150219008779--.name: That's just it. I told you before that I have the ability to sense Balrog and his kin. Well, I've just sensed an entirely new aura. Something unmistakable.

112150219008780--.name: Are you saying what I think you are?

112150219008783--.name: The immortal demon lord $npcName:11003795[gender:0]$ has returned.

112150219008786--.name: Okay fine, so the immortal demon guy is back... What does that mean for us?

112150219008787--.name: I suppose... the end of all things?

112150219008788--.name: The end of... what? Are you saying Maple World is doomed?!

112150219008789--.name: Everyone please calm down! We can't give into fear.

112150219008790--.name: The situation is grim, I admit. But it's not like we have to face Infernog at full strength. Did I forget to mention that I hid some of his blood away?

112150219008791--.name: The situation is grim, I admit. But it's not like we have to face Infernog at full strength. Did I forget to mention that I hid some of his blood away?

112150219008794--.name: Calm down Nainai, or your face might get stuck that way.

112150219008795--.name: Bahaha! I have to admit, Tristan, I've always admired your resourcefulness.

112155619008805--.name: I think we're getting off topic here…

112155619008807--.name: You.. hid some of his blood? How did you even get your hands on that?

112160419008808--.name: And more importantly, how could the Crimson Balrogs have awakened $npcName:11003795[gender:0]$? You yourself said they needed his blood to revive him.

112150219008797--.name: Uh, well... It went something like this…

112182719008811--.name: As I mentioned earlier, just before Infernog was sealed away, he was weakened through the draining of his blood. In an effort to ensure that Infernog would never return to this world, his shed blood was gathered up and stored in two separate locations.

115104519008818--.name: One of which was a shrine hidden in the holy mountains of $map:02000051$, and the other—

115104519008820--.name: Well I suppose it no longer matters.

112182719008812--.name: In any case, during their raid on Perion, the Crimson Balrogs managed to secure half of Infernog's blood. But the rest resides in me. I still don't know how they found it—the sites where the blood was stored were chosen because their holy nature masked any traceable aura emanating from the blood.

112182719008814--.name: I wish I did, but there are more important things to discuss!

112182719008815--.name: There are more important matters to discuss!

112182719008816--.name: $npcName:11003795[gender:0]$ has awakened, but he's not at his full strength. This presents us with a unique opportunity.

115104519008821--.name: Not at his full strength? What exactly do you mean by that?

115104519008822--.name: It's just as I said. His blood is his power. That was part of the genius of hiding it in multiple locations...

115104519008824--.name: Maybe just give us the short version? I can see $MyPCName$'s eyes glazing over.

115104519008826--.name: If you're getting tired, I can think of a few ways to keep you awake.

115104519008829--.name: The Crimson Balrogs recovered enough of Infernog's blood to summon him to this world, but without the rest he's only at half strength.

115104519008830--.name: Which mean things are not as dire as they seem.

115111619008836--.name: In any case, as long as half of $npcName:11003795[gender:0]$'s power is stored safely inside me, he's half the threat he was before.

112182719008817--.name: This may be the best opportunity we'll have to stop the immortal demon lord once and for all!

115105319008831--.name: Hahaha! I never imagined that I might be the one to see my family's ancient duty brought to completion.

115105319008832--.name: I will defeat $npcName:11003795[gender:0]$ with my own two hands!

115105319008833--.name: I hate to be a downer, but didn't you say he was un-killable?

115105319008834--.name: If he was at full strength, that would be the case. But I believe in his current state, the demon can be slain.

115112519008843--.name: In fact, I'm certain of it!

115105319008835--.name: There's no more time to waste! Whatever the plan was before, it's gone out the window. The time to strike is now!

115111619008838--.name: Captain $npcName:11003533[gender:0]$, instruct your crew to set a course. Now is the time to wipe $npcName:11003795[gender:0]$'s evil from this world!

115111619008840--.name: What...? What are you saying? Is it your plan to let $npcName:11003795[gender:0]$ roam freely? He will burn our cities to ash!

115111619008841--.name: That's not what I'm saying at all. We will defeat $npcName:11003795[gender:0]$.

115111619008842--.name: However, rushing heedlessly into battle will only end in unnecessary casualties. We need a plan.

115134319008844--.name: $npcName:11000144[gender:0]$, I understand that $npcName:11003795[gender:0]$ is vulnerable now. But that's about all we really know about him. We need a strategy.

115134319008845--.name: Do you know where $npcName:11003795[gender:0]$ is now?

115134319008847--.name: Can you tell us what abilities $npcName:11003795[gender:0]$ possesses, or the scale of his current powers?

115134319008849--.name: We don't know where $npcName:11003795[gender:0]$ is, his weaknesses, even the size of his forces. This puts us at a tremendous disadvantage.

115134319008850--.name: Don't you think I want to do everything in my power to stop Infernog before he hurts anyone? The lives of every single person on this vessel are in my hands.

115134319008851--.name: I will not order them to run blindly to their deaths, especially when there is no guarantee our mission will succeed. If $npcName:11003795[gender:0]$ has returned in a weakened state, as you say, then our best course of action is to strike when we are fully prepared.

115134319008853--.name: $npcName:11000144[gender:0]$, I hope you understand. If this is, in fact, the best opportunity we'll ever get to defeat $npcName:11003795[gender:0]$, then we can't afford to throw it away.

115134319008854--.name: The closest thing to a guarantee we'll get is making sure we're completely prepared to face Infernog.

115134319008855--.name: Our first step is information-gathering, anything we can use in the battle against $npcName:11003795[gender:0]$. His weaknesses, his capabilities, and so on.

115134319008856--.name: Aye captain! The Green Hoods will analyze all the data we've gathered on the $npcNamePlural:11003781[gender:0]$ to see what we can infer about $npcName:11003795[gender:0]$'s characteristics.

115134319008857--.name: Of course, there'll be a large margin of error, but it's better than nothing.

115134319008858--.name: Now is not the time for analysis…

115134319008860--.name: Dark Wind will be focusing its efforts on reviewing the intelligence we've gathered so far to determine where $npcName:11003795[gender:0]$ might be hiding.

115134319008861--.name: Every moment we wait, innocent lives are in danger!

115134319008862--.name: Very well, $npcName:11003535$. $npcName:11003786[gender:0]$, what about the Lumiknights?

115134319008863--.name: We will analyze any and all traces of $npcName:11003795[gender:0]$ and his minions to see if we can identify any weaknesses he may possess.

115134319008866--.name: I will count on the Imperial Vanguard and their brothers in the Royal Guard to once again safeguard $map:02000001$ and the surrounding areas. As we don't know where Infernog might strike, it's imperative we protect the empress.

115134319008867--.name: Oh—right! Yes, the vanguard will see to it that $map:02000001$ is safe from harm!

115134319008868--.name: This is your plan? This is how you'll stop Infernog before his reign of destruction begins? I can see now that coming here was a mistake from the start.

115212719008872--.name: Was Tristan always so impatient? Usually the hotheaded one—

115212719008874--.name: Right, it's... No I'm not! Why you little—

115212719008875--.name: I wonder... Tristan said he imbibed some of Infernog's blood, and I've begun to sense the same kind of darkness emanating from him as we found at the crashed airship.

115212719008877--.name: I don't know anything for certain, besides that I felt it. But it's possible that Infernog's blood is influencing Tristan's behavior.

115212719008880--.name: You don't think he's going to do something reckless, do you? You know, like something more reckless than drinking the blood of an immortal demon without knowing what would happen...

115212719008882--.name: Sure he was a little short-tempered, but he didn't seem possessed or anything.

115212719008883--.name: How do you know, have you met many people possessed by demons?!

122200419009511--.name: Maybe that's why he was in such a hurry to find Infernog—to deliver the rest of his blood!

115212719008884--.name: Pull yourself together, Nairin! This is no time for wild speculation.

115212719008885--.name: Pull yourself together, Nairin! This is no time for wild speculation.

115212719008886--.name: I may not be Tristan's biggest fan, but I could never see him intentionally putting Maple World in jeopardy.

115212719008887--.name: Nevertheless, it's important we keep him from doing anything foolish. Nairin, where is Tristan now?

115212719008888--.name:
Just a moment.
<font color="#909090">(Nairin murmurs fervently into her earpiece, nodding occasionally.)</font>

115212719008890--.name: Bad news, Captain. I just heard from the hangar deck. Tristan boarded a transport that left a few minutes ago. They're already out of radio distance.

115212719008894--.name: By the time we arrive, he may be long gone. We need to focus on where he's going, not where he went.

115212719008895--.name: And we should do it quickly. Considering that half of Infernog's power, and the key to his immortality currently rests within Tristan...

115212719008896--.name: Then protecting Tristan is the key to protecting Maple World.

115212719008898--.name: No doubt Tristan thinks he's doing what's best for Maple World.

115212719008899--.name: But if, as it seems, Infernog's Blood is influencing his thinking, then he endangers us all.

115212719008900--.name: Considering all the variables, where might he go?

115212719008902--.name: He sounded pretty fired up to have a go at Infernog. So maybe he went... wherever Infernog's lair is?

115212719008903--.name: But even Tristan doesn't know where that is. Well, there is one thing we do know. The Crimson Balrogs will be searching for him.

115212719008904--.name: Which means that time is a factor.

115212719008905--.name: Well then Mr. Know-it-All, how do we find him? Oh! Hey $npcName:11003536[gender:0]$, can't you just, fire up that computer of yours?

115212719008906--.name: Are you kidding? My predictive algorithm doesn't work without data! And as for the ships' instruments, it's a lot easier to track a giant swarm of Simfernals in the sky than one man on the ground.

115212719008907--.name: Well... Technically we don't have to find Tristan if we find the Crimson Balrogs, heh.

115212719008908--.name: That's actually quite clever. $npcName:11003818$ is inside $npcName:11000144[gender:0]$'s body, and $npcName:11003795[gender:0]$ can surely sense it. So we can track $npcName:11000144[gender:0]$ by tracking the $npcNamePlural:11003781[gender:0]$.

115212719008911--.name: I suppose for now that's the best option available to us. We track the $npcNamePlural:11003781[gender:0]$</font>, then. But hear me, there will be no more room for missteps. We must all work in concert. Nairin, give the order. All hands to their stations!

116134519008819--.name: I updated our data profile for the $npcNamePlural:11003781[gender:0]$ in the computer and ran it through the ship's scanners.

116134519008820--.name: The results are coming back now. Lets see... I'm getting radar matches from all over Maple World, but they're scattered. There's a pretty strong hit coming from this region over here.

116134519008821--.name: I don't know if you'll find anything there, but it's the best lead we have right now.

116134519008823--.name: A cave in the mountains near Orbis.

122204719009512--.name: It'll be a little toasty in there but you should be all right without protective gear. Here, take this camera and document anything that might help our search.

116134519008826--.name: All right! I've reserved a transport for you. Head to the hangar deck.

116134519008827--.name: $MyPCName$, did you find anything useful at the $map:52010060$?

116134519008830--.name: <font color="#909090">(You show her the picture you took at the $map:52010060$.)</font>

116134519008832--.name: I found them on a wall in the $map:52010060$.

116134519008833--.name: The way these claw markings are arranged, it almost seems like a pattern... This could be a written language.

116134519008834--.name: This could be extremely important! Thank you, $MyPCName$.

116134519008835--.name: I'll upload the image to my tablet and run it through my pictographic analysis program.

116134519008838--.name: Err... "In the place where hellfire burns, our dark master will return... Our reign of destruction is nigh."

116134519008839--.name: ...Those scratch mark really form complete sentences?

116134519008840--.name: Hehe, of course not! But that's what's so great about my Advanced Linguistic Analysis Algorithm.

116134519008841--.name: The algorithm visually compares input data against a library of ancient hieroglyphics and other symbols from pictograph-based languages whose meanings are known, then generates an iterative series of possible translations, which are automatically sorted based on the translations' coherency. Cool, right?

116163619008861--.name: "Our dark master" has to refer to $npcName:11003795[gender:0]$, right?

116163619008862--.name: So "In the place where hellfire burns" must refer to where $npcName:11003795[gender:0]$</font> returned!

116163619008863--.name: I thought that was pretty clear, yeah.

116163619008864--.name: Good work, $MyPCName$. This is an important clue!

116163619008865--.name: Is it though? Where is "the place where hellfire burns?"

116163619008867--.name: Let's have a look at the map...

116163619008868--.name: It's got to be somewhere extremely hot, but it's hard to say much beyond that...

116163619008869--.name: I guess I could make a list of the hottest regions throughout Maple World...

116163619008870--.name: Isn't that going to be a really big list?

116163619008871--.name: Well, yes but... I'm sure I can narrow it down somehow.

116163619008872--.name: I could try checking any data we have on Crimson Balrog movements against that list and see what happens.

116163619008873--.name: See what happens?! You're not going to get anywhere staring at that stupid monitor all day!

116163619008875--.name: Hey cadet, why don't you come over here and we can get down to some real investigating!

116163619008876--.name: So we know $npcName:11003795[gender:0]$ appeared somewhere hot, and basically nothing else, right?

116163619008877--.name: Your listening skills are top notch.

116163619008878--.name: Bahaha! A true guardsman is always alert.

116163619008879--.name: Those who've never actually been in the field tend to get all hung up over data, and overestimate its usefulness.

116163619008881--.name: Oh no, I wasn't talking about anyone here... I was just, uh, speaking generally.

116163619008883--.name: Don't worry about her. A few balloons and a slice of cake, she'll forget all about this. Now as I was saying, the only way we're going to learn anything useful is to get out into the field and investigate!

116163619008884--.name: When I was captain of the Royal Guard, I had two soldiers in particular who really loved gossip. $npcName:11000157[gender:0]$ and $npcName:11000158[gender:0]$. These days you'll find them standing guard on the road to $map:02000001$, which is highly trafficked. Why don't you go see if they've heard anything that can help us?

116163619008886--.name: Sigh. Lucky for you I keep photos of all of my informants secure in my "face book" here. All right, so this is $npcName:11000157[gender:0]$...

116163619008887--.name: And this guy is $npcName:11000158[gender:0]$. Got it?

116163619008888--.name: Did you... just show me the same photo twice?

116163619008890--.name: They look nothing alike! Look, see? $npcName:11000157[gender:0]$</font> has slanty eyebrows.

116163619008893--.name: Fine, if you want to do things the hard way. But time is of the essence, so get a move on!

116134519008850--.name: Didn't I just send you on a transport to Tria? What are you doing back here?!

116200019008895--.name: Don't tell me you came back empty-handed?

116200019008896--.name: Well, apparently there's this inexplicably hot cave in Orbis full of an endless supply of lava.

116200019008897--.name: Wow. Lairs don't get much more villainous than that. Good work! Let's tell the captain right now and check it out!

116200019008899--.name: Can it wait? We've got some urgent heroism to get to.

116214119008951--.name: You can't just waltz into Orbis.

116200019008901--.name: Did you forget that it's basically an uninhabitable hellscape?

116200019008902--.name: We can't just go in there without a plan. We need to make sure anyone we send can survive in the environment.

116200019008903--.name: We need to send in our best operative. Of course, we'll have to give them special training.

116200019008904--.name: Who do you mean, and what kind of training?

116205019008910--.name: I understand your desire to rush off to Orbis and be the hero, but you can't just run in blind.

116214119008952--.name: I won't have my little kitten hurting $male:himself,female:herself$ by going to Orbis unprepared.

116205019008911--.name: So I came up with a special training regimen for you! Ta-da!

116205019008912--.name: I appreciate your concern, but I don't think that's necessary.

116205019008913--.name: You're going to feel really silly for saying that if you pass out from the heat and fall into a pool of molten lava. I'm not sure there will be anything to fish up for your funeral!

116205019008914--.name: Actually, a little preparation never hurt anybody.

116205019008915--.name: Good choice! If time weren't a factor, I would put you through a whole gauntlet of tests... But considering the circumstances, I've had to develop a much more accelerated lesson plan.

116205019008916--.name: What do you want me to do?

116205019008917--.name: You're going to skip on over to $map:02000268$ to battle monsters while also not dying of heat exhaustion! I don't really know how hot Orbis is going to be, but we have to do something to prepare you for what's ahead.

116205019008918--.name: If you can manage to fight in those conditions, then you probably won't collapse the moment you arrive in Orbis. It won't be easy, but if anyone can beat the heat it's you, hot stuff!

116205019008919--.name: Now is no time for rest! Come back alive after your training, and I'll nurse you back to health.

116205019008920--.name: You made it back safe! Are you hurt?

116205019008922--.name: Oh, poor dear!  Let me see... You're right, you do feel hot!

116205019008924--.name: Oh my, your face is all red. $MyPCName$, did you push yourself too hard?

116205019008927--.name: Well, it looks like you don't have any serious external injuries. That makes me a little less nervous about you going to Orbis.

116205019008928--.name: Oh, before we report to the captain, $npcName:11003537[gender:0]$ wants to see you.

116205019008930--.name: I'm not sure, but he's been staring at us for a while, so he must want something.

116212919008931--.name: I've been waiting for you. You're later than I'd like.

117125219008980--.name: I heard Orbis was our top suspect for the site of $npcName:11003795[gender:0]$ return to this world. Given all we know, it would be no surprise.

117125219008982--.name: Funny, the same thought occurred to me.

117125219008983--.name: In any case, it seems more and more that all roads lead to the ever-burning land of Orbis.

117125219008984--.name: I sense you've already made up your mind about going there, no matter the danger.

117125219008986--.name: I've prepared something to aid you. Come a little closer.

117125219008987--.name: I'm pretty good right here, actually.

117125219008988--.name: Don't worry. I'm not going to teleport you off somewhere strange.

117125219008991--.name: Now close your eyes, and open your mind.

117125219008992--.name: <font color="#909090">(Reluctantly, you close your eyes and focus your thoughts.)</font>

117125219008994--.name: <font color="#909090">(Did he just... blow in your ear?)</font>

117125219008996--.name: I placed a 6th-level warding spell on you. It's a secret Lumiknight trick. I believe it should see you mostly un-singed by the flames of Orbis.

117125219008997--.name: Oh, no need to thank me.

117125219008999--.name: Your safe return will be thanks enough.

117125219009000--.name: Now, I believe you should be ready. You may go ahead and report to the captain.

117125219009001--.name: The other officers have brought me up to speed.

117125219009002--.name: Of course $npcName:11003795[gender:0]$ had to pick Orbis as the place to make his return. This isn't good.

117125219009003--.name: The terrain in Orbis is too treacherous for the Sky Fortress to land, and the aircraft aboard cannot withstand the intense heat of Orbis's surface.

117125219009004--.name: However... We should be able to retrofit an escape pod for you, and guide you in remotely. $npcName:11003536[gender:0]$, please explain the details.

117125219009005--.name: Right! Well, they only seat one, but our escape pods are built to withstand nearly anything. If we reinforce the hull plating, it should be able to survive landing on Orbis.

117125219009007--.name: The craft's specs are certainly up for the challenge! It's built with the same alloy as Sky Fortress, and it's crazy fast.

117125219009008--.name: All that to say, delivering you to Orbis in one piece should be a piece of cake.

117125219009009--.name: $MyPCName$, I'm afraid with the pressing matter of time, this is our only option.

117125219009010--.name: As the escape pod will only hold one person, that individual must be our most capable crewman.

117130119009027--.name: Therefore, I'm entrusting this mission to you.

117125219009011--.name: I'm sorry to burden you with this task but I'm confident that with $npcName:11003535[gender:1]$'s training and Mason's protective charm, you will be able to complete this mission and return to us.

117125219009012--.name: Considering the alternatives, I feel you are the best person for the job.

117125219009014--.name: You're the captain. You give me an order and I'll follow it.

117125219009016--.name: Thank you. Then, are you ready?

117125219009017--.name: I'm ready to go right now!

117125219009018--.name: Excellent. $npcName:11003536[gender:0]$, what's the status of the pod's remote piloting systems?

117125219009020--.name: Very well. $MyPCName$, the retrofit should be completed in short order. Board the escape pod and prepare for launch!

117125219009023--.name: I never expected things to go this way... I'm sorry.

117125219009025--.name: I took on the $npcNamePlural:11003781[gender:0]$, but they were relentless. They knew $npcName:11003818$ was inside me. They captured me and brought me here to their master.

830162219009538-FameContents_EP1_02-.name: Aghh... I never imagined I'd see you here.

117140119009028--.name: Aghh... I never imagined I'd see you here.

117140119009029--.name:
<font color="#909090">(Tristan breaks into a coughing fit.)</font>
Ugh. I'm sorry, I never should've come here.

117140119009030--.name: While $npcName:11003818$ was inside my body, I wasn't thinking clearly. All of the rage bubbling up inside me...

117140119009032--.name: I was so sure that what I was doing was right. I never questioned it for a moment.

117140119009033--.name: I knew that every moment we wasted put innocent lives in jeopardy. I knew that I could defeat Infernog! I knew I could save this world!

117140119009035--.name: So much for my so-called destiny.

117140119009036--.name: I've failed them all. Every single one of my ancestors. So many generations preparing for exactly this day. Today I have ruined their legacy.

117140119009037--.name: Pull yourself together! It's not over yet. We just need a new plan to stop Infernog.

117140119009041--.name: It's too late. Infernog has reclaimed the blood that was within me. Before long, he will have recovered his full strength. He can no longer be killed, and the goddess of light isn't here to save us.

117140119009042--.name: It's all my fault... The end of everything...

117151719009043--.name: I can't believe I brought the blood straight to them.

117151719009044--.name: Well let's go and get it back!

117151719009045--.name: It's too late. $npcName:11003795[gender:0]$'s already absorbed it into his body. There's no stopping him now. He will rain chaos down upon this world like nothing you've ever imagined.

117151719009046--.name: <font color="#909090">(No... This can't really be the end, can it? All your friends, all the helpless people counting on you... You can't let them down. There's got to be some way to stop $npcName:11003795[gender:0]$!)</font>

117151719009047--.name: I ruined everything. It's all my fault.

117151719009049--.name: Ha... Hahaha! That man is one of the hardest-headed people I've ever met, but from time to time he says something that makes sense.

117151719009050--.name: Yes, we might be able to stop him.

117151719009053--.name: It won't be easy, but yes, I think it can be done.

117151719009054--.name: I realized something after having Infernog's thoughts rolling around my head.

117151719009056--.name: $npcName:11003795[gender:0]$ may be immortal, but that doesn't make him unstoppable.

117151719009058--.name: We have been so focused on killing $npcName:11003795[gender:0]$ that we haven't really thought about anything else. Sure he's immortal, but we don't have to kill him to prevent him from destroying this world.

117151719009059--.name: The goddess of light isn't here to seal him away in another dimension, true. But surely there's another way to send Infernog somewhere he will never hurt anyone.

117151719009061--.name: All we need is the right weapon!

117154419009062--.name: Thank you for braving the ruins of Orbis. $npcName:11000144[gender:0]$ is still alive due to your actions.

117154419009063--.name: I wouldn't have been able to get there without everyone's help.

117154419009065--.name: No critical physical injuries, but he definitely needs to recover from his ordeal. He's resting in the infirmary right now.

117181919009067--.name: Indeed. Now, we must discuss our plan for dealing with Infernog's threat. If he is truly immortal once more, then difficult choices must be made. Our first step is to retrieve the empress, and other city leaders, and deliver them to a secure location. Next, we must order a global withdrawal of the alliance's forces to safeguard major population centers.

117181919009068--.name: Captain, when you said you had a solution, scooping up the royal household and going into hiding wasn't what I had in mind. If we run away what happens to the rest of Maple World?! There's got to be a way to stop Infernog!

117181919009069--.name: We need to face the reality that we may not be able to stop Infernog in the short term. At least, not before he's wrought untold destruction upon this world. If we don't prepare ourselves for the worst, then—

117181919009070--.name: But Captain, you're forgetting about our secret weapon, the Ultra-High-Density Magitron Accelerator Cannon! "UHDMAC" for short. Of course, most of us just call it "the Big Gun."

117181919009071--.name: We cannot rely upon the cannon to solve all our problems, the—

117181919009072--.name: But the Big Gun has the juice! The cannon breaks down metric tons of magic stones into an excited stream of magitrons—magically charged particles—and then fires them as a focused beam. A fully charged shot can release the equivalent of up to 500 gigajoules of energy.

117181919009073--.name: That's plenty of power to deal with Infernog! In fact, if the gun were powered electrically, we'd need a battery roughly the size of the Sky Fortress. So, we cut out the middle-man and feed magic stones into a reactor like it's an old-fashioned coal train.

117181919009074--.name: The only drawback is it takes time to charge, and afterwards we've got to let the gun cool down, and purge the reactor. But honestly, a gun like this you only need to fire once.

117181919009075--.name: Of course we could improve on all that with enough time and budget. I'd love to have the cannon in a more presentable state before we unveil it to the world, but unfortunately there's no time for that.

117181919009076--.name: Thank you Nairin, that will suffice.

117181919009077--.name: Nairin, enough! Yes, it's true in theory that the cannon could blast $npcName:11003795[gender:0]$ with enough force to launch him into space. But the weapon isn't ready. We'd need to make numerous modifications just to get it operational!

117181919009078--.name: And even so, a shot like that is one in a million. If we fire and miss, the consequences could be catastrophic. That's not a risk I'm prepared to take. Even with a more competent—

117181919009079--.name: I can make the shot, Captain! I can handle the calculations. And the Big Gun's nearly finished! It would only take a few tweaks to get it up to the task! One shot and we'll send $npcName:11003795[gender:0]$ sailing through the void for a thousand years! With any luck, he'll end up crashing into the center of a distant star.

117181919009080--.name: If that's the case, then what are we waiting for? Let's hook up this cannon and take down Infernog!

117181919009081--.name: Frankly, I'm not sure this crew is up to the challenge. Each of you possess tremendous abilities, but we have continually allowed our flaws to impede our duty. We've wasted time bickering, investigated thin leads, and failed to anticipate the enemy's moves. Our inability to act as a cohesive unit has placed all of Maple World in jeopardy.

117181919009082--.name: Captain, that's not fair! Yes, things have gone wrong, but what you're suggesting is the same as giving up! You yourself said it's our duty to defend this world from harm, not a select few. If we have a chance to save everyone, then we've got to take it, no matter how hard it is!

117181919009083--.name:
We must be practical. If we use the cannon, there is no margin for error. If Sky Fortress falls, so too does Maple World. We must marshal our forces and prepare a foolproof plan to defeat Infernog. And though many will perish, civilization will...
<FONT color='#909090'>(Veliche closes her eyes and rests her face in her palm.)</font>

117181919009084--.name: No... The cost is too great. Nairin, tell the bridge to set a course for Revoldic Dam! Our number one priority is the cannon's completion. But hear me, there can be no mistakes, no distractions! The fate of this world depends upon on each of you working in concert to get the job done. Prepare to disembark!

118212219009299--.name: The captain's right. I haven't been as focused on the mission as I should've been. And don't get me started on everyone else... But now it has my full attention! No more wasting time.

118212219009300--.name: Oh, $MyPCName$, this is your first time here since our emergency launch, right?

118212219009302--.name: Since the Rooks' attack, we've beefed up security, and started using the facility as a place to test new technologies and potential upgrades for the Sky Fortress. We couldn't let this awesome base go to waste!

118212219009303--.name: What's the status of the Ultra-High... um... the Big Gun?

118212219009304--.name: The cannon is virtually complete, but there's work to be done on energy output management.

118212219009305--.name: The plan was to run data simulations using a variety of power sources and firing conditions to determine the optimal operating parameters for the weapon. But we've had to switch to a more expedited plan.

118212219009307--.name: Overkill is what it is! Basically, we'll be using a magiphobic ore to line the barrel of the cannon to focus the energy and prevent leakage. This will allow us to fire the weapon uncalibrated without the gun, uh, exploding.

118212219009308--.name: We're actually running a little short on ore at the moment. I could really use your help, if you're not too busy.

118212219009309--.name: The crystals form almost exclusively in $map:02000104$, near $map:02000076$. I'd like you to gather several more loads. In the meantime, I'll work out how to process them.

118212219009311--.name: Thank you, $MyPCName$. I will contact the Sky Fortress and arrange a transport for you.

118212219009312--.name: Did you bring me ore samples from $map:02000104$?

118212219009314--.name: Great! I think this should be enough.

118212219009315--.name: By the way, I worked out a good way to separate the usable ore from the surrounding rock. Once it's been processed, $npcName:11003535[gender:1]$ can integrate it into the upgraded cannon components.

118212219009316--.name: $npcName:11003535[gender:1]$? I thought you were the technical one.

118212219009317--.name: When it comes to software and tactics, I'm the best on the ship! But... I'm embarrassed to say that $npcName:11003535[gender:1]$ has more experience when it comes to weapons. In any case, would you mind delivering that extra ore to her? I've got more work to do here.

118212219009319--.name: Thanks, $MyPCName$! $npcName:11003535[gender:1]$ is just around the corner.

118212219009320--.name: Oh! Just the $male:man,female:woman$ I wanted to see!

118212219009321--.name: I knew it was destiny that brought us together, but this is just serendipitous timing! I've got a delicate situation here I'd really like you to take a look at...

118212219009322--.name: Keep your pants on lady, I've got your extra ore right here.

118212219009323--.name: You're sweet, sugar, but the ore is the problem. I'm supposed to be lining these panels with the ore sitting over there, but it hasn't even been processed! Nainai left me with this ridiculous manifesto on metallurgy and told me to have the mechanics take care of it, but they're all on their lunch break!

118212219009324--.name: Anyways, I'm doing the best I can with all the sciencey stuff, but I've been having a little trouble with, uh... accidentally breaking everything.

118212219009325--.name: So what exactly did you want me to do?

118212219009326--.name: Listen, as hard as it is to believe, I'm starting to get uncomfortable with all these mechanics gawping at me. You're good with technical stuff, right?

118212219009327--.name: Surely there's something I can do to persuade you to help poor little me?

118212219009328--.name: All right, I'll help. Since the fate of the world is at stake.

118212219009329--.name: Wonderful! Here's Nairin's instruction sheet. All you need to do is process that ore into something I can actually use.

118212219009330--.name: I don't think you've quite finished processing that ore...

118212219009332--.name: Nice work! I'm a lucky girl to have such a well-endowed friend. You know, brains-wise.

118212219009333--.name: Glad I could help. What happens next?

118212219009334--.name: Next I use the processed ore to line the interior panels of the cannon barrel, and have my friends here install them in the cannon—their break's up any minute now. Hey, $MyPCName$, do you think we could keep your helping me out our little secret?

118212219009336--.name: Hehe, thanks! I promise I'll make it up to you later. Condor's been staring over here a while. Maybe you should see if he needs something?

118212219009337--.name: It's time to get to work, cadet.

118212219009338--.name: See those electronic components in the cargo containers over there?

118212219009341--.name: I'll take care of it right now!

118212219009343--.name: I, uh, may or may not have pulled something. Besides, carrying heavy objects is best left to youngsters like yourself.

118212219009344--.name: You don't have to carry it very far. If you just deliver it to the loading platform, one of our technicians will secure it to a crane for transport.

118212219009346--.name: Good. Come back when you've finished.

118212219009347--.name: What are you waiting for? Those containers aren't going to move themselves.

118212219009348--.name: Ah, good job. I was supervising your work from here.

118212219009349--.name: Technology sure is a marvel. Just secure a container to the chain on the crane arm, and away they go!

118212219009350--.name: Yeah. If only we could automate the whole carrying-heavy-things part.

118212219009351--.name: I know! Imagine if those heavy containers could just carry themselves.

118212219009352--.name: Hmm... $npcName:11003536[gender:0]$, couldn't somebody whip up some kind of robot for that?

118212219009353--.name: All finished components need to be inspected by a real human being at least once. If we automated everything without any kind of quality control, our secret weapon would be more likely to blow us up than our foes!

118212219009354--.name: What did the captain just tell us about cutting corners?

118212219009355--.name: And by the way, did I just see $MyPCName$ moving the cargo you said you'd take care of?

118212219009357--.name: <font color="#909090">(Maybe it's time to see if anyone else needs your help...)</font>

118212219009358--.name: Huh? What's that $MyPCName$? You want to hear about my time in the Royal Guard?

118212219009360--.name: Sorry $npcName:11003536[gender:0]$, I've got some things to discuss with $MyPCName$. We'll talk later. Bye!

118212219009362--.name: Ugh... That girl is going to drive me to an early grave.  Anyways, thanks for the assist.

118212219009363--.name: Are you okay? Maybe you should lie down.

118212219009364--.name: No... I'm fine... Why don't  you go see if Mason needs anything?

118212219009365--.name: This should be a safe distance...

118212219009366--.name: Even with my fellow templars at my side, it would be good to have someone I know can keep this power in check...

118212219009368--.name: Ah, $MyPCName$? Did you sense the gravity of my current predicament? Perhaps you have a sixth sense.

118212219009370--.name: You'll recall that $npcName:11003536[gender:0]$ said the UHDMAC is fueled by vast quantities of magic stones, yes?

118212219009371--.name: What you might not know is that those stones are actually filled with dark magic. The Lumiknights stockpiled and magically sealed the stones to prevent their darkness from leeching out into the world and endangering people.

118212219009372--.name: To unleash their power as fuel for our weapon, a high-ranking templar is required to unseal them.

118212219009377--.name: Removing the magical seal isn't complicated, but I will have to precisely control the flow of dark energy during the unsealing process. Otherwise, this base will be replaced by a smoldering crater that goes on for miles.

118212219009378--.name: While I'm unsealing the stones, my body will become a conduit for the darkness. If anything goes wrong, someone must be prepared to "shut off the tap," as they say. Thankfully, I know just the person.

118212219009382--.name: Well, time is of the essence. I'll begin the unsealing process.

118212219009383--.name: If I become overwhelmed with dark energy, you'll need to sever my connection to the stones.

118212219009389--.name: <font color='#909090'>(Mason outstretches his arm, and closes his eyes).</font>

118212219009392--.name: Um... Were you going to do something?

118212219009393--.name:
<font color='#909090'>(Mason wipes his brow.)</font>
The task is done. It wasn't easy directing so much dark power, but thankfully I managed it without complications.

118212219009395--.name: $MyPCName$, do you really think me a charlatan? Let us speak candidly then. Have I been known to embellish the minutest detail here or there when it suits me? Perhaps, but no more than any other man. I would never spin falsehoods about matters of such import.

118212219009396--.name:
How am I supposed to believe that when you say all this crazy stuff, only to wave your arms around and—woah...!
<FONT color='#909090'>(The world seems to whirl around you as something dark and heavy washes over you, before quickly receding.)</font>

118212219009397--.name: Hmph. I will take that as an apology. In any case, thank you for your assistance. My work here is done. Why don't you check back in with Nairin?

118212219009398--.name: Retrofitting the weapon went smoothly, thanks to everyone's help!
