118212219009400--.name: What are you staring at me for? I did plenty of stuff before I hurt my back!

118212219009401--.name: Besides, it's not like I was the only one who wasn't pulling their weight. Even $npcName:11003535[gender:1]$—

118212219009403--.name: How would you like unsupervised access to Dark Wind's vault of prohibited weapons?

118212219009405--.name: What are you two mumbling about?

118212219009406--.name: Just how our technicians had finished installing the new paneling! What were you saying about the Big Gun, Nainai?

118212219009407--.name: Oh right. Well, that means we're ready to bring the weapon aboard the ship. Let's check in with the Captain.

118212219009408--.name: Come in Mama Eagle, this is The Roost. Baby Bird is ready to leave the nest.

118212219009409--.name: What's with all the cutesy call signs? It's not like the Crimson Balrogs have a radio to intercept our call.

118212219009410--.name: I don't know, I kind of like them. They're clear and simple, a tactically efficient choice.

118212219009411--.name: I think you might be biased toward the avian theme.

118212219009412--.name: <font color="#909090">(Seriously, where did they find these people?)</font>

118212219009413--.name: We read you loud and clear, but now is not the time for such discussions.

118212219009414--.name: Sky Fortress is currently engaging the $npcNamePlural:11003781[gender:0]$. All crew are hereby ordered to return to the ship.

118212219009416--.name: The $npcNamePlural:11003781[gender:0]$ appear to have grown tired of our interference. Sky Fortress is in peril.

118212219009417--.name: Any remaining adjustments to the weapon will have to wait. Raise the cannon, and prepare for installation. Over and out.

118212219009419--.name: You heard the captain! Let's get the cannon aboard!

118212219009421--.name: The immediate crisis appears to be over.

118212219009422--.name: Despite the circumstances, everyone performed their roles admirably. I'm proud of each of you.

118212219009423--.name: Thankfully, there was no damage to the ship that can't be repaired in due time. $MyPCName$, you played a big part in that outcome.

118212219009424--.name: It's time we began planning our reprisal. $npcName:11003536[gender:0]$, please have $npcName:11000144[gender:0]$ report to the briefing room.

118212219009427--.name: I was just contacted by our chief medical officer. It seems $npcName:11000144[gender:0]$ is no longer in the infirmary.

118212219009428--.name: Check all interior and exterior cameras. Find him.

118212219009429--.name: I'm scrubbing through the camera footage now... I've got something!

118212219009430--.name: It looks like he left the infirmary, and then... Went to the hangar deck. He left the ship aboard a small vessel.

118212219009431--.name: Someone let him board a ship, in his condition?! Where was the Wing Commander?

118212219009432--.name: According to the casualty report, currently in surgery. Let's watch the footage, shall we?

126143019009537--.name: We should check the camera logs.

118212219009434--.name: There's nothing we can do now but ready the cannon. There's still time to use it on $npcName:11003795[gender:0]$ before he can do any more harm.

118212219009435--.name: How long will it take to fire the cannon?

118212219009436--.name: At least 15 minutes to charge and obtain a firing solution. And we'll need to be within range.

118212219009437--.name: We can't just fire blindly from half a continent away.

118212219009438--.name: I can buy you the time you need.

118212219009439--.name: I won't allow it. $MyPCName$, going up against Infernog alone is too dangerous.

118212219009440--.name: Don't worry, I'll bring friends. And besides, if I don't, $npcName:11000144[gender:0]$ is liable to get himself killed.

118212219009444--.name: $MyPCName$, locate $npcName:11000144[gender:0]$'s ship and engage Infernog. While he's distracted, we'll direct all of our resources toward readying the cannon to fire.

118212219009445--.name: If you get in over your head, retrieve $npcName:11000144[gender:0]$ and return here immediately.

118212219009447--.name: I'm sorry to lay such a heavy burden upon your shoulders.

118212219009448--.name: A captain never has to apologize to her crew.

118212219009452--.name: Today was a major victory. We have defeated an immortal demon threatening all of Maple World.

118212219009453--.name: Thanks to our efforts, the skies are safe once more!

118212219009454--.name: That might be true for now... But what if Infernog finds his way back here? How many more battles like this can we endure?

118212219009455--.name: Sitting around worrying about the future is a surefire recipe for a headache. If that demon shows his ugly mug around here again, we'll defeat him, just like before!

118212219009456--.name: Hah. You're as gruff as ever. But it suits you.

118212219009457--.name: Captain, I want to thank you, truly, for the assistance of yourself and all of your crew.

118212219009458--.name: $npcName:11003795[gender:0]$ was defeated thanks to all of your efforts, even despite all the trouble I put you through.

118212219009459--.name: The Sky Fortress and her crew will never back down from their mission to safeguard the heavens. And try not to be so hard on yourself. Everything you did was with noble intent.

118212219009460--.name: ...Well, maybe he should be a little hard on himself. Anyways, it's not like we could just ignore a giant demon raining down fire and destruction on everyone.

118212219009461--.name: On that we can agree. As the shield of the alliance, it is our duty to defend against any who seek to harm the people of this world.

118212219009462--.name: Now and forever onward, we will roam the skies aiding all who need our help.

118212219009463--.name: For the alliance! For Maple World!

118212219009464--.name: You certainly are a passionate bunch.

118212219009465--.name: $MyPCName$, I wanted to say thank you.

118212219009466--.name: I'm glad everything worked out for the best.

118212219009467--.name: It's all thanks to you. I'm sorry for burdening you time and again, but... if $npcName:11003795[gender:0]$ ever returns, can I count once more on your aid?

118212219009468--.name: I don't know how I could face him without you.

118212219009469--.name: I'll do whatever it takes to protect Maple World.

118212219009472--.name: Still, I can't help but worry.

118212219009473--.name: $npcName:11003795[gender:0]$ will be the first of many.

118212219009475--.name: I didn't tell you? $npcName:11003795[gender:0]$ wasn't the only great being sealed away during the War of Light and Darkness. There were many others. I saw them in an ancient tome handed down by my family.

118212219009476--.name: And besides, $npcName:11003795[gender:0]$'s evil aura was so powerful, I'm sure he managed to influence plenty of monsters and divine creatures before he left this world... We'd do well to be prepared.

118212219009477--.name: This all seems rather vague, and like something you should've brought up sooner.

118212219009478--.name: Well, maybe I'm worrying over nothing. It's just a gut feeling... Still, I'll keep an eye out for trouble.

118212219009479--.name: I trust you'll keep us in the loop.

118212219009480--.name: Of course I will. Now, this is where we part ways, $MyPCName$.

118212219009482--.name: Yes... I've already troubled everyone enough. Besides, there are things I need to set in order, in case worst comes to worst. It's time I moved on.

118212219009483--.name: But this isn't goodbye forever. I'll be right here beside you when—err—if $npcName:11003795[gender:0]$ and his ilk ever return.

118212219009485--.name: Until next time. Fortune be with you.

118212219009486--.name: Did you actually think that would work?

118212219009487--.name: Did you actually think that would work?

118212219009489--.name: I have to admit, the fact you thought a mild inconvenience would save you from the $npcName:11001811[gender:0]$ is pitifully sad.

124203719009514--.name: Well aren't you snippy, for a complete and total failure?

124203719009515--.name: Enough. I came for what you promised.

124203719009518--.name: "The deal is off?" Have you forgotten that your very survival is contingent upon this "deal?"

124203719009520--.name: Oh no, a loud noise! We'd better retreat!

124203719009521--.name: You failed to stop $npcName:11003795[gender:0]$'s revival, and return me to my rightful place as ruler of my kind.

124203719009522--.name: And yet you expect me to hand over the Lapenta Shard? I owe you nothing!

124203719009523--.name: ...You seem to have a short memory.

124203719009524--.name: Did Bella, or did she not deliver the location of Infernog's Blood to the Crimson Balrogs?

124203719009525--.name: Did she not incite them to attack the Sky Fortress? It seems to me we did precisely what we promised.

124203719009526--.name: It was you who failed to strike when the vessel was under siege and your brethren were distracted. You squandered the perfect opportunity to destroy them both.

124203719009527--.name: I couldn't risk it! My father was never supposed to awaken so soon. Who could have known that stupid human would deliver his blood directly to him?

124203719009528--.name: Your cowardice and your weakness are not my concern. Now, I tire of this.

124203719009529--.name: Do you have any last words before I put you out of your misery?

124203719009531--.name:
...Just take it.
<font color='#909090'>(Balrog reluctantly surrenders the Lapenta Shard to the Black Mage)</font>

124203719009532--.name: Hmph. You could have saved some small shred of your pride if you'd only handed it over to begin with.

124203719009533--.name: Our business here is concluded. Let's go.

124203719009534--.name: Yes, my liege. And as for the lord without a kingdom, I'll see you around.

124203719009535--.name: Grr... You won't get away with this.

124203719009536--.name: You and all those insects in the sky who meddled in my affairs...! Just you wait!

104192919010134-Kritias_2018_12-.name: $MyPCName$, it's good to see you in the flesh. So, what do you think of $map:02020041$?

104192919010135-Kritias_2018_12-.name: $map:02020041$? Is that the name of this place?

104192919010136-Kritias_2018_12-.name: That is correct. Kritias is a strange new world to us. Any prolonged operations in the area demand a base of operations. This is ours. Humanitas helped us pick out a location to break ground.

104192919010137-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Of course, none of this would be possible without your aid. Thanks to you, we have made new allies and established a safe haven in Kritias. $MyPCName$, thank you for everything.

104192919010138-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I was just doing my duty.

104192919010139-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Well then, ready for your next assignment?

104192919010140-Kritias_2018_12-.name: <font color="#909090">(Well that was a fine example of modesty backfiring spectacularly...)</font>

111103919010658-Kritias_2018_12-.name: We're beginning to form a rough understanding of this place, but there is much still to learn.

111103919010659-Kritias_2018_12-.name: There are enemies here, both familiar and foreign. It falls to us to ensure we are prepared for anything that may come.

111103919010660-Kritias_2018_12-.name: $npcName:11004430[gender:0]$ may have failed to acquire the Blue Lapenta, but he and his Daemon Army remain a threat to us and to Kritias. We must determine the strength of his forces and their next objective. According to Humanitas, Daemon soldiers have been recently sighted in $map:02020029$.

111103919010661-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I want you to travel to the $map:02020029$ and pick up the Daemon Army's trail.

104192919010141-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Travel to the $map:02020029$ and pick up the Daemon Army's trail.

104192919010142-Kritias_2018_12-.name: <font color="#909090">(You've made it to $map:02020029$, but how are you going to locate the Daemon Army's forces?)</font>

104192919010143-Kritias_2018_12-.name: <font color="#909090">(This forest is huge, and all the trees look the same...)</font>

104192919010144-Kritias_2018_12-.name: (Maybe if you make enough of a scene, the Daemon Army will find you.)

104192919010146-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Maybe if I make enough of a scene, the Daemon Army will find me!

104192919010147-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Maybe if I make enough of a scene, the Daemon Army will find me!

104192919010148-Kritias_2018_12-.name: <font color="#909090">(Hm... Violently purging the local wildlife doesn't seem to be helping.)</font>

104192919010149-Kritias_2018_12-.name: $MyPCName$, do you read me? Our aerial surveillance has revealed evidence of a battle in $map:02020029$. Have you engaged the Daemon Army? We have reinforcements standing by to assist you.

104192919010150-Kritias_2018_12-.name: T-that won't be necessary! I was just making a scene in hopes of getting the Daemon Army's attention…

104192919010153-Kritias_2018_12-.name: If you require assistance completing your mission, do not hesitate to call me.

104192919010154-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Our sensors are detecting movement outside of $map:02020030$. It's possible the Daemon Army is amassing for another attack on our allies. As your current plan has not borne fruit, perhaps it's time to move on.

104192919010159-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Do you have a visual on the Daemon Army?

104192919010160-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Yes. They have a number of troops in the area.

104192919010162-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Then engage them at once. If you drive them from this area, perhaps we can follow them to their stronghold.

104192919010165-Kritias_2018_12-.name: $MyPCName$, have you succeeded in driving the Daemon Army from $map:02020030$?

104192919010166-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Not all of them, but they should definitely be thinking twice about sticking around.

104192919010167-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Good work. $npcName:11004315[gender:0]$ has an update that may be of interest to you.

104192919010169-Kritias_2018_12-.name: While you were engaging the Daemon Army soldiers, Sky Fortress's radar detected a large-scale movement of Daemon forces in the vicinity of the $map:02020032$ and $map:02020003$.

104192919010170-Kritias_2018_12-.name: We believe these two locations are of strategic value to the Daemon Army. If we attack them there once their forces are gathered, we have an opportunity to deal them a crippling blow.

111104719010662-Kritias_2018_12-.name:
We cannot allow these fiends free rein in Kritias. Engage the Daemon troops at either of these strategic points, and show no mercy!

<font color="#00aaef">(Completing this quest requires you to win one Legion Battle. While exploring the Kritias continent, invitations to participate in Legion Battles will appear as periodic pop-up notifications warning that a region is under siege. When minimized, this notification displays as a red radar screen.)</font>

104192919010171-Kritias_2018_12-.name:
We've detected an influx of Daemon Army troops in the vicinity of $map:02020032$ and $map:02020003$. Defeating them at either of these locations could deal a devastating blow to their forces.

<font color="#00aaef">(Completing this quest requires you to win one Legion Battle. While exploring the Kritias continent, invitations to participate in Legion Battles will appear as periodic pop-up notifications warning that a region is under siege. When minimized, this notification displays as a red radar screen.)</font>

104192919010172-Kritias_2018_12-.name:
We've detected an influx of Daemon Army troops in the vicinity of $map:02020032$ and $map:02020003$. Defeating them at either of these locations could deal a devastating blow to their forces.

<font color="#00aaef">(Completing this quest requires you to win one Legion Battle. While exploring the Kritias continent, invitations to participate in Legion Battles will appear as periodic pop-up notifications warning that a region is under siege. When minimized, this notification displays as a red radar screen.)</font>

104192919010173-Kritias_2018_12-.name: How did $npcName:11004430[gender:0]$ raise such an army in so little time...?

104192919010177-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Good. There are matters we must discuss. Return to base immediately.

104192919010180-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Ah, $MyPCName$. I'm glad you made it back safely.

104192919010181-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Tell me, what have you learned from your recent engagement with the Daemon Army?

104192919010182-Kritias_2018_12-.name: From what I saw, their army is very large. And more importantly, it's made up of skilled warriors.

104192919010183-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Of course, there's no telling if the forces I went up against account for the entirety of Turka's army.

104192919010184-Kritias_2018_12-.name: A fine observation. We should relay your findings to Humanitas. $npcName:11004315[gender:0]$, patch us through to $npcName:11004395[gender:1]$.

104192919010185-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Aye, Captain! Patching you through now!

111105019010664-Kritias_2018_12-.name: This is Captain $npcName:11004312[gender:0]$. We've just engaged with a large contingent of the Daemon Army. Their forces in Kritias are much more substantial than we anticipated. You should caution your troops accordingly.

111105019010665-Kritias_2018_12-.name: The Daemon Army... As though we don't have enough to deal with Tairen and Kharon chipping away at our defenses. We'll make the necessary precautions. Thank you for reaching out to warn us.

111105019010666-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Our journeys in this new land continue to be met with unexpected challenges. We must continue to rise to the occasion.

111105019010667-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Good work today, $MyPCName$. Get some rest before your next mission, you've earned it.

104192919010186-Kritias_2018_12-.name: You've been in Kritias for some time now. What do you think of this land?

104192919010187-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Deadly monsters, evil robots, and dark forces conspiring to take over the world... Kritias may have its quirks, but in a lot of ways, it's just like home.

104192919010188-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Well put. And as it seems Kritias isn't going anywhere any time soon, it may be time to begin considering it just another part of Maple World.

104192919010189-Kritias_2018_12-.name: So, do you have a new mission for me?

104192919010190-Kritias_2018_12-.name: $npcName:11004401[gender:1]$, the leader of Humanitas has requested our assistance.

104192919010191-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Our resources are somewhat limited at the moment, so I thought it would be best for everyone if I sent you rather than a platoon of cadets.

104192919010192-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I suspect $npcName:11004395[gender:1]$ will have no problems with that decision.

111105319010668-Kritias_2018_12-.name: $npcName:11004395[gender:1]$ will brief you on the details of the assignment in person. Go and speak with her in $map:02020030$.

104192919010193-Kritias_2018_12-.name: $npcName:11004395[gender:1]$ will brief you on the details of the assignment in person. Go and speak with her in $map:02020030$.

104192919010194-Kritias_2018_12-.name: $MyPCName$ to the Captain, do you read me?

104192919010195-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I'm here. What did she say?

104192919010196-Kritias_2018_12-.name: My mission is to take $map:02020004$ from Tairen.

104192919010197-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I see. As we have begun sharing resources, securing $map:02020004$ and the supplies housed there will benefit both Humanitas and the Alliance. Can I count on you to assist our friends?

111105319010669-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Excellent. Contact me once you arrive in $map:02020004$.

104192919010200-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Contact me once you've arrived in $map:02020004$.

104192919010201-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Contact me once you've arrived in $map:02020004$.

104192919010202-Kritias_2018_12-.name: $MyPCName$ to Captain Veliche, I've arrived in $map:02020004$.

104192919010203-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Very good. I've bridged in Humanitas to discuss the operation.

104192919010204-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I'd like to begin, by thanking you both for assisting us with a matter that has little to do with you. As we've discussed, $map:02020004$ is a Tairen-occupied town of considerable strategic interest to Humanitas.

104192919010205-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Our interests lie in the town's warehouse, for the Tairen have stockpiled a wide variety of supplies there that are of immense value to our organization.

104192919010206-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Our previous attempt to capture the warehouse was nearly a success, until the Tairen received reinforcements from the capital.

104192919010207-Kritias_2018_12-.name: At present, we cannot take $map:02020004$ without risking heavy casualties or compromising our defenses. I would like you to subdue the Tairen forces defending the area, so we can secure it with no loss of life on our side.

104192919010208-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Once the area is secured, we will share the liberated supplies with the Alliance, as per the terms of our agreement.

104192919010209-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Understood. Well $MyPCName$, I leave it to you. Demolish the $npcNamePlural:25020401$ and $npcNamePlural:25020402$ on site, and the Tairen should have no choice but to retreat.

104192919010214-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Our sensors are detecting movement. It seems the enemy has begun their retreat. Excellent work, as always.

104192919010215-Kritias_2018_12-.name: You've impressed me again, $MyPCName$. These supplies should last us for some time, thank you.

104192919010216-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Were you always this pressed for supplies?

104192919010217-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Before your people arrived, we were waging a battle on two fronts—the Tairen on one side, and the Kharon on the other. We managed to hold our own, but resources were tight—especially when dealing with Tairen's new generation of soldiers.

104192919010218-Kritias_2018_12-.name: When those you call the forces of darkness arrived in our land, it seemed our long battle was finally lost.

104192919010219-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Fortunately for us, your Sky Fortress arrived to even the odds. I know it comes a bit late, but I'd like to express our gratitude for your aid.

104192919010220-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I more than anyone understand the pressures you must have been under as the leader of your people. I'm glad we have reached an arrangement that serves us all.

104192919010221-Kritias_2018_12-.name: $MyPCName$, I know I may have been difficult when we first met. I'm sorry.

104192919010223-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Wait... Our equipment is detecting an uptick in encrypted radio chatter. I believe our enemy may be regrouping for a counter-offensive.

104192919010225-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Hah. Ever confident. Very well, dispatch the enemy forces.

104192919010228-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Uh oh, I think you made them angry... I'm detecting a huge spike in aetherine energy nearby. Could that be their commander?

104192919010229-Kritias_2018_12-.name: A large spike in aetherine energy—in $map:02020004$? That must be a $npcName:25020405[gender:0]$! It's too dangerous, $MyPCName$! Get out of there!

104192919010230-Kritias_2018_12-.name: The Alliance doesn't retreat in the face of danger.

111105619010670-Kritias_2018_12-.name: How confident are you in your odds of success?

111105619010672-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I believe in you, $MyPCName$. Show this Tairen commander the might of Sky Fortress and the Maple Alliance.

104192919010233-Kritias_2018_12-.name: The aetherine energy signature has vanished from our sensors! That means $MyPCName$ was victorious!

104192919010234-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Truly incredible. I don't know how to thank you for your aid.

104192919010235-Kritias_2018_12-.name: We're allies. Helping each other is what we do.

104192919010236-Kritias_2018_12-.name: It's been a long mission, $MyPCName$. Why don't you return to $map:02020041$ and get some rest?

104192919010237-Kritias_2018_12-.name: That idea doesn't sound half bad.

104192919010239-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Then I'll see you here. $npcName:11004395[gender:1]$, I'll contact you on a separate channel to discuss supply logistics.

104192919010240-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Your mission is over. Return to base.

104192919010241-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Your mission is over. Return to base.

104192919010242-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I was starting to get worried about you, $MyPCName$. Are you hurt?

104192919010244-Kritias_2018_12-.name: As thanks for your efforts, Humanitas has made an extremely generous gesture and sent us half of the supplies liberated from $map:02020004$.

104192919010245-Kritias_2018_12-.name: As a result, our efforts to find local sources for all of our everyday needs have been significantly eased. Any fears of last-resort plans like resupplying in the mainland can be put to rest.

104192919010246-Kritias_2018_12-.name: The crew has asked me to relay their gratitude to you.

104192919010247-Kritias_2018_12-.name: $npcName:11004395[gender:1]$ is the one who made good on her promise to send the supplies. She's the one they should be thanking.

104192919010248-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Hah. You're too humble. In any case, good work. Go and rest up for your next mission.

107211319010249-Kritias_2018_12-.name: What's the word, Captain? Do you have any special missions for me?

107211319010250-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Special missions? No. Thanks in part to your own excellent work, I don't have any missions that require your special skills at the moment. I'll let you know if that changes. Thanks for checking in.

107211319010251-Kritias_2018_12-.name: If you're looking for something to do, I've got a mission for you!

107211319010253-Kritias_2018_12-.name: There's a strange rumor the ship's crew have been tossing around.

107211319010254-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Since there wasn't any urgent spy work that needed my attention, and I'd already finished reading Nairin's diary from front to back, I decided to look into the rumor. And you'll never guess what I found!

107211319010255-Kritias_2018_12-.name: They're here. I'll give you a hint—it concerns an old friend of ours. A winged beast with a face only a mother could love.

107211319010256-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I really don't know what you're talking about.

107211319010257-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Hmm... Have you really made it this far on your good looks alone? Well then, why don't you go to $map:02020013$ and see for yourself.

107211319010258-Kritias_2018_12-.name: If you still can't figure it out, then give me a call.

107211319010259-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Didn't Schatten ask you to go to $map:02020013$?

107211319010260-Kritias_2018_12-.name:
<font color="#909090">(You pick up your radio and push the talk button).</font>
$MyPCName$ to Schatten. I'm here.

107211319010261-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Hey there cutie! Did you figure it out?

107211319010262-Kritias_2018_12-.name: No. I'm going to need a little more to go on. Also, this seems like a misappropriation of Alliance resources.

107211319010263-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Hmph! You're no fun. A winged beast with a big ugly face?

107211319010264-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Who else but could I have meant but $npcName:23090006[gender:0]$?

107211319010265-Kritias_2018_12-.name: You saw $npcName:23090006[gender:0]$, here? Why didn't you report this to me?!

107211319010266-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Weren’t you listening? I just did. I saw him flying around $map:02020013$ with my own two eyes. Who knows what he's doing in Kritias or what he is plotting. But if we leave him to his own devices, he's going to become a problem for us eventually.

111110919010673-Kritias_2018_12-.name: You hear that, Kitten? The Captain agrees! You need to track down $npcName:23090006[gender:0]$ and figure out what he's doing here!

107211319010268-Kritias_2018_12-.name: You need to track down $npcName:23090006[gender:0]$ and figure out what he's doing in Kritias.

107211319010269-Kritias_2018_12-.name: You need to track down $npcName:23090006[gender:0]$ and figure out what he's doing in Kritias.

107211319010272-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I didn't find $npcName:23090006[gender:0]$</font>, but I did run into a $npcName:25020906$.

107211319010274-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Here, I took a picture. I'm sending it now...

107211319010275-Kritias_2018_12-.name: That's a $npcName:25020906$ all right, no doubt about it.

107211319010276-Kritias_2018_12-.name: It looks like $npcName:23090006[gender:0]$ is here and he brought his lackeys.

107211319010277-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Not necessarily... The $npcNamePlural:25020906[gender:0]$ have had two masters. Either one's presence here spells trouble. $npcName:11004315[gender:0]$ run a sensor sweep! Use the existing profile for $npcName:23090006[gender:0]$'s biosignature.

107211319010278-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Aye, Captain! Tasking sensors now...! I've got something! I'm detecting a signature matching $npcName:23090006[gender:0]$ in $map:02020017$!

111110919010674-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Just as we feared. We need to warn Humanitas. Switch over to their frequency. $MyPCName$, I want you to go to $map:02020017$ while we formulate a strategy.

107211319010281-Kritias_2018_12-.name: This is Captain Veliche for Humanitas, can you hear me?

107211319010282-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Loud and clear, Captain. What seems to be the matter?

107211319010283-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I'm calling to warn you that we have acquired evidence that $npcName:23090006[gender:0]$ has come to Kritias.

107211319010285-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Imagine a giant, angry, fireproof monkey with wings and a wicked scythe.

107211319010286-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Yes, I believe we've seen the creature you describe. That monster arrived just after the seal on Kritias was broken. Our soldiers risked their life to discover his purpose here.

107211319010288-Kritias_2018_12-.name: He said he was searching for a "new power." Our troops reported he was gathering aetherine, and something called "lapenshards."

107211319010289-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I don't quite understand what these lapenshards are, though.

111111319010675-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Lapenshards are gems that echo the power of the Lapentas—giant crystals that govern the very nature of our reality. We have not determined precisely how they made their way to your land.

111111319010676-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I see. Well, we cannot allow such power to fall into the hands of a beast like that.

107211319010290-Kritias_2018_12-.name: It seems we are in complete agreement.

107211319010291-Kritias_2018_12-.name: It seems we are in complete agreement.

107211319010292-Kritias_2018_12-.name: One thing is certain. If $npcName:23090006[gender:0]$ gains the power he seeks, he will be a danger to both our people alike.

107211319010293-Kritias_2018_12-.name: We've been tracking his location. I'll send you the coordinates of his lair.

111111319010678-Kritias_2018_12-.name: $MyPCName$, travel to $npcName:11004395[gender:1]$'s coordinates at once and engage $npcName:23090006[gender:0]$ in battle. We will send forces to assist you as soon as we can.

107211319010294-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Travel to $npcName:11004395[gender:1]$'s coordinates at once and engage $npcName:23090006[gender:0]$ in battle. We will send forces to assist you as soon as we can.

107211319010295-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Travel to $npcName:11004395[gender:1]$'s coordinates at once and engage $npcName:23090006[gender:0]$ in battle. We will send forces to assist you as soon as we can.

107211319010296-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Captain, can you hear me...? Hello?

107211319010297-Kritias_2018_12-.name: <font color="#909090">(Your radio makes a sad whine when the talk button is pressed.)</font>

107211319010298-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Uh oh... I think the battery's starting to go. I'd better return to $map:02020041$ and make my report in person.

107211319010299-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I think my radio is dead... I'd better return to $map:02020041$ and make my report in person.

107211319010300-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I think my radio is dead... I'd better return to $map:02020041$ and make my report in person.

107211319010301-Kritias_2018_12-.name: $MyPCName$! When I didn't hear from you, I started to worry. Thank heavens you're safe.

107211319010302-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Sorry about that, something was up with my walkie-talkie.

107211319010303-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Was it damaged in battle? I'll make sure you're issued a new one. As for your mission—what happened? Is it over? Did you defeat $npcName:23090006[gender:0]$?

107211319010304-Kritias_2018_12-.name: It wasn't easy, but I took him down.

107211319010305-Kritias_2018_12-.name: You never cease to impress, pumpkin. I guess we can consider $npcName:23090006[gender:0]$ officially spanked.

107211319010306-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Let's not celebrate just yet. Defeating $npcName:23090006[gender:0]$ may have been easy, however…

107211319010307-Kritias_2018_12-.name: If $npcName:23090006[gender:0]$ was here, then we may be facing <i>another threat</>.

111111519010679-Kritias_2018_12-.name: We should contact $npcName:11003853[gender:0]$ just to be safe. In any case, good work, $MyPCName$.

1031125219009918-Kritias_Inferno01-.name: Ah, $MyPCName$, exactly the person I was hoping to speak with. $npcName:11004555[gender:0]$'s transport has arrived in Kritias and is en route to $map:02020041$ as we speak.

124162319010800-Kritias_Inferno01-.name: I had intended to hold our briefing after $npcName:11004555[gender:0]$ arrived, but as time is of the essence, we'll have to conduct it by radio. $npcName:11004315[gender:0]$, please patch us through.

124162319010801-Kritias_Inferno01-.name: Connection established! This is Alliance mobile command to $npcName:11004555[gender:0]$, do you copy?

124162319010802-Kritias_Inferno01-.name:
H-hello? What an interesting device. Do I put this part on my ear? You know, I never had to mess about with this sort of techno-nonsense in the Knights. And what do I do with this fuzzy bit? Hello?
<font color="#909090">(You hear a series of uncomfortably loud thumps and clicks as $npcName:11004555[gender:0]$ fumbles with the microphone.)</font>

124162319010803-Kritias_Inferno01-.name: Hello, $npcName:11004555[gender:0]$? You've got to put the ear-shaped hook around your ear, and the fuzzy microphone bit in front of your mouth. No—not inside your mouth! Agh! There, that's better.

124162319010804-Kritias_Inferno01-.name: Ah, it's just like old times.

124162319010805-Kritias_Inferno01-.name: Ahem. Before anything else, I'd like to thank you for coming so quickly after we called.

124162319010806-Kritias_Inferno01-.name: Don't mention it. If he is here, everything else can wait. Speaking of "here," this place is unusual. I've never felt anything quite like this aura.

1031125219009919-Kritias_Inferno01-.name: Don't mention it. If he is here, everything else can wait. Speaking of "here," this place is unusual. I've never felt anything quite like this aura.

1031125219009920-Kritias_Inferno01-.name: You know, in one of my family's tomes there's a description of an aura like this. I myself was skeptical about it, but it seems it really exists. Perhaps my ancestor was sensing a visitation by a being of this land?

124162319010807-Kritias_Inferno01-.name: It was from a volume of the Daybringer's Chronicles—that was what they called him, my ancestor. If I remember correctly, he served the goddess back when the Sages were still alive. In any case, there was a chapter in his book where he mentioned sensing a presence that was "not of his world." The experience really rattled him.

124162319010808-Kritias_Inferno01-.name: ...Returning to the matter at hand, do you sense $npcName:23000150[gender:0]$'s aura in this land?

1031125219009921-Kritias_Inferno01-.name: ...Returning to the matter at hand, do you sense $npcName:23000150[gender:0]$'s aura in this land?

1031125219009922-Kritias_Inferno01-.name: ...Returning to the matter at hand, do you sense $npcName:23000150[gender:0]$'s aura in this land?

124162319010809-Kritias_Inferno01-.name: As distinctive as $npcName:23000150[gender:0]$'s energy is, it's a bit hard to sniff him out from the overwhelming alien aura of this place. It will take me a little while to re-calibrate.

124162319010810-Kritias_Inferno01-.name: I won't be able to say for certain until I've arrived in $map:02020041$ and searched the surrounding areas from top to bottom.

124162319010811-Kritias_Inferno01-.name: You've just arrived on a foreign continent, and your first instinct is to go traipsing into the wilderness alone?! Do you even know how dangerous this place is?!

124162319010812-Kritias_Inferno01-.name: For once, I'm in agreement with $npcName:11004313[gender:0]$. $npcName:11004555[gender:0]$, you are not yet familiar with the dangers that lurk here.

124162319010813-Kritias_Inferno01-.name: That's not to say I'd have you sit on your hands. Instead, I suggest $MyPCName$ serve as your eyes and ears in the field. What do you say, $MyPCName$?

124162319010815-Kritias_Inferno01-.name: Good. After we first asked $npcName:11004555[gender:0]$ to travel to Kritias, $npcName:11004315[gender:0]$ began working on a portable detector using the data we have gathered on $npcName:23000150[gender:0]$ to date.

124162319010816-Kritias_Inferno01-.name: I want you to use the detector to narrow down $npcName:23000150[gender:0]$'s potential location, and coordinate with $npcName:11004555[gender:0]$ remotely to refine your search. Any questions?

124162319010818-Kritias_Inferno01-.name: Good. It appears that the detector is currently pointing towards $map:02020003$. Why not start your search there?

1031125219009924-Kritias_Inferno01-.name: It appears that the detector is currently pointing towards $map:02020003$. Begin your search there.

1031125219009925-Kritias_Inferno01-.name: It appears that the detector is currently pointing towards $map:02020003$. Begin your search there.

1031125219009926-Kritias_Inferno01-.name: $MyPCName$. I forgot to mention something before you left.

124162319010820-Kritias_Inferno01-.name: I'm watching a live feed of the detector's data, and I may ask for your help to help calibrate the device from time to time.

124162319010822-Kritias_Inferno01-.name: Hmm? No, I just want to make sure the device is working correctly. In fact, unless you're currently surrounded by several Infernogs, I believe I'm getting false positives from the aetherine signatures of nearby Tairen and Kharon soldiers.

124162319010823-Kritias_Inferno01-.name: If you could reduce the number of $npcNamePlural:25021504$, $npcNamePlural:25021505$ and $npcNamePlural:25021502$ in the area, I should be able to isolate their aetherine signatures and modify the detector to ignore them.

1031125219009927-Kritias_Inferno01-.name: If you could reduce the number of $npcNamePlural:25021504$, $npcNamePlural:25021505$ and $npcNamePlural:25021502$ in the area, I should be able to isolate their aetherine signatures and modify the detector to ignore them.

1031125219009928-Kritias_Inferno01-.name: If you could reduce the number of $npcNamePlural:25021504$, $npcNamePlural:25021505$ and $npcNamePlural:25021502$ in the area, I should be able to isolate their aetherine signatures and modify the detector to ignore them.

1031125219009929-Kritias_Inferno01-.name: Captain! Now that the interference has been eliminated, the detector is reading one biosignature loud and clear!

124162319010825-Kritias_Inferno01-.name: Not far from $MyPCName$'s location! It looks like he's somewhere in the vicinity of $map:02020018$.

124162319010827-Kritias_Inferno01-.name: Captain, we need a plan before we send our favorite hero off to battle $npcName:23000150[gender:0]$. Our last foolproof plan fell notably short.

124162319010828-Kritias_Inferno01-.name: You're right. We need to formulate a new strategy. $MyPCName$, you're to return to base for now.

124162319010829-Kritias_Inferno01-.name: Hello! Hello?! Am I finally on the right frequency? Can you all hear me?

124162319010831-Kritias_Inferno01-.name: $MyPCName$, I'm headed your way. Meet me at $npcName:23000150[gender:0]$'s current location! I've finally done it! I've found a way to kill him!

124162319010832-Kritias_Inferno01-.name: You found a way to kill him?!

124162319010834-Kritias_Inferno01-.name: A power from outside our world, aetherine! It doesn't operate the way normal magic does—I'm certain it can break through $npcName:23000150[gender:0]$s defenses and truly wound him!

124162319010835-Kritias_Inferno01-.name: I borrowed some processed aetherine from $npcName:11004315[gender:0]$'s lab on a hunch, and I decided to have a few sips, Now I feel a new power flowing within me! This power... it can kill him! I've never been more certain!

124162319010836-Kritias_Inferno01-.name: Hold on just a moment! You took aetherine from $npcName:11004315[gender:0]$'s lab and drank it?!

124162319010837-Kritias_Inferno01-.name: That was incredibly reckless. You could have died! $npcName:11004555[gender:0]$, $MyPCName$, you are both to return here at once!

124162319010838-Kritias_Inferno01-.name: Captain, we'll never know if it works unless we test it.

124162319010839-Kritias_Inferno01-.name: It's too dangerous! The Alliance needs both of you—alive!

124162319010840-Kritias_Inferno01-.name: Trust me, Captain. At the first sign the aetherine doesn't at least horribly maim $npcName:11004555[gender:0]$, we'll zip out of there like a Koborc on fire.

124162319010843-Kritias_Inferno01-.name: Very well. Then I order you to defeat $npcName:23000150[gender:0]$ and return safely.

1031125219009930-Kritias_Inferno01-.name: Very well. Then I order you to defeat $npcName:23000150[gender:0]$ and return safely.

1031125219009931-Kritias_Inferno01-.name: Very well. Then I order you to defeat $npcName:23000150[gender:0]$ and return safely.

124162319010846-Kritias_Inferno01-.name: We're both safe. Not only that, but our $npcName:23000150[gender:0]$ problem is finally over.

124162319010847-Kritias_Inferno01-.name: What a relief. I'll debrief when you arrive in $map:02020041$. Return as quickly as you can.

1031125219009933-Kritias_Inferno01-.name: I'll debrief when you arrive in $map:02020041$. Return as quickly as you can.

1031125219009934-Kritias_Inferno01-.name: I'll debrief when you arrive in $map:02020041$. Return as quickly as you can.

1031125219009935-Kritias_Inferno01-.name: I'm glad to see you safely returned. But where is $npcName:11004555[gender:0]$?

124162319010848-Kritias_Inferno01-.name: He refused to come back with me.

124162319010850-Kritias_Inferno01-.name: Maybe he wanted to make sure $npcName:23000150[gender:0]$ is really dead. It's been his family's sworn duty for I don't know how many generations to protect Maple World from that sort of evil. I don't imagine it will be easy to let go.

124162319010851-Kritias_Inferno01-.name: I wouldn't be surprised if he was still there standing over the body, sword ready, waiting to see if it twitches.

124162319010852-Kritias_Inferno01-.name: I think Condor's right. He wants to be sure this is finally over.

124162319010853-Kritias_Inferno01-.name: Is that so? I suppose he needs time to come to grips with things. Well, this turn of events calls for a celebration.

124162319010854-Kritias_Inferno01-.name: You've done an amazing thing, $MyPCName$. Truly. Though our work here is far from over, it's important to enjoy these victories when they come.

124162319010855-Kritias_Inferno01-.name: Tonight Maple World is safe. Take the day to gather with those you hold dear and celebrate life. Tomorrow, our work continues.

1031125219009936-Kritias_Inferno01-.name: A great deal has happened since we arrived in Kritias. Your triumph over $npcName:23090006[gender:0]$ and $npcName:23000150[gender:0]$ was nothing short of astonishing.

124162319010856-Kritias_Inferno01-.name: Yeah, I guess I am pretty great.

124162319010857-Kritias_Inferno01-.name:
<font color="#909090">(She gives an unexpected chuckle.)</font>
Now that the most imminent threats to Maple World have been addressed, it is time to finally resume our exploration of Kritias.

124162319010858-Kritias_Inferno01-.name: Of course, there are still a number of obstacles that will stand in our way.

124162319010860-Kritias_Inferno01-.name: Such as Kharon and the soldiers of Tairen.

124162319010861-Kritias_Inferno01-.name: The best course of action to address their interference is a preemptive strike. As luck would have it, we an ally with a part to play in this fight.

124162319010862-Kritias_Inferno01-.name: In light of your many achievements and your good relations with Humanitas, I would like you to lead the operation.

124162319010864-Kritias_Inferno01-.name: Excellent. Proceed to $map:02020009$ and await further instruction.

1031125219009937-Kritias_Inferno01-.name: Excellent. Proceed to $map:02020009$ and await further instruction.

1031125219009938-Kritias_Inferno01-.name: This joint operation represents a new chapter in the relations of our peoples, and will surely inflict a devastating blow against our enemies. I'd like to thank all of you for your cooperation, especially $MyPCName$.

124162319010865-Kritias_Inferno01-.name: There's no need for that. Our objective is one and the same.

124162319010866-Kritias_Inferno01-.name: While you were dealing with that monster from your realm, Humanitas was gathering intelligence on Tairen.

124162319010867-Kritias_Inferno01-.name: We've discovered that $map:02020009$ is one of the Kharon's primary bases of operations. By striking here, we can cripple them in a single blow!

124162319010868-Kritias_Inferno01-.name: The elite soldiers of Tairen go through a prolonged and specialized training period, which means it takes quite some time to replace those who fall in battle. The Kharon however have much less exacting standards. They regularly supplant their ranks with conscripted exiles.

124162319010869-Kritias_Inferno01-.name: This is what makes them of such strategic value to the Tairen. They further the Tairen agenda without the shedding of any Tairen blood. For their services, the Kharon are handsomely rewarded.

124162319010870-Kritias_Inferno01-.name: Today we attack the Kharon with such ferocity that they have no choice but to reconsider their arrangement. We will show them that Humanitas is far better positioned to win this war of attrition. And at the very least, we will force them to adopt a defensive posture, buying Humanitas a much needed respite from their onslaught.

124162319010871-Kritias_Inferno01-.name: The time has come to strike back! Unleash your wrath against any $npcName:25021601$, $npcName:25021602$, or $npcName:25021603$ that crosses your path!

1031125219009939-Kritias_Inferno01-.name: Unleash your wrath against any $npcName:25021601$, $npcName:25021602$, or $npcName:25021603$ that crosses your path!

1031125219009940-Kritias_Inferno01-.name: Unleash your wrath against any $npcName:25021601$, $npcName:25021602$, or $npcName:25021603$ that crosses your path!

1031125219009941-Kritias_Inferno01-.name: We're detecting a significant reduction in aetherine signatures in the vicinity. Excellent work.

124162319010872-Kritias_Inferno01-.name: Thanks to you, Kharon military strength has been drastically diminished. We must capitalize on this momentum.

124162319010873-Kritias_Inferno01-.name: While you were fighting, our scans of the area identified an object of interest.

124162319010874-Kritias_Inferno01-.name: Have you seen the large drill there? It seemed unlikely that Kharon could construct and maintain such a device on their own, so naturally Humanitas has been investigating the matter. Using the sensor array on your Sky Fortress, we were able to confirm the device is being operated remotely by Tairen.

124162319010875-Kritias_Inferno01-.name: We haven't determined their purpose for placing the drill their, however, its presence presents a unique opportunity. If we access the device manually, we should be able to decrypt their signal and obtain the Tairen access code!

124162319010876-Kritias_Inferno01-.name: Once we have obtained this code, we can use it to gain entry to countless Tairen facilities for espionage, or sabotage—at least until they detect the intrusion and generate new access codes.

124162319010877-Kritias_Inferno01-.name: $MyPCName$, go to the drill and initiate a connection between the device and Sky Fortress. $npcName:11004315[gender:0]$ will work with Cat Sith to decrypt the access code.

1031125219009942-Kritias_Inferno01-.name: Go to the drill and initiate a connection between the device and Sky Fortress. $npcName:11004315[gender:0]$ will work with Cat Sith to decrypt the access code.

1031125219009943-Kritias_Inferno01-.name: Go to the drill and initiate a connection between the device and Sky Fortress. $npcName:11004315[gender:0]$ will work with Cat Sith to decrypt the access code.

1031125219009944-Kritias_Inferno01-.name: It's done! We've secured the access code.

124162319010878-Kritias_Inferno01-.name: $MyPCName$, could I ask another favor of you?

124162319010879-Kritias_Inferno01-.name: Our reconnaissance teams tell us that $npcNamePlural:25021604$ at that location are transporting $itemPlural:30001257$ supplied to them by the Tairen. If you were to deprive them of this vital resource, it would seriously hamstring the mobility of their forces and their ability to power their weapons of war.

124162319010880-Kritias_Inferno01-.name: Will you seize the $itemPlural:30001257$ on our behalf?

124162319010881-Kritias_Inferno01-.name: Hobbling Kharon will allow our own expeditionary forces to explore Kritias more safely. Are you up to the task?

124162319010883-Kritias_Inferno01-.name: Excellent. Then go relieve those $npcNamePlural:25021604$ of their $item:30001257$.

1031125219009947-Kritias_Inferno01-.name: We have one final assignment for you before you return to base.

124162319010885-Kritias_Inferno01-.name: Now that the enemy forces in the area have been crippled, we have been afforded a unique opportunity.

124162319010886-Kritias_Inferno01-.name: Somewhere under the $map:02020009$ is a control center that oversees all ecological experiments in the area. By gaining access to and redirecting the facility's primary controls to our computers, we can find out what sorts of experiments they're running, and perhaps use them to our own ends.

124162319010887-Kritias_Inferno01-.name: As Sky Fortress's radar was unable to penetrate the $map:52100108$, we don't know what sort of defenses they may have in place. But if there's anyone I trust to carry out this mission, it's you.

124162319010888-Kritias_Inferno01-.name: Gain entry to the $map:52100108$ and redirect the primary controls.

1031125219009948-Kritias_Inferno01-.name: Gain entry to the $map:52100108$ and redirect the primary controls.

1031125219009949-Kritias_Inferno01-.name: Gain entry to the $map:52100108$ and redirect the primary controls.

124162319010889-Kritias_Inferno01-.name: I can hear you. What is your status?

124162319010890-Kritias_Inferno01-.name: The control room was under guard, but I managed to access and redirect the primary controls.

124162319010891-Kritias_Inferno01-.name: I never doubted you for a moment. It's been a long mission—return to base.

1031125219009953-Kritias_Inferno01-.name: Another job well done. Humanitas has been waiting to thank you for your hard work.

124162319010892-Kritias_Inferno01-.name: $MyPCName$! I'm glad you've returned safely. I was starting to worry.

124162319010894-Kritias_Inferno01-.name: I'd like to thank you—on behalf of both your Alliance, and Humanitas. As a result of your efforts, we can finally travel beyond $map:02020013$ without meeting insurmountable resistance.

124162319010897-Kritias_Inferno01-.name: No matter what awaits us, there is no challenge we cannot overcome together.

124162319010898-Kritias_Inferno01-.name: If we are to take Sky Fortress deeper into the heart of Kritias, the crew has a lot of work ahead of them.

124162319010899-Kritias_Inferno01-.name: I'll let you know as soon as preparations are complete. But for now, there are other missions that need your attention. Dismissed.

107211319010309-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Ah, $MyPCName$. I'm glad you're here. You must have felt it too—a dark aura so similar, and yet so different.

107211319010310-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I'm not sure what you mean.

107211319010311-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Come now, there's no need to be so humble.

107211319010312-Kritias_2018_12-.name: What exactly are you talking about?

107211319010313-Kritias_2018_12-.name: This darkness feels similar to that of foes we have combated in days past, but with subtle differences. Nevertheless, all of my experience and all of my learnings as a templar tell me this is a threat that cannot be ignored.

110151219010621-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I have my suspicions as to its source, but even as a High Templar there are some Lumiknight secrets I simply cannot share with you. However…

107211319010314-Kritias_2018_12-.name: If you were to discover the darkness's source on your own, well, I could hardly be blamed for your learning its secret. I sense it emanating from somewhere on the outskirts of $map:02020030$. Go there and have a look about.

110183719010618-Kritias_2018_12-.name: You're not coming? But I don't even know what I'm looking for.

110183719010619-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Surely you jest! $map:02020041$ relies on me to protect it from dark psychic forces and threats both seen and unseen. I also coordinate Lumiknight operations in Kritias; I can hardly be expected to do that remotely.

110183719010620-Kritias_2018_12-.name:
<font color="#909090">(You sigh and then stare blankly at Mason for several long seconds.)</font>
Well, I guess I'll be off then.

110183719010621-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Don't worry. I'll do everything in my power to ward off the darkness from here. You should set out for $map:02020030$ now if you want to reach it before nightfall.

107211319010315-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Don't worry. I'll do everything in my power to ward off the darkness from here. You should set out for $map:02020030$ now if you want to reach it before nightfall.

110151019010619-Kritias_2018_12-.name: He means the Shadow Matter Detectors I built. I put several of them in your bag the last time we spoke. You didn't see them in there?

110183719010622-Kritias_2018_12-.name:
What? I don't remember that. When did that happen?
<font color="#909090">(Incredulous, you rummage through your backpack only to discover a handheld device with a screen and several blinking lights.)</font>

107211319010319-Kritias_2018_12-.name: That device was developed by Sky Fortress's R&D department. Like a digital third eye, it pierces the veil between our world and the astral plane, where light and dark energies hover over us like clouds of colored smoke.

110183719010623-Kritias_2018_12-.name: W-what? That's not remotely how it works! My device is based on actual science!

107211319010320-Kritias_2018_12-.name: ...In any case, the instructional manual says it can detect the power of darkness with a high degree of precision.

107211319010321-Kritias_2018_12-.name: You need only distribute them throughout the area, and the devices will do the rest.

107211319010322-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Distribute the Shadow Matter Detectors around $map:02020030$.

107211319010323-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Distribute the Shadow Matter Detectors around $map:02020030$.

107211319010325-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Your work has already borne fruit. Our detectors have pierced the veil and glimpsed the darkness beyond.

107211319010326-Kritias_2018_12-.name: No wonder it felt unusual... This darkness is not magical in nature... According to our detectors, it's radiating on the EM spectrum.

107211319010327-Kritias_2018_12-.name: The way it fluctuates in amplitude, it almost looks like... a transmission. Uploading detector data to Cat Sith for analysis.

110183719010625-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Ah! It is a transmission! It looks like machine code. So much data... It's almost like we're watching a single entity pulling the strings of a vast number of machines!

110183719010626-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I see... Then perhaps this "transmission" is controlling the machines in $MyPCName$'s vicinity as we speak?

110183719010627-Kritias_2018_12-.name: We already have an eye witness in $map:02020031$ who said that Turka somehow took control of all of the Tairen machines in the area... That can't be a coincidence. Maybe he got his hands on some kind of control device?

107211319010328-Kritias_2018_12-.name: We must understand the method by which the forces of darkness have somehow digitized their evil.

107211319010329-Kritias_2018_12-.name: $MyPCName$, please go to $map:02020031$ and dismantle some of the machines there for analysis.

107211319010330-Kritias_2018_12-.name: $MyPCName$, please go to $map:02020031$ and dismantle some of the machines there for analysis.

107211319010332-Kritias_2018_12-.name: $MyPCName$, how are things going over there?

107211319010333-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I've busted up a bunch of mechanical soldiers, but I haven't found anything out of the ordinary.

107211319010334-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Hm... Strange. But there must be some special mechanism by which these machines are being controlled. After all, none of the wildlife seems to be affected.

107211319010335-Kritias_2018_12-.name: It's quite curious that the forces of darkness have tailored their usual approach to villainy for Kritias—rather than corrupting the local lifeforms, they have corrupted the machines, which are proving far more formidable soldiers.

110183719010629-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Well, we have no greater technology expert at our disposal than $npcName:11004315[gender:0]$. Let's see what she thinks about all this.

107211319010337-Kritias_2018_12-.name: We have no greater technology expert at our disposal than $npcName:11004315[gender:0]$. Let's see what she thinks about all this.

107211319010338-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I'm glad you're ready to turn to actual science to tackle the problem! So, I've been analyzing the energy readings recorded by our Shadow Matter Detectors.

107211319010339-Kritias_2018_12-.name: This is a visualization of the data we've collected.

110183719010630-Kritias_2018_12-.name: It looks like a high-density network...

107211319010340-Kritias_2018_12-.name: You're not completely wrong. From what I can tell, we're seeing one cluster of a neural network.

107211319010341-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Oh! Sorry... Think of it as an advanced form of distributed computing modeled after the human brain, capable of carrying out a number of complex tasks simultaneously by dividing the work up among clusters of artificial neurons.

107211319010342-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Which is to say, an artificial brain that could potentially manipulate countless mechanical soldiers like limbs! This transmission is providing specialized commands to each machine in the network... How could one person ever control such a network alone?

107211319010343-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Perhaps the one pulling the strings is not human at all.

107211319010344-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I agree that no human, no matter how remarkable, could control these machines in this fashion. But I don't believe a human is to blame.

107211319010345-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I agree that no human, no matter how remarkable, could control these machines in this fashion. But I don't believe a human is to blame.

107211319010346-Kritias_2018_12-.name: According to Humanitas, Tairen is an extremely advanced society—both in terms of magic and technology. And they are governed by an artificial intelligence. It stands to reason an AI powerful enough to control a whole kingdom could also control these machines.

110183719010632-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Could Kritias really be so beyond us technologically?

107211319010347-Kritias_2018_12-.name: We need to learn more about whatever being is controlling all these machines using the power of darkness. Perhaps $npcName:11004395[gender:1]$ could help us.

107211319010348-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Good work, $MyPCName$. Return to $map:02020041$ and we'll try to get in contact with her.

107211319010351-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Ah, $MyPCName$—I was just trying to reach you telepathically.

107211319010352-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Your timing is excellent. I have $npcName:11004395[gender:1]$ on the line to discuss the unique darkness we encountered.

107211319010353-Kritias_2018_12-.name: $npcName:11004395[gender:1]$, as I was saying—we believe that all of the corrupted Tairen machines are being controlled by a single entity.

107211319010354-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Considering its transmission resembles a neural network, we can think of only one entity capable of such a feat.

107211319010355-Kritias_2018_12-.name: After analyzing the data you sent us, we can confirm that the machines being controlled by this signal are only a small part of Tairen's forces. And needless to say, there would be no reason for $npcName:11004432$ to hack her own soldiers.

107211319010356-Kritias_2018_12-.name: The network was clearly compromised by a third party. Likely someone from outside of Kritias. Tairen's military networks are secured behind layer after layer of firewall. If someone from your world was able to co-opt them, then your technology is clearly more advanced than we believed.

107211319010357-Kritias_2018_12-.name: However, when our engineers analyzed the signal, they were baffled by the bits of data they managed to decrypt...

110183719010633-Kritias_2018_12-.name: The transmission includes $npcName:11004432$'s unique credentials. I don't know how our hacker managed to fake them...

107211319010358-Kritias_2018_12-.name: What can you tell us about $npcName:11004432$?

107211319010359-Kritias_2018_12-.name: She is an android who controls not just Tairen, but virtually all of Kritias. She is a heartless machine who views people as a commodity. Humanitas will not rest until she is deposed!

107211319010360-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Wait... Do you feel that surge of darkness? We need to investigate its source. I'm afraid our discussion will have to wait.

108202519010361-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Can you feel that surging darkness?

108202519010362-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I'm certain this dark aura belongs to a powerful entity that means us all ill. Deireadh can feel it too... Look at the blade tremble.

108202519010363-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Deireadh tells me the owner of this aura is filled with endless malice. The sword yearns to unleash its righteous wrath and cleanse the world of this evil.

108202519010364-Kritias_2018_12-.name: For the blade to get become so incensed, the source of this evil must be a dangerous individual indeed.

108202519010365-Kritias_2018_12-.name: $MyPCName$, you must investigate this darkness at once.

108202519010367-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Deireadh points in the direction of $map:02020001$. I suspect we'll find our answers there.

108202519010368-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Deireadh points in the direction of $map:02020001$. I suspect we'll find our answers there.

108202519010369-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I'm not seeing any obvious signs of a dark force at work.... Maybe I should've borrowed Mason's magic sword.

108202519010370-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Hm... Maybe I should see if anyone here has seen anything out of the ordinary?

108202519010371-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Hm... Maybe I should see if anyone here has seen anything out of the ordinary?

110183719010634-Kritias_2018_12-.name: No, I'm certain the darkness we seek is immensely powerful. But we do know one individual that fits that description. I suspect it was Turka your witnesses saw.

108202519010377-Kritias_2018_12-.name: According to the eyewitnesses, this "ghost" was muttering something about obtaining power by sacrificing a soul—whatever that means.

108202519010378-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Hmm... This is a matter of great concern. Sacrificing a soul? Soul magic is the darkest type of magic—more foul even than blood magic. I must consult my arcane tomes on the subject.

108202519010379-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Hey there, dumpling! I was listening in on your conversation, and I thought you might be interested to know that one of my undercover agents has sighted your "ghost" in $map:02020006$.

108202519010380-Kritias_2018_12-.name: What a fortunate development! $MyPCName$, please proceed to $map:02020006$ and look into this.

110213219010638-Kritias_2018_12-.name: If not Turka, someone there must be in command of those Daemon forces.

108202519010385-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I'll find a higher ranking Daemon to have a "chat" with.

108202519010386-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I'll find a higher ranking Daemon to have a "chat" with.

108202519010387-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I'll find a higher ranking Daemon to have a "chat" with.

110183719010636-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Sigh... If only you were a High Templar like myself, we could simply communicate telepathically, instead of relying on such unreliable machines.

108202519010389-Kritias_2018_12-.name: In any case, have there been any developments?

108202519010390-Kritias_2018_12-.name:
No one was feeling very chatty, but I did find some orders on one of the bigger Daemons. Here, I'll send you a picture.

108202519010391-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Hm... Let's see. At first glance, these orders seem fairly mundane.

108202519010393-Kritias_2018_12-.name: These orders were penned by Daemon Field Commander $npcName:23000301$... Gah!

108202519010394-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Calm down Deireadh! Stay your wrath! The blade trembles with rage... Could this $npcName:23000301$ be responsible for the darkness I felt?

108202519010409-Kritias_2018_12-.name: But we must first learn what we are up against.

114101519010708-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Hmm... I didn't want to resort to this…

108202519010410-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I must open my mind and gaze into the Eye of Providence—borrowing of its divine power. The authority to perform such a feat is limited to a select few, even among the High Templar. Luckily, I am counted among them.

110213219010640-Kritias_2018_12-.name: ...I have no idea what you are saying.

110213219010642-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Quiet please. It will take all of my focus to peer through the Eye.

110213219010645-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Phew... I managed to glimpse $npcName:23000301$ using the Eye of Providence. However, I could not get as close as I would have liked, for fear of being assaulted in my astral form.

110213219010646-Kritias_2018_12-.name: It's a good thing I volunteered for the Kritias expedition. I shudder to think what would happen had I not been here to help.

108202519010412-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Gazing through the Eye of Providence, I discovered that $npcName:23000301$ possesses a dark and terrible power. But I also saw that there was one among us capable of obliterating that power. I remain uncertain as to whether you are that individual…
