108202519010415-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Don't worry Cadet. Unlike some people, I'm not afraid to get my hands dirty. I'll fight by your side.

108202519010416-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Didn't the Empress entrust you with the defense of $map:02020041$? There's no cause for concern. I'll be watching over $MyPCName$ from here.

108202519010417-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I won't have a cadet die on my watch!

108202519010418-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Don't worry Condor, I can take care of myself. After all, I learned from the best.

108202519010419-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Fine... Go and be a hero. But you'd better come back safe! That's an order!

108202519010420-Kritias_2018_12-.name: The Eye of Providence showed me that $npcName:23000301$ is at the $map:02020032$.

108202519010423-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Alliance Command, do you read me?

108202519010424-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I take it you've arrived at the $map:02020032$? Then please activate the Precision Darkwave Analyzer Nairin gave you.

110213219010649-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Activate the what? Nairin never gave me anything like that.

110213219010650-Kritias_2018_12-.name: It's a device that tracks and identifies unique configurations of dark power. I built it exactly to the Captain's specifications! I put it in your bag before you left!

110213219010651-Kritias_2018_12-.name: W-what? I think we need to have a conversation about personal boundaries...

110213219010652-Kritias_2018_12-.name: $MyPCName$, are you picking anything up on the device?

108202519010425-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Uhh... There's a frowny face on the screen, and below that it says "Error 408—unable to connect to host device."

108202519010426-Kritias_2018_12-.name: That can't be. The Darkwave Analyzer is perfect! It should be able to connect to our network from anywhere in Kritias!

110213219010653-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Uh... Nainai... Maybe I should have told you this earlier, but one of those sprout guys chewed through some wires on your computer.

108202519010427-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Ahh! Why are you just telling me this now? $MyPCName$, please give me a few minutes! I'll get the equipment replaced!

108202519010428-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Well, in the mean time I'll see about reducing the number of Daemon Army soldiers in the area.

108202519010429-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I'll contact you by radio once the device is repaired.

108202519010430-Kritias_2018_12-.name: While we're waiting for Nairin to repair the machine, why not reduce the number of Daemon soldiers at the $map:02020032$?

108202519010431-Kritias_2018_12-.name: While we're waiting for Nairin to repair the machine, why not reduce the number of Daemon soldiers at the $map:02020032$?

108202519010432-Kritias_2018_12-.name: $MyPCName$, can you hear me? It seems the device was damaged beyond repair.

110213219010654-Kritias_2018_12-.name: The captain designed it herself, and we never even got to use it...! I'm so ashamed…

108202519010433-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I peered once more through the all-seeing Eye of Providence and discovered $npcName:23000301$'s location. $map:02020016$.

108202519010435-Kritias_2018_12-.name: A High Templar of the Lumiknights does not lie.

108202519010436-Kritias_2018_12-.name: However, I won't be able to call upon the Eye of Providence again. My strength, much like the goddess's generosity, is not boundless.

108202519010437-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I must recharge my energies. And you must travel to $map:02020016$ to deal with $npcName:23000301$, before our quarry eludes us again.

108202519010438-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Travel to $map:02020016$ to deal with $npcName:23000301$, before our quarry eludes us again.

108202519010439-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Travel to $map:02020016$ to deal with $npcName:23000301$, before our quarry eludes us again.

108202519010440-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Are you ready to form a pact with $npcName:23400071$, and all that entails?

108202519010441-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Yes my liege. I am ready to wake the stone god, so that he might share with you his bountiful power.

108202519010442-Kritias_2018_12-.name: And you understand what $npcName:23400071$ requires in exchange?

108202519010444-Kritias_2018_12-.name: And you understand what that means?

108202519010446-Kritias_2018_12-.name: You will obtain the power to conquer not just this land, but all of Maple World!

108202519010447-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Paika, I have always been grateful for your unwavering loyalty, but…

108202519010448-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Surely loyalty alone cannot account for your willingness to make this sacrifice. No one offers their soul for another. Even I would not pledge my soul for him.

108202519010451-Kritias_2018_12-.name: My soul has always been yours. And as my soul falls into the fiery abyss, your secret will be buried forever.

108202519010450-Kritias_2018_12-.name: But why would you sacrifice yourself for me?

108202519010453-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I've pledged my life to you, $npcName:11004430[gender:0]$. If you do not believe me, then take it now.

108202519010452-Kritias_2018_12-.name: But if you end me here, you will have no soul to offer $npcName:23400071$.

108202519010455-Kritias_2018_12-.name: But if you deceive me, you will be met with a terrible fate the likes of which you cannot begin to imagine.

108202519010458-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I'm here, and $npcName:23000301$ is too. I can feel the chill of his dark aura.

108202519010459-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Yes, l feel it too. You should know, the Eye of Providence has whispered to me of $npcName:23000301$'s intentions…

108202519010460-Kritias_2018_12-.name: They involve a bargain with a horror of old.

110232619010657-Kritias_2018_12-.name: An ancient demon in a body of stone which feeds on negative emotions. $npcName:23400071$...

114101519010710-Kritias_2018_12-.name:
A difficult battle awaits you. To ensure you are not swallowed by darkness, I will conjure a protective sigil for you at the entrance to $npcName:23400071$'s temple. Step through it before you enter.
<font color="#909090">(You hear Mason chanting quietly under his breath.)</font>

108202519010461-Kritias_2018_12-.name:
To ensure you are not swallowed by darkness, I will conjure a protective sigil for you at the entrance to $npcName:23400071$'s temple. Step through it before you enter.
<font color="#909090">(You hear Mason chanting quietly under his breath.)</font>

108202519010462-Kritias_2018_12-.name:
To ensure you are not swallowed by darkness, I will conjure a protective sigil for you at the entrance to $npcName:23400071$'s temple. Step through it before you enter.
<font color="#909090">(You hear Mason chanting quietly under his breath.)</font>

108202519010463-Kritias_2018_12-.name: $MyPCName$, a great trial is upon you. Do you have the resolve to face it?

108202519010465-Kritias_2018_12-.name: The time has come to find out whether you are the one destined to put an end to $npcName:23000301$'s machinations. Now is the time we strike.

108202519010466-Kritias_2018_12-.name: It is time to put an end to $npcName:23000301$'s machinations. Now is the time we strike.

108202519010467-Kritias_2018_12-.name: It is time to put an end to $npcName:23000301$'s machinations. Now is the time we strike.

108202519010468-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Just as I anticipated—you are the one the Eye of Providence foresaw would vanquish this darkness.

108202519010469-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I saw $npcName:23000301$'s darkness vanish from this world and knew the deed had been done..

108202519010474-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I still don't understand what $npcName:23000301$ was trying to accomplish by summoning $npcName:23400071$.

108202519010475-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I witnessed a conversation through the Eye of Providence that might shed some light on that matter... $npcName:23000301$ intended to offer his soul to $npcName:23400071$ in exchange for power. But... that power was not for $npcName:23000301$.

108202519010479-Kritias_2018_12-.name: $npcName:23000301$ wanted $npcName:23400071$'s power for $npcName:11004430[gender:0]$... But I have never heard of any among the forces of darknesses willingly giving their life for another...

114101519010712-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I'm afraid we are left with more questions than answers. Nevertheless, all that matters is we have averted catastrophe.

114101519010713-Kritias_2018_12-.name: With $npcName:23400071$'s power, $npcName:11004430[gender:0]$ would have been a danger to the entire world.

108202519010480-Kritias_2018_12-.name: $npcName:11004430[gender:0]$ may have lost this battle, but I doubt we've seen the last of him. He still has plans for Kritias.

114101519010714-Kritias_2018_12-.name: We all need to be ready.

123155819010716-Kritias_2018_12-.name: The Lumiknights' full resources have been devoted toward tracking down $npcName:11004430[gender:0]$, yet we've made no real progress. The whole affair is frustrating to say the least.

123155819010717-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Deireadh grows impatient with every moment justice is delayed.

123155819010718-Kritias_2018_12-.name: We could always try gathering information the old-fashioned way. Knocking some heads.

123155819010719-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Well... It's a crude plan, but it's not like our current endeavors are baring fruit. Are you volunteering for the job?

123155819010722-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I hate to butt in, but it seems like you both may be missing an important detail.

123155819010723-Kritias_2018_12-.name: We already know $npcName:11004430[gender:0]$ has somehow managed to hack a large number of Tairen's mechanical soldiers and place them under his control.

123155819010724-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Rather than blindly slaughtering Daemon Army troops—as fun as that sounds—why not see if you can track the signal controlling those robots back to its source?

123155819010725-Kritias_2018_12-.name: But I'm just an expert in tactics and espionage, what would I know?

123155819010727-Kritias_2018_12-.name: We have reports of hacked sentries at the $map:02020017$. Why not start your investigation there?

1031125219010010-Kritias_2018_12-.name: $MyPCName$! $npcName:11004316[gender:0]$ told me you're trying to track Turka down using the signals from his hacked machines. You're going to need someone tech savvy to analyze the data. Need some help?

123155819010729-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I'll monitor all signals coming in and out of the area. Go and pummel some $npcNamePlural:25021202$ to force them to call home for instructions!

1031125219010011-Kritias_2018_12-.name: You heard Nairin. Defeat $npcNamePlural:25021202$ so we can track their calls for help.

1031125219010012-Kritias_2018_12-.name: You heard Nairin. Defeat $npcNamePlural:25021202$ so we can track their calls for help.

1031125219010013-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Kritias's technology never ceases to impress!

123155819010731-Kritias_2018_12-.name: The speed and volume of the data they're transmitting... It's light-years beyond the tech we have back home.

123155819010732-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Even their magics are quite advanced. This land is quite a fascinating place.

123155819010733-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I don't believe we've gathered enough data for analysis yet.

123155819010734-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Defeat $npcNamePlural:25021205$ and produce some, won't you?

1031125219010014-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Defeat $npcNamePlural:25021205$ so we can analyze the resulting data transmissions.

1031125219010015-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Defeat $npcNamePlural:25021205$ so we can analyze the resulting data transmissions.

1031125219010016-Kritias_2018_12-.name: $MyPCName$! I've had some luck triangulating the network's central node—the source of the transmissions!

123155819010735-Kritias_2018_12-.name: The only problem is, it's still on the move.

123155819010736-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I've estimated its trajectory based on its current speed and heading. I'm sending you intercept coordinates, but you've got to hurry!

124174019010900-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Is this our first meeting since $npcName:11004431$'s daughter escaped my grasp?

123155819010738-Kritias_2018_12-.name: That encounter was quite revealing... I feel I can finally see clearly who I am.

123155819010739-Kritias_2018_12-.name: What do you mean? And what are you plotting? Answer me!

123155819010740-Kritias_2018_12-.name: The machines are pitiful. Soon they will all be under my command.

123155819010743-Kritias_2018_12-.name: You have once again ruined my plans to conquer this land, and now I intend to make you pay.

123155819010744-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I leave you with this parting gift.

1031125219010020-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I leave you with this parting gift.

1031125219010021-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I leave you with this parting gift.

123155819010748-Kritias_2018_12-.name: There was some kind of interference—we lost radio contact. Are you all right?

123155819010750-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I'm relieved to hear it. Nairin is tracking the source of the interference as we speak.

123155819010752-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Good. I'll see you when you arrive.

123155819010753-Kritias_2018_12-.name: <font color="#909090">(You relay everything that happened in $map:02020033$.)</font>

123155819010755-Kritias_2018_12-.name: What is he up to now?

123155819010756-Kritias_2018_12-.name: And what did he mean when he said he could finally see clearly who he was?

123155819010757-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I have no idea, but it didn't seem like the usual Turka we love to hate.

123155819010760-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Perhaps this is all some elaborate ruse to confuse us? At times like these, it's important to remain skeptical.

123155819010761-Kritias_2018_12-.name: In the mean time, there's nothing stopping $npcName:11004430[gender:0]$ from trying to find another sacrifice for his bargain with $npcName:23000073$. I say we track $npcName:23000073$ down and send the demon back from whence he came.

123155819010763-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Excellent. I'll make the necessary preparations. For now, good work.

1031125219010026-Kritias_Zakum01-.name: Ah, $MyPCName$. I was hoping to speak with you.

123155819010764-Kritias_Zakum01-.name: Between consulting a number of ancient tomes and the Lumiknights' investigation, I have learned some important details about $npcName:23000073$.

123155819010766-Kritias_Zakum01-.name: $npcName:23000073$ is an ancient demon that was sealed away alongside Kritias. It seems a special ritual was required to summon him.

123155819010767-Kritias_Zakum01-.name: According to a tome sent over by a library in Victoria Island, $npcName:23000073$ was once summoned in Maple World…

123155819010768-Kritias_Zakum01-.name: Naturally, I dispatched the Lumiknights to investigate the altar where this ritual was conducted. After analyzing the scene, we were able to use what we learned to determine $npcName:23000073$ current location.

123155819010770-Kritias_Zakum01-.name: $npcName:23000073$ is within the $map:02020034$. I want you to go there.

1031125219010027-Kritias_Zakum01-.name: $npcName:23000073$ is within the $map:02020034$. I want you to go there.

123155819010772-Kritias_Zakum01-.name: $map:02020034$ was built over an $map:02000426$—that's where you'll find $npcName:23000073$... Of course, you'll have to get past an army of mechanized soldiers to get there.

123155819010773-Kritias_Zakum01-.name: Defeat the $npcNamePlural:25020801$, $npcNamePlural:25020803$, and $npcNamePlural:25020805$ nearby to clear a path.

1031125219010029-Kritias_Zakum01-.name: You must forge a path forward. Good luck.

1031125219010030-Kritias_Zakum01-.name: You must forge a path forward. Good luck.

1031125219010031-Kritias_Zakum01-.name: I'm detecting a significant reduction in noise on the sentries' communication frequency. I take it you've accomplished your task?

123155819010775-Kritias_Zakum01-.name: Not quite yet... $npcName:23000073$ is immensely powerful. So much so that primitive cultures believed him a god. We need to take steps to weaken him.

123155819010776-Kritias_Zakum01-.name: You will find a number of totems throughout the reactor plant. $npcName:23000073$ draws power from these totems. Therefore, your duty is clear.

1031125219010034-Kritias_Zakum01-.name: Have you destroyed all the totems?

123155819010780-Kritias_Zakum01-.name: Then all that remains is defeating $npcName:23000073$... Even in his weakened state, the demon will prove a powerful adversary...

1031125219010035-Kritias_Zakum01-.name: Have you destroyed all the totems?

1031125219010036-Kritias_Zakum01-.name: Have you destroyed all the totems?

123155819010783-Kritias_Zakum01-.name: Resist all you like. You only hasten your demise.

123155819010784-Kritias_Zakum01-.name: Sadly, I have more important matters to be concerned with than indulging you in this futile exercise.

123155819010786-Kritias_Zakum01-.name: It's too bad really. I so enjoy watching you struggle. Goodbye.

1031125219010040-Kritias_Zakum01-.name: $MyPCName$, are you all right? I felt a great disturbance.

123155819010791-Kritias_Zakum01-.name: Good. I'll see you when you arrive.

1031125219010041-Kritias_Zakum01-.name: Good. I'll see you when you arrive.

1031125219010042-Kritias_Zakum01-.name: Good. I'll see you when you arrive.

123155819010792-Kritias_Zakum01-.name: I never doubted you would overcome that ancient demon—but it remains a very impressive feat.

123155819010794-Kritias_Zakum01-.name: Though $npcName:23000073$ has been dealt with, there is still something that worries me.

123155819010796-Kritias_Zakum01-.name: This all started with a data transmission composed of dark energy, which $npcName:11004430[gender:0]$ used to commandeer Tairen's mechanized force...

123155819010797-Kritias_Zakum01-.name: But we are no closer to understanding how such a thing is possible, and how this transmission was generated.

123155819010798-Kritias_Zakum01-.name: I suppose all that matters is that we have foiled $npcName:11004430[gender:0]$'s latest scheme. Perhaps the answers I seek will be revealed in time.

123155819010799-Kritias_Zakum01-.name: In any case, I am grateful once again for your unflinching heroism.

108202519010481-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Welcome to $map:02020041$, $MyPCName$! Isn't it strange seeing each other in an unfamiliar setting?

108202519010482-Kritias_2018_12-.name: We haven't been in Kritias long, but a lot's happened!

108202519010484-Kritias_2018_12-.name: This land is a new frontier, full of unidentified flora and fauna. People from throughout Maple World are already flocking to Kritias to pioneer this uncharted territory. In time, they could prove a valuable source of information and resources for us!

108202519010485-Kritias_2018_12-.name: In the mean time, we have to do whatever we can to make sure they have the tools they need to survive and thrive here. Luckily our survival training and wilderness experience makes the Green Hoods perfectly suited for mapping this uncharted terrain and identifying safe food sources!

108202519010486-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Our newest crop of pioneers have already arrived. What do you say to serving as $map:02020041$'s unofficial ambassador and checking in with each of them?

111193819010681-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Excellent! I'm sure it'll go a long ways toward helping them settle in. Plus, you may see some familiar faces!

108202519010487-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Get a move on, ambassador, there's no time to lose!

108202519010488-Kritias_2018_12-.name: We have a lot of new arrivals in town. $MyPCName$, why don't you go welcome them to $map:02020041$?

108202519010489-Kritias_2018_12-.name: So, how are our friends settling in?

111194419010682-Kritias_2018_12-.name: It's a mixed bag, but overall they seem excited to be here.

108202519010490-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Really? Well that's good. Let's see... There are some other people on our arrivals list I think you're acquainted with.

108202519010491-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Why don't you pay $npcName:11004323[gender:1]$ and $npcName:11004324[gender:0]$ a visit next?

108202519010492-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Why don't you pay $npcName:11004323[gender:1]$ and $npcName:11004324[gender:0]$ a visit next?

108202519010493-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Why don't you pay $npcName:11004323[gender:1]$ and $npcName:11004324[gender:0]$ a visit next?

108202519010494-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I hope you had an nice time catching up! Now, there are a few more names on my list...

111194419010683-Kritias_2018_12-.name: $npcName:11004331[gender:1]$ and $npcName:11004332[gender:1]$. They've been giving everyone a hard time since they arrived, spouting gibberish and asking for research data we don't have.

108202519010495-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Why don't you pay them a visit and see how they're settling in?

108202519010496-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Why don't you pay $npcName:11004331[gender:1]$ and $npcName:11004332[gender:1]$ a visit next?

108202519010497-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Why don't you pay $npcName:11004331[gender:1]$ and $npcName:11004332[gender:1]$ a visit next?

108202519010498-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Oh, $MyPCName$! While I've got you here, there's something I could use your help with.

108202519010499-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I've heard there's a substance found here called "aetherine" that's supposedly the cornerstone of Kritian civilization.

111200419010685-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I've heard something to that effect as well.

108202519010500-Kritias_2018_12-.name: So... Do you think you can get your hands on some Aetherine Crystals? Whatever you're doing now can wait. I'm just dying to study the crystals—for the Frontier Foundation of course.

111200419010686-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Right! We want to study the aetherine for the Foundation! Not out of some personal curiosity. So you'll help us right? For the Foundation?

108202519010501-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I heard Aetherine Crystals can be found all throughout Kritias. We don't need much, just a small sample. Thanks!

108202519010502-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I heard Aetherine Crystals can be found all throughout Kritias. Would you bring back some for us to study?

108202519010503-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I heard Aetherine Crystals can be found all throughout Kritias. Would you bring back some for us to study?

108202519010504-Kritias_2018_12-.name: $MyPCName$, I'm detecting aetherine energy signatures near you... What's going on? What happened to greeting the new arrivals?

108202519010506-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Studying aetherine is key to understanding Tairen and the development of civilization on Kritias. We can't go handing it off to everyone who wants to gawk at it.

111200419010688-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Let me guess. $npcName:11004331[gender:1]$ and $npcName:11004332[gender:1]$ put you up to this, didn't they?

108202519010507-Kritias_2018_12-.name: That aetherine belongs to the Alliance, understood?

108202519010509-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I'll take that aetherine off your hands. But in the mean time, could you check up on $npcName:11004329[gender:0]$ and $npcName:11004330[gender:1]$?

108202519010510-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I'm sure they'll be happy to see you.

108202519010513-Kritias_2018_12-.name: As for $npcName:11004331[gender:1]$ and $npcName:11004332[gender:1]$, they'll be getting an earful from me!

108202519010514-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Why don't you pay $npcName:11004329[gender:0]$ and $npcName:11004330[gender:1]$ a visit next?

108202519010515-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Why don't you pay $npcName:11004329[gender:0]$ and $npcName:11004330[gender:1]$ a visit next?

108202519010516-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I think that's about everyone! Now, could you swing by with that Aetherine Crystal you found?

108202519010517-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Could you swing by with that Aetherine Crystal you found?

108202519010518-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Could you swing by with that Aetherine Crystal you found?

108202519010520-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I can't believe you, just humoring everybody's requests without a second thought. What if they'd asked you to do something dangerous?! You need to learn to embrace the power of "no."

111200419010689-Kritias_2018_12-.name: ...Does that include requests coming from you?

108202519010521-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Ahem. All I'm saying is you can't let people walk all over you.

108202519010522-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Well, how did greeting all the new arrivals go? Are they adjusting to life in Kritias?

108202519010523-Kritias_2018_12-.name: There were a wide variety of motives and feelings about being here, but overall I think they'll do fine.

108202519010524-Kritias_2018_12-.name: That's wonderful to hear. In an unfamiliar new frontier like this, we have to work together more than ever.

111200419010690-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I look forward to your continued assistance!

109164619010527-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Due to the nature of our responsibilities here, the Green Hoods have been working alongside Humanitas, and our people have been relaying some disheartening things. It seems that between fighting Tairen and Kharon, Humanitas's resources are stretched thin.

109164619010528-Kritias_2018_12-.name: As much as I'd like to ask the captain about providing reinforcement, we have our own troubles to worry about…

109164619010530-Kritias_2018_12-.name: So I got to thinking, maybe we could provide our support in an unofficial capacity to help lighten their load!

109164619010531-Kritias_2018_12-.name: What do you mean by "unofficial support?"

109164619010533-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Thank you! I knew I could count on you!

109164619010534-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I'd like you to travel to $map:02020001$ and reach out to Commander $npcName:11004395[gender:1]$ on Humanitas's radio frequency. She should be happy to hear from you.

1031125219010063-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Travel to $map:02020001$ and reach out to Commander $npcName:11004395[gender:1]$ on Humanitas's radio frequency.

109164719010525-Kritias_2018_12-.name:
<font color="#909090">(You adjust your radio to Humanitas's communication frequency and press the talk button.)</font>
This is $MyPCName$ of the Maple Alliance calling for Commander $npcName:11004395[gender:1]$. Please respond.

109164719010526-Kritias_2018_12-.name:
<font color="#909090">(After several moments of silence, your radio crackles.)</font>
$MyPCName$, it's good to hear your voice.

109164719010527-Kritias_2018_12-.name: We don't have any joint operations with your people scheduled for today. Is something the matter?

109164719010528-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I was passing through $map:02020001$, and I thought you might like some help with your Kharon problem.

109164719010529-Kritias_2018_12-.name: $map:02020001$? Our operations in the area have been hindered by the Kharon presence there... But how did you hear about that?

109164719010530-Kritias_2018_12-.name: $npcName:11004315[gender:0]$ said you could use some assistance.

109164719010533-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Ah, you mean Sky Fortress's second-in-command. I see she is as kind as she looks.

111201719010693-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Well, if you're up for thinning Kharon's ranks in $map:02020001$, we'll take any help we can get. Thank you.

1031125219010065-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I'm counting on you to suppress the Kharon incursion in $map:02020001$.

1031125219010066-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I'm counting on you to suppress the Kharon incursion in $map:02020001$.

109164819010525-Kritias_2018_12-.name:
<font color="#909090">(You activate your portable radio.)</font>
$MyPCName$ to Humanitas command, do you copy?

109164819010526-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I've been eagerly awaiting your call, $MyPCName$.

109164819010527-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I've dealt a crippling blow to the Kharon forces in this area. They should be too busy licking their wounds to give you much trouble, at least for a while. Is there anything else I can help you with?

109164819010528-Kritias_2018_12-.name: As a matter of fact, there is. The Kharon incursion interrupted a vital mining operation we were performing in $map:02020001$.

111202119010694-Kritias_2018_12-.name: There is a very valuable ore there that's used to stabilize Aetherine Crystals, allowing us to extract pure aetherine.

109164819010529-Kritias_2018_12-.name: We need that ore. You should be able to find several exposed veins of it that our mining operation managed to unearth.

111202119010695-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Thank you. You'll be able to identify the ore by its brilliant green glow.

1031125219010068-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Thank you. You'll be able to identify the ore by its brilliant green glow.

1031125219010069-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Thank you. You'll be able to identify the ore by its brilliant green glow.

109164919010525-Kritias_2018_12-.name: $MyPCName$, can you hear me? How's your mission going?

109164919010526-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I've just finished securing some ore Humanitas requested.

109164919010527-Kritias_2018_12-.name: That's great, $MyPCName$! I knew you'd be able to help them!

111210819010696-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Umm... I'm sorry to do this, but there's one more thing I could use your help with...

109164919010528-Kritias_2018_12-.name: According to members of Humanitas, Tairen is propping up Kharon's operation. They're supplying Kharon with supplies and labor in the form of exiles. In exchange, Kharon attacks Humanitas.

109164919010529-Kritias_2018_12-.name: That's awful! There's got to be something we can do to throw a wrench in the Tairen's terrible schemes!

109164919010530-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Well, we could sneak into the nearest Tairen base and destroy their supplies.

109164919010533-Kritias_2018_12-.name: No, it's brilliant! Go ahead and get started!

111210819010698-Kritias_2018_12-.name: The nearest Tairen base is $map:02020004$. Go there and deal a blow to their operation by destroying the supplies they've prepared for Kharon!

109164919010535-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Tairen's closest base is $map:02020004$. If you want to cripple their efforts to supply Kharon, that's the place to go.

109164919010536-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Tairen's closest base is $map:02020004$. If you want to cripple their efforts to supply Kharon, that's the place to go.

109164919010537-Kritias_2018_12-.name: You made it inside their base! Do you see anything that looks like supplies?

109164919010538-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I see some crates over there.

109164919010539-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Crates? What do you think is in them?

109164919010540-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I can't tell from here, but they're heavily guarded. There's a red label with a picture of a skull and crossbones on the side...

109164919010542-Kritias_2018_12-.name: $MyPCName$, whatever's in those crates, we can't let Kharon get hold of them!

109164919010543-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Roger. I'll blow them all up and let the goddess sort it out.

109164919010547-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I'll check in after I've finished destroying the crates.

109164919010548-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I'll check in after I've finished destroying the crates.

109164919010549-Kritias_2018_12-.name: $MyPCName$, we're detecting additional forces converging on your location! What is your status?

109164919010550-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I haven't quite finished what I came for.

109164919010551-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Sigh. That's unfortunate, but it can't be helped. Fall back for now. I don't want you getting cut off behind enemy lines.

109164919010552-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I can take out the rest of the supplies, I just need a few more minutes.

109164919010553-Kritias_2018_12-.name: $MyPCName$, I believe in you, but we need to avoid attracting any more attention than necessary. If the Tairen decide to send reinforcements from the capital, we'll have done Humanitas more harm than good.

109164919010555-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Then return to $map:02020041$. I'll be waiting!

109164919010559-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I'm glad you made it back safely.

109164919010560-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I just heard from $npcName:11004395[gender:1]$. She's extremely grateful for what you've done.

109164919010561-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I'm glad I could help out.

109164919010562-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Kritias is a beautiful place... It's such a shame it's full of so much conflict.

109164919010563-Kritias_2018_12-.name: There's nothing we can do besides keep fighting for a brighter tomorrow.

109164919010564-Kritias_2018_12-.name: You're right, $MyPCName$. The Green Hoods will do our part! Here's to a brighter tomorrow!

109164919010565-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Hey there, $MyPCName$. How have you been? Now that things have settled down in $map:02020041$, it's time to commence our primary mission!

109164919010566-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Studying Kritias! Don't tell me you forgot...

109164919010568-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Anyways, our first step is analyzing the local flora to identify potential food sources, medicinal plants, and plants with other uses.

109164919010569-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I'd like you to gather some samples for me from the vicinity of $map:02020013$. Are you up to the task?

109164919010570-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Go to $map:02020013$ and investigate the local plant life.

109164919010571-Kritias_2018_12-.name: It looks like you've arrived. Do you see any plants there that can't be found in Maple World?

109164919010572-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I see something over there that looks pretty different...

109164919010573-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Just as I suspected! Could you bring me back a sample?

109164919010577-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Have you collected any plant samples yet?

109164919010578-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Have you collected any plant samples yet?

109164919010579-Kritias_2018_12-.name: <font color="#909090">(You sniff at the plant and a sweet, familiar aroma fills your nose.)</font>

109164919010581-Kritias_2018_12-.name:
It couldn't hurt to eat just one...
<font color="#909090">(You pick a piece of fruit and bite into it. And then another. And another.)</font>

109164919010582-Kritias_2018_12-.name: $MyPCName$, what's going on? Did you find anything interesting in the plant samples you've collected?

109164919010583-Kritias_2018_12-.name:
<font color="#909090">(You choke down a mouthful of fruit and wipe your mouth.)</font>
It tastes just like $item:30000232$.

109164919010584-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I'm writing this down. "Plant specimen tasted like..." Wait, WHAT?! You ate it?

109164919010585-Kritias_2018_12-.name: What, it smelled like $item:30000232$! It tastes pretty good, too.

109164919010586-Kritias_2018_12-.name: You're on a mysterious continent from somewhere beyond Maple World, and you put an unidentified plant in your mouth because it smells like $item:30000232$? Are you crazy?! You could end up in the hospital, blasting out both ends! Or what if the plant has hallucinogenic properties?!

109164919010587-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Hey there Cadet! What's all this about a delicious hallucinogenic berry? You're bringing back enough for the rest of the crew, right?

109164919010588-Kritias_2018_12-.name: What?! Absolutely not! We have to test the samples to make sure they're safe!

111210819010700-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Hmph! There's no need to snap at me about it! Forget it. I'm going somewhere less yelly.

111210819010701-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Sigh. Well, if the fruit were toxic I supposed we'd know by now. Still, it's odd finding a fruit so similar to one from Maple World. I wonder if there's some kind of unknown link between Kritias and our world.

111210819010702-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Well, there's more work to be done! I need you to take some soil samples.

111210819010703-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I'd like to study the soil found at the $map:02020051$. Shall we go have a look?

109164919010589-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Would you mind bringing me some soil samples from the $map:02020051$?

109164919010590-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Would you mind bringing me some soil samples from the $map:02020051$?

109164919010592-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Ah good, you've arrived! Now, I'd like for you to sample the soil in the area for analysis.

109164919010593-Kritias_2018_12-.name: What's the best way to go about that?

109164919010594-Kritias_2018_12-.name: We've discovered an old drill in the middle of the area capable of analyzing soil, and transmitting the data off-site. By re-tuning the drill's frequency, we should be able to send that data to Sky Fortress for study.

111212119010704-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Not only will the resulting soil sample tell us how deep the pollution there runs, but it will provide a window to study conditions in Kritias dating back through time, as each layer of soil is older than the last! Cool, right?

111212119010705-Kritias_2018_12-.name: In some ways, this drill will reveal the history of Kritias! Well, shall I explain how to use the drill?

109164919010595-Kritias_2018_12-.name:
All right! Turn on the drill and it should start transmitting a soil analysis immediately.
<font color="#00aaef">(You need a $item:30001278$ in order to operate the Gigantic Drill. $itemPlural:30001278$ can be purchased from the faction shops in $map:02020041$.)</font>

109164919010596-Kritias_2018_12-.name: All right, go ahead and start the drill!

109164919010597-Kritias_2018_12-.name: All right, go ahead and start the drill!

109164919010598-Kritias_2018_12-.name: The drill is operating at full efficiency. Receiving soil analysis now…

109164919010599-Kritias_2018_12-.name: $MyPCName$, I'm getting some weird rumbling from your microphone... Wait, Sky Fortress is detecting seismic activity localized at your position... Something's coming out of the ground!

109164919010600-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Sky Fortress is detecting seismic activity localized at your position... Something's coming out of the ground!

109164919010601-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Sky Fortress is detecting seismic activity localized at your position... Something's coming out of the ground!

109164919010603-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I've been trying to reach you over the radio! What just happened?

109164919010604-Kritias_2018_12-.name: A giant mechanical worm-thing popped out of the ground and tried to kill me.

109164919010606-Kritias_2018_12-.name: It's okay, I ended up winning.

109164919010608-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I'm glad you're safe. I want to hear all about this in person! Please return to $map:02020041$.

109164919010611-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Welcome back, $MyPCName$. I'm afraid that we weren't able to salvage any usable data from before the soil analysis was interrupted.

109164919010612-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I'm glad you weren't hurt. So tell me, what was that out there?

109164919010613-Kritias_2018_12-.name: The thing I encountered was too big to bring in, but I can tell you what happened...

109164919010614-Kritias_2018_12-.name: A summary of events will be fine.

109164919010615-Kritias_2018_12-.name:
<font color="#909090">(Nairin stares, jaw agape, as you finish your riveting tale.)</font>
Attacked by a giant mechanical worm?! What other surprises does Kritias have in store for us...?

109164919010616-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Well, the more we know about this creature, the better prepared we'll be. Thank you for your report.

109164919010617-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I'll start brainstorming ways to deal with our mechanical monstrosity, in case it rears its ugly head again!

124202519010901-Kritias_2018_12-.name: The Green Hoods are starting to feel more at home in Kritias, but we can't let our guard down! There's still lots to investigate, and lots that could go wrong.

124202519010902-Kritias_2018_12-.name: <font color="#909090">($npcName:11004315[gender:0]$ often seems eccentric, but she has a realistic outlook on things.)</font>

124202519010903-Kritias_2018_12-.name: There's something I'd like to investigate. According to reports from members of our expedition, there are ancient structures found in Kritias that bear a striking resemblance to the ancient ruins found on Victoria Island.

124202519010904-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Isn't that interesting? A link between our own civilization and one from another world! We have a fascinating mystery on our hands!

124202519010905-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Our expedition located one such structure but weren't able to find a way inside. That's why I've decided to call in my secret weapon to finish the job—you! The structure is located in $map:02020003$. I'll radio you once you arrive!

124202519010906-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Head to $map:02020003$. I'll radio you again once you arrive!

124202519010907-Kritias_2018_12-.name: $MyPCName$! Did you make it there safely?

124202519010908-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Well, I'm here, but the place is crawling with enemy forces.

124202519010909-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Oh no... That's going to interfere with our investigation efforts.

124202519010910-Kritias_2018_12-.name: You'll have to run the Tairen troops off before we can get started. Drive out as many $npcNamePlural:25021504$ and $npcNamePlural:25021505$ as you can!

124202519010911-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Drive out as many $npcNamePlural:25021504$ and $npcNamePlural:25021505$ as you can!

124202519010912-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Drive out as many $npcNamePlural:25021504$ and $npcNamePlural:25021505$ as you can!

124202519010913-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Good work! I think we should be able to begin our investigation of the structure without being disturbed.

125151919010800-Kritias_2018_12-.name: First, I'd like you to get some shots of the structure. We've already set up a camera at a good vantage on site.

124202519010914-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Go ahead and take some pictures of the largest structure!

124202519010915-Kritias_2018_12-.name: You haven't told me where the camera is yet.

124202519010916-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Ah! Sorry, I forgot you can't see Cat's-Eye-View I've got displayed on my tablet which is streaming from our Cat's Eye satellite.

124202519010917-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I'm sending you the GPS coordinates for the camera now. Once you've found it, please go ahead and take some photos of the structure to send to Sky Fortress.

124202519010918-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I'm sending you the GPS coordinates for the camera now. Once you've found it, please go ahead and take some photos of the structure to send to Sky Fortress.

124202519010919-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I'm sending you the GPS coordinates for the camera now. Once you've found it, please go ahead and take some photos of the structure to send to Sky Fortress.

124202519010920-Kritias_2018_12-.name: <font color="#909090">(You snap a series of pictures of the structure, then press the "DATASYNC" button to transmit them to Sky Fortress.)</font>

124202519010921-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Oh! Thanks! Your pictures are coming in now.

124202519010923-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Hehe... That's right! Our tech team has been working overtime to launch a series of surveillance and communication satellites to aid our operations in Kritias.

124202519010924-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Our data team has been going out of their minds dealing with the influx of new data from the satellites.

124202519010925-Kritias_2018_12-.name: But it's a necessary effort. Manually mapping the continent on foot would be a huge nightmare—one forces on the ground are very grateful to avoid.

124202519010926-Kritias_2018_12-.name: But enough shoptalk, let's have a look at those pictures!

124202519010928-Kritias_2018_12-.name: It's just as I was told. There are a ton of architectural similarities between this structure and the ancient ruins of Victoria Island.

124202519010929-Kritias_2018_12-.name: There's no way this could be a coincidence. From the shapes they used to the construction methods, there's just too many similarities. Just look at those arches, for example…

124202519010930-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I have even more questions now than when we started...

124202519010931-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I've got to know more! Let's find out what the interior of the structure looks like.

124202519010932-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Sky Fortress's radar is detecting the presence of an underground passage... I want you to check it out. I'll send you the GPS coordinates.

124202519010934-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Of course! I've planned for exactly this contingency! The last time you were here, I slipped a Firefly into your bag. It's a signal amplification device our team whipped it up. Oh! Also, I left you three kinds of trail mix in a plastic baggie, in case you get hungry!

124202519010935-Kritias_2018_12-.name: <font color="#909090">(What a wholesome invasion of personal privacy...)</font>

124202519010936-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Initiating Firefly calibration now... Wow, look at that! Your signal's coming in loud and clear. We should be able to read you fine up to a depth of at least 50 meters.

124202519010937-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Sky Fortress's radar is detecting the presence of an underground passage... I want you to check it out. I'll send you the GPS coordinates.

124202519010938-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Here are the GPS coordinates of the underground passage. I'll contact you again as soon as you're inside!

124202519010939-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Here are the GPS coordinates of the underground passage. I'll contact you again as soon as you're inside!

124202519010940-Kritias_2018_12-.name: $MyPCName$, your signal's still coming in strong. Can you hear me?

124202519010941-Kritias_2018_12-.name: What's that sound? An alarm?! Why would some random building need an alarm system?

124202519010942-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I doubt whoever thought this facility was worth securing is still around, but still... You'd better find a place to hide. Engaging the ground-penetrating radar…

124202519010943-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I'm detecting a large chamber at the end of the corridor. That seems as good a hiding place as any! And maybe you'll find something inside that can explain what this place is.

124202519010944-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I'm detecting a large chamber at the end of the corridor. That seems as good a hiding place as any! And maybe you'll find something inside that can explain what this place is.

124202519010945-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I'm detecting a large chamber at the end of the corridor. That seems as good a hiding place as any! And maybe you'll find something inside that can explain what this place is.

124202519010946-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I've found some old books in here.

124202519010947-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I have to know what's written inside! And you need to get out of there before any more Tairen soldiers come snooping around! Please return to $map:02020041$ with the books!

124202519010948-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I have to know what's written inside! And you need to get out of there before any more Tairen soldiers come snooping around! Please return to $map:02020041$ with the books!

124202519010949-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I have to know what's written inside! And you need to get out of there before any more Tairen soldiers come snooping around! Please return to $map:02020041$ with the books!

124202519010951-Kritias_2018_12-.name: These books must be important if the facility where they were found had a security system!

124202519010952-Kritias_2018_12-.name:
Hehe... I can't wait to see what's inside...
<font color="#909090">(She grins mischievously.)</font>

124202519010953-Kritias_2018_12-.name:
<font color="#909090">(Your radio crackles and Schatten's voice comes out.)</font>
What's going on over there? The last time I saw Nainai make a face like that, she was looking through her secret bookshelf.

124202519010954-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Ah! W-what do you mean s-secret bookshelf?!

124202519010955-Kritias_2018_12-.name: You know, the one in your quarters hidden behind the painting of Henesys. It's where you keep those gossip magazines with the fashion tips, and the shirtless pictures of Blake.

124202519010956-Kritias_2018_12-.name:
Ah! Sorry, I think you're breaking up! Technical difficulties!
<font color="#909090">(Nairin taps frantically on her tablet, and then the radio channel goes dead.)</font>

124202519010957-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Well, I have no idea what $npcName:11004314[gender:1]$ was talking about just now!

124202519010958-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Ahem! Anyways, I'll have these books analyzed. Who knows what secrets they hold?

124202519010959-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I'll run them through the linguistic database we got from $npcName:11004395$ and see if we can translate the contents!

125151919010802-Kritias_2018_12-.name: This could be a while. Why don't you take on some more missions in the mean time?

124202519010960-Kritias_2018_12-.name: We've managed to translate roughly 30% of the text of the books you brought me.

124202519010961-Kritias_2018_12-.name: The translation is going slower than you might expect due to the difficulties of matching the characters and words used by the Kritian writing system to those in our own. But the process speeds up with every pairing we find.

124202519010962-Kritias_2018_12-.name: From what we've been able to decipher so far, these books seem to be a journal or written record.

124202519010963-Kritias_2018_12-.name: We don't know who the author is, but they've written about Kritias in great detail.

124202519010964-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Of course we have no way of knowing whether this is a historical account or a work of fiction. I've reached out to Humanitas about corroborating the validity of the contents, but they say they have more urgent problems...

124202519010965-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Well, knowledge waits for no one! I don't see any reason why we can't do our own sleuthing in the meantime. There's a location the author mentions on numerous occasions as a place they like to go and write. These "skylocked islands of shimmering white..."

124202519010966-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I remember a place that meets that description... Ugh, where was it? Let me pull up a topographical map of Kritias on my tablet!

124202519010969-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Yes, that's it! $map:02020018$! You can see the floating islands clear as day.

124202519010970-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Good eye! You've got a knack for this kind of work, don't you?

124202519010971-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Head to $map:02020018$ and we'll see if we can't verify more of what's written in these books.

124202519010972-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Head to $map:02020018$ and we'll see if we can't verify more of what's written in these books.

124202519010973-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I see you've made it to $map:02020018$! Your signal is coming in clear thanks to the Firefly.

124202519010974-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Let me run some scans of the area through Cat Sith's analysis subroutines.

124202519010976-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Wow! That place is absolutely jam-packed full of aetherine!

124202519010977-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Do you think the aetherine is somehow responsible for $map:02020018$'s floating islands?

124202519010978-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Judging by the feed I'm getting from Sky Fortress's long-range reconnaissance lens, $map:02020018$ seems like a perfect match for the place described in the books.

124202519010980-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Let's see what else this book has to tell us...

124202519010981-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Let's see what else this book has to tell us...

124202519010982-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Let's see what else this book has to tell us...

124202519010985-Kritias_2018_12-.name: When I first took a look at the books, I noticed there were some pages missing. I didn't realize they were from the section about $map:02020018$...

124202519010986-Kritias_2018_12-.name: But the way these pages were so neatly torn out... It seems intentional.

124202519010987-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Maybe it was information the author wanted to hide? Or maybe he was just planning to rewrite the section later?

124202519010988-Kritias_2018_12-.name: It could be important information about $map:02020018$…

124202519010989-Kritias_2018_12-.name: We'll never know what was on those pages unless we manage to find them.

124202519010990-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Ahh! Not knowing what they said only makes me more interested.

124202519010991-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I want to know what I'm missing!

124202519010992-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I'd like to see what the missing pages say too.

124202519010993-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Huh? What are you doing accessing an encrypted Green Hoods frequency?!

124202519010994-Kritias_2018_12-.name: After I finished reading Nainai's diary, I was feeling bored, so I thumbed through the translations she left sitting out. I'm curious how our mysterious author's story ends.

124202519010995-Kritias_2018_12-.name: W-what?! You read my diary?! Is that why it was out on my desk?!

124202519010996-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Oh yes, all the juicy bits. Especially the ones about the captain…

124202519010997-Kritias_2018_12-.name:
Ahh!!! Scrambling frequencies...!
<font color="#909090">(You hear the sounds of furious tapping over the radio, and suddenly the background noise of Schatten's microphone vanishes.)</font>

124202519010998-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Hahaha! Ha ha ha! What a jokester. Anyway, please forget about Schatten's silly stories... We've—we've got work to do!

124202519011000-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Ahem! Now! If our mystery author discarded the pages while he was writing, and he did most of his writing here, there's the slimmest chance the pages are still here. And with Cat Sith's brainpower...

124202519011001-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Okay. Since I've already analyzed the materials the book is made from, and we know it was exposed to serious levels of ambient aetherine energy, I might just be able to use Sky Fortress's sensors to track down... There! I'm sending you some GPS coordinates. Go and see if they lead to our missing pages!

124202519011002-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Okay. 124202519011003-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Okay.
