130145621029737-Kritias_2018_12-.name: The $npcNamePlural:25022005$ in $map:02020036$ are nimble, despite their size. They have especially keen senses, too. Our scouts are trained pros, but they manage to find them and give chase.

1228182021028649-Kritias_2018_12-.name: If we don't thin their numbers, our efforts to scout the enemy's base will be thwarted. That's why we need you to take out the $npcNamePlural:25022005$ at $map:02020036$. Only then can the scouts gather the vital intel we need!

1228182021028651-Kritias_2018_12-.name: If we don't thin their numbers, our efforts to scout the enemy's base will be thwarted. That's why we need you to slay <font color="#ffd200">$npcNamePlural:25022005$</font> in <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020036$</font>. Only then can the scouts gather the vital intel we need!

1228182021028652-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Look! We have reports coming in from our scouts in $map:02020036$ again! And you're the one who made it possible, $MyPCName$!

1220183321028230-Kritias_2018_12-.name: $MyPCName$! It may come as no surprise to you, but we've got another mess on our hands! Do you remember the substance you brought in before that could counteract the $npcName:23001006$'s poison?

130145621029738-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Thanks to you, our pharmaceutical team succeeded in developing an antidote! It's still in the trial phase for now, but once it's been deemed safe, it can go straight into mass production.

130145621029739-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Or rather, it could have... You see, the $npcNamePlural:25021604$ launched a surprise raid on the research team's facilities, destroyed the research data, and stole the $item:30001256$!

1220183321028231-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Without the research data, the team would have no choice but to re-create the sample again from scratch, and that'd take time we can't afford. If we delay the mass production of the antidote, we'll have a lot of poisoned soldiers on our hands!

1220183321028232-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Who else could we turn to but you? You need to go to <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020009$</font>, eliminate the <font color="#ffd200">$npcNamePlural:25021604$</font> there, and retrieve the <font color="#ffd200">$item:30001256$</font>.

1220183321028233-Kritias_2018_12-.name: We need you to go to <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020009$</font>, eliminate the <font color="#ffd200">$npcNamePlural:25021604$</font> there, and retrieve the <font color="#ffd200">$item:30001256$</font>.

1220183321028234-Kritias_2018_12-.name: You really came through in a pinch, $MyPCName$! Now we can get the mass production of this antidote rolling and start treating everyone!

1220183321028235-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Greetings, $MyPCName$. Do you happen to remember me telling you about a large quantity of aetherine we detected in $map:02020018$?

130145621029740-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Uh... Yeah, how could I possibly forget such a fascinating detail?

130145621029741-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Hm... You say you do, but scratching your head like that makes it seem sort of like you don't... T-that's no problem, though, because I needed to brief you on the mission anyway.

130145621029742-Kritias_2018_12-.name: The Green Hoods decided to set up a research camp in $map:02020018$ to collect large quantities of aetherine and begin research on it right away.

130145621029743-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Unfortunately, the researchers have had their hands full dealing with attacks from $npcNamePlural:25021703$ instead. They've completely foiled every attempt the researchers have made to set up a camp.

130145621029744-Kritias_2018_12-.name: $map:02020018$ is a key region we need to control for aetherine research and collection. But for that to happen, we need to set up a camp, and we can't do that until you send those <font color="#ffd200">$npcNamePlural:25021703$</font> packing!

1220183321028237-Kritias_2018_12-.name: We need to set up a camp, and we can't do that until you send those <font color="#ffd200">$npcNamePlural:25021703$</font> packing!

1220183321028238-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I've received a report that the research team has begun setting up their camp! It's been a long time coming, and they couldn't have done it without your expert display of applied force, $MyPCName$!

1220183321028239-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Ah, there you are, $MyPCName$. Did you receive the classified document from Humanitas?

130145621029745-Kritias_2018_12-.name: <font color="#909090">(Oh no... That one I made into a really sweet paper airplane?)</font>

130145621029746-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Huh? You never got it? Hmm... It must be because you're out in the field so often. Not to worry, though; giving briefings is one of the little joys I cherish.

130145621029747-Kritias_2018_12-.name: A-ahem! 'Humanitas is planning to launch a full-scale attack on the Daemon Army's key stronghold, $map:02020036$, with the support of the allied forces of Sky Fortress. The goal of this operation is to suppress enemy activity and secure a launching point to reclaim Tairen'

130145621029748-Kritias_2018_12-.name: 'We formally request the aid of Sky Fortress, due to their exceptional capabilities in reconaissance and intelligence gathering. All data related to this operation must be encrypted and transmitted on the secure channel Badger-Mushroom-Mushroom-Slime.'

130145621029749-Kritias_2018_12-.name: That's their official communique. In compliance with our allies' request, the Green Hoods sent scouts to $map:02020036$. However…

1220183321028240-Kritias_2018_12-.name: While the scouts were gathering information on $map:02020036$, they were discovered by $npcNamePlural:25022004$ and forced to retreat, giving up ground.

1220183321028241-Kritias_2018_12-.name: It's not easy to shake their pursuit, either. Their smell, hearing, and sight are all incredibly acute. But the problem is, we can't coordinate a proper attack on $map:02020036$ without the data those scouts are gathering.

1220183321028242-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Please, do this one for the Green Hoods! Help our attack on <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020036$</font> succeed by taking out those <font color="#ffd200">$npcNamePlural:25022004$</font> and letting our scouts do what they do best!

1220183321028243-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Help our attack on <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020036$</font> succeed by taking out those <font color="#ffd200">$npcNamePlural:25022004$</font> and letting our scouts do what they do best!

1220183321028244-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Take a look! We've got brand new, up-to-date topographical data on $map:02020036$! We'll be able to use this to find the most defensible routes to advance on the enemy!

1228142921028290-Kritias_2018_12-.name: $npcName:11004395[gender:1]$'s adjutant, $npcName:11004396[gender:0]$, sent a request for support. Are you available?

1228142921028292-Kritias_2018_12-.name: The monsters in $map:02020029$ and $map:02020030$ are closing in on Humanitas. Unfortunately, Humanitas doesn't have the manpower to hold them off for long.

1228142921028295-Kritias_2018_12-.name: $npcName:11004396[gender:0]$ reports that you were a great help. Humanitas owes you a debt.

1228142921028296-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I'm sure you're aware that $map:02020004$ and $map:02020006$ are key strategic locations for $map:02020041$.

1228142921028297-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Our scout patrols have reported increased monster locations around both of those areas.

1228142921028298-Kritias_2018_12-.name: This is a direct threat to our supply lines. If we don't do something about those monsters, this outpost will fall.

1228142921028301-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Our patrols are already reporting that the situation has improved.

1228142921028302-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Our supply lines are safe once again. You're dismissed.

1228142921028303-Kritias_2018_12-.name: We set up $map:02020041$ in record time, but there were some critical elements that we neglected.

1228142921028304-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Our soldiers are holding the $map:02020032$, but that's all that stands between the civilians here and the Daemon Army.

1228142921028305-Kritias_2018_12-.name: We need a safe haven here on Kritias. If not, all of our operations will fall apart. That's why we must hold the line.

1228142921028308-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Now that we have a secure foothold, we can begin our exploration in earnest.

1228142921028309-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Kritias is fascinating. Nowhere in Maple World can you find so much advanced technology alongside so much lush nature.

1228142921028310-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I wish to protect this uniqueness. The monsters in $map:02020014$ have other ideas.

1228142921028311-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Defeat the monsters in $map:02020014$ before they ruin the beautiful scenery there.

1228142921028312-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Defeat the monsters in $map:02020014$ before they ruin the beautiful scenery there.

1228142921028313-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Thank you. $map:02020014$ is one of the few places where our agents can relax peacefully.

129160221029609-Kritias_2018_12-.name: In fact, I'm thinking of visiting it for myself when the fighting is over. I may ask you to be my guide when that time comes.

1228142921028314-Kritias_2018_12-.name: The further we push into Kritias, the more fierce our opposition becomes. I can't afford to lose anymore scouts to unexpected ambushes.

1228142921028315-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I'll clear a path for the scouts.

1228142921028316-Kritias_2018_12-.name: That should work. Thank you for volunteering.

1228142921028319-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Thanks to you, our scouts have managed to push into a new area.

129160221029610-Kritias_2018_12-.name: We're lucky to have you. Take a rest before your next mission.

1227151321028272-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Our scouts' radios are being jammed by $npcNamePlural:25020102$.

115221521029190-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Normally, I'd be perfectly happy to use telepathy to communicate over the vast distances required, but our scouts lack the sensitivity that you and I share. Unfortunately they don't, so we must ensure that their wretched radios are in working order.

1227151321028273-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Go to $map:02020030$ and dispose of the meddlesome machines.

1227151321028274-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Go to $map:02020030$ and dispose of the $npcNamePlural:25020102$.

1227151321028275-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I was just contacted by a scout via radio, so it seems your efforts were not in vain.

116112121029225-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Thanks to you, I have many, many radio conversations in my future... Sigh.

1227151121028254-Kritias_2018_12-.name: $map:02020004$ is practically next door to $map:02020041$. It is also overrun with Tairen's mechanical abominations.

1227151121028255-Kritias_2018_12-.name: This means that Tairen is always in striking distance of us.

1227151121028257-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Are you not yet done? Go to $map:02020004$ and defeat $npcNamePlural:25020405[gender:0]$.

1227151121028258-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I expected nothing less than complete success.

116113321029226-Kritias_2018_12-.name: On behalf of the Lumiknights, you have my thanks.

1227151121028259-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Ecological research in $map:02020034$ and $map:02020013$ has come to a stop.

115221521029191-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I'm assured that this research is of vital importance, but it's impossible to progress when our scientists are under constant threat of monster attack.

1227151121028260-Kritias_2018_12-.name: In order to get things under way once again, defeat $npcNamePlural:25020804$ in $map:02020034$ and $npcNamePlural:25020904$ in $map:02020013$.

1227151121028261-Kritias_2018_12-.name: In order to get things under way once again, defeat $npcNamePlural:25020804$ in $map:02020034$ and $npcNamePlural:25020904$ in $map:02020013$.

1227151121028262-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Research is progressing apace thanks to you.

116113321029227-Kritias_2018_12-.name: As your reward, I shall grant onto you a fraction of my aura.

1227151121028263-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Have you read the signs, too, $MyPCName$?

1227151121028264-Kritias_2018_12-.name: The signs... that all of our soldiers look busy?

1227151121028265-Kritias_2018_12-.name: It's because we are preparing to call our wrath upon the Tairen wretches in $map:02020017$ and $map:02020033$.

128180921029518-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I would have you participate in this raid. Go to those places and defeat $npcNamePlural:25021205$ and $npcNamePlural:25021305[gender:0]$.

128180921029519-Kritias_2018_12-.name: The time for words is past. I will leave this mission to you.

1227151121028267-Kritias_2018_12-.name: You may have turned the tide of the battle.

128180921029520-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Truly, the goddess has sent you to our side.

1227151121028268-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I have waited for you through the minutes and the hours.

1227151121028269-Kritias_2018_12-.name: The monsters of $map:02020035$ and $map:02020037$ are attacking our agents.

128180921029521-Kritias_2018_12-.name: The $npcNamePlural:25021904$ and $npcNamePlural:25022104$ present a particularly troubling threat. I would have you vanquish them first.

128180921029522-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I will continue to wait for you here.

1227151121028270-Kritias_2018_12-.name: The $npcNamePlural:25021904$ and $npcNamePlural:25022104$ present a particularly troubling threat. I would have you vanquish them first.

1227151121028271-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Did the monsters seem strange to you?

128180921029524-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I see. I shall have my templars look into this more thoroughly. Thank you.

1228142921028320-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Guess what? I've got a mission for you!

116183821029388-Kritias_2018_12-.name: It's hard enough getting enough aetherine for our research, and the $npcNamePlural:25020102$ near $map:02020030$ have only made our job harder.

1228142921028321-Kritias_2018_12-.name: These $npcNamePlural:25020102$ gather aetherine crystals and use them like batteries to keep their bodies going.

1228142921028322-Kritias_2018_12-.name: The more of them show up, the less aetherine there is for us. Help us by driving the $npcNamePlural:25020102$ from $map:02020030$!

1228142921028323-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Help us by driving the $npcNamePlural:25020102$ from $map:02020030$!

1228142921028324-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Thanks so much! Our aetherine source is secure... for now.

1228142921028325-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I've been looking all over for you!

116183821029389-Kritias_2018_12-.name: The Green Hoods are researching the correlation between aetherine and mana levels. Unfortunately, the heaps and heaps of monsters out there keep getting in our way.

1228142921028326-Kritias_2018_12-.name: The monsters in $map:02020001$ and $map:02020004$ are especially terrible!

116183821029390-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Can you help us out by defeating the $npcNamePlural:25020505$ in $map:02020001$ and $npcNamePlural:25020402$ in $map:02020004$?

1228142921028327-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Can you help us out by defeating the $npcNamePlural:25020505$ in $map:02020001$ and $npcNamePlural:25020402$ in $map:02020004$?

1228142921028328-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Thank you so much! We all owe you a big one!

1228142921028329-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I have news! Our scouts discovered a ruin in $map:02020016$.

1228142921028330-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I've got a team ready to excavate the place. Ancient ruins on an unknown world... It's like an adventure novel!

1228142921028331-Kritias_2018_12-.name: But it's not easy sailing. Enemies are coming from all over the place to keep us out of $map:02020016$.

130151521029758-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I can't send my people into that. But I can't just give up on the research, either!

130151521029759-Kritias_2018_12-.name: So... Help us? Pretty please? With a cherry on top?

130151521029760-Kritias_2018_12-.name: How can I say no to that?

1228142921028332-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Thanks! I owe you soooo much!

130151521029761-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Please drive the monsters away from $map:02020016$. I'll get my team ready to move out as soon as it's safe.

1228142921028333-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Please drive the monsters away from $map:02020016$. I'll get my team ready to move out as soon as it's safe.

1228142921028334-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Good job, $MyPCName$! We can finally start laying out the groundwork for a research camp out there.

1228142921028335-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Have I got an important mission for you!

130145621029750-Kritias_2018_12-.name: $map:02020017$ is a high priority research site, since it contains an archive of writings on ancient Kritias.

1228142921028336-Kritias_2018_12-.name: The problem is, my scouts tell me that monsters and enemy soldiers are working together by stealing or destroying those writings.

130145621029751-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Oh, and they're hurting my field agents, too. But think of all the writings we're losing!

1228142921028337-Kritias_2018_12-.name: We can't keep on like this. Please move out to $map:02020017$ and send those monsters packing!

1228142921028338-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Please move out to $map:02020017$ and send those monsters packing!

1228142921028339-Kritias_2018_12-.name: They should think twice before they mess with Sky Fortress again, thanks to you.

1228142921028340-Kritias_2018_12-.name: One of my research teams are testing out how aetherine crystals react to mana from Maple World.

130145621029753-Kritias_2018_12-.name: The strange thing is that they react with each other at all! Could these two types of energy be related somehow?

1228142921028341-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I want to know more, but monsters keep getting in our way!

130145621029754-Kritias_2018_12-.name: This research is too important to give up now. Besides, our comrades need our help!

130145621029755-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I'm always up for helping comrades.

130145621029756-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I knew I could count on you, Comrade! Heheh.

1228142921028344-Kritias_2018_12-.name: That was amazing! I knew I could count on you.

1121192421026035-FameContents_EP1_01-.name: We've detected an unidentified flying object blipping in and out of radar range. I want to analyze it to figure out what it is, and whether it's a threat to Sky Fortress. That's where you come in!

1121192421026036-FameContents_EP1_01-.name: It's not aliens, is it? I'm not sure how I feel about aliens...

1121192421026037-FameContents_EP1_01-.name: I said "unidentified," didn't I? Our sensors aren't currently able to identify what it is or where it's from. According to our radar logs, the object has approached the ship several times, each time coming a little closer. It's almost like its getting faster.

1121192421026038-FameContents_EP1_01-.name: We won't know any more until we can get a better look at it.

1121192421026039-FameContents_EP1_01-.name: Okay. Well, I'm up for the job, but it's not like I can fly or anything.

1121192421026043-FameContents_EP1_01-.name:
This doohickey looked important.
<font color="#909090">(You hand over what's left of the mech's flight recorder.)</font>

1121192421026044-FameContents_EP1_01-.name: Excellent work! I'll take it from here.

1121192421026045-FameContents_EP1_01-.name: What now, do we bring that to the captain?

1121192421026049-FameContents_EP1_01-.name: Wait, this file from the machine's radio logs is intact! I'm going to play it.

1121192421026050-FameContents_EP1_01-.name: Hmph. Looks like I still have improvements to make to the primary rockets before we can reach the ship. CHKY, return to base.

1121192421026053-FameContents_EP1_01-.name: This could be bad... I've got to warn the captain immediately!

1121192421026055-FameContents_EP1_01-.name: This is an emergency! Out of the way!

1126133221026059-FameChallengeDungeon-.name: Meet me on the top deck when you're ready.

1126133221026062-FameChallengeDungeon-.name: You. Me. A cage in a secret underground bunker. What do you say?

1126133221026063-FameChallengeDungeon-.name: I can't wait to give you some of my... undivided attention.

1126133221026064-FameChallengeDungeon-.name: I can't wait to give you some of my... undivided attention.

1126133221026065-FameChallengeDungeon-.name: Not bad, hot stuff. I can tell you're improving.

1126133221026066-FameChallengeDungeon-.name: But don't expect me to make things so easy for you next time.

1126133221026067-FameChallengeDungeon-.name: I hear a whispering in my soul. It can only mean one thing...

1126133221026068-FameChallengeDungeon-.name: Today is the day the oracle will speak.

1126133221026069-FameChallengeDungeon-.name: Today is the day the oracle will speak.

1126133221026072-FameChallengeDungeon-.name: We will try again in our next battle.

1126133221026074-FameChallengeDungeon-.name: I have not given up hope...

1126133221026075-FameChallengeDungeon-.name: ...that you may be the one to punish the gods!

1126133221026076-FameChallengeDungeon-.name: My upgrades are ready! This round of testing won't be like last time!

1126133221026079-FameChallengeDungeon-.name: ...All this data... So many anomalies... Thousands of errors…

1126133221026080-FameChallengeDungeon-.name: Why is it giving me different results each time?!

1126133221026081-FameChallengeDungeon-.name: You must be improving as well, $MyPCName$... I think my simulator is picking up on it…

1126133221026082-FameChallengeDungeon-.name: I need more data! I'm going to work on a patch. Help me test it out later!

1126133221026086-FameChallengeDungeon-.name: Get a load of you! You're improving, day by day!

1126133221026088-FameChallengeDungeon-.name: What a workout! Why don't we sweat it out at the sauna? Just don't mention it to the captain!

1126133221026089-FameChallengeDungeon-.name: You can visit the sauna all you wish... when you aren't on duty.

1126133221026090-FameChallengeDungeon-.name: You know I'd never slack off at work, Captain! I was joking!

1228173721028572-Kritias_2018_12-.name: This isn't good. $npcName:23001006$ is on a rampage in the $map:02020051$.

116130421029230-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I'll see what I can do about it.

1228173721028579-Kritias_2018_12-.name:
Defeating that mechanical abomination would be a good start.

1228173721028581-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I have already heard praise for your valiant performance.

116130421029232-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I will call upon you again soon.

I beg you, $MyPCName$! Please fight it and collect as much data as you can!

1228173721028604-Kritias_2018_12-.name: These Daemon Army guys keep attacking my teams in Kidel. Wherever they go, they leave our researchers scattered and their camps ruined.

1228173721028605-Kritias_2018_12-.name:
I beg you, $MyPCName$. Fight them and collect intelligence on how they fight.
<font color="#909090">(Once you accept this mission, you cannot begin any other weekly [Special] First Legion missions until the weekly reset.)</font>

1228173721028606-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Please collect data by fighting the Daemon Army.

1228173721028607-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Thanks! I'll get on this data right away.

1228173721028608-Kritias_2018_12-.name: The Daemon Army is on the move.

1228173721028609-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I'm worried they're preparing to make a bid for all of Kritias.

1228173721028610-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Whatever they're planning, we must stop them. Intercept them before they gain too much ground.

1228173721028611-Kritias_2018_12-.name:
Be careful. This won't be an easy battle.
<font color="#909090">(Once you accept this mission, you cannot begin any other weekly [Special] Second Legion missions until the weekly reset.)</font>

1228173721028612-Kritias_2018_12-.name: You haven't left yet? Attack before the Daemon Army can gain any ground!

1228173721028614-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Well, that's not important. The important thing is that we continue to beat them.

1228173721028615-Kritias_2018_12-.name: $npcName:11001813[gender:0]$'s Daemon Army has resumed their grim march forward.

1228173721028618-Kritias_2018_12-.name:
Do what you can to weaken the Daemon Army.
<font color="#909090">(Once you accept this mission, you cannot begin any other weekly [Special] Second Legion missions until the weekly reset.)</font>

1228173721028620-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I stopped them this time, but this isn't over. Not yet.

1228173721028621-Kritias_2018_12-.name: An astute observation, $MyPCName$. I shall take it under consideration.

1228173721028622-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Ugh! All of these reports are the same... A specter wearing a ragged cape shows up, says something ominous, and vanishes...

116183821029394-Kritias_2018_12-.name: After all this time, we still know almost nothing about $npcName:11001813[gender:0]$. How?!

116183821029395-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Well, I intend to change that. $npcName:11001813[gender:0]$ and his forces have been spotted in Kidel.

116183821029396-Kritias_2018_12-.name: $npcName:11001813[gender:0]$ is a Category 1 threat. We can't leave ourselves in the dark when it comes to him, right?

1228173721028623-Kritias_2018_12-.name: So, if we can't get any information by tracking him...

116183821029397-Kritias_2018_12-.name: ...I say we go through his minions!

<font color="#909090">(If you accept the quest, you cannot being any other weekly legion battle quests until the weekly reset.)</font>

1228173721028627-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Oh well. We've just got to keep trying!

1228160921028347-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Scouts in the field report that $npcName:11004430[gender:0]$ continues to turn monsters to his side.

107133121028671-Kritias_2018_12-.name: We must destroy his minions, as well as any monsters we think might fall for under his thrall.

107133121028672-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Your mission, should you choose to accept it, is to defeat $npcNamePlural:25020001$ in $map:02020029$, $npcNamePlural:25020205$ in $map:02020031$, and $npcNamePlural:25020106$ in $map:02020030$.

107134421028674-Kritias_2018_12-.name: That's good. They will return... but we will be ready.

1228160921028352-Kritias_2018_12-.name: My scouts have already reported your progress. You deserve a commendation.

107134421028678-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Take a rest for now. I'll have more missions for you soon.

1228160921028353-Kritias_2018_12-.name: We received an call for help from Humanitas. They're outnumbered and outgunned by the enemy.

107153121028679-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I don't have any regular forces to send to them. I'll need to call on a specialist...

107153121028681-Kritias_2018_12-.name: That would be best. You've worked with them before, after all.

107153121028682-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Help Humanitas by defeating $npcNamePlural:25020306$ in $map:02020006$, $npcNamePlural:25020406$ in $map:02020004$, and $npcNamePlural:25020506$ in $map:02020001$.

1228160921028354-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Help Humanitas by defeating $npcNamePlural:25020306$ in $map:02020006$, $npcNamePlural:25020406$ in $map:02020004$, and $npcNamePlural:25020506$ in $map:02020001$.

1228160921028355-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Humanitas sent us thanks for your work.

107153121028683-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Our alliance survived today thanks to you. Well done.

107153121028684-Kritias_2018_12-.name: We can't sit by and watch our ally suffer. Will you go to their aid?

107153121028687-Kritias_2018_12-.name: They've asked for you by name in any future missions.

1228160921028359-Kritias_2018_12-.name: $MyPCName$, I have a bit of a personal request.

107153121028689-Kritias_2018_12-.name: You can say anything to me, Captain.

107153121028690-Kritias_2018_12-.name: The swordsmanship used here in Kritias is strange to me. I'd like to learn about their fighting style for myself.

107153121028691-Kritias_2018_12-.name: That's why I'd like you to fight them for me. Through you, I can learn their techniques.

107153121028694-Kritias_2018_12-.name: <font color="#909090">(You attempt to demonstrate the sword techniques you encountered.)</font>

107153121028695-Kritias_2018_12-.name: ...This will take some time. Thank you anyway.

107160121028696-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I don't trust anyone but you with this task. Will you study the enemy's gun technique?

1228160921028364-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Good work, $MyPCName$. I'll send your data on to our field operatives.

107160121028699-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Of course, we'll need more data in the future. I'll speak with you then.

1228160921028365-Kritias_2018_12-.name: This is unacceptable. I will court-martial whatever officer was responsible for this!

107160121028701-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Yes! $map:02020051$, $map:02020017$, and $map:02020003$ are some of the most hotly-contested zones in Kritias.

107160121028702-Kritias_2018_12-.name: They form fronts on the civil war between this land's factions. Only our veteran agents are cleared for duty there.

107160121028703-Kritias_2018_12-.name: And yet, somehow, our latest batch of recruits were shipped out there instead. They aren't ready for that level of action.

107160121028704-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I need you to get there and defeat $npcNamePlural:25021106$ in $map:02020051$, $npcNamePlural:25021202$ in $map:02020017$, and $npcNamePlural:25021502$ in $map:02020003$. If you don't, our recruits won't be coming home.

1228160921028366-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I need you to get there and defeat $npcNamePlural:25021106$ in $map:02020051$, $npcNamePlural:25021202$ in $map:02020017$, and $npcNamePlural:25021502$ in $map:02020003$. If you don't, our recruits won't be coming home.

1228160921028367-Kritias_2018_12-.name: My soldiers are safely in their barracks, thanks to you. And I've taken steps to ensure that this does not happen again.

107160121028705-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Unfortunately, I haven't been able to determine who sent the order to the wrong squad. If this happens again... I know who to turn to.

1228160921028368-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I've received an alarming report from the field.

107160121028706-Kritias_2018_12-.name: New enemies in heavy armor have appeared. They've openly attacked our forces and are delaying our operations. Are you ready to strike back against them?

107161521028708-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Take care of $npcNamePlural:25021205$ in $map:02020017$ and $npcNamePlural:25021406$ in $map:02020014$.

1228160921028369-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Take care of $npcNamePlural:25021205$ in $map:02020017$ and $npcNamePlural:25021406$ in $map:02020014$.

1228160921028370-Kritias_2018_12-.name: You returned safely. Are you hurt?

107161521028710-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I'm fine, but you should see the other guys!

107161521028711-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Thanks to your quick work, our agents were able to continue their work. Well done.

1228160921028371-Kritias_2018_12-.name: $map:02020018$, $map:02020037$, and $map:02020035$ are major choke points on the main routes through Kritias.

1228160921028372-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Take care of $npcNamePlural:25021703$ in $map:02020018$, $npcNamePlural:25022105$ in $map:02020037$, and $npcNamePlural:25021905$ in $map:02020035$.

1228160921028373-Kritias_2018_12-.name: You've created enough of an opening for our scouts to get through.

107161521028716-Kritias_2018_12-.name: It's only a matter of time before we strike out for the furthest reaches of Kritias.

1228160921028374-Kritias_2018_12-.name: My cartography team tells me that $map:02020018$ and $map:02020037$ are the gateway to the furthest reaches of Kritias.

107162121028717-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Of course, our enemies have fortified their positions there.

107162121028718-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Open the way for us by defeating $npcNamePlural:25021702$ in $map:02020018$ and $npcNamePlural:25022102$ in $map:02020037$.

1228160921028375-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Open the way for us by defeating $npcNamePlural:25021702$ in $map:02020018$ and $npcNamePlural:25022102$ in $map:02020037$.

1228160921028376-Kritias_2018_12-.name: My people tell me that the threats in those areas are gone. They will return someday, but we will defeat them again.

107162121028719-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I'm counting on your help in extending our reach in Kritias.

1228160921028377-Kritias_2018_12-.name: $npcName:11004315[gender:1]$ tells me that she needs to study pacified monsters in order to understand them.

107164521028726-Kritias_2018_12-.name: No, no, it's fine. I'll pass this on to the researchers.

1228160921028380-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Our research into the creatures of Kritias continues.

107164521028727-Kritias_2018_12-.name: My tactical officer has a working hypothesis, but she needs more samples for analysis.

1228160921028382-Kritias_2018_12-.name: It does look strange. Perhaps this will prove the researchers' theory.

107164521028729-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Thank you. We'll see to this creature's return to the wild when we're done.

107165421028734-Kritias_2018_12-.name: It doesn't walk on all fours?

107165421028736-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Never mind. It seems my scout was mistaken.

107165421028737-Kritias_2018_12-.name: My researchers will make sure the creature gets home when we're done with it. Take a rest until your next mission.
