107170221028739-Kritias_2018_12-.name: It'll be a piece of cake.

1228160921028388-Kritias_2018_12-.name: My research team won't be quiet about the creature. Do you have it?

107170221028742-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I can hear them cheering from here. I'll tell you what results they achieve... just as soon as they tell me what it is they're doing.

1228160921028389-Kritias_2018_12-.name: We've been here for some time. You must have encountered the leshies by now.

107171321028743-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Unlike the other monsters of Kritias, they don't have any aetherine in their bodies. Instead, they wear aetherine around their neck and draw power from that.

107171321028744-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I wonder... could my soldiers learn to use $itemPlural:30001303$?

107171321028747-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Good work. Hopefully our researchers can find a way to use these without hurting themselves too much.

1228160921028392-Kritias_2018_12-.name: The research team asked me to send you their thanks. They've made a lot of progress because of you.

107173421028749-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Of course, their thanks came with a request for more help. They need $itemPlural:61000164$.

107173421028750-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I can count on you, can't I? You can capture $itemPlural:61000164$ in $map:02020051$.

1228160921028394-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Is that it? It certainly is... unique.

107173421028751-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I'll send them to the researchers. Thank you, $MyPCName$.

1228160921028395-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I'll keep this brief. Our research team needs another test subject.

107173421028752-Kritias_2018_12-.name: They've requested a $item:61000165$ from $map:02020033$. In spite of its name, it's apparently less aggressive than the other monsters of Kritias. They want to know why.

1228160921028397-Kritias_2018_12-.name: That was quick. The researchers should be happy.

107173421028755-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I will send the $item:61000165$ to the team. If they need anything more, I will let you know.

1228160921028398-Kritias_2018_12-.name: You know what the research team needs, don't you?

107200521028756-Kritias_2018_12-.name: They need me to capture a monster.

107200521028758-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Correct. They tell me that they're nearing the end of their research.

107200521028759-Kritias_2018_12-.name: What monster do they need this time?

107200521028760-Kritias_2018_12-.name: They need monsters. Tamed monsters that they can experiment on.

107200521028764-Kritias_2018_12-.name: ...Are there no monsters that walk on all fours?

114142721029073-Kritias_2018_12-.name: There's one like this that walks on all fours.

114142721029077-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I do not believe the captain likes that monster.

114142721029078-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Pitiable creature. I shall take it with me.

114142721029079-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Let's send the $item:61000170$ to the research team, first.

114142721029080-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I'll take a look at that insect... that monster later. Good job.

1228160921028401-Kritias_2018_12-.name: My research team tells me that they've learned a great deal about the monsters of Kritias. However…

107202221028766-Kritias_2018_12-.name: We apparently still know very little about $itemPlural:61000166$. If you capture one from $map:02020018$, the research team would be ecstatic.

107202221028767-Kritias_2018_12-.name: It'll be a piece of cake.

1228160921028402-Kritias_2018_12-.name: If you capture one from $map:02020018$, the research team would be ecstatic.

1228160921028403-Kritias_2018_12-.name: The research team has been eagerly—and persistently—awaiting your return.

107202221028769-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I'll send this creature on to them. When we're done, we'll release it back into the wild.

1228160921028404-Kritias_2018_12-.name: My researchers have been asking when you'd return.

107205121028770-Kritias_2018_12-.name: What do they want me to catch this time?

107205121028771-Kritias_2018_12-.name: The team wants to analyze a $item:61000169$ from $map:02020037$.

1228160921028405-Kritias_2018_12-.name: The research team wants to analyze a $item:61000169$ from $map:02020037$.

1228160921028406-Kritias_2018_12-.name: That was quick. Was it difficult?

107205121028775-Kritias_2018_12-.name: So you say. Take a moment to rest before you go on your next mission.

1228160921028407-Kritias_2018_12-.name: My research team is on edge. Every time I check on the lab, it's a tangle of shouting scientists and spilled beakers.

107211221028776-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Let me explain the rest, Captain. I could use a little face time with $MyPCName$. You see, one of the researchers was burning the midnight oil and accidentally let a test subject go.

107211221028777-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I've already found the culprit, but the team is short a specimen. While I get to work... disciplining the naughty researcher, I want you to catch a replacement monster for them.

107211221028778-Kritias_2018_12-.name: They just need one measly $item:61000163$. You can find them in $map:02020009$.

1228160921028408-Kritias_2018_12-.name: You need to capture a $item:61000163$ in $map:02020009$.

1228160921028409-Kritias_2018_12-.name: It appears you've captured the monster.

107211221028779-Kritias_2018_12-.name: My intelligence officer assures me that this won't be a problem again. Thank you both.

1228160921028410-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Our monster research continues. The monster for today is a $item:61000168$ from $map:02020008$.

107211221028780-Kritias_2018_12-.name: The researchers are especially interested in this specimen, since it's surprisingly gentle for its size.

114142721029082-Kritias_2018_12-.name: By the skin of my teeth, I did.

1228160921028412-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Are you sure this is it?

107211221028781-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Did I catch the wrong monster...?

114142721029084-Kritias_2018_12-.name: This isn't the monster the researchers described...

107211221028783-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I'll pass this along to the researchers...

1228160921028413-Kritias_2018_12-.name: You've been to $map:02020029$, haven't you? Our scouts believe that monsters are drawing aetherine from there.

107212521028784-Kritias_2018_12-.name: They discovered a strange pit in the area. Unfortunately, they couldn't get close enough to investigate further.

107212521028785-Kritias_2018_12-.name: The monsters shouldn't pose much of a problem for you. I'd like you to look into it.

1228160921028414-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I want to know what's in that pit.

107212521028786-Kritias_2018_12-.name: There's a cave filled with aetherine ore there.

107212521028787-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Indeed? I'll send a party out there right away.

1228160921028416-Kritias_2018_12-.name: The $npcName:25020302$ population in $map:02020006$ is on the rise. We can't afford to keep fighting them with conventional tactics.

107212521028790-Kritias_2018_12-.name: You're going to enter their habitat and do something about it.

107212521028791-Kritias_2018_12-.name: You're going to destroy their eggs.

107212521028792-Kritias_2018_12-.name: We have no choice in this. Our scouts are in danger. Enter the $npcName:25020302$ habitat in $map:02020006$ and get rid of the eggs.

1228160921028417-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Enter the $npcName:25020302$ habitat in $map:02020006$ and get rid of the eggs.

1228160921028418-Kritias_2018_12-.name: It was no doubt a difficult mission. Good work.

107212521028794-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Yes. The safety of the crew is important.

1228160921028419-Kritias_2018_12-.name: We've received an emergency communique from Humanitas in $map:02020033$.

107213221028795-Kritias_2018_12-.name: They need help from our engineer corps, but I don't have the men to spare. That means that you're going in their place.

107213221028796-Kritias_2018_12-.name: It's they're blasted cannons! The dang things aren't firing. Why don't you head out there and fix 'em up?\

107213221028797-Kritias_2018_12-.name: It's be a piece of cake for my cadet. BAHAHAHA!

107213221028799-Kritias_2018_12-.name: There's no time to waste. Go to $map:02020033$ and do what you can for their cannons.

1228160921028420-Kritias_2018_12-.name: There's no time to waste. Go to $map:02020033$ and do what you can for their cannons.

1228160921028421-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Humanitas had a lot of great things to say about your work at $map:02020033$.

107213221028800-Kritias_2018_12-.name: My trust was well placed, as always.

107214421028802-Kritias_2018_12-.name: It's this place. Kritias. A dire aura runs deep through it.

107214421028803-Kritias_2018_12-.name: The darkness is especially thick in $map:02020029$, $map:02020030$, and $map:02020031$. We must hasten to action.

107214421028804-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Restore order by slaying $npcNamePlural:25020005$ in $map:02020029$, $npcNamePlural:25020104$ in $map:02020030$, and $npcNamePlural:25020202$ in $map:02020031$.

1228160921028423-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Restore order by slaying $npcNamePlural:25020005$ in $map:02020029$, $npcNamePlural:25020104$ in $map:02020030$, and $npcNamePlural:25020202$ in $map:02020031$.

1228160921028424-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I feel as though a weight has lifted. Sky Fortress is warded against evil for another day.

107214421028805-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Of course, this peace won't last long. When the time comes, I shall call upon you again.

1228160921028425-Kritias_2018_12-.name: It is good to see you again, my loyal subject.

107214421028807-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I took counsel with the oracle yesterday. We must defeat the forces of darkness to avert a great disaster in Kritias.

107214421028809-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Verily! Away, to defeat $npcNamePlural:25020105$ in $map:02020030$ and $npcNamePlural:25020004$ in $map:02020029$... before it's too late!

1228160921028426-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Defeat $npcNamePlural:25020105$ in $map:02020030$ and $npcNamePlural:25020004$ in $map:02020029$... before it's too late!

1228160921028427-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Thanks to your swift action, we may yet live to see another day.

107214421028810-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I shall contact you when next the oracle speaks to me.

1228160921028428-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Should I despise them? No! It is my pity that they deserve!

107215221028812-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Do not wave your ignorance brazenly in my face. I speak, of course, of the monsters whose souls have been twisted by corruption. Can you not hear them cry out in pain?

107215221028814-Kritias_2018_12-.name: We cannot allow this to go on. Lay to rest the $npcNamePlural:25020306$ in $map:02020006$, $npcNamePlural:25020402$ in $map:02020004$, and $npcNamePlural:25020503$ in $map:02020001$!

1228160921028429-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Lay to rest the $npcNamePlural:25020306$ in $map:02020006$, $npcNamePlural:25020402$ in $map:02020004$, and $npcNamePlural:25020503$ in $map:02020001$!

1228160921028430-Kritias_2018_12-.name: The cries of the darned have ceased. A tragedy, and yet a relief!

107215221028815-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I pray that they rest in peace.

1228160921028431-Kritias_2018_12-.name: You've arrived at just the right time. It seems our psychic connection has been firmly reestablished!

107215921028816-Kritias_2018_12-.name: My many agents have reported of strange creatures in $map:02020006$. And their descriptions are…

107215921028818-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I don't like where you're going with this.

107215921028819-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I must know more. Travel to $map:02020006$ and carefully observe $npcNamePlural:25020307$ and $npcNamePlural:25020305$.

1228160921028432-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Travel to $map:02020006$ and carefully observe $npcNamePlural:25020307$ and $npcNamePlural:25020305$.

107215921028821-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Hm. Your observation is as useless as it is blind to the greater mysteries of the other world.

107215921028822-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I'll be more specific next time I ask for your help.

1228160921028434-Kritias_2018_12-.name: It's wrong. The strategy is all wrong.

107220721028823-Kritias_2018_12-.name: What are you going on about?

107220721028824-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Do you not see? We will never win if we devote all of our efforts to fighting wave after wave of underlings!

107220721028825-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I believe, however, that if we target the leaders, we have a chance. I'd do it myself, but it would be too great of a risk to unleash my power on the battlefield.

107220721028826-Kritias_2018_12-.name: But you... Yes, you can be my implement of precisely-honed violence! Defeat $npcNamePlural:25020606$ in $map:02020010$, $npcNamePlural:25020806$ in $map:02020034$, and $npcNamePlural:25021006$ in $map:02020016$.

1228160921028435-Kritias_2018_12-.name: You can be my implement of precisely-honed violence! Defeat $npcNamePlural:25020606$ in $map:02020010$, $npcNamePlural:25020806$ in $map:02020034$, and $npcNamePlural:25021006$ in $map:02020016$.

1228160921028436-Kritias_2018_12-.name: So? Have we begun to make real progress?

107220721028827-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Well, I accomplished something out there.

107220721028828-Kritias_2018_12-.name: That you did, my friend. That you did.

1228160921028437-Kritias_2018_12-.name: We must discuss many dire things today, $MyPCName$. I hope you are prepared.

107221421028830-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I have eyes on the forces of Kharon, and I have witnessed attempts to liaise with the Daemon Army. They are exchanging information.

107221421028832-Kritias_2018_12-.name: We cannot have that, can we? Let us punish them. Defeat $npcNamePlural:25020603$ and $npcNamePlural:25020703$.

107221421028835-Kritias_2018_12-.name: It is fortunate, then, that we nipped this alliance in the bud.

1228160921028440-Kritias_2018_12-.name: The researchers of Sky Fortress have drawn a connection between an unhealthy blue glow and aetherine in the body.

107222021028836-Kritias_2018_12-.name: It's a curious idea. Don't you want to learn more for yourself?

107222021028838-Kritias_2018_12-.name: As you should be! Let's begin by performing field autopsies on $npcNamePlural:25021101$ in $map:02020051$, $npcNamePlural:25021204$ in $map:02020017$, and $npcNamePlural:25021501$ in $map:02020003$.

107222021028839-Kritias_2018_12-.name: You know how to perform a field autopsy, do you not? Strike your subject with vigor and see if aetherine comes out.

1228160921028441-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Perform field autopsies on $npcNamePlural:25021101$ in $map:02020051$, $npcNamePlural:25021204$ in $map:02020017$, and $npcNamePlural:25021501$ in $map:02020003$.

107222021028841-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Were the researcher mistaken? We'll have to perform more autopsies...

1228160921028443-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Guns... Is there any weapon so inelegant, so detached from the true potency of the soul, as a gun?

107222821028842-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Nonetheless, I must know every facet of the enemies we face. We must conduct research into the gun-wielders of this land.

107222821028843-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Let's begin with $npcNamePlural:25021103$ in $map:02020051$ and $npcNamePlural:25021407$ in $map:02020014$.

107222821028844-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Why do you linger? Your task awaits!

1228160921028445-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Those soulless gunslingers were beneath you, I assume. You can defeat them with your eyes closed, can you not?

107222821028845-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Sure, but maybe I'll keep my eyes open, anyway.

107222821028846-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Your lack of conviction is disturbing. We'll have to work on that, won't we?

1228160921028446-Kritias_2018_12-.name: My informants tell me that Kharon and the Daemon Army persist in their foolish alliance.

107223421028847-Kritias_2018_12-.name: We must be more active in discouraging them.

107223421028848-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Cut the lines between them by defeating $npcNamePlural:25021904$ in $map:02020035$, $npcNamePlural:25022005$ in $map:02020036$, and $npcNamePlural:25021602$ in $map:02020009$.

1228160921028447-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Cut the lines between them by defeating $npcNamePlural:25021904$ in $map:02020035$, $npcNamePlural:25022005$ in $map:02020036$, and $npcNamePlural:25021602$ in $map:02020009$.

107223421028849-Kritias_2018_12-.name: This should put their alliance on hold.

107223421028850-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Well done. I knew I could count on you.

1228160921028449-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I've had some time to contemplate the challenges that face us in this strange land, and I've reached a conclusion.

107223921028852-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Our greatest hope for surviving this place is the quick and complete destruction of the Daemon Army.

107223921028853-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Take a step towards this goal by vanquishing $npcNamePlural:25021903$ in $map:02020035$ and $npcNamePlural:25022001$ in $map:02020036$.

1228160921028450-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Take a step towards this goal by vanquishing $npcNamePlural:25021903$ in $map:02020035$ and $npcNamePlural:25022001$ in $map:02020036$.

1228160921028451-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I can sense the Daemon Army's power waning from here.

107223921028854-Kritias_2018_12-.name: With your skills and my insight, peace will come soon.

1228160921028452-Kritias_2018_12-.name: The Lumiknights take a keen interest in the culture and wildlife of Kritias. By studying how our worlds are different, we can learn more about Maple World.

108093321028855-Kritias_2018_12-.name: The robotic insects, in particular, stand out to me. It seems they're only to be found in $map:02020029$.

108093321028856-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Go to $map:02020029$ and find out who made these mechanical insects, whether they're truly alive, and what their purpose is.

108093321028857-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Do you want me to bring them back?

108093321028858-Kritias_2018_12-.name: No. I'll leave the actual seeing and touching to you.

1228160921028453-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Go to $map:02020029$ and find out who made these mechanical insects, whether they're truly alive, and what their purpose is.

108093321028859-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I don't know who made them, but they're kind of cute.

108093321028860-Kritias_2018_12-.name: That's hardly helpful. Thanks anyway, I suppose.

1228160921028455-Kritias_2018_12-.name: But why would they all gather in such a place?

108094521028862-Kritias_2018_12-.name: $map:02020030$. $npcNamePlural:25020104$ are swarming there, and I don't know why.

108094521028863-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Could it be the dark crystals that are in that place?

108094521028864-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I must know more. Go to $map:02020030$ and gather the crystals there.

1228160921028456-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Go to $map:02020030$ and gather the crystal fragments there.

1228160921028457-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I feel a dark aura coming from you. You must be carrying the crystals.

108094521028865-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Perhaps these will reveal to me the weakness of the Daemon Army...

1228160921028458-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Humanitas is embroiled in a longstanding battle that I'd rather not get involved in, no matter what you or the captain say.

108094521028866-Kritias_2018_12-.name: However, what's done is done, and it would be dishonorable to turn our backs on them now.

108094521028868-Kritias_2018_12-.name: The transmission tower in $map:02020030$ is under attack by monsters. It seems the fence was broken by those monsters and needs to be repaired.

110191221029050-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Please repair the fence. That should keep it safe... For a time, at least.

1228160921028459-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Please repair the fence around $map:02020030$'s transmission tower. That should keep it safe... For a time, at least.

1228160921028460-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Humanitas sent us their thanks. I'm still dubious of our alliance, but at least we've done some good here.

108094521028869-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Thank you. I'll send for you when I have more work.

1228160921028461-Kritias_2018_12-.name: This world is full of strange ore. Perhaps too much for our research team to handle. I've noticed they're making more and more mistakes...

108103521028870-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I would never make such mistakes, of course, but I recognize that not everyone can be me. I would like to do something to help them.

108103521028871-Kritias_2018_12-.name: To that end, I want you to go to $map:02020031$ and examine the ore there.

108103521028872-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I thought you were going to help them.

108103521028873-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Absolutely not! Were I to put myself to this task, I'd complete it so quickly that all of the researchers would die of shame. We cannot have that.

1228160921028462-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Begin by examining the ore in $map:02020031$.

1228160921028463-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Excellent news! The researchers were enheartened by your help.

108103521028874-Kritias_2018_12-.name: They didn't have the nicest things to say about the quality of the help, but it seems you've inspired them to redouble their efforts. Well done!

1228160921028464-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I didn't expect to find so much diversity in the wildlife here. There's something more to Kritias than meets the eye if such creatures can survive in such an environment.

108103521028875-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Perhaps it's something in the water. Water is the source of life, you see.

108103521028877-Kritias_2018_12-.name: While the ship's researchers are looking into various metals and creatures, I've turned my attention to analyzing the water.

108103521028878-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I placed false plants in $map:02020001$ to gather data. Head there and see if there are any new records worth reviewing.

1228160921028465-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Head to $map:02020001$ and see if there are any new records worth reviewing.

108103521028880-Kritias_2018_12-.name: That's all...? Sigh. Thank you anyway...

1228160921028467-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Sky Fortress has been anchored in Kritias for some time. It's not meant to be at dock for so long.

108104321028881-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Why not fly it around, then?

108104321028882-Kritias_2018_12-.name: If we're in the sky for too long, the enemy starts deploying missiles. We have safe harbor here, but we don't exactly have free rein of the continent.

108104321028883-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Of course, Sky Fortress must be ready to launch at a moment's notice. That means we can't slack off on regular maintenance.

108104321028884-Kritias_2018_12-.name: $MyPCName$, please inspect Sky Fortress to make sure it's in flying condition.

1228160921028468-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Please inspect Sky Fortress to make sure it's in flying condition.

1228160921028469-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Were there any issues with Sky Fortress?

108104321028885-Kritias_2018_12-.name: It's a little dusty, but the engines still work.

108104321028886-Kritias_2018_12-.name: That's a relief. I'll call upon you again soon.

108111321028894-Kritias_2018_12-.name: This is about that, erm, that red fruit. You know. The one from Maple World...

108111321028897-Kritias_2018_12-.name: You're hearing things, Vanguard Captain! You're simply hearing things...

108111321028898-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Hmph. The altitude must be messing with my hearing…

108111321028899-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Keep your voice down, $MyPCName$. According to my research, they have $itemPlural:30000232$ in Kritias, too. It's the same as the cherries in Maple World in every way. Every way.

108111321028900-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I need it. For my, er, my research, you see! Quickly... and discreetly... gather some $itemPlural:30000232$ for me.

1228160921028474-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Quickly... and discreetly... gather some $itemPlural:30000232$ for me.

1228160921028475-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I'd recognize that smell anywhere. I'll put this to good use!

108111321028902-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Isn't that what I said? Leave me to my cherries, $male:man,female:woman$.

1228160921028476-Kritias_2018_12-.name: We have no shortage of injured soldiers. That is nothing new. However, it's difficult to ship enough medical supplies from the empire.

110191221029051-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Do not ask me how he discovered this, but one of my knights learned that a local herb called $item:30001299$ is an effective painkiller. That plant it comes from slumbers in $map:02020032$.

108123621028903-Kritias_2018_12-.name: $item:30001299$ can only be harvested when the $npcName:25020705$ is sleeping.

108123621028904-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Please examine the $npcName:25020705$ in $map:02020032$ and harvest some $item:30001299$.

1228160921028477-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Please examine the $npcName:25020705$ in $map:02020032$ and harvest some $item:30001299$.

1228160921028478-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Yes, this should be enough. For now, at least.

108123621028905-Kritias_2018_12-.name: At least now I know who I can ask when we need more.

1228160921028470-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Do you recall the robot soldiers that $npcName:11004430[gender:0]$ hacked? Our researchers were inspired by him and started experimenting with the same techniques.

108111321028887-Kritias_2018_12-.name: It took many sleepless nights, but they managed to finally capture and hack some of those robots for themselves.

108111321028889-Kritias_2018_12-.name: The hacking isn't precise, unfortunately. The robots require constant adjustment to keep them in line.

108111321028890-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I think it would be a good idea for you to check in with the lab and see if they have any updates.

1228160921028471-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I think it would be a good idea for you to check in with the lab and see if they have any updates.

108111321028891-Kritias_2018_12-.name: It's not smooth sailing, but they're managing.

108111321028892-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I see. I'll keep a close watch over the project.

1228160921028479-Kritias_2018_12-.name: The rafflesia of $map:02020013$ poison everything around them. It's made the $npcNamePlural:11004342[gender:0]$ there very angry.

108124521028906-Kritias_2018_12-.name: As a templar, I can't sit by and watch these creatures suffer. They must be relieved of their anger!

108124521028907-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Go to $map:02020013$ and pacify the angry poings.

1228160921028480-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Go to $map:02020013$ and pacify the angry poings.

108124521028909-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I shall take your word for it. Thank you, $MyPCName$.

1228160921028482-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Have you ever been to $map:02020014$? I'm told there are magnificent cherry blossom trees there.

108125321028910-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Cherry blossoms on a backdrop of machines... I would like blossoms from such a tree. Can you retrieve some for me?

108125321028912-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Do not make me ask again. Please.

108125321028914-Kritias_2018_12-.name: You have my gratitude. The $itemPlural:30001300$ can be found in $map:02020014$.

108125321028917-Kritias_2018_12-.name: It's for me! I needed something beautiful to go along with my radiant brilliance.

1228160921028485-Kritias_2018_12-.name: $map:02020014$ is a treasure trove of information about Kritias. It provides a microcosm of ecologies for our researchers to pour over.

108130121028918-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Unfortunately, we've lost contact with our researchers there. I'm worried for their safety.

108130121028919-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Go to $map:02020014$ and ensure their safety.

1228160921028486-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Go to $map:02020014$ and ensure their safety.

108130121028920-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Let's just say that they're safe and busy with research.

108130121028922-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I suppose I shall have to get a more thorough report directly from them.

1228160921028488-Kritias_2018_12-.name: One of our scouts has found what appears to be a waspling breeding ground.

108131821028923-Kritias_2018_12-.name: It's in the north of the $map:02020017$. We need to examine these creatures so we can learn how to better fight the wasplings.

108131821028924-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I want you to secure the location.

1228160921028489-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I want you to secure the location.

1228160921028490-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Were you able to secure the area?

108131821028925-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Well, it's about as secure as I can make it.

108131821028926-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I see. Perhaps I should send a templar escort with the researchers...

1228160921028491-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Have you ever visited $map:02020018$? It's at a much higher altitude than anywhere else in Kritias.

108131821028927-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Unlike the rest of this place, it seems almost untouched by technology. Perhaps that's why a unique plant grows only there—the Tiaman Sky Herb.

108131821028928-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Every morning, $item:30001301$ gathers on this herb. I want you to retrieve some.

108131821028930-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Interesting. I can sense a unique vibration from this dew... I will let you know if anything interesting comes of it.

1228160921028494-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I've received an interesting report. It seems that the plants in $map:02020037$ have an unusually high aetherine content.

108133521028931-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I need not tell you that aetherine is an extremely valuable power source. I wonder if there's some way we could extract a useful amount from these plants.

108133521028932-Kritias_2018_12-.name: As you might imagine, I intend to assign this task to you.

108133521028933-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Go to $map:02020037$ and pick some flowers.

1228160921028495-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Go to $map:02020037$ and pick some flowers.

1228160921028496-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Hm. At a glance, I sense nothing remarkable about these $itemPlural:30001302$.

108133521028934-Kritias_2018_12-.name: All the same, this warrants a closer analysis. I'll call upon you again soon.

1228160921028497-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Isn't Kritias great? So, so great. So many things to learn. Some might say too many things, but not me! No, I love pouring over pages and pages and pages and pages of data...

108160921028935-Kritias_2018_12-.name: For instance, we need to know more about the local monsters. We can't have them eating our scouts, after all.

108160921028936-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I'd like you to look into the monsters that live close to us. Doesn't that sound exciting?

110191221029054-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Please fight the $npcNamePlural:25020003$ in $map:02020029$, $npcNamePlural:25020103[gender:0]$ in $map:02020030$, and $npcNamePlural:25020203$ in $map:02020031$. Come back when you've got enough data!

1228160921028498-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Please fight the $npcNamePlural:25020003$ in $map:02020029$, $npcNamePlural:25020103[gender:0]$ in $map:02020030$, and $npcNamePlural:25020203$ in $map:02020031$. Come back when you've got enough data!

1228160921028499-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Good job! This data will make a huge difference to our teams out in the field. Just as soon as I get around to analyzing it...

108160921028937-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Please be careful out there. We're all counting on you, after all!

1228160921028500-Kritias_2018_12-.name: We really don't have much data on the various hostile entities of this land. Some of our scouts say they've run into some really weird bad guys, but I don't have anyone free to check them out.

108160921028938-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Ugh! What if they get away before we can study them?

108160921028939-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I could help, if you like.

108160921028940-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Would you really?! The hostiles in question are the $npcNamePlural:25020101[gender:0]$ in $map:02020030$ and $npcNamePlural:25020201$ in $map:02020031$!

108160921028941-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Keep your eyes peeled for anything that makes these enemies special or unique. I'm so lucky I have you, $MyPCName$!

1228160921028501-Kritias_2018_12-.name: The foes you're investigating are the $npcNamePlural:25020101[gender:0]$ in $map:02020030$ and $npcNamePlural:25020201$ in $map:02020031$.

108160921028942-Kritias_2018_12-.name: They seemed like regular bad guys to me.

108160921028943-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Was my scout wrong? Hm. I won't give up yet! Not when there's a chance I could discover a really freaky monster!

1228160921028503-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I was just thinking about you, $MyPCName$. I need your help.

108160921028945-Kritias_2018_12-.name: It seems like we can't send anyone to $map:02020004$, $map:02020001$, or $map:02020006$ without them getting terribly hurt. Our people there need help, but how can I send them supplies with all those monsters around?

108160921028946-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Please defeat the $npcNamePlural:25020405[gender:0]$ in $map:02020004$, $npcNamePlural:25020502$ in $map:02020001$, and $npcNamePlural:25020303$ in $map:02020006$ so I can get help to the people who need it.

1228160921028504-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Please defeat the $npcNamePlural:25020405[gender:0]$ in $map:02020004$, $npcNamePlural:25020502$ in $map:02020001$, and $npcNamePlural:25020303$ in $map:02020006$ so I can get help to the people who need it.

1228160921028505-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Thanks to you, our people in the field can breathe a little easier.

108160921028947-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I don't know when more monsters will crop up, but I know who to turn to when they do.

108160921028949-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I've got a new hypothesis, and I need your help to prove it before $npcName:11004316[gender:0]$ swoops in and steals the credit!

108160921028950-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I was up all night working on this, too. Okay, tell me what you think: the blue monsters of Kritias all have something in common!

108160921028951-Kritias_2018_12-.name: It's a brilliant hypothesis, I know, but I need your help to prove it. Please investigate $npcNamePlural:25020302$ in $map:02020006$ and $npcNamePlural:25020505$ in $map:02020001$!

108160921028952-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I didn't really see anything connecting them...

108160921028953-Kritias_2018_12-.name: No way! All right, time for another all-nighter. I'll stump that stupid templar yet...

1228160921028509-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Maybe you've noticed that we're a little... overwhelmed. I've been having people run all over the continent studying things at random. I think we might have an easier time if we brought some order to this chaos.

108160921028954-Kritias_2018_12-.name: So I'm setting up categories of monsters for you to investigate. Let's start with the weirdly-shaped robot category!

108160921028955-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Please fight $npcNamePlural:25020605$ in $map:02020010$, $npcNamePlural:25020807$ in $map:02020034$, and $npcNamePlural:25021001$ in $map:02020016$ to find out how they can move with such weird shapes.

1228160921028510-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Please fight $npcNamePlural:25020605$ in $map:02020010$, $npcNamePlural:25020807$ in $map:02020034$, and $npcNamePlural:25021001$ in $map:02020016$.

108160921028956-Kritias_2018_12-.name: They were as weird as you said they would be.

108160921028957-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Wonderful! Also... that wasn't as useful as I thought it would be! Maybe I need to reconsider my categories...

108160921028958-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Well, I'm not giving up yet!

1228160921028512-Kritias_2018_12-.name: When we first got here, I thought that Kritias was a land of machines. But it turns out there are lots of interesting creatures living here, too!

108160921028959-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I can't stop thinking about $npcNamePlural:11004342$. I hear there are a few different species living in the area.

108160921028960-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I want to know more! Go out and study the $npcNamePlural:25020704$ in $map:02020032$ and $npcNamePlural:25020905$ in $map:02020013$, please!

1228160921028513-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Go out and study the $npcNamePlural:25020704$ in $map:02020032$ and $npcNamePlural:25020905$ in $map:02020013$, please!

1228160921028514-Kritias_2018_12-.name: So, how did the different species vary from each other?

108160921028962-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Ah-ha! I knew it. We must study this in more depth next time!

1228160921028515-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Hey, could you do me a teeny tiny favor?

108160921028964-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I was going through our data on Kritias monsters, and some of our entries are looking awfully thin. That just won't do!

108160921028965-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Please gather data on $npcNamePlural:25021102$ in $map:02020051$, $npcNamePlural:25021203$ in $map:02020017$, and $npcNamePlural:25021401$ in $map:02020014$.

1228160921028516-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Please gather data on $npcNamePlural:25021102$ in $map:02020051$, $npcNamePlural:25021203$ in $map:02020017$, and $npcNamePlural:25021401$ in $map:02020014$.

1228160921028517-Kritias_2018_12-.name: You sure brought a lot of data!

108160921028966-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Thank you. I'll start uploading this new information right away.

108163521028977-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I was looking at our database of mechanical Kritias monsters and found that some of the entries are empty.

108163521028978-Kritias_2018_12-.name: We need to fill them with relevant data. $MyPCName$, you'll help me, right?

108163521028979-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Study them by fighting the $npcNamePlural:25021104$ in $map:02020051$ and $npcNamePlural:25021201$ in $map:02020017$.

108163521028980-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Study them by fighting the $npcNamePlural:25021104$ in $map:02020051$ and $npcNamePlural:25021201$ in $map:02020017$.

108163521028981-Kritias_2018_12-.name: That's some mighty fine data! Our understanding of this place grows by the day.

108163521028982-Kritias_2018_12-.name: It's only a matter of time before we have perfect countermeasures for these mechanical monsters. I can't wait!

108160921028967-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Calm down and tell me everything.

108160921028968-Kritias_2018_12-.name: If these reports are right, then Kharon and Tairen have a plot to use the local plant monsters to attack us!

108160921028969-Kritias_2018_12-.name: If those green meanies join the battle, there's no way we'll be able to hold out for long!

110191221029055-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Oh, would you? You're a life saver!

108160921028971-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Thank you very much! Please defeat the $npcNamePlural:25021801$ in $map:02020008$, $npcNamePlural:25021603$ in $map:02020009$, and $npcNamePlural:25022101$ in $map:02020037$.

1228160921028519-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Please defeat the $npcNamePlural:25021801$ in $map:02020008$, $npcNamePlural:25021603$ in $map:02020009$, and $npcNamePlural:25022101$ in $map:02020037$.

108160921028972-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Those weeds won't be bothering us anytime soon.

108160921028973-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Thanks again! The next time I have some killer gardening problems, I'll turn to you.

1228160921028521-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I've been looking over our scout reports, and I've come to an important conclusion. Those Daemon Army guys are bad news!

108160921028974-Kritias_2018_12-.name: If we take care of them, then Humanitas can focus their efforts on Tairen.

108160921028975-Kritias_2018_12-.name: So, shall we defeat the Daemon Army? Please defeat $npcNamePlural:25021901$ in $map:02020035$ and $npcNamePlural:25022002$ in $map:02020036$.

1228160921028523-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Good job! Humanitas is probably grateful, too.

108160921028976-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I'm sure it's only a matter of time before the Daemon Army is back. I'm glad we have you on our side!

1228160921028524-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Have you heard about the giant $npcName:11004342[gender:0]$ in $map:02020006$? They say that if you move his heart, you'll find a great treasure!

110191221029057-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I think there's something to this rumor.

108163521028983-Kritias_2018_12-.name: The best way to find out for sure is to try it out for yourself!

108163521028984-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Please go to $map:02020006$ and find out the truth of the rumor!

1228160921028525-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Please go to $map:02020006$ and find out the truth of the rumor!

1228160921028526-Kritias_2018_12-.name: So? Did you move the heart of the giant $npcName:11004342[gender:0]$?!

108163521028985-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I did, and he gave me treasure as a reward!

108163521028986-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Really?! I can't believe the rumor was actually true! Wow!

108163521028988-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I kind of authorized a mission to $map:02020031$ since things had settled down there, but now I've lost contact with the team.

110191221029058-Kritias_2018_12-.name: That place isn't exactly safe. And the monsters there are wild.

108163521028989-Kritias_2018_12-.name: What if they're hurt? Can you check on them for me?

1228160921028528-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Please make sure our people are okay in $map:02020031$.

108163521028990-Kritias_2018_12-.name: The robot soldiers were giving them some trouble, but they're fine.

108163521028991-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I'm glad to hear it, but then what's with the radio silence? How strange...

1228160921028533-Kritias_2018_12-.name: As our people explore Kritias, they hear all kinds of rumors. Intriguing rumors.

108165221028992-Kritias_2018_12-.name: For example, there's supposedly a machine in $map:02020034$. If you use the machine, a shiny ring appears in the sky.

110191221029059-Kritias_2018_12-.name: It's a little ridiculous, isn't it? But I can't stop thinking about it! Could you go there and find the machine? And if a ring actually does appear, use a flying mount to go through it.

108165221028993-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I can't wait to hear your report!

1228160921028534-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Please look into the rumor about $map:02020034$!

1228160921028535-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Well? Did a shiny ring appear in the sky?

108165221028995-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Huh. This place keeps surprising me. I can't wait to research this strange phenomenon for myself!

1228160921028536-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Are you ready to hear the latest rumor from my field researchers?

108165221028996-Kritias_2018_12-.name: My agents in $map:02020016$ say that there's a machine that makes the flowers bloom.

110191221029060-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Ah, $npcName:11004315$—I thought you were a technophile, but heart, you're still a Green Hood. Shall we grow a garden in the outpost for you?

108165221028997-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I'm more than a little curious, myself. Please see if there's any truth to these rumors about $map:02020016$!

110191221029061-Kritias_2018_12-.name: ...I suddenly feel as though I'm being ignored.

1228160921028537-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Please look into the rumor about $map:02020016$!

1228160921028538-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Did the machine actually exist? No way, right?

108165221028998-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Not only was it there, but a treasure chest appeared when I used it.

108165221028999-Kritias_2018_12-.name: How can that be? Is it science? Or magic...?

1228160921028539-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Our soldiers at the $map:02020032$ have passed along a strange rumor. They say that adventurers keep hanging out around the binoculars, then running off at full speed.

108173221029000-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Is it a new jogging craze? I have no idea.

108173221029001-Kritias_2018_12-.name: The vanguard captain also wants to know what's going on. Could you go to the $map:02020032$ and find out?

1228160921028540-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Please go to $map:02020032$ and find out.

1228160921028541-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Did you find out why the adventurers are running? There must be a reason... right?

108173221029002-Kritias_2018_12-.name: There sure is, but I'm not telling you!

1228160921028542-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Today's rumor of Kritias is about $map:02020014$.

108173221029004-Kritias_2018_12-.name: They say there's a device in $map:02020014$ that makes platforms appear in the air.

110191221029062-Kritias_2018_12-.name: It sounds like something out of a fantasy novel! How can I resist a rumor like that?

1228160921028543-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Please go to $map:02020014$ and check out the rumor!

1228160921028544-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Was the rumor true? Did platforms actually appear in the air?

108173221029007-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Wow! How is that possible? I'll have to look into it for myself.

1228160921028545-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Today's rumor of Kritias is about $map:02020017$.

108173221029008-Kritias_2018_12-.name: There's another device that summons shiny rings in the sky. I wonder if it's the same kind of device as before.

108173221029009-Kritias_2018_12-.name: What are these devices for? I want you to find out.

1228160921028546-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Please go to $map:02020017$ and check out the rumor!

1228160921028547-Kritias_2018_12-.name: So? Was it the same ring? A different ring?

108173221029011-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Hm... There must be a pattern to this. Time to run a simulation!

1228160921028548-Kritias_2018_12-.name: You know those strange floating platforms from before?

108173221029013-Kritias_2018_12-.name: There's no time to waste. We have to see this with our own eyes. Er, with your own eyes!

1228160921028549-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Please go to $map:02020018$ and check out the rumor!

111180821029065-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Yes. There was a chest at the top, too.

108173221029014-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I'll get to the bottom of this someday. They must serve some special purpose!

1228160921028551-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Do you remember that shiny sky ring we heard a rumor about?

108193421029015-Kritias_2018_12-.name: One of our scouts spotted one in $map:02020035$.

108193421029016-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Unfortunately, he wasn't able to go after it. But I bet you could!

1228160921028552-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Please go to $map:02020035$ and check out the rumor!

1228160921028553-Kritias_2018_12-.name: So what happened when you went through the ring?

108193421029017-Kritias_2018_12-.name: There was a chest at the end.

108193421029018-Kritias_2018_12-.name: My hypothesis wasn't wrong! A little more evidence, and I could have a full-blown theory on my hand!

1228160921028554-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Say, do you remember that giant $npcName:11004342[gender:0]$ from the rumor a while ago?

108193421029020-Kritias_2018_12-.name: We found another one in $map:02020009$. I don't know what it's guarding, but I feel kind of bad for it. It must be so bored, standing in place all day!

110191221029063-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Ah yes, the Green Hoods: friends and protectors to the bored and lonely.

110191221029064-Kritias_2018_12-.name: ...Can no one else hear me? Have I become a ghost?

1228160921028555-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Please give freedom to the $npcName:11004342[gender:0]$ in $map:02020009$.

108193421029023-Kritias_2018_12-.name: That's good. I know I'd get depressed if I had to stand in one place all day, every day.

1228160921028557-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Do you remember that weird machine? The one that made the flowers blossom?

108193421029024-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Another one was spotted in $map:02020008$! I'll figure out how it works this time for sure!

108193421029025-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Please go to $map:02020008$ and uncover the secret of the device!

1228160921028558-Kritias_2018_12-.name: Please go to $map:02020008$ and uncover the secret of the device!

1228160921028559-Kritias_2018_12-.name: I feel like I've been waiting all day! What happened when you used the device?

108193421029026-Kritias_2018_12-.name: A chest appeared. That was cool.

108193421029027-Kritias_2018_12-.name: That's all? There must be more! Go back there right now!

111180821029066-Kritias_2018_12-.name: $npcName:11004437[gender:1]$, it won't do to lose your temper. Where's your cool objectivity as a scientist?

111180821029068-Kritias_2018_12-.name: ...I'll take my leave now. $MyPCName$, I suggest you do the same.

627165304000753-Striker-.name: There were some gold bars that were misplaced during transportation, so the boss dispatched a team to retrieve them. Long story short, the residents of $map:02000138$ were awful keen on keeping the boss's gold, and surprise, surprise, they got hurt.

627165304000754-Striker-.name: Then some $male:guy,female:lady$ shows up out of nowhere and roughs up our men real good. So the boss decides to make an example of $map:02000138$ and this "Gray Wolf" protecting the town. He sends more than a hundred guys to teach that do-gooder a lesson $male:he'd,female:she'd$ never forget.

627165304000756-Striker-.name: And here's the craziest part of the story! They say you sent the lot of them—some 100 men—straight to the hospital! And supposedly the whole fight was over in an hour?! Ridiculous, right?

627165304000758-Striker-.name: Right? I knew it was a load of bull.

628000304000760-Striker-.name:
<font color="#909090">($npc:11001545[gender:0]$ shakes his head and mutters.)</font>
I don't believe it... There's no way that's $male:him,female:her$.

702183804000763-Striker-.name:
Don't kid yourself about being a big shot here just because you were a big fish in $map:02000100$.
You're gonna need more than that if you want to make it here!

702183804000764-Striker-.name:
I've just received an order from the boss to help you get stronger.
It's almost as if he doesn't think you have the stuff.
I've got some important info to share, so listen closely!

702183804000765-Striker-.name:
Those with real power train without getting full of themselves.
I'm going to show you how to get stronger.
And you're going to do it by <font color="#ffd200">upgrading your skills</font>!

702183804000766-Striker-.name:
You need materials to <font color="#ffd200">upgrade skills</font>, and <font color="#ffd200">$item:40100001$</font> is the most basic material there is.
The material type and amount required for upgrading varies by skill.

702183804000767-Striker-.name:
You can get <font color="#ffd200">$item:40100001$</font> from merchants, which are easy to find.
Finding other materials, however, won't be so easy.
I've heard you can occasionally get them by defeating <font color="#ffd200">powerful monsters</font>.

702183804000768-Striker-.name:
Here's a <font color="#ffd200">$item:40100001$</font>. Open the skill window and use it to upgrade a skill!
Look for a <font color="#ffd200">General Store</font> if you need more materials!

702183804000769-Striker-.name:
Feel like all this dust is damaging my lungs...
Should quickly finish the talk and go get some fresh air.

702183804000770-Striker-.name:
Diligently upgrading your skills?
Boss must think your skills are lame,
because he told me to show you how to get stronger.

702183804000771-Striker-.name:
In order to upgrade the skill above the average level,
you will not only need $item:40100001$, but also <font color="#ffd200">a special crystal</font>.

702183804000772-Striker-.name:
It is similar to <font color="#ffd200">$item:40100002$</font> or <font color="#ffd200">$item:40100003$</font>, but it is not easy to find.
It can only be earned by <font color="#ffd200">defeating elite or boss monsters</font>.

702183804000773-Striker-.name: First, I will give you <font color="#ffd200">$item:40100002$</font>, so use it to <font color="#ffd200">upgrade active skills</font>.

727164304000920-SoulBinder-.name:
$MyPCName$!  
You know that <font color="#ffd200">Brother $npcName:11001716$</font> hates those who are lazy, right?
That's why I called you. Although it's a bit cumbersome, I'm sure I'll get in trouble if I don't take care of you…

727164304000921-SoulBinder-.name:
Knowing this will help you get even stronger!
It's very important, so listen carefully!

727164304000922-SoulBinder-.name:
Have you heard about <font color="#ffd200">skill upgrades</font>?
It makes the skills you can use even more powerful.
This means that the same skill can be even more effective!

727164304000923-SoulBinder-.name:
You need materials to <font color="#ffd200">upgrade skills</font>, and <font color="#ffd200">$item:40100001$</font> is the most basic material you can use.
The type of material and the amount you need to upgrade varies by skill.

727164304000924-SoulBinder-.name:
You can get <font color="#ffd200">$item:40100001$</font> from merchants, so they're relatively easy to find.
But it's not so easy to find out where to get the other materials.
Rumors say that they are sometimes dropped after defeating <font color="#ffd200">powerful monsters</font>.

727164304000925-SoulBinder-.name:
Here's a <font color="#ffd200">$item:40100001$</font>. Open the skill window and use it to upgrade a skill!
Look for a <font color="#ffd200">General Store</font> if you need more materials!

727164304000926-SoulBinder-.name:
Tired from all the investigating?
Just remember, you can't be lazy with your work. Brother $npcName:11001716$ is always watching.
He seems to keep track of our every breath. Maybe he's clairvoyant...

727164304000927-SoulBinder-.name:
Brother $npcName:11001716$ said that you, $MyPCName$, have to get better at reconnaissance, scouting, mission planning...
As a result, he told me how you could get even stronger.
And although he looks like he only cares about the mission, there is a gentler side to him.

727164304000928-SoulBinder-.name:
In order to upgrade the skill above the average level,
you will not only need $item:40100001$, but also <font color="#ffd200">a special crystal</font>.

727164304000929-SoulBinder-.name:
It's similar to <font color="#ffd200">$item:40100002$</font> or <font color="#ffd200">$item:40100003$,$item:40100021$</font>, but it is difficult to find.
It can only be earned by <font color="#ffd200">defeating an elite or boss monster</font>.

727164304000930-SoulBinder-.name: First, I will give you <font color="#ffd200">$item:40100002$</font>, so use it for an <font color="#ffd200">active skill upgrade</font>.

1023200804000939-ContentsGuide01-.name: Oh my, another customer! I'm surprised you found your way to this little island.

1115231204001087-ContentsGuide01-.name: There's no better way to relax than to cast your line while drinking in the scent of the ocean... Anyhow, welcome. Seems like this is your first time around here. Allow me to give you this fishing rod as a gift. It may be a little worn in, but it'll reel them in fine!

1115231204001088-ContentsGuide01-.name: So many fish biting today, all you've gotta do is cast your line. What are you waiting for? Get that line in some water!

1023200804000940-ContentsGuide01-.name: What's wrong? Are the fish not biting?

1115231204001089-ContentsGuide01-.name: I don't own a fishing pole.

1115231204001090-ContentsGuide01-.name: I'm just stopping to take a breather.

1115231204001091-ContentsGuide01-.name: Listen $male:friend,female:little lady$, I like you plenty, but I'm not exactly swimming in spare gear over here. If you really don't got any fishing tackle, I'd be happy to sell you some.

1115231204001092-ContentsGuide01-.name: Ah, I see. Can't say I blame you! Heck of a sight, isn't it? Stay as long as you like.

1023200804000941-ContentsGuide01-.name: Well, what do you think? Satisfying, isn't it?

1115231204001093-ContentsGuide01-.name: Say that you do not have the <font color="#ffd200">$item:20000342$</font> bait.

1115231204001094-ContentsGuide01-.name: Say that you are just resting for a bit.

1115231204001097-ContentsGuide01-.name: Say that you do not have a fishing pole.

1115231204001098-ContentsGuide01-.name: Say that you are just resting for a bit.

1115231204001101-ContentsGuide01-.name: Say that you do not have a new fishing pole.

1115231204001102-ContentsGuide01-.name: Say that you are just resting for a bit.

1023200804000951-ContentsGuide01-.name: Hm... I just can't figure it out...

1115231204001106-ContentsGuide01-.name:
Is something wrong...? Take a look around.
Can't you see the murky water full of algae?
Some time ago, the water started to become polluted. Now it's all that way. Sigh...

1115231204001107-ContentsGuide01-.name:
Since then, the number of fishermen who visit the area has noticeably decreased...
I was also debating whether to leave or not. That's when... 
I saw a peculiar thing in the muddy water that I have never seen before.

1115231204001108-ContentsGuide01-.name:
I'm still here because a part of me is determined to catch that peculiar thing
and find out what exactly it is.
Aren't you curious as well? What could it be...
Won't you try and catch it with me?

1023200804000952-ContentsGuide01-.name: Why are you standing there like that?

1115231204001109-ContentsGuide01-.name: I don't have any fishing stuff.

1115231204001110-ContentsGuide01-.name: I'm just resting for a bit.

1115231204001111-ContentsGuide01-.name:
Yeah? Is that so?
I didn't pick my money off a tree, so I can't give you another one for free...
But if you need one, you can purchase it at production cost. Heh...

1115231204001112-ContentsGuide01-.name:
The place isn't even worth looking at anymore...
Just go and fish.

1023200804000953-ContentsGuide01-.name:
A <font color="#ffd200">Shrubberpuff</font>?
What a strange looking thing... I wonder if it always looked like this.

1115231204001115-ContentsGuide01-.name:
Uhhh...  How are you speaking so calmly about what just happened?
A volcano exploded and we barely escaped with our lives!
Are you so in shock that you don't have a sense of the situation?

1115231204001116-ContentsGuide01-.name: Yeah, I'm pretty used to this kinda thing.

1115231204001117-ContentsGuide01-.name: <font color="#909090">(Takes a look around.)</font> Ask if this is heaven.

1115231204001118-ContentsGuide01-.name:
Huh... Seems like you're not a normal fisherman...
The lava was overflowing when the volcano exploded and you didn't even blink...

1115231204001120-ContentsGuide01-.name:
Haha... Well, you are...
<font color="#909090">(Appears shocked while looking towards the lava canal.)</font> What… What is that!

1115231204001122-ContentsGuide01-.name:
J-Just now... Something came out of the lava and went back in!
Here... There is something in here as well!

1115231204001123-ContentsGuide01-.name:
Look here, <font color="#ffd200">$MyPCName$</font>!
Look and see what's inside the lava! ...Yeah?

1115231204001124-ContentsGuide01-.name:
I am fine.
What about you? Are you okay?

1115231204001125-ContentsGuide01-.name: Yeah, I'm pretty used to this kinda thing.

1115231204001126-ContentsGuide01-.name:
<font color="#909090">(Shakes head left and right.)</font> You must have experienced a lot of shock...
<font color="#909090">(Appears shocked while looking towards the lava canal.)</font> Huh…? W-What is that!

1023200804000955-ContentsGuide01-.name:
What's wrong? 
Worried the volcano will erupt again?

1115231204001128-ContentsGuide01-.name: I don't have any fishing stuff.

1115231204001129-ContentsGuide01-.name: Respond by saying you're the type of person who would bathe in lava if you had to.

1115231204001130-ContentsGuide01-.name:
Is that so? 
Well I didn't pick my money from a tree, so I can't give you another one for free...
Luckily I was holding some of my equipment and therefore can spare a few to sell.
You're free to purchase some from me.

1115231204001131-ContentsGuide01-.name:
Sigh... I didn't imagine you as a bluffer.
Stop blabbing. If you aren't afraid, hurry and cast your fishing pole!

1023200804000956-ContentsGuide01-.name:
What... What's this! 
How hideous! A flaming fish... My goodness!

1115231204001132-ContentsGuide01-.name:
Let us hurry out of here!
We should get to an expert and ask about this enormous thing!

1023200804000957-ContentsGuide01-.name:
<font color="#909090">(He looks you up and down.)</font>
Hmm? Are you here for the audition?

1116171904001133-ContentsGuide01-.name: I'd like to learn how to play an instrument.

1116171904001134-ContentsGuide01-.name: Sorry, but class is not in session. These are the auditions for the Moonlight Ensemble, which will be performing soon.

1116171904001135-ContentsGuide01-.name: Okay. I'm here for that, then.

1116171904001136-ContentsGuide01-.name:
<font color="#909090">(He strokes his chin and ponders silently, looking worried.)</font> 
Hmm... Well... Do you have any experience? Music isn't something someone can teach you with just a few words.

1116171904001137-ContentsGuide01-.name: Don't look so disappointed... I'll loan you this instrument and music sheet to experiment with. You can practice on your own time.

1023200804000958-ContentsGuide01-.name: Ah... Did you want to ask me something?

1116171904001138-ContentsGuide01-.name: I don't have what I need to play.

1116171904001139-ContentsGuide01-.name: I want to play in the Ensemble!

1116171904001140-ContentsGuide01-.name: I thought I'd given you everything you might need, but it seems not. Oh well. You can always buy instruments and scores from $npcName:11001865[gender:0]$.

1116171904001141-ContentsGuide01-.name: You will perform in the Moonlight Ensemble when I say you are ready, and not a moment sooner! Ah... Ahem. Excuse me. What I meant to say was... Keep practicing, and you will be on the stage in no time!

1023200804000959-ContentsGuide01-.name: You're a little rough around the edges... But I'll be darned if there isn't a spark in you... What did you say your name was?

1116171904001143-ContentsGuide01-.name: $MyPCName$...? I'll remember that. If you give it all you've got, eat your veggies, and practice every day, I think you just might have what it takes.

1023200804000960-ContentsGuide01-.name: Have you been practicing your instrument?

1116171904001144-ContentsGuide01-.name: Boast that others may lose their hearing due to your tremendous skill.

1116171904001145-ContentsGuide01-.name: Say that performing isn't very fun.

1116171904001146-ContentsGuide01-.name:
Ha hah! Your confidence is overflowing!
It's good to see you're enjoying music.
Have you considered trying a different instrument?
I will give an instrument as a gift.

1116171904001147-ContentsGuide01-.name:
Oh my...
It would be such a waste of your natural talent to give up like this... Hmm...
Have you considered trying a different instrument? I'll give you one as a gift.

1023200804000961-ContentsGuide01-.name: Ah... Did you have any questions...?

1116171904001148-ContentsGuide01-.name: Say that you want to perform, but you don't have the tools.

1116171904001149-ContentsGuide01-.name: Say that you want to participate in the ensemble.

1116171904001150-ContentsGuide01-.name:
Ah... Is that so?
Actually, $npc:11001865$ has come to sell new products to the people auditioning. 
Go and purchase the instrument and music score you need.

1116171904001151-ContentsGuide01-.name:
Ah... Is that so?
There is still plenty of time before the ensemble performance, so it isn't impossible if you start practicing right away.
Put in the effort, and you can accomplish anything.

1023200804000962-ContentsGuide01-.name:
Of course... You're a natural, just as expected.
I hope you don't let your musical talents go to waste!

1116171904001153-ContentsGuide01-.name:
Right now it's time for the <font color="#ffd200">Moonlight Ensemble</font> to begin...
But we can't seem to get in contact with our piano player.

1116171904001154-ContentsGuide01-.name: Ask when the ensemble audition was.

1116171904001155-ContentsGuide01-.name:
It was a few days ago... Did you not hear about it?
When you didn't show up I was disappointed. I thought that you, <font color="#ffd200">$MyPCName$</font>,
had lost interest in performing... Woe was me...

1116171904001156-ContentsGuide01-.name:
<font color="#909090">(Realizes something...)</font> 
Ah! Of course!
If you had participated in the audition, the piano performance would have been yours!
There is no one who compares to your level of talent!

1116171904001157-ContentsGuide01-.name:
<font color="#ffd200">$MyPCName$</font>!
Please play the piano for the ensemble.
Though it is a new piece...with your talent, I'm sure you will be able to perform it amazingly!

1023200804000964-ContentsGuide01-.name:
<font color="#ffd200">$MyPCName$</font>!
Please play the piano for this ensemble.
Though it's a new piece, with your talent I'm sure you can perform it amazingly!

1023200804000965-ContentsGuide01-.name:
Bravo! Bravo!
That was an amazing performance!

1116171904001158-ContentsGuide01-.name:
I only heard the news just after the performance started.
The piano player had a severe stomachache and couldn't make it.

1116171904001159-ContentsGuide01-.name:
Anyways, thanks to $MyPCName$, the performance was a success.
The next time there is an ensemble, earn your way in through an audition.
I'm sure I'll see you soon!

1023200804000966-ContentsGuide01-.name: Judging from those clothes, you've obviously never been here before. Welcome. I'm sure we've got something to elevate your fashion.

1117023004001160-ContentsGuide01-.name: I don't see anything that's really "me" here.

1117023004001161-ContentsGuide01-.name: There's no accounting for taste. Have you any idea how much love and care goes into each of my pieces?

1117023004001162-ContentsGuide01-.name: I bet I could do better!

1117023004001163-ContentsGuide01-.name:
<font color="#909090">(She scoffs at you.)</font>
Is that confidence I hear? Or arrogance? Fine, I'll humor you. There's nothing I enjoy more than watching the fashion-impaired make fools of themselves.

1023200804000967-ContentsGuide01-.name: You simply can't design anything without a fashion template. If you're determined to embarrass yourself, you can buy one at the workshop. You know, the little button on the bottom-right corner of your screen?

1023200804000968-ContentsGuide01-.name:
<font color="#909090">(For the briefest moment, her eyes widen.)</font>
That... Hm. That isn't half-bad.

1023200804000969-ContentsGuide01-.name: This design looks perfectly adequate... at a glance. But how does it hang off the body? Does it even fit you properly? No, no, the true test of a designer is on the runway. Put this on and I will show you what I mean.

1023200804000970-ContentsGuide01-.name: Have you lost your nerve? Very well. I shall accept your defeat.

1023200804000971-ContentsGuide01-.name: Well... It fit you... because you're the one who made it. That's the only reason that outfit looks even half-passable on you.

1023200804000972-ContentsGuide01-.name: You insist on playing at fashion design? Fine. Even I have to admit that you have some small, small kernel of talent.

1117023004001164-ContentsGuide01-.name: Allow me to introduce you to the League of Fashionistas. But first, I insist that you take a new profile picture to show off your outfit. We don't want to make a bad first impression, now, do we?

1023200804000973-ContentsGuide01-.name: Allow me to introduce you to the League of Fashionistas. But first, I insist that you take a new profile picture to show off your new outfit. We don't want to make a bad first impression, now, do we?

1023200804000974-ContentsGuide01-.name: Ha. You look better in photographs than you do in real life. Perhaps... perhaps we could work together, after all.

1023200804000981-ContentsGuide01-.name: Hey! It's $MyPCName$! Don't say a word, you beautiful dummy. I know exactly what you're here for.

1117023004001166-ContentsGuide01-.name: There's no need to get flustered. I'll teach you the basics. First, take these materials. Let's try making something simple!

1023200804000982-ContentsGuide01-.name: What was what? Is there a problem?

1117023004001168-ContentsGuide01-.name: What's the deal with this place?

1117023004001169-ContentsGuide01-.name: What!? How could you lose them? Did you think because I gave them to you for free, that they were worthless, and safe to throw out? Well I've got news for you, $male:mister,female:lady$. From now on, you're paying for your own materials.

1117023004001170-ContentsGuide01-.name: Hmm? You don't know? It's a handicraft workshop. Aren't you here to learn how to handicraft?

1117023004001171-ContentsGuide01-.name: Actually, I was just sort of wandering around.

1117023004001172-ContentsGuide01-.name: What? (Her eyebrow twitches with subdued rage.)

1117023004001173-ContentsGuide01-.name:
<font color="#909090">(She clears her throat, then smiles.)</font>
No matter! What's important is that you are here. What you learn today will be just as useful tomorrow.

1023200804000983-ContentsGuide01-.name: A ring! Wow! You shouldn't have. I think you deserve another lesson.

1023200804000984-ContentsGuide01-.name: Your timing is perfect. I could use a hand!

1117023004001176-ContentsGuide01-.name: I came to gather materials for a special order that just came into the shop. I have no problem getting my hands dirty, but I can only mine so much on my own!

1117023004001177-ContentsGuide01-.name: There's a material found primarily here in $map:63000046$ known as $item:33000023$. I need a lot of it. How would you like to help me mine them? You'll be rewarded, of course.

1023200804000985-ContentsGuide01-.name: There's a material found primarily here in $map:63000046$ known as $itemPlural:33000023$. I need a large number of them. How would you like to help me mine them? You'll be rewarded, of course.

1023200804000986-ContentsGuide01-.name: Thank you so much for your help! You should swing by the workshop again some time. I'll teach you all about handicrafting!

1023200804000990-ContentsGuide01-.name: Oh my! Where has the time gone? $MyPCName$, I'd love to teach you more of my wondrous handicraft techniques... But I'm afraid I have an appointment to make.

1117023004001179-ContentsGuide01-.name: My older sister is a famous blacksmith at $map:02000203$. I was on my way to ask her to enchant one of my items when you stopped by...

1023200804000991-ContentsGuide01-.name: Hey, this is a great chance for you to try enchanting something. I could sell you something to enchant, if you want!

1023200804000992-ContentsGuide01-.name: Well? What do you think? It's only been enchanted once, but it looks good, right?

1023200804000993-ContentsGuide01-.name: Anyway, we can't stop here. Let's enchant something else!

1023200804000994-ContentsGuide01-.name: Anyway, we can't stop here. Let's enchant something else!

1023200804000995-ContentsGuide01-.name: Not bad, huh? You know, this place isn't half bad. I should move the forge here! Ha!

1117023004001180-ContentsGuide01-.name: Ask the reason for being here.

1117023004001181-ContentsGuide01-.name:
Why, what other reason do I have to leave the workshop and come here?
I'm here to grab reforging materials, of course.
This time I came to get a special material needed to decorate a piece of my own handiwork.

1117023004001182-ContentsGuide01-.name:
$map:63000046$ isn't very big; however, geographically, there is a variety of soil.
In $map:02000076$ it can be difficult to purchase materials only found in <font color="#ffd200">deep forests like $map:02000023$</font> 
and <font color="#ffd200">beaches like $map:02000062$</font>. Even for a premium…

1117023004001183-ContentsGuide01-.name:
Luckily, although there isn't much variety here, 
you can purchase materials that can't be easily found in the $map:02000076$ meadow.
<font color="#ffd200">$MyPCName$</font>, won't you help me find the materials? At least for the sake of experience?

1023200804000997-ContentsGuide01-.name:
If you go <font color="#ffd200">downward</font>, you''ll come across a <font color="#ffd200">small forest</font> containing a mysterious energy. Further down you'll find a <font color="#ffd200">cozy little beach</font>.
Will you collect <font color="#ffd200">$item:33000024$</font> in the forest and <font color="#ffd200">$item:33000025$</font> on the beach for me?

1023200804000998-ContentsGuide01-.name:
Wow! Thank you very much. 
You have helped me countless times...

1023200804000999-ContentsGuide01-.name:
Hmm... I can't leave the workshop empty for so long. 
That would be quite a problem.

1117023004001184-ContentsGuide01-.name: Ask if there is any reason to not return to the workshop.

1117023004001185-ContentsGuide01-.name:
The thing is...I have received more reforging orders than I can handle. I do not have enough materials.
To meet the requests, I'll need to gather a lot more materials, and quickly.
<font color="#ffd200">$MyPCName$</font>, think you have it in you to help me again?

1023200804001000-ContentsGuide01-.name:
The thing is...I have received more reforging orders than I can handle. I do not have enough materials.
To meet the requests, I'll need to gather a lot more materials, and quickly.
<font color="#ffd200">$MyPCName$</font>, think you have it in you to help me again?

1023200804001001-ContentsGuide01-.name:
Is it too difficult?

1023200804001002-ContentsGuide01-.name:
This won't do.

1023200804001003-ContentsGuide01-.name:

1023200804001004-ContentsGuide01-.name:
Huhuh. Look here, young friend!
Be careful, for there is cow poop scattered about like landmines. Huhuhuh.

1023200804001005-ContentsGuide01-.name:
Okay, young friend.
What is the reason you have passed through the cow poop to be here?

1117023004001187-ContentsGuide01-.name:
Haha, what's there to do?
There aren't any left... Our only choice is to make more...

1117023004001188-ContentsGuide01-.name: Say that materials will need gathered before they can be made.

1117023004001189-ContentsGuide01-.name:
Hmm, so materials need to be gathered...
See the cows at that barn? Go and bring back a few <font color="#ffd200">$item:33000041$</font>.

1023200804001006-ContentsGuide01-.name:
Hmm, if that's the case materials need to be gathered.
See the cows at that barn? Go and bring back a few <font color="#ffd200">$item:33000041$</font>.
If you have raised livestock at your home before, you will find this to be similar.

1023200804001007-ContentsGuide01-.name:
Not that difficult, huh?

1117023004001196-ContentsGuide01-.name:
Wow! <font color="#ffd200">$MyPCName$</font>, you're the best!

1110111004001056-ContentsGuide01-.name: Listen, I'd drive it myself if I could... But let's face it, I'm old. I could break a hip if I fall out of bed. To think what the G-force of speeding down the raceway would do to my bones... All I can picture is a crushed bag of chips.

1110111004001057-ContentsGuide01-.name: What do you say, kiddo? Won't you test my magnificent, high-tech super-engine? 1110111004001058-ContentsGuide01-.name:
<font color="#909090">(He sighs.)</font>

1110111004001059-ContentsGuide01-.name: Listen, I'd drive it myself if I could... But let's face it, I'm old. I could break a hip if I fall out of bed. To think what the G-force of speeding down the raceway would do to my bones... All I can picture is a crushed bag of chips.

1110111004001061-ContentsGuide01-.name: Don't get mad but I, uhh, lost your car...

1110111004001062-ContentsGuide01-.name: Don't worry, pops. I've got this race in the bag.

1110111004001063-ContentsGuide01-.name: Y-you... lost my car!? Do you have ANY idea how many hours, how many mesos I spent...

1110111004001064-ContentsGuide01-.name: There's the research and development costs, my assistant's monthly salary, hush money for my previous assistant's family... I'm not made of mesos, you know! The best I can do is sell you a new car at cost. If you're interested, perhaps we can make a trade.

1110111004001065-ContentsGuide01-.name: Excellent! And if you manage to adequately test the performance of my engine, you can keep that prototype super-car. How do you like them apples?

1023200804001016-ContentsGuide01-.name: Hahaha, yes! The car made it through the lap without so much as a mild explosion! Well, what do you think? How did it feel to be speeding along, listening to the roar of the engine with the wind whipping through your hair?

1110111004001067-ContentsGuide01-.name: To be honest, I've driven more impressive super-cars.

1110111004001068-ContentsGuide01-.name: It seems the reactor is stable after all. I'd like you to keep the prototype as thanks for your help. You shouldn't need to swap fuel rods for the next century or so. They're a bit radioactive, but, uhh... you weren't planning on procreating, right?

1110111004001069-ContentsGuide01-.name:
R-really? To fail after having worked so hard... Alas... I suppose there's no point in returning the car...
<font color="#909090">(He lowers his head in disappointment.)</font>

1023200804001017-ContentsGuide01-.name: Hm? Oh goodness, it's you! You're the young adventurer who helped me stress-test my race car super-engine before!

1110133904001072-ContentsGuide01-.name: What a pleasant surprise! Are you still driving that car I gave you?

1110133904001074-ContentsGuide01-.name: Actually, I've moved on to shinier, fancier vehicles.

1110133904001075-ContentsGuide01-.name: Oh, is that so? Still cruising around with your wheels on the ground, eh? Hahaha... Well then, you've come at the perfect time! What would you say to the chance to rule the skies?

1110133904001076-ContentsGuide01-.name: Pending the results of a lawsuit, I've taken a break from my engine research and started looking into making flight more accessible to all. This is my first invention, a $item:40400001$. I believe I've perfectly counterbalanced the balloons for your weight, so you should be able to soar the skies without getting lost in the stratosphere. Give it a try!

1110133904001077-ContentsGuide01-.name: Ah, is that so? Already on to a new and exciting mode of transport? Hahaha... Well, what would you say if I offered you an opportunity to slip the surly bonds of the earth entirely? Oh no, not death... I mean flight of course!

1110133904001078-ContentsGuide01-.name: Pending the results of a lawsuit, I've taken a break from my engine research and started looking into making flight more accessible to all. 1023200804001018-ContentsGuide01-.name: All you have to do is grab on tight to this balloon, and you'll float away! Follow the rainbow and fly to that other building way over there.

1110133904001079-ContentsGuide01-.name: Hey, uhh... That wasn't the only balloon you made, right?

1110133904001080-ContentsGuide01-.name: Do you have something else I can fly in?

1110133904001081-ContentsGuide01-.name: Well of course I made more than one, any good scienti— Hey, wait a second! Did you lose my balloon? Sigh... Well, there's no use being angry. You can purchase another from $npcName:11001875[gender:1]$ for a marginal fee.

1110133904001082-ContentsGuide01-.name: Err... Well, I came here to test my $item:40400001$</font>, which is why I gave it to you... But ultimately you can fly with whatever vehicle strikes your fancy. Just look at the other people flying around the rainbow.

1023200804001019-ContentsGuide01-.name: Ahhh... Was this your first time flying?

1110133904001085-ContentsGuide01-.name: Well, you've demonstrated marvelous control... You're a natural aviator! I'll report the results of the test to Doctor $npcName:11001873[gender:0]$.
