1110133904001086-ContentsGuide01-.name: It shows! I'll tell $npcName:11001873[gender:0]$ how the test went. Feel free to keep that $item:40400001$. Really they're just store-bought balloons filled with an experimental gas.

1023200804001020-ContentsGuide01-.name: Ah! Perfect timing. As a complimentary service, Goldus Real Estate is providing our customers with interior design assistance.

1219155104001209-ContentsGuide01-.name: One of my dearest, trendiest friends will be coming by to help you with your interior design. I trust you'll give him a warm welcome.

207142004001223-ContentsGuide01-.name: And here he is. I'm going to head back to the office... Good luck to the both of you!

207142004001224-ContentsGuide01-.name: Hello there. $npc:11001876[gender:0]$'s the name, and interior design's my game! I'm here to help you make your house look amazing.

207142004001225-ContentsGuide01-.name: Hm... Let's start with the basics, and take it step-by-step.

1023200804001021-ContentsGuide01-.name: If you head over to your home now, you'll discover one of our associates waiting eagerly to tutor you in the basics of interior design.

1023200804001022-ContentsGuide01-.name: Ah, very nice. You may just have an eye for this.

1117155004001199-ContentsGuide01-.name: Hmm... There must be a furnishing better suited to your home's aesthetic. Shall we pick one out together?

1023200804001025-ContentsGuide01-.name: Hmm… The vibe in here is definitely improving. I have to hand it to you, you do seem to have a sense for interior decorating.

1117155004001200-ContentsGuide01-.name: You can change the feel of a home drastically with the right furniture. Work hard to make your house a place you can be proud of!

1023200804001027-ContentsGuide01-.name: I'd like to give you a gift. It's a $item:50200299$. It's got a very practical and clean design, a nice starter-bed. Why don't you place it somewhere? It would really class up the place.

1023200804001028-ContentsGuide01-.name: It's easy to tell a neglectful homeowner from a caring one by the care $male:he,female:she$ puts into decorating. There are certain furnishings which are especially good indicators of this, and thus, increase your home's decoration score. Take that $item:50200299$, for example.

1121193504001205-ContentsGuide01-.name: You may have noticed that the moment you placed $item:50200299$, your decoration score increased. Your decoration score is a representation of how any tasteful observer would assess your home.

1117155004001201-ContentsGuide01-.name: Decorate your home however you wish, but if you have any interest in maintaining a sensibly arranged home, you should pay attention to your decoration score.

1023200804001029-ContentsGuide01-.name: The atmosphere in here is all off. I know! How about a new table and sofa?

1023200804001030-ContentsGuide01-.name: This room... It's just not working.

1023200804001031-ContentsGuide01-.name: Swapping out a piece of furniture here and there can drastically change the ambiance of a home. It's far easier than changing the wallpaper, and just as satisfying.

1117155004001202-ContentsGuide01-.name: I have to admit, you're not half bad. Perhaps you don't need my help after all. Well, I'll be off then.

1023200804001032-ContentsGuide01-.name: Ah, hello...? Is anyone home? I brought over a little housewarming present. This cuddly little chickie is yours to raise.

1219160104001210-ContentsGuide01-.name: A little young to own a home aren't you? I like it! It shows forward thinking and dedication.

1219160104001211-ContentsGuide01-.name: My name's $npcName:11001877$ and I run the farm up the way. I was passing by when I couldn't help but peep through your windows and notice how empty your house looked! So, I thought I'd do the neighborly thing and bring you a housewarming gift. It's a chicken!

1219160104001212-ContentsGuide01-.name: Here, take it. If I had my way, there'd be a hen in every home! Really makes the place feel cozy. I hope you'll look after it.

1023200804001033-ContentsGuide01-.name: Here, take it. If I had my way, there'd be a hen in every home! Really makes the place feel cozy. I hope you'll look after it.

1023200804001034-ContentsGuide01-.name: I raised that there little gal ever since she hatched from her egg. Take good care of her!

1023200804001038-ContentsGuide01-.name: Look! The little chickie has something for you!

1023200804001039-ContentsGuide01-.name: Look! The little chickie has something for you!

1023200804001040-ContentsGuide01-.name: Hahahaha... What do you think? Caring for livestock is a lot of work, but it's worth it in the end.

1117155004001203-ContentsGuide01-.name: Take good care of that little birdie. And don't worry... I'll let myself in once in a while and see that she's fed and looked after. Well, see you next time!

1023200804001041-ContentsGuide01-.name:
Hey! Have you been well? The livestock is doing well?
Oh... The animal smell is too strong at the house, huh?

1023200804001042-ContentsGuide01-.name:
Hey! Have you been well?
The livestock is doing well too, you say?

1023200804001043-ContentsGuide01-.name:
They are a bit slow, and therefore more calm and quiet...
They are also low-maintenance, which makes them easier to raise. Good luck!

1023200804001047-ContentsGuide01-.name:

1023200804001048-ContentsGuide01-.name:
Have you been well? I have something great to pass on to you!

1023200804001049-ContentsGuide01-.name:
Wow! Your workmanship is excellent! Ha!

1023200804001051-ContentsGuide01-.name:

1023200804001052-ContentsGuide01-.name:

106154704001213-ContentsGuide01-.name: Greetings! Welcome to the Guild Registry HQ. I'm the chairwoman of the registry, and I'm in charge of overseeing all guild-related activities in Maple World!

106154704001214-ContentsGuide01-.name: $MyPCName$, have you joined a guild yet?

106154704001215-ContentsGuide01-.name: I wouldn't join any guild that would have me as a member.

106154704001216-ContentsGuide01-.name: Hmm... I guess I could apply to one of those.

106154704001217-ContentsGuide01-.name: Don't be silly! Guilds are a wonderful place to meet new friends, and besides, you get benefits just for being a member!

106154704001218-ContentsGuide01-.name: Just remember, if you can't find a guild you're interested in, you can always start your own!

106154704001219-ContentsGuide01-.name: That's the spirit, $MyPCName$! In addition to friendship and comradery, you'll receive all kinds of benefits as a member of a guild! Just remember, if you can't find a guild you're interested in, you can always start your own!

106154704001220-ContentsGuide01-.name: You can view information about your guild from the Guild window.

106154704001221-ContentsGuide01-.name: $MyPCName$! How does it feel to be a part of something bigger than yourself? Seeking out and interacting with like-minded guild members is the key to a fun and happy Maple World for everyone!

106154704001222-ContentsGuide01-.name: Here's to the continued success and growth of all guilds in Maple World! I hope I'll see you again real soon!

223151404001226-ContentsGuide02-.name: Welcome to our garden. Here, we grow ancient and endangered herbs. Just breathe in that smell! Isn't it magical?

308172604001265-ContentsGuide02-.name: Hm... Judging by that vacant stare, you weren't listening to my very important suggestion. Allow me to repeat myself. Go collect a flower from the garden and give it a good sniff! One hit will relax you, body and mind.

223151404001227-ContentsGuide02-.name: Go collect a flower from the garden and give it a good sniff! One hit will relax you, body and mind.

223151404001228-ContentsGuide02-.name: Ah, the subtle scent of the $item:33000166$. Lovely.

223175804001244-ContentsGuide02-.name: Ah, now this is a nice home! Ahem. Please don't stare at me. It's rude to stare.

308172604001286-ContentsGuide02-.name: My name is $npcName:11003142$, and I come bearing a gift from beyond the stars. I simply... had a good feeling about this house, so I decided to pop in.

308172604001288-ContentsGuide02-.name: That is how we make new friends on my world. It takes time for people to grow close. Perhaps as long as it will take this rice seed to grow.

308172604001289-ContentsGuide02-.name: Will you accept my gift? Will you nurture it and harvest it? If you do not want to, that's all right... I will simply return home.

223175804001245-ContentsGuide02-.name: Will you accept my gift and nurture it?

223175804001246-ContentsGuide02-.name: That is the perfect place for it.

223175804001250-ContentsGuide02-.name: When the time comes, the rice must be harvested. Your dedication now will determine what you reap in the future.

223175804001251-ContentsGuide02-.name: When the time comes, the rice must be harvested. Your dedication now will determine what you reap in the future.

223175804001252-ContentsGuide02-.name: Ahh, that golden luster... It brings to mind the light of my world's star. I'm glad I came here to bring you this gift. It was the right choice.

816160004001437-ContentsGuide03-.name: Hmm? Haven't you heard? Those hungry $item:61000002$ monsters can actually be tamed as pets.

816160004001438-ContentsGuide03-.name: Why would I want a pet slime?

816160004001439-ContentsGuide03-.name: You really don't know? Tamed pets not only enhance your attributes, but they'll fight by your side.

816160004001440-ContentsGuide03-.name: How does one tame a monster?

816160004001441-ContentsGuide03-.name: Well, you can't tame just any monster. It has to be a hungry one. $npc:11003507[gender:1]$ over there can tell you more.

816160004001442-ContentsGuide03-.name: What are you still looking at me for? If you want to learn about monster taming, talk to $npc:11003507[gender:1]$ over there.

816160004001443-ContentsGuide03-.name: You want to learn how to tame monsters? And why, may I ask, is that?

816160004001445-ContentsGuide03-.name: I want to get an edge over my enemies in combat.

816160004001446-ContentsGuide03-.name: So you're looking for a friend, eh? I can help you out with that. Let me know when you're ready to get down to business.

816160004001447-ContentsGuide03-.name: That's all well and good, but you should know your pet won't fight your battles for you. Well then, let me know when you're ready to get down to business.

816160004001448-ContentsGuide03-.name: Let's dive right in. You probably know that there's a brand of candy designed specifically for monster taste buds. What you may not know, is that it is key to taming them.

816160004001449-ContentsGuide03-.name: Monster candy? Where can I get some?

816160004001451-ContentsGuide03-.name: Lots of merchants sell it. It just so happens that I've already placed a special order with $npc:11003508[gender:1]$. I'll give you some of my candy if you pick up my order.

816160004001452-ContentsGuide03-.name: Do you see $npc:11003508[gender:1]$ over there? You can pick up my order from that pile next to her. Be careful, it's kind of heavy.

816160004001453-ContentsGuide03-.name: You brought it! Here, you can have these. Now that you have your candy, $npc:11003503[gender:0]$ can show you how monster taming works in practice.

816160004001454-ContentsGuide03-.name: You want to learn how to tame monsters? Well, you're in the right place! There are plenty of hungry $itemPlural:61000002$ right over there. You brought some $itemPlural:63000000$, right?

816160004001455-ContentsGuide03-.name: All right. The process is quite simple, actually. Just throw the candy at one of those hungry $itemPlural:61000002$. Keep feeding the monster, and it'll let down its guard and approach you.

816160004001456-ContentsGuide03-.name: How will I know when it's working?

816160004001457-ContentsGuide03-.name: Well that's easy. As you feed it candy, it will grow docile, and then a heart will appear above its head. And then, you strike! But that's a separate lesson. For now, just try feeding one of those $itemPlural:61000002$ until it lets you close.

816234204001507-ContentsGuide03-.name: As you feed the monster, a bar will appear over its head indicating how comfortable it is with you. If the bar is yellow or red, it means you'll need to use more candy to pacify it, but it also means there's a chance the beast is a rare one.

817000104001531-ContentsGuide03-.name: Where do I find those $itemPlural:61000002$ again?

817000104001533-ContentsGuide03-.name: All this candy-throwing is too much work.

817000104001534-ContentsGuide03-.name:
You're having trouble finding hungry $itemPlural:61000002$?
If you hunt the slimes nearby, it shouldn't be long before a hungry $item:61000002$ shows up.

821231704001549-ContentsGuide03-.name: Isn't there anywhere else I can find them?

821231704001550--.name: Somewhere besides $map:02000017$? Of course. If you look up the $item:61000002$ in the Pet Album, you can see the various habitats where it resides.

817000104001535-ContentsGuide03-.name: You... didn't eat it all, did you? You buy more from $npc:11003506[gender:1]$ over there. Supply Merchants in major towns also sell the candy.

817000104001536-ContentsGuide03-.name: If you haven't already, you should add the candy to a quickslot so you can use it more easily. Be sure to face the monster that you want to tame before you throw it. Easy, right?

817000104001538-ContentsGuide03-.name: What's the deal with that bar over the monster's head?

817000104001539-ContentsGuide03-.name: Yeah! Good luck! Let me know if you have any other questions.

817000104001540-ContentsGuide03-.name: As you feed the monster, a bar will appear over its head indicating how comfortable it is with you. If the bar is yellow or red, it means you'll need to use more candy to calm it down, but it also means there's a chance the beast is a rare one.

816160004001459-ContentsGuide03-.name: Now that you know how to pacify $itemPlural:61000002$, why don't you try capturing one? First, there's a tool you'll need to craft. $npc:11003507[gender:1]$ will show you how. You can use these materials.

816160004001460-ContentsGuide03-.name: Ah, you want to craft a monster trap, do you? it looks like $npc:11003503[gender:0]$ gave you everything you need to put together a $item:63100000$.

816160004001461-ContentsGuide03-.name: All you need to do to craft the $item:63100000$ is open the Life Skills window and navigate to Leisure > Pet Taming.

816160004001462-ContentsGuide03-.name: The higher your Pet Taming mastery, the higher the grade of snares you can craft. Now, go see $npc:11003503[gender:0]$ to learn how to capture pets.

816160004001464-ContentsGuide03-.name: Now, go capture yourself one of those $itemPlural:61000002$! You remember how to tame them, right?

816160004001467-ContentsGuide03-.name: Okay. So once you've pacified the $item:61000002$ with delicious monster candy, it will follow you. The trick is to set your trap on the ground and lead the monster into it.

816160004001468-ContentsGuide03-.name: That's how it works! But remember that if the monster isn't docile when it steps into the trap, it's not going to work. Now, go try capturing a $item:61000002$.

816160004001469-ContentsGuide03-.name:
It's simple. You just throw candy at it until a heart appears over its head. 
Then, it's time to capture it!

816160004001471-ContentsGuide03-.name: What would you like me to explain?

816160004001472-ContentsGuide03-.name: How do I pacify a monster?

816160004001473-ContentsGuide03-.name: How do I capture a pacified monster?

816160004001474-ContentsGuide03-.name: How do I find hungry monsters?

816160004001475-ContentsGuide03-.name:
It's simple. You just throw candy at it until a heart appears over its head. 
Then you know what to do next, right?

816160004001477-ContentsGuide03-.name: Would you mind explaining one more time?

816160004001478-ContentsGuide03-.name: You have to lead the monster over the trap while it's pacified. It won't work otherwise. Now, go try capturing a $item:61000002$.

816160004001479-ContentsGuide03-.name: Good! Why don't you give it another go? Remember, you can't capture a monster until you've pacified it.

816160004001480-ContentsGuide03-.name: You don't know where to find hungry monsters? Hungry monsters show up as blue dots on the minimap. Got it?

816160004001482-ContentsGuide03-.name: What if there aren't any hungry monsters around?

816160004001484-ContentsGuide03-.name: You can't find any hungry $itemPlural:61000002$? Maybe they're off foraging for food. Why don't you try beating up their slime friends? I bet they'll come running to help!

816160004001485-ContentsGuide03-.name: Sometimes hungry $itemPlural:61000002$ will appear if you just wait here long enough. Of course, you can find them in other areas as well.

821231304001543-ContentsGuide03-.name: Where else can I find them?

821231304001544--.name: In addition to $map:63000056$, you can find $itemPlural:61000002$ at the habitats listed on the monster's Pet Album card.

816160004001486-ContentsGuide03-.name: Good job! You'll need to keep practicing and get good at pet taming if you want to pass the test to join Team Mushroom.

816160004001487-ContentsGuide03-.name: Is it your first time here? Have you captured pets before?

816160004001489-ContentsGuide03-.name: Ah, then perhaps you're here to learn about leveling up your pets through fusion? If you have multiple pets, you can fuse one pet with another to increase the first pet's experience. Why don't you try leveling your $item:61000002$ through pet fusion?

816160004001490-ContentsGuide03-.name: Do you have any questions I can answer?

816160004001492-ContentsGuide03-.name: I don't have any pets I can fuse.

816160004001493-ContentsGuide03-.name: To fuse your pets, navigate to the Character menu and open the Pets window. Then go to the Fusion tab.

816160004001494-ContentsGuide03-.name: If you don't have enough pets to fuse, try capturing those hungry $itemPlural:61000002$ there.

816160004001497-ContentsGuide03-.name: I've forgotten how to tame monsters...

816160004001498-ContentsGuide03-.name: You can't find any hungry monsters? Then hunt the $itemPlural:61000002$ nearby until a hungry $item:61000002$ shows up to help its friends!

816160004001499-ContentsGuide03-.name: Sometimes hungry $itemPlural:61000002$ will appear if you just wait here long enough. Of course, you can find them in other areas as well.

821231304001546-ContentsGuide03-.name: Where else can I find them?

821231304001547--.name: In addition to $map:63000056$, you can find $itemPlural:61000002$ at the habitats listed on the monster's Pet Album page.

816160004001500-ContentsGuide03-.name: Throw the $itemPlural:63000000$ to a hungry monster to pacify it. Once the monster is fond of you, a heart will appear over its head, and it will follow you.

816160004001503-ContentsGuide03-.name: Set up a trap, and lure the monster with the heart over its head into it! You can craft traps like the $item:63100000$ by opening the Life Skills window and navigating to Leisure > Pet Taming.

816171104001506-ContentsGuide03-.name: Now, go and level up that $item:61000002$.

816160004001505-ContentsGuide03-.name: Good. Keep helping your pet grow. A high level one will be much more useful to you.

803231604001575-SurvivalTutorial-.name: Hm? The chest was empty? That's strange, I know I filled it... uh, last week? Nevermind, just take these. If you want something to test them on, we just got a huge shipment of $npcPlural:29000403$. Nobody'll miss one or two.

805163104001591-SurvivalTutorial-.name: I lost those items you gave me...

805155104001588-SurvivalTutorial-.name: Life as a mushroom isn't easy, you know…

As promised, I'll pay you handsomely.

831174302001521--.name:
If we leave the haystacks here, the sea salt bugs will eat them all.

228151924003322-Colosseum01-.name: Hey hey hey! Are you ready to get down with the Queen Bean Rumble?

228151924003323-Colosseum01-.name: $npcName:11004285[gender:1]$, the queen of the Pink Beans, has arrived in Maple World.

228151924003324-Colosseum01-.name: And this queen loves a good fight. That's why she's throwing the Queen Bean Rumble, the roughest, toughest, paying-est tournament around!

228151924003325-Colosseum01-.name: Of course, Her Highness wouldn't host just any old tournament. You can find out exactly how special this tournament is, you'll need to ask $npcName:11004287[gender:0]$!

228151924003326-Colosseum01-.name: Well, I'd better get going. MCing is a full-time job, after all! You can find $npcName:11004287[gender:0]$ in $map:83000001$, which is just a click away! Open the Challenge Map and click on the "Lobby" button for Queen Bean Rumble!

228151924003327-Colosseum01-.name: Well, I'd better get going. MCing is a full-time job, after all! You can find $npcName:11004287[gender:0]$ in $map:83000001$, which is just a click away! Open the Challenge Map and click on the "Lobby" button for Queen Bean Rumble!

228151924003328-Colosseum01-.name: Ah, another would-be challenger in the Queen Bean Rumble. Well, let's take a look at you.

228151924003330-Colosseum01-.name: Ugh, you peasant! You unwashed mass! You truly do not know of Her Bulbous Magnificence, $npcName:11004285[gender:1]$?

228151924003331-Colosseum01-.name: Were you brought up in a cave?

228151924003332-Colosseum01-.name: Need I explain everything to you? What a bother!

228151924003333-Colosseum01-.name: $npcName:11004285[gender:1]$, the queen of the Pink Beans, is always in search of new amusements. Why, just last week, we held the first ever quasi-annual Pink Bean Circus!

228151924003335-Colosseum01-.name: Alas, Her Rotund Highness did not think so. Thus, we have set about preparing the Queen Bean Rumble for our liege's enjoyment.

228151924003336-Colosseum01-.name: Whosoever can make our queen smile will be granted a grand cash prize. A mint, as one of lesser birth might call it. It's easy enough—make her smile or rise as champion of the tournament.

228151924003338-Colosseum01-.name: Oh-ho! So, the street urchin has a taste for the finer things in life.

228151924003339-Colosseum01-.name: Oh-ho! So, the street urchin has a taste for the finer things in life.

228151924003341-Colosseum01-.name: Indeed. You have a good eye for these things.

228151924003342-Colosseum01-.name: We sent our foremost experts on Maple World to scout the top talent for our tournament. After all, our queen deserves the very best!

228151924003343-Colosseum01-.name: I'm sure it will all be very difficult and more than a little painful for you, but that's a small price to pay for Her Pinkish Majesty's smile.

228151924003344-Colosseum01-.name: I'm sure even an uncouth cave-dweller like you will recognize your fellow competitors. Unlike you, they are quite famous.

228151924003346-Colosseum01-.name: Once you're in the ring, pay attention to everything $npcName:11004288[gender:0]$ says and do your very best to be entertaining. The queen's amusement depends upon it.

228151924003347-Colosseum01-.name: Go on, then. The entrance is behind me. Win a round and witness the smile of our joyous queen!

831174302000291--.name: I honestly didn't believe I would live to see my granddaughter again. Thank heavens this world still has heroes.

831174302000292--.name: But... I fear that $npc:11000188[gender:1]$ isn't getting any better... Such a delicate girl. She was frozen in ice too long. Sigh.

831174302000293--.name: Something must be done to release her from the clutches of that blasted frost. I hate to impose, but could I ask you a favor?

831174302000295--.name: I'd like you to go to $map:02000059$ and find $npcName:11000190[gender:0]$, a well-respected herbalist. He happens to be the son of an old friend. Surely he has something that will help my granddaughter!

831174302000296--.name: I'd like you to go to $map:02000059$ and find $npcName:11000190[gender:0]$, a well-respected herbalist. He happens to be the son of an old friend. Surely he has something that will help my granddaughter!

831174302000297--.name: Oh, hello. Is there something I can help you with?

831174302000299--.name: Sigh... $npcName:11000190[gender:0]$'s lives here, but it's been more than three days since I last saw my husband.

831174302000300--.name: What has my life become? More than half my day is spent cleaning the house, my kids keep getting into fights, and I haven't heard from my husband since he went out to gather herbs DAYS ago!

831174302000301--.name: I'm positively fed up! But I can't just leave my kids alone to go looking for the inconsiderate oaf.

831174302000302--.name: Well, if you DO find that man of mine, please tell him to come home. It's been three whole days without a peep. You might have a word with $npcName:11000192[gender:0]$ just down the hill. That's who my hubby was headed to see before his vanishing act.

831174302000303--.name: You might have a word with $npcName:11000192[gender:0]$ just down the hill. That's who my hubby was headed to see before his vanishing act. And if you do find my husband, please tell him to come home.

831174302000306--.name: Oh...? He did stop by, but that was days ago.

831174302000307--.name: Do you know where he went?

831174302000308--.name: He told me he was off to the $map:02000082$ to investigate the sighting of a precious $item:30000233$. He really ought to have been back by now.

831174302000309--.name: If you're heading to the $map:02000082$ to find him, would you mind bringing him this bag? He scrambled off in such a hurry that he forgot it. The entrance to the $map:02000082$ is right below us.

831174302000312--.name: Nope! I just got turned around.

831174302000313--.name: You really should take better care of other people's belongings. Lucky for you, that wasn't the first bag $npcName:11000190$ has left here. Try not to lose this one, all right?

831174302000314--.name: You mean that conspicuously bag-shaped object sticking out of your pockets? Perhaps you should check again.

831174302000315--.name: Really now, I don't see anywhere in that bag of yours to put it. Why don't you come back after you've parted with some of that junk you're lugging around?

831174302000316--.name: Hmph. You seem pretty bad with directions for an adventurer. The entrance to the $map:02000082$ is right below us. If you can't find it, you're not looking.

831174302000319--.name: Huh, this bag looks just like one of mine. Even has my name on it. Oh! I must have left it at $npcName:11000192[gender:0]$'s house. Thanks. Uh... was there something else?

831174302000320--.name: Your wife wants you to come home.

831174302000321--.name: Ugh, family. Kids running around yelling all day, wife always nagging. "Don't leave your shoes on the table, dear. Will you be wearing pants to dinner? Honey, you can't feed the boys dog food." Go back home? No thank you.

831174302000322--.name: I'd much rather stay here where it's quiet, picking mushrooms.

831174302000324--.name: $npc:11000187[gender:1]$ said you could help me find an herb.

831174302000325--.name: An herb? For $npc:11000187[gender:1]$? Is everything all right? I can't remember the last time I saw the old broad.

831174302000327--.name: Really? Her granddaughter's not an ice cube anymore? That's great to hear. Come to think of it, I remember her hiring me to find her a $item:50200451$ Seed a few years back…

831174302000328--.name: She was pretty torn up about losing her son, daughter-in-law, and granddaughter... At least with the kid back, maybe she can find a little peace. But wait, what do you need the herb for?

831174302000330--.name: Hmm... What you need is something to kickstart her metabolism and get her body's temperature regulation back under control. There's a medicinal fruit that would help, super common too. I'm just can't for the life of me recall the name.

831174302000331--.name: I wrote it down in my herb guide... Should be somewhere in my house. I gotta warn you though, my handwriting is not super great.

831174302000332--.name: Head over to my house and look for my herb guide. My penmanship isn't great, but you should be able to read it.

831174302000334--.name: Your dad sent me to look for his herb guide.

831174302000335--.name: Really? You should look on top of the wardrobe. Dad likes to hide stuff where $npcName:11000200[gender:0]$ and I can't reach. Hey... Is my mom still outside?

831174302000337--.name: Sigh... Guess I'm not getting off easy. How much longer do I have to sit like this? $npc:11000200[gender:0]$'s gonna get what's coming to him!

831174302000338--.name: <font color="#909090">(The recipe book was on top of the wardrobe, just like $npc:11000202[gender:0]$ said. You start leafing through the pages.)</font>

831174302000339--.name: Pg. 15 | Mushmint Especially effective for boosting energy and overcoming fatigue. It usually takes root near sources of fresh water, such as riversides or near waterfalls. To Prepare: Sun-dry and submerge in 1 cup $item:30000230$. Bring to boil, stirring until homogeneous.

831174302000340--.name: Pg. 40 | $item:30000232$ Tasty, but no real medicinal value. Grind fruit to extract juice, or boil as tea. Often takes root between rocks within warm mountainous regions. Fruit best collected in spring.

831174302000341--.name: Pg. 89 | $item:20000044$ Remarkable fruit, boosts metabolism and warms the body. Especially good for replenishing energy. Can be eaten whole, juiced, or blended. Its extract is used in numerous commercial medicines. It is often found in $map:02000059$ and $map:02000054$.

831174302000342--.name: <font color="#909090">($item:20000044$, eh? If this book is right, the fruit could be the key to $npc:11000188$'s recovery. You should go to $map:02000059$ or $map:02000054$ and collect some.)</font>

831174302000343--.name: <font color="#909090">($item:20000044$, eh? If this book is right, the fruit could be the key to $npc:11000188$'s recovery. You should go to $map:02000059$ or $map:02000054$ and collect some.)</font>

831174302000344--.name: $MyPCName$, you're back. What's that you've got there in your hand? Did $npc:11000190[gender:0]$ help you find an herb that could help my dear granddaughter?

831174302000346--.name: An... apple? Well, whatever works! Thank you very much. So, how is $npcName:11000190[gender:0]$ these days?

831174302000349--.name:
Of course, of course. That's how it should be...
If not for the Shadow Gate, my son and his wife might still be living happily together too... Sigh...

831174302000350--.name: Oh no, what a shame. Is there a problem with his home life?

831174302000351--.name: He and his wife are pretty much fed up with each other.

831174302000352--.name: Oh my... It's easy to forget how precious family is. When someone is such a regular part of your life, sometimes you take them for granted.

831174302000353--.name: Families should sacrifice for each other, and embrace one another no matter their flaws. After all I've lost, I would never neglect someone who meant so much to me.

831174302000356--.name: I chop firewood 'til I'm stiff and sweaty, only to have it snatched up by the monsters living in the $map:02000082$ while my back is turned.

831174302000357--.name: What do monsters need with firewood?

831174302000358--.name: Why are you asking me? All I know is holes leading into the $map:02000082$ keep cropping up. $npcName:11000192[gender:0]$ found one south of here, and now parts of the road to $map:02000054$ have started caving in.

831174302000359--.name: I went to investigate the crater, and what should I find but those blasted monsters digging their way to the surface.

831174302000360--.name: First they cut down all the saplings in the area, and then they started stealing our lumber. This is the last time I let those monsters get their hands on my wood!

831174302000361--.name: No firewood to sell, means no food in our bellies. Won't you please liberate my wood? You can just set it down wherever.

831174302000362--.name: No firewood to sell, means no food in our bellies. Won't you please liberate my wood? You can just set it down wherever.

831174302000363--.name: I'm in your debt, friend. Thanks!

831174302000366--.name: Mind doing me a favor? I've put some mushrooms in this bag. Take them to my wife and tell her to sell them, okay?

831174302000367--.name: And tell her not to sell 'em too cheap! These are RARE medicinal mushrooms that pretty much only grow in bat poop. Well... She'll probably figure it out. Her shrewd business sense and effective-but-yappy negotiating skills are why I fell in love with her.

831174302000368--.name: Oh and on your way out would you mind re-lighting any burned out candles you come across? The bats hate the light, and I really enjoy not getting gnawed to death by rats with wings. Thanks buddy!

831174302000371--.name: Nope! I just got turned around.

831174302000372--.name: Oh. Well, it is pretty dark in this cave. I just want to stress how RARE these mushrooms are, and how much work it was to gather them. Here's another bag.

831174302000373--.name: What? It's sitting right there in the top of your bag!

831174302000374--.name: Yeesh. There's nowhere to put it! How do you walk with a bag that full? Come back to me when you've dumped some of that junk.

831174302000375--.name: Oh, yeah. It 's pretty dark in here. Be careful on your way out.

831174302000378--.name: Oh my... If he'd collected this many, he should have just come home! Sigh... Well, thank you for going to the trouble of bringing these.

831174302000431--.name:
Hey! Why are you standing there staring blankly?
Hurry and gather the <font color="#ffd200">$item:30000120$</font>, put them in the <font color="#ffd200">furnace</font>, and fire it up.
How will you ever make <font color="#ffd200">$item:30000121$</font>$pp:를,을$ standing around like that?
Get moving!

831174302000432--.name:
Hey! Why are you standing there staring blankly?
Hurry and gather the <font color="#ffd200">$item:30000120$</font>, put them in the <font color="#ffd200">furnace</font>, and fire it up.

831174302000433--.name:
Heh heh. Doesn't it look alive, bubbling and boiling over like that?
Scrap metal that was little more than someone else's garbage has gained new life.
As a new laborer, this must be your first time seeing something so wondrous, right?

831174302000434--.name: Say you are not a laborer.

831174302000436--.name:
Huh? You're not the laborer who came to work here?
Then why did you do the job?

831174302000437--.name: Say you did it because he told you to.

831174302000438--.name: Say you wanted to try operating the furnace.

831174302000439--.name:
Wow... You must not have much to do. Go on, get out of here~
But then where in the world is the new laborer who was supposed to arrive...?

831174302000440--.name:
Others see $map:02000084$$pp:는,은$ as nothing but a place filled with abandoned trash,
but I don't see it that way.
Even the <font color="#ffd200">Royal Guard weapons left gathering dust after the royal audience was canceled
were melted in that furnace, turned to molten metal, and reborn as solid iron ore</font>.

831174302000441--.name:
Whenever I see that, even this humble job as a scrapyard laborer feels worthwhile.
Heh heh heh.

831174302000586--.name:
Goodness... This is troublesome.
It's not as if behaving that way will solve the problem…

831174302000588--.name:
Didn't you see the <font color="#ffd200">person shouting and protesting indiscriminately in front of City Hall</font>?
They're a <font color="#ffd200">relative of someone claiming to suffer side effects from medicine made by Goldus Pharmaceuticals</font>.

831174302000589--.name:
They protested outside Goldus Pharmaceuticals for days, but when the company gave no answer,
they demanded that I mediate and resolve the matter.
I asked them to give me time to find a solution, but they couldn't wait
and began protesting like that.

831174302000590--.name:
I'm doing my best too, but this protest reflects poorly in front of the citizens...
And it leaves my reputation in tatters... Goodness...
Would you convey my intentions and persuade them to withdraw?

831174302000591--.name:
I'm doing my best too, but this protest reflects poorly in front of the citizens...
And it leaves my reputation in tatters... Goodness...
Would you convey my intentions and persuade the protesters to withdraw?

831174302000592--.name: You seem to be coming from City Hall... Did the mayor send you?

831174302000594--.name:
He wants more time?
Hmph! It's already been months since I met $npcTitle:11000065[gender:0]$$pp:를,을$ and pleaded for help.
All this time, $npcName:11000065[gender:0]$ $npcTitle:11000065[gender:0]$$pp:는,은$ has done nothing but delay without investigating.

831174302000595--.name:
Neither I nor the other victims protesting outside Goldus headquarters
can trust the mayor any longer.

831174302000596--.name:
Many people grew worse after taking medicine from Goldus Pharmaceuticals.
Yet Goldus simply denies everything, claiming there is no proof
that their medicine worsened anyone's illness.

831174302000597--.name:
If we could only see data that conclusively showed whether the medicine was responsible,
we wouldn't feel so helpless.
But Goldus Pharmaceuticals holds all the information about the medicine…

831174302000598--.name:
If even one researcher or pharmacist who actually makes medicine at Goldus Pharmaceuticals
would help us...
Would you <font color="#ffd200">go directly to the Goldus Pharmaceuticals factory and find someone willing
to take our side and help</font>?

831174302000599--.name:
If even one researcher or pharmacist who actually makes medicine at Goldus Pharmaceuticals
would help us...
Would you <font color="#ffd200">go directly to the Goldus Pharmaceuticals factory and find someone willing
to take our side and help</font>?

831174302000600--.name:
A person... A normal person...
Ah... I'm saved...
I thought I'd be trapped here until I died...

831174302000601--.name:
Once the safety testing of this new drug sample is complete, I will personally face the victims,
apologize, and do everything I can to treat them.
Before then, deliver the <font color="#ffd200">data proving the drug's side effects</font> that the victims want.

831174302000602--.name:
There is a drug-ingredient mixing room beneath this factory.
Print a <font color="#ffd200">pharmaceutical composition report</font> from the <font color="#ffd200">composition analyzer</font> there,
and draw a <font color="#ffd200">raw-material sample</font> from the <font color="#ffd200">drug ingredient pipe</font>.

831174302000603--.name:
There is a drug-ingredient mixing room beneath this factory.

and draw a <font color="#ffd200">raw-material sample</font> from the <font color="#ffd200">drug ingredient pipe</font>.

831174302000605--.name: Hand over the evidence found at the pharmaceutical factory.

831174302000606--.name:
Thank you! Thank you so much!
This will be a tremendous help.

831174302000608--.name:
Is that really true?
They distributed an untested drug and then denied everything...
Those scoundrels...!

831174302000609--.name:
I resent that doctor too... But since he's willing to help us now,
we should wait until he arrives. In any case, thank you so much.

831174302000610--.name:
I don't know how this happened... Monsters suddenly stormed the factory in a horde
and seized control of it...
The surprise attack threw the entire factory into chaos, and the employees
scattered and fled.

831174302000611--.name:
There was something important I absolutely had to recover,
so I returned, only to end up like this... attacked by those creatures...
Please. I have a difficult favor to ask.

831174302000612--.name:
Those <font color="#ffd200">monsters struck me from behind and took
the new drug sample I spent my entire life developing.</font>
Please recover it. I beg you.

831174302000613--.name:
Those <font color="#ffd200">monsters struck me from behind and took
the new drug sample I spent my entire life developing.</font>
Please recover it. I beg you.

831174302000614--.name:
Ah... I truly don't know how to thank you...
This is my only hope of restoring my pride and honor
as a pharmaceutical researcher.

831174302000615--.name:
Once, through my own poor judgment...
I yielded to pressure from my superiors and created an <font color="#ffd200">untested drug</font>.
This <font color="#ffd200">new medicine can resolve the problems caused by that drug</font>.

831174302000616--.name:
Once I completed the safety tests on this new drug sample,
I intended to mass-produce it and distribute it to everyone...

831174302000617--.name: Relay what Humphrey, the protester, said.

831174302000618--.name:
The drug's side effects have already appeared? This is terrible... It's all my fault...
I've been trapped in here, so I knew nothing about the situation.

831174302000619--.name: Oh man, oh jeez. What should I do?

831174302000621--.name: I am so fired... I was taking $npc:11000049$ for a walk, and before I knew what was happening, she had scampered down into a crevice in the side of the cliff!

831174302000623--.name: Oh. $npc:11000049$ is my boss's cat. I can't go back without her, and there's no way I can climb down there. Please, save the cat and save my job!

831174302000624--.name: Please climb down the cliff side and rescue $npc:11000049$ before my boss comes back.

831174302000625--.name: I can't believe you risked your life climbing down to rescue $npc:11000049$... You've really saved my bacon! Thanks.

831174302000686--.name: The monsters came out of nowhere... They trashed the lab, and attacked our researchers. Worst of all, they made off with the $itemPlural:20000049$ that were the foundation of our research!

831174302000687--.name: The $itemPlural:20000049$ are experimental prototypes that were never meant to leave the lab. If they are introduced into the ecosystem, they could wreak untold havoc! Please, you must recover the samples before it's too late...

831174302000688--.name: The $itemPlural:20000049$ are experimental prototypes that were never meant to leave the lab. If they are introduced into the ecosystem, they could wreak untold havoc! Please, you must recover the samples before it's too late...

831174302000689--.name: Thank heavens... You recovered the $itemPlural:20000049$ before the monsters escaped the lab with them. I'm... Urgh... In your debt.

831174302000690--.name: Sigh... Now what do I do?

831174302000692--.name:
I finally decided to take my girlfriend on an outing after all this time...
But she suddenly got upset, threw our couple's ring into the field below,
and rode up alone in the cable car.

831174302000694--.name:
I don't know.
She asked whether the cable car attendant was pretty,
so I told her that she was much prettier in my eyes.
But then she suddenly got upset and threw <font color="#ffd200">$item:30000046$</font>$pp:를,을$ into the field.

831174302000695--.name: Anyways... I don't know what I did wrong, but I have to find the $item:30000046$ before I can go and patch things up with my girlfriend. The problem is, the place is surrounded with monsters.

831174302000696--.name:
I'm weaker than I look...
$MyPCName$, could you go find <font color="#ffd200">$item:30000046$</font> for me?

831174302000697--.name:
I'm weaker than I look...
$MyPCName$, could you go find <font color="#ffd200">$item:30000046$</font> for me?

831174302000700--.name: You're a life-saver! This ring was custom-made, I would never have been able to replace it.

831174302000701--.name: Sigh... But returning the promise ring isn't going to solve whatever made her angry in the first place.

831174302000702--.name: I just know she's going to ask if I know what I did wrong. What am I supposed to say to that?

831174302000703--.name: Listen, I'm really sorry to ask for another favor, but could you deliver this $item:30000046$ to my girlfriend $npc:11000224[gender:1]$? Maybe you could even figure out why she's angry for me...

831174302000704--.name: What's wrong? Did I ask too much?

831174302000706--.name: Nope! I just got turned around.

831174302000707--.name: Huh? Isn't that it on the floor right there? Please be more careful, it's the only one of its kind.

831174302000708--.name: I saw you put it in your bag... is it not in there? Why don't you look again?

831174302000709--.name: Your bag looks really full. Why don't you clean it up first?

831174302000710--.name:
Ah... well, I suppose.
This place is so big and complicated...

831174302000711--.name: Hmph! Forget it. Something like this <font color="#ffd200">$item:30000046$</font> is useless now.

831174302000713--.name:
<font color="#ffd200">$npc:11000223[gender:0]$</font> keeps looking at other women.
Even when I'm standing right beside him.

831174302000714--.name:
Earlier, I casually tested him by asking whether the cable car attendant was pretty...

Please give $npc:11000009[gender:0]$ my thanks and regards. Farewell...

831174302003573--.name:
You've worked hard.
I truly hope the prayers offered through the ritual are answered this time...

831174302003574--.name:
Welcome, $MyPCName$.
When $npc:11000076[gender:0]$ said there was an outstanding person who could lend strength to Greenhood's operation to eradicate the Devilins, I had my suspicions...
But having you here in person already puts my mind at ease.

831174302003575--.name:
As you probably already know, our Greenhood vigilantes are still fighting desperately against the Devilins in the broken lands of $map:02000115$.
To end this situation as soon as possible, $npc:11000015[gender:1]$ has been searching for a way to eradicate the Devilins forever.

831174302003576--.name:
From what we've learned so far, the powerful dark energy emitted by the Devilins originates from the enormous horns embedded in their heads.
Go to $map:02000115$ and <font color="#ffd200">pull the $item:30000283$ embedded in the heads of</font> <font color="#ffd200">$npc:23000001[gender:0]$</font> or <font color="#ffd200">$npc:23000008[gender:0]$</font>.

831174302003577--.name: Go to $map:02000115$ and <font color="#ffd200">pull the $item:30000283$ embedded in the heads of</font> <font color="#ffd200">$npc:23000001[gender:0]$</font> or <font color="#ffd200">$npc:23000008[gender:0]$</font>.

831174302003578--.name: Thanks to your efforts, $MyPCName$, the vigilantes fighting the Devilins on the frontier have gained tremendous strength and courage. Once again, thank you.

831174302003579--.name:
While you were active at $map:02000115$, we learned something new. The source of the darkness within $item:30000283$ was $npc:23100007[gender:0]$.
$npc:23100007[gender:0]$ has been awakening vengeful spirits sleeping in the deep darkness, turning them into members of the demon legion and granting the Devilins even greater dark power.

831174302003580--.name:
Go to <font color="#ffd200">$map:02000356$</font>, defeat <font color="#ffd200">$npc:23100007[gender:0]$</font>, and destroy the <font color="#ffd200">Shadow Soul Stone</font> it uses to awaken vengeful spirits from the darkness.
Once the mission is complete, report the situation to $npc:11000015[gender:1]$ at $map:02000076$.

831174302003581--.name:
Go to <font color="#ffd200">$map:02000356$</font>, defeat <font color="#ffd200">$npc:23100007[gender:0]$</font>, and destroy the <font color="#ffd200">Shadow Soul Stone</font> it uses to awaken vengeful spirits from the darkness.
Once the mission is complete, report the situation to $npc:11000015[gender:1]$ at $map:02000076$.

831174302003582--.name:
Welcome, $MyPCName$!
I heard the news from $npc:11000007[gender:1]$.
You went to $map:02000356$ to destroy the Shadow Soul Stone... How... did it go?

831174302003583--.name: Say you destroyed the Shadow Soul Stone.

831174302003584--.name:
Ah... What a relief.
Without you, $MyPCName$, we would never have broken the Devilins' momentum.

831174302003585--.name:
Through the Devilins, I feel we've moved closer to uncovering the true nature of the mysterious Shadow Legion.
But... perhaps the Devilins are merely the Shadow Legion's tail.
We must uncover its body... and even the leader at its head.

831174302003586--.name:
Until then, not only Greenhood, but every Guardian and hero throughout Maple World must join forces.
Now that an even greater enemy stands before us, what we need most is <font color="#ffd200">trust in one another</font>.

831174302003587--.name: I know it's a burden, but please return to $map:02000146$ and convey my thoughts to $npc:11000007[gender:1]$.

831174302003588--.name: I know it's a burden, but please return to $map:02000146$ and convey my thoughts to $npc:11000007[gender:1]$.

831174302003591--.name:
Yes, I understand. I'll convey those thoughts to the allied forces gathered here as well.
Just as $npcName:11000015[gender:1]$ said... the real struggle begins now.

831174302003592--.name:
Argh! <font color="#ffd200">$npc:11000604[gender:0]$</font>!
That guy is at it again...

831174302003594--.name:
Ah... There's a fellow named $npc:11000604[gender:0]$.
He has no interest in anything happening in the world and spends all day buried in books.
Now a book called <font color="#ffd200">$item:39000011$</font> has disappeared, and I'm certain he's responsible...
Sometimes he takes books I'm organizing and reads them without saying a word to me.

831174302003595--.name:
Ah, he should be hiding in some corner of <font color="#ffd200">$map:02000109$</font> right now...
Would you find him and retrieve <font color="#ffd200">$item:39000011$</font> for me?

831174302003596--.name:
$npc:11000604[gender:0]$ should be hiding in some corner of <font color="#ffd200">$map:02000109$</font> right now...
Would you find him and retrieve <font color="#ffd200">$item:39000011$</font> for me?

831174302003599--.name:
Ugh... What do you want...? You're bothering me...
Just leave quietly...

831174302003600--.name:
Sigh... I don't know who you are, but I know you're still standing there.
Stop distracting me and leave...

831174302003601--.name: Say that $npc:11000033[gender:0]$ is looking for <font color="#ffd200">$item:39000011$</font>.

831174302003602--.name:
Ugh, what a nuisance. Seriously!
I still have something to check! Tell him I'll give it back later!

831174302003603--.name: Say he seems to need it now.

831174302003604--.name:
Sigh... He absolutely has to get it back right now?
Then check what I want to know in my place, and you can take the book afterward.
Obtain the <font color="#ffd200">$item:30000189$</font> described here and bring it to me.

831174302003606--.name: They say <font color="#ffd200">$npc:22000038$</font> sometimes appears at <font color="#ffd200">$map:02000089$</font>, so go there and investigate for yourself.

831174302003607--.name: They say <font color="#ffd200">$npc:22000038$</font> sometimes appears at <font color="#ffd200">$map:02000089$</font>, so go there and obtain <font color="#ffd200">$item:30000189$</font> yourself.

831174302003612--.name:
Already? You're... more persistent than I expected.
I thought you'd get scared and give up...

831174302003613--.name:
I finished the book while you were obtaining $item:30000189$,
so I don't need it anymore. I'll give it back.

831174302003614--.name: Ask whether he sent you to obtain $item:30000189$ just to buy himself time to read.

831174302003615--.name:
Of course.
What kind of fool goes around checking every last thing written in a book? How naive...
Anyway, I have another book to read, so take what you came for.

831174302003618--.name: Say you took a wrong turn.

831174302003619--.name:
Seriously... You find every possible way to be a nuisance.
Here!! Now please stop bothering me!!

831174302003620--.name:
Are you stupid?
I put it in your bag!

831174302003621--.name:
Why are you lugging around such an absurdly heavy bag?
Organize it!

831174302003622--.name:
Sigh... You got lost in such a cramped little place...?
Seriously... Unbelievable.

831174302003623--.name:
Ah, you're back?
What about <font color="#ffd200">$item:39000011$</font>?

831174302003625--.name:
So it was $npc:11000604[gender:0]$ after all!
I only needed to check one thing, but that guy kept me waiting for ages...
Let's see...

831174302003626--.name:
Hmm... Ah! Found it. Here it is.
The monsters of Ellinia absorb the forest's energy...
Ah! So that's it... Just as I expected!!

831174302003628--.name:
Hm? Ah, right. It's nothing important.
Anyway, thanks to you, I confirmed everything I was looking for... and I'm grateful for your help...
Do you happen to like books?

831174302003630--.name: Say you don't particularly like them.

831174302003631--.name:
Oh, really? That's great!
As thanks, I'll give you $item:39000011$ as a gift. It's quite entertaining!

831174302003632--.name:
Oh, really? Then this is perfect! $item:39000011$ has more pictures than words, so it's ideal for getting interested in books.
Give it a read!

831174302003633--.name:
Sigh... The old man $npc:11000021[gender:0]$ told me.
The leader commanding the ghost pirates... calls himself <font color="#ffd200">$npc:23100015[gender:0]$</font>...
<font color="#ffd200">$npc:23100015[gender:0]$</font>... That's the missing <font color="#ffd200">captain of the Victoria</font>.

831174302003634--.name:
He was my late father's closest friend... and like a father to me...
The old man $npc:11000021[gender:0]$ said he saw the pirate leader carrying <font color="#ffd200">$item:39000032$</font>.

831174302003635--.name:
If that truly is... the missing <font color="#ffd200">captain of the Victoria's</font> logbook...
It will be an important clue for uncovering the truth behind the unidentified pirate leader and <font color="#ffd200">the disappearance of the Victoria</font>.

831174302003636--.name:
If the <font color="#ffd200">$item:39000032$</font> carried by the pirate leader truly belonged to... the <font color="#ffd200">captain of the Victoria</font>...
It will be an important clue for uncovering the truth behind the unidentified pirate leader and <font color="#ffd200">the disappearance of the Victoria</font>.

831174302003637--.name:
Th-this is...!!!
Yes... It was definitely written by the captain of the Victoria himself!

831174302003638--.name:
The last page... black sea... anglerfish... ruler...
What... in the world happened to the Victoria...?

831174302003639--.name:
Ah! $MyPCName$!
It seems $npcTitle:11000119[gender:0]$ is urgently looking for you. You should go at once.

831174302003640--.name: It seems $npcTitle:11000119[gender:0]$ is urgently looking for you. You should go at once.

831174302003641--.name:
Ah! Welcome.
I've been waiting for you to arrive!

831174302003642--.name: As you already know, throughout Maple World, not only the allied Guardians but also regional leaders, civilian organizations, and residents are doing what they can from their own positions to protect this world.

831174302003643--.name: When they face a problem they can't resolve themselves or need the Guardians' help, they send a request for support, as they have now.

831174302003645--.name:
$npc:11000031[gender:0]$, the leader of $map:02000023$.
He protects the forests of $map:02000023$ from being engulfed by the Demon King's shadow.
But... it seems some problem has arisen recently.

831174302003646--.name:
You'll learn the details after meeting $npcTitle:11000031[gender:0]$...
I'd like you to go and help him. What do you say?
Can you do it?

831174302003647--.name:
The energy in the forests of $map:02000023$ seems ominous.
You'll learn the details after meeting $npcTitle:11000031[gender:0]$...
For now, go to $map:02000023$.

831174302003648--.name:
Oh, $MyPCName$!
Were you able to help $npc:11000031[gender:0]$?

831174302003650--.name:
As expected, I can trust you with any task.
You've done well!

831174302003651--.name:
I'm sorry to keep giving you missions without any time to rest... but there's also a matter at $map:02000076$ awaiting your help.
Go to $map:02000076$ and meet $npc:11000001[gender:0]$.

831174302003652--.name:
There's also a matter at $map:02000076$ awaiting your help.
Go to $map:02000076$ and meet $npc:11000001[gender:0]$.

831174302003653--.name:
Oh, $MyPCName$! You've worked hard.
Your contributions will surely be rewarded someday!

831174302003654--.name:
Hmm... $MyPCName$!
This time, go to $map:02000062$ and meet $npc:11000019[gender:0]$, the head of the Adventurers Guild.
I hear pieces of wreckage from a ship believed to have sunk while traveling from $map:63000001$ to $map:02000062$ were found at $map:02000063$.

831174302003655--.name:
It seems the Adventurers Guild has dispatched its own investigation team.
Go assess the situation and find out whether there's anything you can do to help.

831174302003656--.name:
I hear pieces of wreckage from a ship believed to have sunk while traveling from $map:63000001$ to $map:02000062$ were found at $map:02000063$.
Go to $map:02000062$ and meet $npc:11000019[gender:0]$, the head of the Adventurers Guild.

831174302003657--.name:
Ah, you're back.
What was the situation along the coast?

831174302003659--.name:
What?
You discovered where the <font color="#ffd200">missing Victoria</font> sank?
Does this mean we can finally uncover the truth behind <font color="#ffd200">the disappearance of the Victoria</font>, which seemed destined to remain an eternal mystery...?

831174302003660--.name:
We'll need to support the Royal Guard so they can join the coastal expedition.
You've done well, $MyPCName$!

831174302003661--.name:
$MyPCName$!
There's one more task I need you to handle.

831174302003662--.name:
The <font color="#ffd200">Chaos Time Center</font> dispatched researchers to investigate why time stopped in parts of northern Ludibrium, but it seems they've encountered a problem.
Go to <font color="#ffd200">$map:02000142$</font>, meet <font color="#ffd200">$npc:11000869[gender:0]$</font>, and support their research.

831174302003663--.name:
The <font color="#ffd200">Chaos Time Center</font> dispatched researchers to investigate why time stopped in parts of northern Ludibrium, but it seems they've encountered a problem.
Go to <font color="#ffd200">$map:02000142$</font>, meet <font color="#ffd200">$npc:11000869[gender:0]$</font>, and support their research.

831174302003664--.name:
Were you able to help the temporal engineers with their research?
What problem did they encounter?

831174302003665--.name: Report on the situation in the clock tower.

831174302003666--.name:
There was a strange creature called <font color="#ffd200">$npc:23000077$</font> in the clock tower's basement?
The clock stopped... and time throughout the surrounding region froze...
Was that creature responsible?

831174302003667--.name: Say you weren't able to determine the exact cause.

831174302003668--.name:
Could something have happened... to the <font color="#ffd200">Red Lapenta of Time</font>...?
I have a bad feeling...

831174302003669--.name:
In any case, you've worked incredibly hard running from place to place without a moment's rest.
I'll give you a special gift as a token of my hope that you'll continue protecting this world!

831174302003670--.name: Congratulations on taking another step toward becoming a <font color="#ffd200">true hero of Maple World</font>!

831174302003671--.name:
Hmm... Even though everyone is trying so desperately...
The darkness in the forest grows deeper with each passing day.

831174302003672--.name:
The power of darkness is growing stronger because the <font color="#ffd200">$item:30000314$</font> that protects and purifies our forests at $map:02000023$ is gradually disappearing.
We must recover the lost <font color="#ffd200">$item:30000314$</font> and restore the forest's light.
Will you help?

831174302003674--.name:
There are enormous monsters that threaten the fairies and trample the forest.
Creatures such as <font color="#ffd200">$npc:23000035$</font>, <font color="#ffd200">$npc:23000017$</font>, and <font color="#ffd200">$npc:23000047$</font>.
They are indiscriminately absorbing <font color="#ffd200">$item:30000314$</font>.

831174302003675--.name:
If you encounter them while traveling through the forests of $map:02000023$, don't retreat. Fight them.
The moment their souls depart, you'll be able to obtain the <font color="#ffd200">$item:30000314$</font> they held!

831174302003676--.name:
If you encounter creatures such as <font color="#ffd200">$npc:23000035$</font>, <font color="#ffd200">$npc:23000017$</font>, and <font color="#ffd200">$npc:23000047$</font> while traveling through the forests of $map:02000023$, don't retreat. Fight them.
The moment their souls depart, you'll be able to obtain the <font color="#ffd200">$item:30000314$</font> they held!

831174302003679--.name:
Oh! That must have been a great deal of work.
Thank you.

831174302003680--.name:
Listen, $MyPCName$.
Now that we've recovered $item:30000314$, it's time to illuminate the forest.
There's a place in the forests of $map:02000023$ filled with the darkest and most sinister energy.
It is... $map:02000315$!

831174302003681--.name:
The dark energy there is so powerful that fairies quickly lose their strength and consciousness.
Only heroes like you can illuminate $map:02000315$.
Will you help us again?

831174302003683--.name:
Thank you for agreeing so readily once again.
Here, this is $item:30000315$, made by concentrating the $item:30000314$ you gathered earlier.
Take it to $map:02000315$ and sprinkle it on the trees that have lost their vitality to restore the forest's light.

831174302003684--.name:
I'm counting on you again this time.
Please be careful.

831174302003685--.name: Why have you returned? Did something happen?

831174302003687--.name: Say you came to say goodbye before going to $map:02000206$.

831174302003688--.name:
Goodness... Something so precious... Tsk, tsk... You should have taken better care of it.
I happen to have a spare, so I'll give you another... but be sure to keep it safe this time.

831174302003689--.name:
Are you certain? Did you search every corner of your bag thoroughly?
Look once more.

831174302003690--.name:
Hmm... Your bag seems to contain too much clutter.
Organize it first.

831174302003691--.name:
Ah... Is that so?
I'll say it again: please be careful not to get hurt.

831174302003692--.name:
Oh, you've returned safely!
Thanks to you, the darkness covering the forest has weakened greatly. Thank you so much!

831174302003693--.name:
Hmm... We can't simply sit idle...
If this continues, all of $map:02000076$ may turn into a barren land where not a single blade of grass grows...

831174302003695--.name:
As you know, our $map:02000076$ is among the most fertile and vibrant lands in Maple World.
That's entirely because <font color="#ffd200">$item:30000316$</font> exists to protect and purify these green plains.

831174302003696--.name:
But... lately, the monsters of the plains have been indiscriminately draining <font color="#ffd200">$item:30000316$</font> and using its power to trample this world instead.
Because of them, the once-vibrant land is steadily becoming barren and desolate.

831174302003697--.name:
Before all of $map:02000076$ is devastated, we must recover <font color="#ffd200">$item:30000316$</font> from the monsters!
Will you help?

831174302003699--.name:
Thank you.
According to the vigilantes' investigation, the monsters known to have drained <font color="#ffd200">$item:30000316$</font> so far are <font color="#ffd200">$npc:22000322[gender:0]$</font>, <font color="#ffd200">$npc:22000001$</font>, and <font color="#ffd200">$npc:22000024$</font>.
If you encounter them, be sure to recover <font color="#ffd200">$item:30000316$</font>!

831174302003700--.name:
According to the vigilantes' investigation, the monsters known to have drained <font color="#ffd200">$item:30000316$</font> so far are <font color="#ffd200">$npc:22000322[gender:0]$</font>, <font color="#ffd200">$npc:22000001$</font>, and <font color="#ffd200">$npc:22000024$</font>.
If you encounter them, be sure to recover <font color="#ffd200">$item:30000316$</font>!

831174302003701--.name:
Oh, you've recovered <font color="#ffd200">$item:30000316$</font>.
You've truly worked hard!!

831174302003702--.name:
Hmm... Recovering $item:30000316$ doesn't mean everything is completely resolved.
Unless Shadow World is fully sealed and all shadow energy disappears...
Monsters threatening this world will continue to appear without end...

831174302003703--.name:
The best fundamental solution available to us now... is to remove the evil energy from monsters born through its influence.
Among them... the griffins, sacred birds of the Vayar Mountains that have now become monsters...
If purified life force could restore their original forms before they were corrupted by evil energy, they might instead gain the power to protect this world.

831174302003704--.name:
Somewhere northwest of $map:02000076$, near <font color="#ffd200">$map:02000009$</font>, you should find <font color="#ffd200">$map:02000316$</font>.
<font color="#ffd200">Cover the eggs incubating inside $map:02000316$ with this $item:30000317$</font>.
The $item:30000317$, imbued with $item:30000316$, will warmly embrace the young griffins' eggs so they can enter the world in their original sacred forms.

831174302003705--.name: Why have you returned? Did something happen?

831174302003707--.name: Say you came to say goodbye before going to $map:02000177$.

831174302003708--.name:
Goodness... Something so precious... Tsk, tsk... You should have taken better care of it.
I happen to have a spare, so I'll give you another... but be sure to keep it safe this time.

831174302003709--.name:
Are you certain? Did you search every corner of your bag thoroughly?
Look once more.

831174302003710--.name:
Hmm... Your bag seems to contain too much clutter.
Organize it first.

831174302003711--.name:
Ah... Is that so?
I'll say it again: please be careful not to get hurt.

831174302003712--.name:
You've returned?
So, did the young griffins hatch in their original sacred forms?

831174302003714--.name:
What a relief, truly. Even if only little by little, we must restore this world to what it once was...
In any case, you've done excellent work!

831174302003715--.name:
Ah, welcome!
I think you've visited once before... What brings you here this time?

831174302003716--.name: Say you came under orders from $npc:11000119[gender:0]$.

831174302003717--.name:
Ah... I see!
I recently received a report that ghost pirates have occupied $map:02000063$ and $map:02000067$, causing serious trouble for the expedition at $map:02000068$.

831174302003718--.name: Those pirates carry $item:30000318$, covered in an unidentified code. It seems to be... a clue connected to the ships that have suddenly disappeared at sea.

831174302003719--.name:
I'd like you to help <font color="#ffd200">eliminate the pirates at $map:02000063$ and $map:02000067$</font> and <font color="#ffd200">collect $item:30000318$</font>.
$map:02000063$ and $map:02000067$ aren't close to here, but you can travel there quickly through <font color="#ffd200">$map:02000183$</font>.

831174302003720--.name:
While carrying out missions for $map:02000068$, you can use the <font color="#ffd200">Marcos</font>.
It's currently <font color="#ffd200">running between $map:02000062$ and $map:02000183$</font>.
Find <font color="#ffd200">$npc:11000981[gender:0]$</font> at the <font color="#ffd200">$map:02000062$ docks</font>, and you should be able to board the ship!

831174302003721--.name:
I'd like you to help <font color="#ffd200">eliminate the pirates at $map:02000063$ and $map:02000067$</font> and <font color="#ffd200">collect $item:30000318$</font>.
If you meet <font color="#ffd200">$npc:11000981[gender:0]$</font> at the <font color="#ffd200">$map:02000062$ docks</font>, you can board the <font color="#ffd200">Marcos</font>, which <font color="#ffd200">sails to $map:02000183$</font>. That will make the journey easier.

831174302003722--.name:
Pardon? What did you just say?
My mind was somewhere else for a moment...

831174302003724--.name:
Ah, I was just examining the $item:30000318$ we've collected so far...
I've been struggling because the code hidden within it feels so close to being solved, yet remains just out of reach.

831174302003725--.name:
If I examine what you brought together with the rest, perhaps I'll find something...
I'll investigate further. Thank you.

831174302003728--.name:
I found it!
The meaning of the code hidden in $item:30000318$!

831174302003730--.name: This is a <font color="#ffd200">message</font> left by <font color="#ffd200">$npc:23100015[gender:0]$, the missing captain of the Victoria</font>.

831174302003732--.name: The captain was like a father to me. Before setting sail, he would often leave me messages in riddles, then ask whether I'd solved them when he returned. These $item:30000318$ are combinations made using the captain's unique code.

831174302003734--.name: You separate the combined words to uncover the meaning. The words are... <font color="#ffd200">disassemble</font>, <font color="#ffd200">lantern</font>, <font color="#ffd200">record</font>, <font color="#ffd200">treasure chest</font>, <font color="#ffd200">device</font>, <font color="#ffd200">anglerfish</font>... That's all of them.

831174302003735--.name:
Now we combine the words whose meanings connect...
A disassembly device? Does that mean there's some kind of machine that takes things apart...?
A treasure chest record? Could it mean a treasure map...?
Lantern... anglerfish...? A lantern anglerfish?

831174302003736--.name: A lantern anglerfish... I heard something from $npc:11000021[gender:0]$. When the ghost pirates held them hostage, their leader looked like a giant anglerfish with a lantern on its head. And it calls itself $npc:23100015[gender:0]$.

831175903000007--.name: Oh! This will be plenty. Thanks!

831175903000008--.name: If I lump up the $itemPlural:20000055$ and bake them in the furnace, I can make my own special cement. Could you help me?

831175903000009--.name: Don't worry if you end up needing more $itemPlural:20000055$. You can just head right back to the stream and defeat the $npcPlural:21000029$ to get them.

831175903000010--.name: Take the $itemPlural:20000055$ I gave you and make $item:30000094$ in the furnace! If you don't have enough $itemPlural:20000055$, just hunt $npcPlural:21000029$ nearby!

831175903000011--.name: Excellent! Now I can work on the bricks!

831175903000039--.name: It's high time I stop acting like a hooligan!

831175903000040--.name: Why do you want to stop?

831175903000041--.name: Lately, my hooligan friends and I have started doing a lot worse than petty crime. I've started to think, "Is it okay? Do I really want this life for myself?" Worse, the salary for hired muscle isn't nearly what it used to be.

831175903000042--.name: So I'm done with that thug life for good! I swear! But if I turn myself in, I might go to prison. I don't want to go to prison!

831175903000043--.name: I was really worried about it until I saw a bulletin board! Katvan, the leader of Dark Wind himself, is the one who posted it! "Reward! Defeat $npcPlural:29000023$ and Provide Proof to Earn Cold, Hard Mesos!"

831175903000044--.name: This is how I can redeem myself! It even said I'd be pardoned of my crimes if I can just collect some $itemPlural:30000097$!

831175903000045--.name: I heard there are $npcPlural:29000023$ hiding somewhere in $map:02000110$. The problem is, I can't show my face anywhere right now, or I'll go straight to the big house. Won't you defeat some $npcPlural:29000023$ and collect  their capes to save me from life in prison?

831175903000046--.name: You'll flush all the $npcPlural:29000023$ out of hiding if you pull on the levers you see around the area!

831175903000047--.name: Please defeat $npcPlural:29000023$ and get $itemPlural:30000097$ for me! Pull on the levers, and you're sure to find them.

831175903000048--.name: Wow! You don't know what this means to me, friend! I'm well on my way to being a reformed hooligan now!

831175903000049--.name: Why is it so noisy here?

831175903000051--.name: I had a call with my son, $npc:11000360[gender:0]$, yesterday. He said he's old enough to live on his own now, and he found a place in some swelteringly hot, noisy place called $map:02000086$.

831175903000052--.name: I knew it was a construction site, but who knew it could be so loud?

831175903000053--.name: Do you think maybe... Would you make those noisy monsters quiet down?

831175903000054--.name: How is my precious son supposed to sleep through all that racket?

831175903000055--.name: I'm doing all of this for my son. He really needs his beauty sleep!

831175903000056--.name: Please make those noisy monsters quiet down. I love my son too much to let that racket continue.

831175903000060--.name: You know my son moved here, right?

831175903000061--.name: Well, I came here for a visit, but it turns out that it's really noisy here... and really, really hot! Too hot for my liking!

831175903000062--.name: I got worried about my son and thought it would be a good idea to give him this ice pack. The trouble is, that lava is terrifying! I'm too scared to try crossing it.

831175903000063--.name: But you seem really brave. Would you please take this ice pack to my son, $npc:11000360[gender:0]$? I'm so worried he's going to pass out from heat exhaustion or something...

831175903000067--.name: The weather here is so hot that it must have melted. No worries! I've got more! Have another.

831175903000068--.name: Hm? But it's already in your bag. You should pay more attention.

831175903000069--.name: Isn't your bag full? Come to me after you empty it.

831175903000070--.name: My son, $npcName:11000360[gender:0]$ is on the other side of the lava. I wanted to visit him, but I'm just too scared to cross it myself.

831175903000071--.name: Mom? She doesn't need to worry. I'm doing just fine on my own! Parents are such worrywarts, aren't they?

831175903000263--.name: Phew! I thought I could handle it, but this heat is unbearable!

831175903000265--.name: But it's not just the heat! Some engineer didn't account for the unstable ground around here. They overdeveloped the area, and now sinkholes are opening up full of lava!

831175903000266--.name: The lava pits are a serious hazard to anyone passing through, and the heat they're giving off is unbearable.

831175903000267--.name: Please pick up some of this ice and use it to block up those lava pits. It's the only way I can think of to solve both problems at once.

831175903000268--.name: Watch out. That lava's hot, and if you aren't careful, you could fall in! As long as you do it right, you can place the ice without getting hurt.

831175903000269--.name: You know, I really didn't figure on the ice melting. But it's definitely a lot cooler now! Anyway, thanks for the help. Now I've just got to order a few dozen more tons of ice...

831175903000073--.name: What are you trying to catch?

831175903000075--.name: I set up traps on the beach to catch $npcPlural:29000033$. But those sneaky little crustaceans aren't falling for my tricky traps today. They're just too smart!

831175903000076--.name: I'll bet if I have help, I could catch a bunch of $npcPlural:29000033$ though! I've been looking forward to a tasty seafood meal for ages!

831175903000077--.name: If you've got the time, would you help me lure the nearby $npcPlural:29000033$ into the traps on the beach?

831175903000078--.name: Prep the trap by opening it, then lure the $npcPlural:29000033$ right into it.

831175903000079--.name: You'll find the traps I set up down on the beach. If you lure the $npcPlural:29000033$ into them, you'll have plenty of $itemPlural:20000056$ in no time!

831175903000080--.name: Oooh! My mouth's watering already. I can't wait to cook these beauties up! Thank you!

831175903000256--.name: What do you think? $itemPlural:30000140$! You caught so many $npcPlural:29000033$ for me, I was able to make a bunch of $itemPlural:30000140$! It's a veritable feast!!

831175903000257--.name: My cooking is amazing, and this dish turned out even better than the last time I made it. I want the world to taste my cooking! But how is anyone supposed to hear about it?

831175903000258--.name: Listen, I'll keep making $itemPlural:30000140$. While I do that, you can spread the word to tourists on the beach. What better person to tell everyone how great my food is than the person who caught the fresh ingredients for it?

831175903000259--.name: Follow the beach to the east and you're sure to find tourists. Spread the word about my $itemPlural:30000140$, so the whole world can have the best crab they've ever eaten!

831175903000262--.name: Even one is enough! So begins my career as a gourmet $item:30000140$ chef! Thank you so much!

831175903000081--.name: <font color="#909090">(This pig is no more. It has ceased to be.)</font>

831175903000083--.name: <font color="#909090">(The pig is surrounded by broken pieces of wood and a propeller that is still spinning. A cloud of dust hangs in the air, slowly settling to the ground.)</font>

831175903000084--.name: <font color="#909090">(Was this pig... trying to fly? This oddity warrants further investigation)</font>

831175903000085--.name: <font color="#909090">(It seems that before its untimely demise, this pig was attempting to fly on a homemade aircraft. It must have jumped from somewhere high. Perhaps you can retrace its short-lived journey.)</font>

831175903000086--.name: Hello, my name is Fondue. All my life I've looked up at the sky in envy of the birds who soared so freely above.

831175903000088--.name: My friends would merely laugh at me and say, "Only things with wings can fly. You don't have any." A lesser pig's dreams would be forever dashed. But I was inspired.

831175903000089--.name: Couldn't I make my own wings? Why should I settle for the way the world made me? And so I set to work, sneaking wood and tools from nearby humans. And after a long effort, my wings are finally complete!

831175903000090--.name: All that's left is to don my wings, and jump. Today is the day that a pig will finally fly!

831175903000091--.name: And so, if you are reading this, look up to the sky. That's where you'll find me. Flying free with the birds.

831175903000111--.name: Humans... they try to change everything to their taste!

831175903000113--.name: Humans are trying to develop the $map:2000017$! $npcName:11000350[gender:0]$ over there is one of them!

831175903000114--.name: I can't understand why they are trying to destroy this beautiful forest. Take this potion made from dew and spray it on the seedlings around the path!

831175903000115--.name: If they can't be driven out... I'm going to make it as difficult as possible for them to move here!

831175903000116--.name: $MyPCName$, I trust that you won't do something like $npc:11000350[gender:0]$ and build a house in my already perfect forest!

831175903000117--.name: You can get the potion from the basket next to me! Spray it in front of the portal to the human town!

831175903000118--.name: Thank you! You taught those entitled humans a lesson while protecting the forest.  I call that a win-win deal!

831175903000119--.name: Such raw power, it will be mine!

831175903000121--.name: Let me guess, you look upon what's happening here in $map:02000145$ with horror. That is because you are shortsighted! When I look out there, I see beauty!

831175903000122--.name: Observe the overwhelming power of those creatures as they overtake their prey. In nature, the strong triumph over the weak. But science is a tool that allows men to conquer nature itself!

831175903000123--.name: We need only learn to harness nature's power, a task which requires data. Unfortunately, my assistants are cowards. A few light maimings, and they abandon all of our research!
