831175903000124--.name: That data is crucial to my research, perhaps even the future of humanity!

831175903000125--.name: You'll note that this facility has three large structures. At the top of each is a computer used to store our research.

831175903000126--.name: As our network was disrupted in the first attack, the computers' data must be retrieved manually. I however, am ill suited to deal with the monsters that surround them. And so it falls to you! Will you answer science's call?

831175903000127--.name: What are you doing standing around gawking like a buffoon? Find the three computers and download their data!

831175903000128--.name: Beep! Primary ingredient is rabbit saliva infused with shadow energy. Sample Contents by volume: Rabbit Saliva 55.75%. Slime Extract 44.25%.

831175903000129--.name: Beep! Transfer data to terminal $npc:11000370$ for further analysis.

831175903000130--.name: Beep! Transfer data to terminal $npc:11000370$ for further analysis.

831175903000131--.name: Beep! High concentrations of dark energy contaminants detected. Tests Conclusion: Distillation of shadow energies viable. Prolonged exposure to sample not recommended.

831175903000132--.name: Beep! Extrapolating. Serum synthesis viable using provided formula. Transfer data to terminal $npc:11000371$ for usage analysis.

831175903000133--.name: Beep! Extrapolating. Serum synthesis viable using provided formula. Transfer data to terminal $npc:11000371$ for usage analysis.

831175903000134--.name: Beep! Analysis Findings: Injection of 29 ml distilled proteins via syringe will trigger extreme spontaneous muscle growth, and diminished brain capacity. Effects irreversible.

831175903000135--.name: Beep! Analysis concluded. Serum synthesis data processed for mass-production. Please deliver data to appropriate department representative.

831175903000136--.name: Beep! Analysis concluded. Serum synthesis data processed for mass-production. Please deliver data to appropriate department representative.

831175903000137--.name: Yes, yes! This research will prove most helpful. Hmm? Oh, you needn't worry, I will use it responsibly. Eheheh.

831175903000138--.name:
Oh great beings from beyond the stars... Hear my call!
<font color="#909090">(He stands with his eyes closed and his arms outstretched toward the sky.)</font>

831175903000140--.name: AN ALIEN!!! Huh? Oh, s-sorry... I thought you were one of them.

831175903000141--.name: I'm trying to contact the aliens watching over Maple World from above! I set up messages of love all over the $map:02000087$ for them, so they know they are welcome.

831175903000142--.name: Any alien culture advanced enough to reach our planet is probably waaaay more advanced than us. So they could squish us like bugs if they wanted to. That's why it's important to get on their good sides!

831175903000143--.name: It's been a while since I set up my signals. Would you mind checking to see if the aliens have left a response? You can find my messages all over the hilltop!

831175903000144--.name: You can find my messages all over the hilltop. Hurry and see if the aliens have responded!

831175903000145--.name: What? My neighbors are complaining about my signals? They're the idiots! The universe is too big for us to be alone. We'll see who's laughing when the invasion comes!

831175903000146--.name: All right! Ready to surmount your next challenge?

831175903000148--.name: This time, you've gotta climb your way to my buddy $npc:11000382[gender:0]$ in the $map:02000148$!

831175903000149--.name: What are you still doing here? Hurry up and climb your way to $npc:11000382[gender:0]$ in the $map:02000148$!

831175903000150--.name: Impressive! I like your gumption, pal.

831175903000151--.name: Ahh, the wind on your face and a view that can't be matched. A worthwhile reward after a long climb.

831175903000152--.name: What are you doing up here?

831175903000153--.name: Oh hey! Did you climb all the way up here? You might have what it takes to join the Wall Climbers!

831175903000154--.name: Doesn't reaching the top just fill you with a sense of serenity and accomplishment?

831175903000155--.name: In that case, maybe you would be a good fit for our crew.

831175903000156--.name: But don't get your hopes up! Not everybody has what it takes to become a Wall Climber! You'll have to go through a series of rigorous tests and come out on top. Only then will you be able to call yourself one of us.

831175903000157--.name: My associate $npc:11000379[gender:0]$ is somewhere high up in $map:02000135$. Put your climbing skills to the test, and find him.

831175903000158--.name: Put your climbing skills to the test and find $npc:11000379[gender:0]$ high above $map:02000135$!

831175903000159--.name: Well I'll be a mushroom's uncle. $npc:11000381[gender:0]$ said you were coming. Good work making it to the top!

831175903000162--.name: This time you've gotta climb your way to a cool cat named $npc:11000380[gender:0]$ at $map:02000110$.

831175903000163--.name: It's time for your final challenge! Climb your way to $npc:11000380[gender:0]$ at $map:02000110$. Well? Hop to it!

831175903000164--.name: No way, you made it all the way up here!

831175903000167--.name: It's my pleasure to officially welcome you to the ranks of the Wall Climbers! Congratulations, and keep climbing to greater heights!

831175903000187--.name: You know, I wasn't always alone like this. When I was just a sapling, I had more tree friends than leaves!

831175903000188--.name: But it's been many years since then, and all of my friends have gone. I'm so lonely. I have only myself to talk to now.

831175903000189--.name: But you... You could plant new friends for me! Red trees if you please. Not those green ones. They're notorious sunlight hogs.

831175903000190--.name: Red trees next to me, please!

831175903000191--.name: Thanks! They don't talk much now, but I'm sure they will in time.

831175903000194--.name: Haven't you heard? It's $npcName:11000406[gender:0]$</font>! $npcName:11000406[gender:0]$ is right here in $map:02000137$!

831175903000195--.name: That vacant stare on your face... Do you really not know who $npcName:11000406[gender:0]$ is?! Have you been living under a rock?

831175903000196--.name: $npcName:11000406[gender:0]$ is a really, really, really, ridiculously good looking superstar sensation with the voice of an angel. His singles constantly top the charts. Ladies want him, and men want to be him!

831175903000197--.name:
And he's RIGHT OVER THERE ON THAT STAGE! I have to get a picture of him...
<font color="#909090">(She stares intently into the distance, her breathing intensifying).</font>

831175903000198--.name: His stupid bodyguards are confiscating cameras from anybody who gets too close. Somebody could climb up that building <b>to the left of the stage</b to get a picture…

831175903000199--.name: But since that building is swarming with monsters, all I can do is stand here and stamp my feet.

831175903000200--.name: I can't let $npcName:11000406[gender:0]$ just swoop out of my life without at least some kind of memento. But you... You could get past those monsters! Would you please take some pictures of $npcName:11000406[gender:0]$ without getting caught by his bodyguards?

831175903000201--.name: Here you can use my camera. Won't you help a girl in love? Just get me some shots from a few different angles. Pleeeeeeaaase?

831175903000202--.name: What are you doing back here?

831175903000205--.name: WHAT?! Do you know how much I spent on that camera? Sigh, it's a good thing I've got extras.

831175903000206--.name: What? It's right there in your bag!

831175903000207--.name: There's no room in your bag! Let me know when you've made some space.

831175903000208--.name:
What are you waiting for? Go get me some pictures of $npcName:11000406[gender:0]$!
<font color="#909090">(She stares off into the distance and starts to drool.)</font>

831175903000209--.name: Wow! Thank you so much! I'm going to keep these pictures under my pillow, heehee!

831175903000240--.name: This is such pitiful art. It's breaking my heart.

831175903000242--.name: Yo! Have you seen my magnificent art all over $map:02000110$?

831175903000243--.name: What do you mean you don't know which art is mine? The magnificent ones are mine, of course! It's that weird mushroom stuff that's bringing down the class in this joint!

831175903000244--.name: Don't you agree? I don't know who that artist is, but they're cramping my style. They must be stopped!

831175903000245--.name: I'm going to find out who is doing this. In the mean time, you can go around and erase all those lame mushrooms! Just make sure you don't mess up my stuff by mistake, okay? It's gonna make me famous!

831175903000246--.name: What are you doing wasting time?! Hurry up and erase those mushrooms! I can't stand too look at them anymore!

831175903000247--.name: You're sure you got them all? Good! You're the best!

831175903000248--.name: I finally found the culprit behind that eyesore art!

831175903000250--.name: It's some hack named $npc:11000412[gender:0]$ living in $map:02000086$! Pah! That name is almost as pathetic as their art.

831175903000251--.name: $MyPCName$! I need you to go to $npc:11000412[gender:0]$'s hideout in $map:02000086$ and replace all the art around their house with mine! I know you're not an artist but, it's more about payback than quality now anyway.

831175903000252--.name: Time for some sweet revenge! I need you to go to $npc:11000412[gender:0]$'s hideout in $map:02000086$ and replace all the art around their house with mine!

831175903000253--.name: Hey! I saw your art in $map:02000110$, and it's actually pretty cool. I guess we're kindred artist spirits, huh?

831175903000270--.name: A real adventurer feels no pain!

831175903000272--.name: Strength and daring, of course! Do you think you've got what it takes to be a real adventurer?

831175903000274--.name: Ha! Maybe you think so, but you look weak to me. I'll bet you can't even handle a pinch on the arm!

831175903000275--.name: You disagree? All right then. If you're so great, then prove it, hot shot! Bring me some of the $itemPlural:20000061$ that grow in the lava! Survive the heat, and I might just consider you worthy of my respect!

831175903000276--.name: What? You still haven't gotten the $itemPlural:20000061$? You're scared, aren't you. I'll bet if you put some thought into it, you could figure out a way to get it without going into the lava.

831175903000277--.name: Wow, you actually did it! Did you really go into the lava to get them?

831175903000280--.name: Good job! I can admit when I'm wrong. You're a lot tougher than I thought!

831175903000281--.name: I can't believe you actually got the $itemPlural:20000061$!

831175903000282--.name: Adventurers should go on adventures all the time!

831175903000283--.name: Now what are you talking about?

831175903000284--.name: So, how did it feel to pluck those $itemPlural:20000061$ straight out of that lava? I've got to say, I find adventures like that to be completely exhilarating! You must be flying right now!

831175903000285--.name: Of course. Who doesn't love a good soak in hot lava?

831175903000286--.name: Well, now I've got another adventure that's sure to make your heart race! The Twingo workers around here mine something that's really hard to get. It's called $item:30000142$.

831175903000287--.name: Now, the $npcPlural:21000086$ do the really tough work on the night shift. That's why they take a lot of naps.

831175903000288--.name: So here's what I want you to do. Wake up the sleeping $npcPlural:21000086$ and while they're still confused, take them down and steal their $itemPlural:30000142$! If that doesn't get your heart racing, I don't know what will!

831175903000289--.name: Follow the lava all the way down there, then bang on the smelting furnace to wake the $npcPlural:21000086$! They'll be so dazed, they won't know what hit 'em! Haha!

831175903000290--.name: Just follow the lava down, and you can't miss the smelting furnace. Ha! These are the kind of adventures I live for!

831175903000291--.name: You really did it! You really are a true adventurer!

831175903000292--.name: Hmph! How rude! There's just no respect for business ethics anymore!

831175903000294--.name: My mom owns a fish store here in $map:02000111$, but business has gotten really tough recently.

831175903000295--.name: She was doing really well until $npc:11000362[gender:0]$ came and opened up a $item:30000140$ business! Now she can't get customers to even glance her direction.

831175903000296--.name: I can't sit by and watch my mom's business fail! Ugh! I hate competition. What happened to a good old corner on the market?

831175903000297--.name: We've got to tip the scales back in our favor. Stack those tubes over the $npc:29000033$ traps $npc:11000362[gender:0]$ set up! That'll teach him not to interfere with our business!

831175903000298--.name: It's his own fault! He should have known better than to come into our territory and disrupt our business.

831175903000299--.name: Quick! Put the stack of tubes on the traps. Business is getting worse by the second!

831175903000300--.name: Good job! I would have liked to solve this amicably, but this is a cold, rough world. Sometimes you've got to be aggressive!

831175903000303--.name: Well, we hardly sold any fish today, but our display is almost completely empty. There should be a lot more there...

831175903000304--.name: There must be a fish thief in our midst! They're out to sabotage me!

831175903000306--.name: I am not! I'll bet you anything those $npcPlural:21000101$ in the center of town are up to no good!

831175903000307--.name: I'm so furious! $MyPCName$, I need you to go to the center of town, lay down the law with those $npcPlural:21000101$, and get my fish back. I refuse to tolerate thieves!

831175903000308--.name:
I knew this would happen the moment those $npcPlural:21000101$ came to $map:02000111$!
I need you to go to the center of town and teach those meanies a lesson!

831175903000309--.name: You're back! But where are the fish?

831175903000310--.name: It turns out they weren't the fish thieves.

831175903000311--.name: Wh-what? Hmph! Fine, just forget it! Whether they stole the fish or not, those $npcPlural:21000101$ still needed to be taught a lesson. They cause so much trouble!

831175903000314--.name: My mom said drinking milk would make me taller, but I drank until I hurled, and I haven't grown an inch!

831175903000315--.name: Look at those $npcPlural:21099049$ that wander around here. How did they get so tall?

831175903000316--.name: There must be some secret allowing them to bulk up so quick.

831175903000317--.name: I tried to ask one but he threw a tire at me... You look tough though. Would you mind investigating those crates of mysterious pill bottles they keep around?

831175903000318--.name: Just rummage through those crates down there and let me know what you find!

831175903000319--.name: Oh man! This'll make me tall, right? All right bottle of mystery pills, down the hatch!

831175903000322--.name: Ahh! Oh, hey. You see all those $npcPlural:29000025$ in the maintenance tunnel behind me? If somebody doesn't do something, they're gonna keep multiplying.

831175903000323--.name: Okay, so do something about them.

831175903000324--.name:
That's what I was about to do right before you interrupted me! I've just... Gotta do some spider-squishing warm-ups first.
<font color="#909090"> (He starts stomping back and forth.)</font>

831175903000327--.name: I've just gotta get my stompers ready before I go crawling into that dark, web-covered death trap, okay? If you're in such a hurry, why don't you go in there and squish them?!

831175903000329--.name: Well, get to work then! I was totally going to squish them all when I finished my warm up, but since you've volunteered...

831175903000330--.name: Weren't you going to squish those spiders? Don't tell me you're backing out now!

831175903000331--.name: Oh man, you squished them all? That's a real shame, I was just about to send them on a one-way trip to Stomptown. Oh well, thanks!

831175903000465--.name: Oh man... That was too close…

831175903000467--.name: Huh? Oh, hey. I'm $npcName:11000599[gender:0]$, treasure hunter extraordinaire.

831175903000468--.name: I was checking out the tunnels behind me. Seemed like the perfect place to hide a treasure chest…

831175903000469--.name: Well, there wasn't a treasure chest. Instead, there were falling rocks!

831175903000470--.name: My foot got stuck and I had to leave my lucky shoe behind to escape.

831175903000471--.name: Do me a solid and find it, would you? The entrance to the tunnel system is behind me, just past the "do not enter" sign.

831175903000472--.name: Sure, I have these spare shoes, but that was my lucky shoe. Good luck in those tunnels.

831175903000473--.name: Oh man, my shoe is a mess. It's still lucky, I guess... Thanks for your help.

831175903000480--.name: We Kiyos are great flyers, but even we need to practice. It's not as though we're born knowing how to fly...

831175903000481--.name: But good luck getting my good-for-nothing husband to acknowledge that!

831175903000482--.name: $npcName:11000630[gender:0]$ said he'd teach the kids how to fly. So what does he do? He zooms off to the other side of the mountain and tells them to catch him if they can!

831175903000483--.name: My poor babies! That's too far for little buzzards to fly on their own.

831175903000484--.name: Please save my babies! They're probably crying for help down below…

831175903000485--.name: My babies, my babies. You must save my babies!

831175903000486--.name: Ha! Look at the little brats go! I told $npcName:11000629[gender:1]$ she was worried for nothing!

831175903000487--.name: Sigh. I suppose there's no helping it.

831175903000489--.name: After recent developments in my research, I thought I would finally be able to realize a project of great importance to me.

831175903000490--.name: However, things did not turn out as I had hoped...

831175903000491--.name: We face many setbacks in science. Sometimes they change things for good. But the science... The science must go on.

831175903000492--.name: Below us is the $map:02000240$. Inside, you will find what remains of my experiment.

831175903000494--.name: Please... Go down there and end the abomination that lies within. It will bring nothing to this world but pain.

831175903000495--.name: T-that note... Give that to me! You didn't read it, did you?

831175903000497--.name: Merely a memory. One that should never have been unearthed.

831175903000498--.name: Thank you. Now, I'd like to be left alone... I... I have much science to conduct.

831175903000499--.name: I won't have this. I can't have it! This is unacceptable!

831175903000500--.name: What are you going on about?

831175903000501--.name: It's the T'oomba! It's all their fault!

831175903000502--.name: The $map:02000048$ is my home. See the tipis everywhere? Those belonged to my neighbors!

831175903000503--.name: Did the T'oomba care? Nooooo! They showed up one day and kicked us out of our own homes! Those good-for-nothing so-and-sos...

831175903000504--.name: Oh, they think they can boss us around because there are more of them and they're stronger than us.

831175903000505--.name: But I'll show them. I'll show them all!

831175903000506--.name: You! Help me out. Gather a bunch of $item:30000198$ for me. There should be plenty laying around here.

831175903000507--.name: You go get that $itemPlural:30000198$. I've got a plan...

831175903000508--.name: The $map:02000048$ used to be a mine. You'll find the $item:30000198$ in no time.

831175903000509--.name: This $item:30000198$ will do. This will do quite nicely...

831175903000512--.name: I can't fight the T'oomba. I can't take our homes back. There's only one thing I can do...

831175903000513--.name: I'll burn it all to the ground!!

831175903000515--.name: Of course I have! I'm not a madwoman, after all. But if we can't have our houses, then no one can!

831175903000516--.name: Don't hold back. Teach the T'oomba a lesson they'll never forget!

831175903000520--.name: How can you be so irresponsible? Luckily for you, I have plenty to spare. Now get back to committing arson!

831175903000521--.name: It's in your hand! Pay attention. You still have homes to burn down!

831175903000522--.name: Losing your home is the worst feeling in the world. I want the T'oomba to know exactly how that feels.

831175903000523--.name: Yes, burn... Burn! The T'oomba deserve what they got! Thanks. You're a real hero.

831175903000593--.name: You didn't, did you? It's the wildest rumor I've ever heard of!

831175903000594--.name: Just tell me the rumor already!

831175903000595--.name: There's this wolf statue on the northwestern side of town, right? Well, I heard that it's actually alive!

831175903000598--.name: When the moon is full at night, it howls and howls! Just like a real wolf!

831175903000599--.name: How do you know you aren't hearing some other wolf?

831175903000600--.name: No, this howl is different. Trust me.

831175903000601--.name: This howl was... it was filled with pain…

831175903000602--.name: $npcName:11000136[gender:1]$ didn't believe the rumors at first, either, but now she's looking for someone to help her get to the bottom of it.

831175903000603--.name: If you're so sure it's nothing, why don't you take a look for yourself? The wolf statue is on a tower in northwestern $map:02000051$!

831175903000604--.name: But, if you do discover something, you let $npcName:11000136[gender:1]$ know right away, okay?

831175903000605--.name: What have you got for me?

831175903000606--.name: This is $npcName:11000694[gender:0]$'s handwriting. I haven't seen him in ages…

831175903000607--.name: I found it in the attic of the $map:02000081$.

831175903000609--.name: This makes sense. And how is this note connected to the rumors about the howling wolf?

831175903000610--.name: $MyPCName$, can you go back to the attic in the $map:02000081$?

831175903000611--.name: Find a nice cozy place to hide. Somewhere you can see everything...

831175903000612--.name: If this is really his note, then maybe $npcName:11000694[gender:0]$ will show up if he thinks he's alone. Then you can jump out and get some answers from him!

831175903000613--.name: I'll leave you to stake out the $map:02000081$ and get answers from $npcName:11000694[gender:0]$. I've got to keep an eye on the pack.

831175903000615--.name: Sure, I found him. Then he turned into a wolf!

831175903000618--.name: I didn't exactly have a choice.

831175903000619--.name: Th-thanks for your help. I need some time to figure out what's going on...

831175903000691--.name: I'm depressed. I'm despondent. I'm just plain sad! I miss the music of the garden…

831175903000692--.name: I could play you a tune.

831175903000693--.name: That won't put the pep back in my step, I'm afraid. It's the music of our enchanted fountain that I miss! I don't know why it went silent, but I have some ideas…

831175903000694--.name: I've noticed strange totems around here lately. I think they've cursed the fountain with quietness!

831175903000695--.name: If the fountain doesn't sing, then all of the wondrous beauty of the gardens will wither up and die. It's science.

831175903000696--.name: I'm begging you! Please, find the totems and get rid of them. It's the gardens' only hope!

831175903000697--.name: If the fountain doesn't sing, then all of the wondrous beauty of the gardens will wither up and die. It's science. I'm begging you! Please, find the totems and get rid of them. It's the gardens' only hope!

831175903000698--.name: You got rid of the totems, right? So the music will come back now, right?!

831175903000699--.name: But it's still so quiet. Quickly now! Take the ladder over there and find my brother, $npcName:11000891[gender:0]$.

831175903000700--.name: You tell him what happened! He'll know what to do.

831175903000701--.name: I'd go with you, but I need to keep an eye on this rainbow! Quickly now. $npcName:11000891[gender:0]$ needs to know what we did.

831175903000702--.name: Stop right there! What do you think you're doing?

831175903000703--.name: $npc:11000890[gender:1]$ sent me. We got rid of the totems.

831175903000704--.name: That was you? What a relief…

831175903000705--.name: Thing is... our trouble's just getting started.

831175903000707--.name: There are three fairfolk who watch over the fountain here. I need a special $item:30000261$ to summon them, but it was kind of... stolen.

831175903000708--.name: Have you seen the $npcPlural:21000065$ wandering around the gardens? One of them ran off with the flute.

831175903000710--.name: You will? I'm counting on you! The $npc:21000065$ who took the $item:30000261$ must still be around here somewhere.

831175903000711--.name: Did you get the $item:30000261$ back yet?

831175903000712--.name: Wow, you're amazing! Now we can get the guardian fairfolk here and put them to work!

831175903000713--.name: Since you did all the hard work, I think it's only fair that you get to summon the guardian fairfolk.

831175903000715--.name: It's easy! See the fountain over there?

831175903000716--.name: Walk right up to it, put this $item:30000261$ up to your lips, and blow!

831175903000717--.name: You didn't lose the $item:30000261$, did you? It's a long drop down from here. One of the $npcPlural:21000065$ might have picked it up...

831175903000719--.name: The Picchu Picchus will never forget you, friend.

831175903000720--.name: <font color="#909090">(This board has a fresh bulletin posted to it. It looks like a commission to hunt monsters in the $map:02000095$.)</font>

831175903000722--.name: The monsters in the $map:02000095$ are a plague on the Picchu Picchu tribe!

831175903000723--.name: Are you a fighter? Are you addicted to the thrill of battle? Then we need you to fight for the future of the Picchu Picchu!

831175903000724--.name: Are you a fighter? Are you addicted to the thrill of battle? Then we need you to fight for the future of the Picchu Picchu!

831175903000725--.name: On behalf of the tribe, thank you to all the heroes who fight to keep the $map:02000095$ safe.

831175903000726--.name: Your reward has been attached to this thank-you note. Please only take your fair share. By working together, the gardens can once again be a marvel of nature enjoyed by all!

831175903000820--.name: I didn't even tell her goodbye. I have failed as a mate…

831175903000822--.name: I am blind, but in my mind's eye, I see visions. Visions of distant places and of the future.

831175903000823--.name: These past few nights, I have dreamt of my mate. I see Anka standing alone in a desolate wasteland. A dark shadow passes over her, and when it passes, only her fur remains…

831175903000824--.name: I could not accept it, but now... now I'm sure something terrible has happened to her.

831175903000825--.name: You don't know that for sure.

831175903000826--.name: I appreciate the thought, but I know it to be true. If only I had $item:30000270$... to give her a proper burial...

831175903000827--.name: An old blind wolf like me wouldn't survive $map:02000267$, but you could go there. Please, find my mate. Or what remains of her...

831175903000828--.name: In my dream, $item:30000270$ was burning amongst the lava flows. I don't know why she would have gone to such a dangerous place.

831175903000829--.name: If... If you do find her fur, find somewhere in a sunny place to lay her to rest. Help her find peace in the afterlife.

831175903000830--.name: Truly, I am wretched. All I can do is beg a stranger to do this thing in my place...

831175903000831--.name: In my dream, $item:30000270$ is nestled in the lava flows of $map:02000267$. If you find her there, please find somewhere sunny to lay her to rest.

831175903000832--.name: I have been watching for you to return. My vision has often been a boon, but it failed me when I needed it most...

831175903000833--.name: I am pleased that she is at rest, at least. The love and warmth that she embodied in life continues on with the ancestors. Thank you.

831175903000834--.name: Just look at this place. It's a cesspool of pollution thanks to the fat cats who rule $map:02000100$. It's a tale as old as time.

831175903000835--.name: Rich companies get folks elected to city hall, who furnish them with private contracts in the name of "industrialization" and "development." The companies cut corners during production. Toxic chemicals enter the environment, and the city covers it up. And then...

831175903000837--.name: Giant mutant frogs is what happens! I keep telling people, you can do things the right way and still make a profit. But they're insatiable. They're got to have every last meso they can squeeze out of you, no matter the cost.

831175903000838--.name: Okay, but... How do you even get mutant frogs?

831175903000839--.name: Easy. The frogs live in the brook. Improperly disposed industrial waste gets into that brook and mixes up their DNA. Next thing you know, the frogs weigh a thousand pounds and are dressing themselves like some kind of royalty!

831175903000840--.name: We call it $npc:23000013[gender:0]$, because that's what his stomping sounds like when you hear him coming. Really, that frog is prodigiously fat. It's kind of impressive.

831175903000841--.name: Anyway, city hall knows all about our buddy $npc:23000013[gender:0]$ here, but they couldn't do anything about him if they wanted to, and they don't. You know this place used to be a purification facility? Well, now it's where they dump their sludge, which I can only assume forms the base of $npc:23000013[gender:0]$'s diet.

831175903000842--.name: Is there something I can do to help?

831175903000843--.name: Help? You could start by putting $npc:23000013[gender:0]$ out of our misery, but really that's as good as shutting the stable door after the horses have bolted. Failing that, just get out of my face. I've already got a headache from this smell.

831175903000844--.name: If you can't solve corporate greed, you could at least get rid of $npc:23000013[gender:0]$. It'd be one less thing I have to smell in the morning.

831175903000845--.name: Wait, what? You really got rid of fatso the frog?

831175903000847--.name: Well I'll be! Now if you could just address the corrupting influence of capitalism that spawned this whole mess, maybe we could start turning this water back the color it was before. You heard me. That green stuff down there is crisp, refreshing water. Yum yum!

831175903000848--.name: No? Well, it was worth a try. Now if you'll excuse me, I'm off to toil for an unlivable wage so my kids can live in above-average squalor on a quietly dying rock.

831175903000861--.name: They say that no news is good news, but I've got a bad feeling about this.

831175903000862--.name: The captain sent a squad out a few days ago, and we haven't heard a peep from them since. They should be back by now.

831175903000863--.name: There have been all kinds of rumors about the $map:02000013$ lately. We didn't take it seriously, but now I'm wondering if we should have…

831175903000864--.name: If you happen to be headed out that way, would you mind swinging by the $map:02000013$ to see if my fellow Green Hoods are still there?

831175903000865--.name: The captain is all about following procedures and making regular reports. The squad we sent to the $map:02000013$ wouldn't go this long without checking in. I'm worried...

831175903000866--.name: Huh? What are you doing in this remote place?

831175903000867--.name: $npc:11000961[gender:1]$ sent me to check on you.

831175903000868--.name: I-I knew it... I knew $npc:11000961[gender:1]$ wouldn't forget about us! Listen, the situation here is bad.

831175903000869--.name: We're fighting for our lives out here. Things seemed peaceful at first, but then a whole mess of monsters appeared from nowhere and ambushed us.

831175903000870--.name: We've got wounded, and we don't have the medicine we need to cure them. We don't even have any basic field supplies left...

831175903000872--.name: Me? I'm fine. It's the others that I'm worried about. If you're here to help, go find them, first.

831175903000874--.name: Find $npcName:11000832[gender:1]$. She's the only person treating the wounded right now.

831175903000875--.name: I'll head back to $map:02000076$ and get reinforcements.

831175903000876--.name: Find $npcName:11000832[gender:1]$! She can't heal all the injured Green Hoods on her own.

831175903000877--.name: $npc:11000962[gender:1]$ must have sent you. Glad to hear she's still on her feet!

831175903000878--.name: I'm $npcName:11000832$. Quiet, you fool! This is no time for introductions!

831175903000879--.name: You seem fit enough for the job. There's no time to waste. Get to it!

831175903000881--.name: Helping the injured, of course! I'm fresh out of medicine, and their prognosis is not good without it.

831175903000882--.name: Luckily, I happen to know a thing or two about field chemistry. You'd be surprised at all the tinctures and cures you can make up with the right mixture of goo and gunk!

831175903000883--.name: What goo and gunk do you need?

831175903000884--.name: Oh, good question! Let's see. A handful of $item:30000285$ and a cup of $itemPlural:30000286$ should do the trick!

831175903000885--.name: The area is teeming with $npcPlural:21000353$ and $npcPlural:21000003$, so this should be a piece of cake for you. Probably.

831175903000886--.name: Hunt the $npcPlural:21000353$ and $npcPlural:21000003$ nearby. Get $item:30000285$ and $itemPlural:30000286$. Simple, no?

831175903000887--.name: There you are. I hope you didn't sample any of the ingredients while you were collecting them—I may have forgotten to mention they're pretty poisonous on their own.

831175903000888--.name: Anyway, this should be enough to keep our medicine cabinets full. For now.

831175903000889--.name: It's going to take me a while to mash this goop into something usable. In the meantime, I need you to check on my patients.

831175903000890--.name: I've enlisted the aid of a traveling merchant named $npcName:11000963[gender:0]$. Go find him on the hill west of here.

831175903000891--.name: The folks here deserve better than this. But I gotta say, my supplies are running low and I don't really know what I'm doing.

831175903000892--.name: The nice lady over the hill gave me this medicine to ease the pain of all the injured people on the path below. I think you're better suited to that particular job.

831175903000893--.name: I'm going to take a quick breather, then I'll head out and get more medicine from $npcName:11000832[gender:1]$. Good luck down there!

831175903000894--.name: It won't cure them, but that $item:30000287$ should help with the pain.

831175903000895--.name: I might have used up all the $item:30000287$.

831175903000897--.name: You already ran out of $item:30000287$? I'm practically out of it, myself. I've gotta get back to $npcName:11000832[gender:1]$ for more...

831175903000898--.name: I don't exactly have enough of the stuff. You'll have to make due with however much you have left for now.

831175903000899--.name: Your bag is stuffed to the brim! Drop some stuff and ask me again.

831175903000900--.name: We don't have time for this. Please hurry.

831175903000901--.name: That stuff was potent. I saw a bunch of the survivors run off towards $map:02000076$!

831175903000902--.name: What about you? Need some ointment?

831175903000903--.name: Oh, no, no, I'm fine! Thank you for offering, though. Mighty kind of you.

831175903000904--.name: Besides, teamwork is the best medicine. Or maybe kindness? Whatever it is, your good acts today have put a smile on my face.

831175903000905--.name: I don't know what happened here. Honestly, I'm not sure I even care.

831175903000906--.name: Look at those hideous creatures, swarming the fortress below. I've seen my share of action in my time with the militia, but this…

831175903000907--.name: But if I let something like a little monster army be the end of me, I'd be a disgrace to the Green Hoods!

831175903000908--.name: $MyPCName$, stand with me. We're the only ones left who can hold the fort!

831175903000909--.name: I'll snipe any monsters trying to scale the walls. I want you on the ground, cutting through the $npcPlural:21000003$, $npcPlural:21000353$, and $npcPlural:21000306$ below.

831175903000910--.name: There's an army of $npcPlural:21000003$, $npcPlural:21000353$, and $npcPlural:21000306$ at the base of the $map:02000013$. I suggest we do something to thin their numbers.

831175903000911--.name: Blast it! We've hardly put a dent in their numbers. At least you've bought us some time to regroup...

831175903000912--.name: When I get back to $map:02000076$, I'm letting $npc:11000015[gender:1]$ know that we couldn't have held this place without you.

831175903000913--.name: Persistent gnat! Unsightly cretin! Have you come to taunt me with your CLANG CLANG and your THUMP THUMP and your... ugh! ...trendy music?

831175903000915--.name: Don't interrupt me! I'm asking the questions here! If I hear another peep from you, I'll beat you 'round the ears!

831175903000917--.name: Well, speak up! Are you deaf?!

831175903000918--.name: You told me not to say anything!

831175903000919--.name: And you'd do well to do so! Honestly, kids these days. It's impossible to have a civilized conversation with the likes of you…

831175903000920--.name: What's got you in such a tizzy?

831175903000921--.name: Don't you hear all that banging and clanging just outside my door? It's enough to drive a man mad! Trendy, uncultured drivel!

831175903000922--.name: A man of culture—like me—should only subject himself to the finest of concertos! If you really aren't with them, then it is your duty to society to drive them from this place!

831175903000923--.name: Sure. Who am I evicting, exactly?

831175903000924--.name: I hesitate to say their names, lest the mere act of speaking them lowers my standing in polite society! But it must be done. I would have you defeat the $npcPlural:21000173$... ugh! ...and the $npcPlural:21000278$. Disgusting!

831175903000925--.name: I cannot tolerate such uncouth percussion! Defeat the $npcPlural:21000173$... ugh! ...and the $npcPlural:21000278$.

831175903000926--.name: Yes, yes, that's better. Say what you will about the peasantry, but you lot do know a thing or two about brute strength.

831175903000927--.name: That will be all. I have my compositions to return to, and you really belong... Well, anywhere that isn't here, I suppose.

831175903000928--.name: You just can't stay away, can you? It doesn't matter what you are—man, woman, disgruntled chicken—I'm simply irresistable! It's enough to get on a gal's nerves, I tell you. And this terrible hunger is not helping.

831175903000929--.name: It's almost swimsuit season here in the $map:02000186$, so I'm working on shedding some pounds, but... this diet hasn't even shed one pound yet!

831175903000930--.name: I don't get it. I made a super strict diet plan and everything! It makes no sense.

831175903000931--.name: There's a lot that doesn't make sense here…

831175903000932--.name: Stop mumbling to yourself and help me. That's what you hero-types do, isn't it?

831175903000933--.name: There's a lady uphill from here, $npcName:11000974[gender:1]$. I hear she knows all about cooking.

831175903000934--.name: Show her my diet regimen and figure out what I'm doing wrong. There's no point starving myself if I'm not getting my beach bod back!

831175903000935--.name: What's the hold up? My diet regimen won't bring itself to $npcName:11000974[gender:1]$!

831175903000936--.name: I may have lost the regimen...

831175903000938--.name: Pay attention! I only have so many of these. If I didn't know any better, I'd think you were trying to sabotage my diet...

831175903000939--.name: I can see it sticking out of your pack! You aren't trying to steal my secret diet plan, are you? For shame!

831175903000940--.name: Your bag could stand to lose some weight, too! Drop some of the garbage and I'll give you another copy.

831175903000941--.name: Hurry! Time waits for no $male:man,female:woman$, and swimsuit season is almost here!

831175903000942--.name: Oh my! Look at all the rich food on this regimen. Surely this isn't meant to be a diet...?

831175903000943--.name: If someone were to eat all of this food in a single day... Why, it's enough to kill a normal human!

831175903000945--.name: Is that so? This might be an interesting challenge. All right, I'll try my best!

831175903000946--.name: She'll be the slimmest pig in the pen. Hmm... am I allowed to say that? Anyway, I've got a delicious dish in store for her!

831175903000948--.name: I call it $item:30000292$! I don't have all of the ingredients I need, though. Help a lady out?

831175903000950--.name: Let's see here... $itemPlural:30000289$, $itemPlural:30000290$, and... $itemPlural:30000291$! Yes, those ingredients will do.

831175903000951--.name: You can get $itemPlural:30000289$ from $npcNamePlural:21000160$. $itemPlural:30000289$ grow on the trees around here and there are $itemPlural:30000291$ all over the place.

831175903000952--.name: Such lovely, fresh ingredients! Give me just a moment to pack this lunch box.

831175903000953--.name: Ta-da! Presenting $item:30000292$! Doesn't it smell good?

831175903000954--.name: Hurry it over to $npcName:11000973[gender:1]$ while it's still hot.

831175903000955--.name: Oh! And let her know that I threw away her old diet regimen and put a new one in the lunch box.

831175903000956--.name: I'd like $npcName:11000973[gender:1]$ to try the lunch before it gets cold, if at all possible. May I help you?

831175903000959--.name: I'm a little hurt you lost it, to be honest. Oh well. I'll whip up another box, I suppose!

831175903000960--.name: Oh-ho! You're a busy one, aren't you? The lunch box is in your bag. I can smell it from here!

831175903000961--.name: Oh dear! Your bag is full, I'm afraid. Are you sure you can't make any room?

831175903000962--.name: There aren't any preservatives in my cooking, so please get the lunch box to $npcName:11000973[gender:1]$ straight away. Until next time!

831175903000963--.name: Mm, what's that smell? It's so... sweet!

831175903000964--.name:
<font color="#909090">(She snatches $item:30000292$ from your hands and gobbles it down.)</font>
This's supposed to be healthy? Really? But it's so good!

831175903000965--.name: That's it! Starting today, I'm on $npcName:11000974[gender:1]$'s diet!

831175903000966--.name: With this diet and my natural good looks, I'll be unstoppable! Now, if only the beach wasn't so far away...

831175903000976--.name: Hey, kid! You see that? My punch flew at the speed of light!

831175903000978--.name: Hmph, of course you didn't. My fists are too fast to be seen by the naked eye!

831175903000979--.name: But... Oh oh! I threw out my shoulder. That smarts.

831175903000981--.name: O-of course I look fine! A martial arts master never reveals his weaknesses. I wouldn't want my opponent to see any openings, eh?

831175903000982--.name: Aaaanyway... Since I need a minute to, um, set my shoulder, I can't collect the $itemPlural:30000294$ I came here for.

831175903000984--.name: You ever hear of the Black Bamboo School? They—I mean, we're a school of the most powerful martial artists in the world. And our big tournament is coming out.

831175903000985--.name: I need those $itemPlural:30000294$ to gain entry into the tournament and rise to the head of the school, but my shoulder…

831175903000986--.name: You aren't busy, are you? Stroll on down to the lava flows and pick some $itemPlural:30000294$ for me.

831175903000987--.name: You aren't busy, are you? Stroll on down to the lava flows and pick some $itemPlural:30000294$ for me.

831175903000988--.name: Oh, they look just like they did in those old books! Yes! With these, the Black Bamboo School will have to let me join!

831175903000989--.name: I thought you were already a member.

831175903000990--.name: Ahem! Did I say become a member? I meant... become the leader! Wa-tcha!

831175903000991--.name: A martial artist always repays his favors. Come find the Black Bamboo School someday and ask for $npcName:11000976[gender:0]$ if you ever need help.

831175903000992--.name: This is a catastrophe! It is nearly time to begin our prayers, but I'm not nearly ready.

831175903000994--.name: My people wake up every 777 days and devote ourselves to the rituals of our god... which, incidentally, also take 777 days.When we're done, we go back to sleep for another 777 days, and so on.

831175903000995--.name: The humans of Perion know little of us, because we spend most of our lives either sleeping or tending to our duties. But we are as tied to this land as they are.

831175903000996--.name: This place is holy to my people's god, and he is not a patient deity. The flowing lava is proof of his displeasure that the prayers have been delayed. Lava and heat are pretty motivating when you're made of straw...

831175903000997--.name: I must complete the ritual and begin our 777 days of prayer before we all burn away. But this is not something I can do alone! For the sake of the kunkun, please help me gather the ritual components!

831175903000999--.name: Hunt the monsters sent to test my people and retrieve their $itemPlural:30000295$, $itemPlural:30000296$, and $itemPlural:30000297$.

831175903001000--.name: These monsters are the $npcNamePlural:21000374$, $npcNamePlural:21000377$, and $npcNamePlural:21000303$, and they wield terrible powers of flame. Sometimes I think our god doesn't like us very much...

831175903001001--.name: Hunt the $npcNamePlural:21000374$, $npcNamePlural:21000377$, and $npcNamePlural:40000038$. Retrieve the $itemPlural:30000295$, $itemPlural:30000296$, and $itemPlural:30000297$.

831175903001002--.name: Kunba, oh, kunba, oh, kunbaba kunbaba kunba, oh! That is everything I need. Now we must awaken the $npcNamePlural:11000978[gender:0]$ who will join me in our prayer.

831175903001003--.name: The shamans are nearing the end of their 777-day slumber. Find their huts and shake the last of the sleep from their eyes.

831175903001004--.name: If even a single shaman is missing, we will incur our god's wrath. And, you guessed it, that means more fire.

831175903001005--.name: It may seem rude to awaken my fellow shamans from their huts, but it will be much more rude if our god awakens them with fire and brimstone.

831175903001006--.name: Everything is ready and I must begin my 777 days of prayer. When I am done, I shall grant you a great blessing as thanks for the service you have done for the kunkun.

831175903001032--.name: I... I can make it work! I don't care of the others think I'm mad. I won't give up on them...

831175903001034--.name: It's my finest creations, the $npcPlural:21000241[gender:0]$. I created them to defend $map:02000023$. At first, it was going so well!

831175903001036--.name: I assembled them each by hand. Chassis, arms, legs, and an advanced chipset that gave them intelligence and... life...

831175903001037--.name: I don't know where it all went so wrong. The robots started attacking people and tearing down trees. It breaks my heart, but there's no other choice. They must be...

831175903001038--.name: No! No, I can't do it. Please, you have to act in my place. Destroy the $npcPlural:21000241[gender:0]$ before they cause any more damage...

831175903001039--.name: No! No, I can't do it. Please, you have to act in my place. Destroy the $npcPlural:21000241[gender:0]$ before they cause any more damage...

831175903001041--.name: I can't give up yet. I'll rebuild them with a better AI, even if it takes me another forty years!

831175903001042--.name: Data doesn't lie. If I analyze it long enough, then I can find the source of the error.

831175903001043--.name: I'm afraid I need to rely on you one more time. While I get started up here, can you copy the data from my computer?

831175903001044--.name: Take this chip and download all of my research records onto it.

831175903001045--.name: Just insert the $item:30000302$ into the console below. The computer will take care of the rest automatically.

831175903001048--.name: You need to pay more attention, kid. Luckily, I've got plenty of $itemPlural:30000302$ to spare. Here you go.

831175903001049--.name: And what's that in your bag, hm? Looks like a $item:30000302$ to me.

831175903001050--.name: Hey! These $itemPlural:30000302$ are fragile. Make some room in your bag or it'll get crushed under all that other junk!

831175903001052--.name: Good. I don't know how long it will take, but I will not rest until I've succeeded with this research!

831175903001053--.name: I will prove that I'm not mad with my next batch of high-power combat droids. Then they'll have no choice but to call me a genius!

831175903001054--.name: Help me. Oh, please help me. The took my birthstones!

831175903001056--.name: My parents are... they're no longer with us. After they went away, I wandered deep into the forest to be alone...

831175903001057--.name: I made new friends there. They helped me work through the pain.

831175903001058--.name: I was going to craft some necklaces using my father's birthstones to thank them. But... but those monsters stole all of the stones!

831175903001060--.name: R-really? The $npcPlural:21000052$ and the $npcPlural:21000004$ are the ones who did this!

831175903001061--.name: Those birthstones are all that I have left from my father. Please get them back from the $npcPlural:21000052$ and $npcPlural:21000004$!

831175903001062--.name: Those are my father's birthstones! Thank you! I'd better get to work on those necklaces...

831175903001063--.name: I owe you a big reward for this. I know! I'll introduce you to my friends!

831175903001064--.name: But first, you have to promise not to tell anyone else about them. It'll be our little secret, okay?

831175903001065--.name: Come close and I'll whisper it in your ear. My friends are... the boroboro dwarves! Isn't that amazing?

831175903001066--.name: They vanished years and years ago. Most people don't even know they exist anymore! Why, I wouldn't be surprised if you had no idea what I'm talking about.

831175903001067--.name: Well, what do you say? Want to meet them? This is a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity!

831175903001069--.name: Make sure you aren't being followed, then climb to the top of the Ellin Tree. You'll see the entrance to $map:02000197$ way up there.

831175903001070--.name: Tell them hello for me, okay? Oh, and don't mention the necklaces I'm making for them. They're a surprise!

831175903001071--.name: Do you still want to meet my friends? Just climb to the top of the Ellin Tree and find the entrance to $map:02000197$.

831175903001072--.name: Speak up! What're you doing here, giant?!

831175903001074--.name: That crybaby sent you? Hmph. Come to think of it, I haven't seen her in a while...

831175903001075--.name: The other boroboros will be happy to see her again soon. But we don't got time for pleasantries right now!

831175903001076--.name: Look, I'm not in the habit of sharing our worries with outsiders, but our beloved $npc:11000751[gender:1]$ was in a spot of trouble not too long ago.

831175903001077--.name: Luckily for us, someone came along and saved her. Unluckily for us, the person who saved her was an outsider. Like you, but even uglier. And now it'll be impossible to keep our existence a secret any more!

831175903001078--.name: That's why we're looking for a new home out in the world. If we don't have to squat in caves, then we may as well make the most of it.

831175903001079--.name: At least, that was the plan. These lazy bums decided to nap the day away, instead.

831175903001080--.name: Since you're here anyway, make yourself useful and rouse the others. They'll be happy to hear that $npc:11000986[gender:1]$ is visiting soon, anyhow.

831175903001081--.name: You go ahead and wake up the other boroboros. Let them know that $npc:11000986[gender:1]$ will be here soon.

831175903001082--.name: The boroboro are at a turning point, and they're all sleeping like babies. Sigh…

831175903001083--.name: Can't say I'd mind a little nap myself... Lucky pups.

831175903001084--.name: Out of the frying pan, into the fire. Defeat one and there's two to take its place. Cut down two, and three more appear…

831175903001085--.name: The $map:02000091$ plays a key role in keeping $map:02000076$ safe. Which is too bad, because I don't know how much longer I can hold it.

831175903001086--.name: The rest of my unit abandoned their posts when the monsters came. Now I patrol the ramparts alone, and let me tell you... it's not easy.

831175903001087--.name: You're loyal to the empire, aren't you? I could use another strong arm to hold off the monster horde.

831175903001088--.name: Just tell me what to do.

831175903001089--.name: We've got too many monsters swarming the base of the watchtower. I'd like you to keep them busy while I shore up our defenses.

831175903001090--.name: If you can thin out the $npcNamePlural:21000265$ and $npcNamePlural:21000306$, we may hold the tower yet.

831175903001093--.name: I'm glad to hear it. We've held on for now, but this struggle is far from over.

831175903001094--.name: I'll do my best to hold this position for a while longer. In the meantime, I want you to send a request for reinforcements.

831175903001096--.name: You don't have to go far. There are carrier pigeons all over the watchtower. They can deliver the message.

831175903001097--.name: All you need to do is send the birds on their way, and my fellow soldiers will get the message.

831175903001098--.name: Don't let your guard down. The monsters sieging this place will not hesitate to fire at you with their cannons.

831175903001099--.name: All over the watchtower are <font color="#ffd200">carrier pigeons</font> that carry messages for scouts to send and receive <font color="#ffd200">information</font>. Send the carrier pigeon to <font color="#ffd200">request reinforcements</font>.

831175903001100--.name: All I can do now is clench my teeth and hold out for reinforcements.

831175903001101--.name: I've never felt so exhausted in my life. But as long as the watchtower is in danger, I will stand my ground.

831175903001130--.name: He'll understand, won't he? Of course he will. This is no problem. No problem at all…

831175903001131--.name: Who am I kidding? If $npc:11000031[gender:0]$ finds out about this, he'll turn me into a shrub!!

831175903001132--.name: Take a deep breath and start from the top.

831175903001133--.name: It was all that little fur ball's fault! He kept nagging me to make him beautiful. Look at my face. Do you think I have that kind of power?

831175903001134--.name: So... what did you tell him?

831175903001135--.name: I... I told him that I could make him beautiful if he brought me the whispers that live in a spider's heart, three golden apples, and the seed of the great tree. I never thought he would believe it...

831175903001136--.name: And I certainly never thought Lo would go to $npc:11000304[gender:1]$ and get the $item:30000329$!

831175903001137--.name: I don't like the sound of that.

831175903001138--.name: It's a mask with the power to brainwash monsters. Once it's on, you have no choice but to obey the person who put it on you.

831175903001139--.name: The forest giant Moomoo is a gentle soul. Gentle, but powerful. Lo put the $item:30000329$ on him and now they're trying to steal the seed!

831175903001140--.name: $npc:23000035$ must be stopped before they do any more damage! And, more importantly, before $npcName:11000031[gender:0]$ finds out I had anything to do with this! That man can make a witch's blood turn cold...

831175903001141--.name: I beg you. Defeat $npc:23000035$ and bring the $item:30000329$ to me.

831175903001142--.name: This can't be allowed to go on! Defeat $npc:23000035$ and bring the $item:30000329$ to me.

831175903001143--.name: I'm saved! Oh, that old $npc:11000304[gender:1]$ will be hearing from me! And I'll make sure no one ever gets their hands on this $item:30000329$ again.

831175903001144--.name: It looks like I'm in your debt. Huh. A strange feeling...

831175903001145--.name: Ellinia just doesn't smell as nature-y as it used to, you know?

831175903001146--.name: I was walking through the forest the other day to listen to the ladybugs sing—you know how ladybugs are, always singing such beautiful songs—but something had turned them all purple!

831175903001147--.name: Ladybugs are supposed to be red. A purple ladybug... Well, that's just not a very good ladybug at all!

831175903001148--.name: It's all because of those goggy guys! I spotted them putting some purple goop in the water at the $map:02000022$ before, but I didn't think anything of it at the time...

831175903001149--.name: And it's reached as far as the $map:02000215$. Just one drop of that purple water is enough to make the grass all withered and gross!

831175903001150--.name: If this keeps up, the whole $map:02000215$ will be totally purple. Please get those goggy guys!

831175903001151--.name: Oh, by goggy guys, I mean the $npcPlural:21090176$, $npcPlural:21090177$, and $npcPlural:21090175$.

831175903001152--.name: Please kick the $npcPlural:21090176$, $npcPlural:21090177$, and $npc:21090175$ out of the forest before they totally ruin the $map:02000215$.

831175903001153--.name: With the goggy guys gone, hopefully the $map:02000215$ can return to normal soon...

831175903001154--.name: I can't wait to hear the ladybugs sing again. Thank you!

831175903001155--.name: I say, what year is it? How long have I been traveling?

831175903001157--.name: Don't you recognize your own king? It is I, $npc:11001016[gender:0]$! Tell me, peasant, which county are you from?

831175903001159--.name: World, you say? Then that mage sent me a very far ways, indeed! Little matter. I've taken a liking to this $map:02000181$ and I've decided to take it as my own.

831175903001160--.name: Your world is a tad more blocky than I'm used to, but I'm sure I'll be feeling right at home in no time. Nothing like some free real estate to put a smile on one's face, after all!

831175903001161--.name: First order of business: I need to hire on some pest control! The wild beasties wandering around the palace grounds are simply unacceptable. Why, one of them could splash mud onto my fine clothes!

831175903001162--.name: Attend me, my commoner friend. As the new king of this castle, I command you to remove these creatures from my sight!

831175903001164--.name: The $npcPlural:21000220$, $npcPlural:21000222$, and $npcPlural:21000266$, of course! I detest such atrocious critters. I shan't tolerate them in my new kingdom!

831175903001165--.name: As a reward for your service, I shall bestow upon you invisible silken garments, just like the robe I am wearing at this very moment. A tempting offer, no?

831175903001166--.name: I'll have no $npcPlural:21000220$, $npcPlural:21000222$, or $npcPlural:21000266$ in my palace!

831175903001167--.name: Good, very good. Now that that's done, I shall erect a statue of myself up front... and a statue on the side parapet... and in the rear courtyard, another statue, perhaps?

831175903001168--.name: As for your reward, here you go. It may be invisible to the naked eye, but I assure you, this robe is woven from the finest silk!

831175903001237--.name: The only thing worse than a terrifying scream... is a terrifying scream that you can't put to a face...

831175903001238--.name: You must help me, $MyPCName$. I've been kept up for days by constant screaming... crying... wailing...

831175903001239--.name: Around the time this started, primordial monsters from the last ice age started showing up nearby.

831175903001240--.name: The last time I experienced such horror... the Blue Lapenta was destroyed…

831175903001241--.name: I won't stand idly by while evil is afoot. It's time I performed a divination to get at the heart of this.

831175903001242--.name: Will you help me? I need objects related to these disturbances in order to do my reading.

831175903001244--.name: To learn where the monsters are coming from, I need $itemPlural:30000345$ and $itemPlural:30000346$.

831175903001245--.name: For the ritual itself, I will need a mirror. I doubt we'll find any of those out here... But a reflective $item:30000344$ will do in a pinch.

831175903001246--.name: You can hunt $npcNamePlural:21000199$ and $npcNamePlural:21000089$ for the $itemPlural:30000345$ and $itemPlural:30000346$.

831175903001247--.name: As for $itemPlural:30000344$, just break some off the nearby ice blocks.

831175903001248--.name: You can hunt $npcNamePlural:21000199$ and $npcNamePlural:21000089$ for the $itemPlural:30000345$ and $itemPlural:30000346$.

831175903001249--.name: As for $itemPlural:30000344$, just break some off the nearby ice blocks.

831175903001250--.name: Everything is ready. Please be quiet while I tune into the vibes of divination...

831175903001253--.name: It's terrible... Simply terrible! The reason the monsters have come here... is to awaken $npcName:23000026[gender:1]$…

831175903001255--.name: $npcName:23000026[gender:1]$ was a servant of the Demon King that commanded terrible shadow spirits. She was feared by all, even the greatest heroes and warriors.

831175903001256--.name: It took great sacrifice for the Sages to freeze $npc:23000026[gender:1]$ deep below the ice of $map:02000260$.

831175903001258--.name: I know why I haven't been able to sleep. I am haunted by the screams of those who suffered at her hand, all those years ago...

831175903001260--.name: She'll still be in a weakened state, having spent so much time in the ice.

831175903001261--.name: Please defeat $npcName:23000026[gender:1]$ before she recovers her power. If you don't...

831175903001262--.name: Oh wanderer, the lives of everyone here depends on you. May divinity guide your steps.

831175903001263--.name: Please defeat $npcName:23000026[gender:1]$ before she recovers her power. If you don't...

831175903001264--.name: By heaven and earth, you have returned safely. Thank the divine!

831175903001265--.name: You have averted a great disaster. Thank you.

831175903001467--.name: You here for the special pardon, too? Hm. Looks like you can handle yourself in a fight.

831175903001468--.name: The kingdom's cutting a deal with any convict who can beat $npcName:23100011$ 50 times in $map:02000311$. A small price to pay for freedom, eh?

831175903001469--.name: It'd be a piece of cake for me, obviously. But, uh, hey... Wanna go in my place?

831175903001471--.name: Sigh... Listen, I'm a pretty famous guy. They say my punches can go through six feet of rock. But I don't exactly get to fight these days, see? I'm rusty.

831175903001472--.name: You do this for me, and I'll tell everyone how you helped me. You'll be famous by association! That's a great deal, right?

831175903001473--.name: Don't spread this around, but my old man is a big deal back in $map:02000062$.

831175903001474--.name: You'd have to be an idiot not to help me out here. So let's stop wasting time and start getting to business!

831175903001475--.name: It's not hard. Just go to $map:02000311$ and beat up $npcName:23100011$. 50 times. Simple!

831175903001476--.name: Go to $map:02000311$ and beat up $npcName:23100011$. 50 times. Simple!

831175903001477--.name: Bravo! Great work! You're like my personal guardian angel.

831175903001478--.name: Wait for me outside the prison. I'll pay you plenty just as soon as I come out. Honest!

915214503001717--.name: Wow! There's so much work to do here that we're always busy, but that means we never have any time for safety. It's getting downright hazardous here!

915214503001719--.name: I'm just so worried. We're really lucky we haven't had an accident already. But the conditions around here have gotten so bad. It's only a matter of time before something terrible happens.

915214503001720--.name: I mean, just look at these rusty gas tanks leaking everywhere! It's like working in the middle of a minefield. One spark, and the whole place will go up!

915214503001721--.name: It used to be that when the tanks started looking bad, they'd get replaced. Safety inspectors get mean when you're not following the rules. But not anymore.

915214503001722--.name: And the $npcPlural:21000281$ around here aren't helping matters. Every time they throw a bomb, my heart skips a beat. What if they hit a gas tank?!

915214503001723--.name: I can't stand it any more. If no one else is going to do anything, I'll fix the problem myself. $MyPCName$, will you help me?

915214503001725--.name: Please make sure all the valves on the nearby gas tanks are closed, and check to see if any of them are leaking.

915214503001726--.name: Just be careful! A lot of the tanks here are so rusty and old that just looking at them could make them explode. They're already venting a ton of soot and smoke.

915214503001727--.name: Please make sure all the valves on the nearby gas tanks are closed, and check to see if any of them are leaking.

915214503001728--.name: I'm relieved to hear there aren't any big problems, but this is just a temporary solution. I hope they replace the tanks soon.

915214503001729--.name: I'm going to ask HQ to store the gas tanks somewhere safer until they can be removed.

1228034903001929--.name: Infuriating! Those shelled thugs won't get away with this!

1228034903001930--.name: It's those slow... foolish... block-headed turtles! They stepped on the tail of the salamander I was riding and sent him running for the hills!

1228034903001932--.name: Sigh... I was going to get back before $npcName:11001314[gender:0]$ noticed I was gone, but that plan's done for.

1228034903001933--.name: Since those turtles messed up my day, I want to mess up their day. They'll feel sorry they ever even heard of the great $npcName:11001328[gender:0]$!

1228034903001934--.name: Hey, you going to help me, or you going to stand their gawking? Why'd you ask me what's wrong if you aren't going to help?

1228034903001935--.name: We'll wipe those filthy turtles from the face of $map:02010043$! First the $npcNamePlural:21000143$, and then the $npcNamePlural:21000145$, and especially the $npcNamePlural:21000144$!

1228034903001936--.name: We'll wipe those filthy turtles from the face of $map:02010043$! First the $npcNamePlural:21000143$, and then the $npcNamePlural:21000145$, and especially the $npcNamePlural:21000144$!

1228034903001938--.name: Is this your first time to Karkar Island? Come see me sometime. I owe you one, after all!

1228034903001939--.name: Absurd. Absolutely absurd! There is only a one-in-sixty-five million chance of something like this ever occurring!

1228034903001941--.name: Last night, as I was stepping out for my nightly counting of the stars, a brazen band of $npcNamePlural:21000423$ and $npcNamePlural:21000417$  broke into the house and stole all of Master Oliver's portraits!

1228034903001943--.name: Surely you jest! Why, the odds that you've never heard of the great $npcName:11001350[gender:0]$ are less than 0.000002%!

1228034903001944--.name: The master is the famous oil baron of Karkar Island. There is no greater businessman in all of Maple World, or so I am contractually obligated to say. He is known throughout the lands for his opulent tastes and... gulp... utter ruthlessness...

1228034903001945--.name: Maybe I'll just pack up my things and leave before word gets out that his portraits were stolen. Yes, that would yield the highest chance of my survival...

1228034903001947--.name: Unbelievable! For precisely 0.01 seconds, I thought I was hearing things. For a complete stranger to offer $male:his,female:her$ aid...

1228034903001948--.name: Very well. I shall place my fate in your hands.

1228034903001950--.name: I estimate a 95% chance that the $npcNamePlural:21000423$ and $npcNamePlural:21000417$ that stole the $itemPlural:30000451$ are still nearby.

1228034903001951--.name: Please defeat the $npcNamePlural:21000423$ and $npcNamePlural:21000417$ and ensure the safe return of $itemPlural:30000451$.

1228034903001952--.name: You are back far too early. It is as I feared... The chance that an utter stranger could help me was one-to-thirty-five million...

1228034903001954--.name: I never thought this would happen! Out of the 3,527 people that passed me today, I never thought one of them would save my hide.

1228034903001955--.name: Thank you. I don't think I can ever repay you, but come to me if you ever have questions about Karkar Island. You will find that I am a font of information.

1228034903001956--.name: Ugh, my guts... What could be taking her so long?

1228034903001957--.name: Maybe you should slow down with the burgers.

1228034903001958--.name: Youngster! Everything aches when you get to be my age. But it isn't my tummy that's bothering me today. No, it's my... feelings.

1228034903001959--.name: I decided to join my wife at the mall today, but it's been hours and she still hasn't come back from her shopping.

1228034903001960--.name: Women, am I right? $female:No offense. $I don't know where she gets all that energy for shopping...

1228034903001961--.name: I've got a bad case of the ol' burger bloats to go find her. Would you be a friend and let her know that her doting husband is waiting for her?

1228034903001963--.name: $npcName:11001331[gender:1]$, of course. I'm sure you'll have no trouble finding her. Let's just say she stands out in a crowd.

1228034903001964--.name: You let my wife to get back straight away. I don't know how many more of these burgers I can take.

1228034903001966--.name: My husband sent you? Oh no! I completely lost track of the time...

1228034903001967--.name: But what am I going to do? I can't go back like this!

1228034903001969--.name: I was about to join my husband for a lovely lunch of cheeseburgers, but I was accosted by monsters. They took everything!

1228034903001970--.name: I am not moving one inch until I get my things back. Do you have any idea how much that cute new top cost?

1228034903001972--.name: Oh? You don't look like a mall employee... But I guess I have no choice.

1228034903001973--.name: Please get my things back from the awful, horrible, no-good $npcNamePlural:21000726$, $npcNamePlural:21000720$, and $npcNamePlural:21000714$ that are loitering about $map:02010010$.

1228034903001974--.name: Please get my things back from the awful, horrible, no-good $npcNamePlural:21000726$, $npcNamePlural:21000720$, and $npcNamePlural:21000714$ that are loitering about $map:02010010$.

1228034903001975--.name: Adore by Perika... Perion Pursery... Racheal's Rags... It's all here. No wonder the monsters picked on me. I have all the best brands!

1228034903001976--.name: Now, my husband... I won't ever hear the end of this, will I?

1228034903001977--.name: I can find him from my own. Poor dear is probably eating himself silly at our favorite burger place. Thank you!

1228034903001978--.name: Y-you look like you're tougher than our usual customers. Perhaps you can help!

1228034903001979--.name: You s-see those... those walking tin cans? Steel cans? I'm honestly not sure what their cans are made of. The important thing is, they're scaring off all our business!

1228034903001980--.name: I r-run the $map:02010010$ Merchant Society. But if the merchants all go out of business, there will be no society, right? S-so please, I beg you, help us with this inconvenient monster problem!

1228034903001981--.name: I will pay you h-handsomely for driving off the $npcNamePlural:21000726$, $npcNamePlural:21000720$, and $npcNamePlural:21000714$.

1228034903001982--.name: I will pay you h-handsomely for driving the $npcNamePlural:21000726$, $npcNamePlural:21000720$, and $npcNamePlural:21000714$ away from $map:02010010$.

1228034903001983--.name: At $map:02010010$, we pride ourselves in providing the highest quality retail, entertainment, and dining experience for our customers.

1228034903001984--.name: Thanks to you, we can now boast that we offer the highest quality monster extermination service, as well.

1228034903001985--.name: Phew. I feel like I can finally get my nerves under control...

1228034903001986--.name: You're here to see my $npcName:11001334[gender:0]$, aren't you? He's world famous for his charms, you know.

1228034903001987--.name: But now he's got a bad case of the crankies. A cranky $npcName:11001334[gender:0]$ is not a charming $npcName:11001334[gender:0]$.

1228034903001988--.name: There's only one thing that can calm $npcName:11001334[gender:0]$ down when he's like this: $item:30000453$. But there are too many monsters for me to make it to the vending machine!

1228034903001989--.name: $MyPCName$, can you get some $item:30000453$ for me? $npcName:11001334[gender:0]$ is no good without it!

1228034903001990--.name: You can get $item:30000453$ from the vending machines all over $map:02010010$.

1228174803002165--.name: Thank you, $MyPCName$. You're welcome to come by whenever you want to bask in $npcName:11001334[gender:0]$'s cuteness.

1228034903001992--.name: Hold on! Don't just walk away. We got to talk, you and me.

1228034903001994--.name: We're two of a kind. I can tell. Real skaters, deep down in our hearts. You heading up to see $npcName:11001336[gender:0]$?

1228034903001996--.name: Oh, I gotcha. You were too lazy to return your board, and now you're scared of what he'll say if you bring it back now. We've all been there, $male:bro,female:girl$.

1228034903001997--.name: I'm pretty sure I've never been "there."

1228034903001998--.name: Don't feel bad, $male:bro,female:girl$. It's never too late to start! Heck, I bet if you headed over to the skate shop right now, they'd be happy to hook you up with a sweet board.

1228034903001999--.name: And while you're at it, mind taking the board I rented back to $npcName:11001336[gender:0]$? You'd be doing me a real solid.

1228034903002000--.name: No time like the present, $male:bro,female:girl$. I bet $npcName:11001336[gender:0]$'s real eager to get that board back.

1228034903002001--.name: $npcName:11001335[gender:0]$, that slacker. Couldn't face me after waiting weeks to return this, eh? Well, thanks.

1228034903002002--.name: Man.. I don't want to be that guy. I remember how it is. I used to be a skater when I was younger, y'know?

1228034903002003--.name: But I'm trying to run a business here. These kids don't appreciate that.

1228034903002004--.name: They rent a skateboard and I never hear from them again. Most of them just ditch their boards in the park. It's not like the boards'll magically pick up themselves...

1228034903002005--.name: Maybe they'll come to their senses if I start charging late fees... See this? Half my boards are missing!

1228034903002006--.name: If you're headed out to the skate park anyway, mind grabbing the abandoned boards for me? I'll throw in a free rental to make it worth your time.

1228034903002007--.name: I'm in a bit of a hurry. It's skating season and I need those skateboards back to rent to new customers.

1228034903002008--.name: Look at all the boards you found! That does it. Let's see how those punks like paying late fees out the nose!

1228034903002009--.name: It was bad enough that nobody returns my board. But the bugs here are out of control!

1228034903002010--.name: You saw it, didn't you? Swarms of filthy insects all over the place! I stepped out of the shop for just a minute and they looted all my skateboard parts.

1228034903002011--.name: What do they even want with skateboard parks? Are they just in it to annoy me? Ugh, my head is throbbing...

1228034903002012--.name: You've got to help me. Track down those bugs and get my $itemPlural:30000458$ back.

1228034903002013--.name: I've got to watch the store. But if you do this for me, I'll pay you generously.

1228034903002014--.name: Hurry over to $map:02010014$ and defeat the $npcNamePlural:21000438$ and $npcNamePlural:21000434$. They're the ones who took my $itemPlural:30000458$

1228034903002015--.name: They better not have damaged these parts... Anyway, you did your part. Here's your pay.

1228034903002016--.name: First, the customers stopped coming. Then I complained that things couldn't get any worse. Then the bugs showed up...

1228034903002017--.name: Let's make a deal. You exterminate those bugs for me, and I'll cook you up a fresh dish. On the house.

1228034903002018--.name: I've got to keep sanitary, you know? I can't be seen touching those dirty bugs!

1228034903002019--.name: Take out any $npcNamePlural:21000434$ and $npcNamePlural:21000438$ you see. I beg you!

1228034903002020--.name: Take out any $npcNamePlural:21000434$ and $npcNamePlural:21000438$ you see. I beg you!

1228034903002021--.name: You got rid of 'em already? Amazing!

1228034903002025--.name: I came here because we got a report of an infestation. I had no idea things'd be this bad.

1228034903002026--.name: If the bug swarms keep growing, then soon all of Ludari will be infested!

1228034903002027--.name: Something must be done. Find $npcName:11001342[gender:0]$ out in $map:02010019$ and tell him I need help.

1228034903002028--.name: I'll be here. Fighting bugs. <font size='20'>Please hurry.</font>

1228034903002029--.name: We don't have much time! Please get my message to $npcName:11001342[gender:0]$ in $map:02010019$. If you don't hurry, $map:02010019$ may be lost!

1228034903002030--.name: $map:02010014$ is that bad? I can't exactly leave here. Not while there are so many bugs left...

1228034903002031--.name: What's the cause of all this? We'll never win if we can't cut them off at the source.

1228034903002032--.name: I can't understand it. Nobody's ever escaped Alikar before. So how did these louts manage it?

1228034903002033--.name: Yes, but they won't enjoy their freedom for long. I've tracked them to $map:52010008$.

1228034903002034--.name: They may have escaped before, but $npcName:11001344[gender:0]$ is on the job now. They're trapped like rats.

1228034903002035--.name: Lend me a hand. Go into the $map:52010008$ and drag them out of hiding.

1229155703002188--.name: I'll watch the exits to make sure they don't make a run for it. Any come out, and I'll be all over them.

1228034903002036--.name: $map:52010008$ is big, so be careful not to lose them. Check under all the beds and in all the closets!

1228034903002037--.name: Leave no bed unturned and no closet unchecked.

1228034903002039--.name: Thanks for the help. I'm glad to put this whole mess behind me.

1228034903002040--.name: Unexpected. Unplanned for. And, worst of all, unscheduled!

1228034903002042--.name: We put in an order for repairmen to fix up the subway, but the workers were actually monsters in disguise!

1228034903002043--.name: Without the rails, Ludari simply doesn't run. We're the lifeblood of the city!

1228034903002044--.name: We must eliminate these monsters to keep the peace. $MyPCName$, can I rely on you to take care of this matter?

1228034903002045--.name: Defeat the monsters near the tracks. The $npcNamePlural:21000735$ and $npcNamePlural:21000732$ cannot be allowed to continue this charade!

1228034903002046--.name: I'm relieved. With your help, we were able to evacuate the passengers, at least.
