1228034903002047--.name: The repairmen—the real repairmen—are still trapped inside the $map:52010009$.

1228034903002048--.name: I'm certain there are monsters in there with them... While I want the rails repaired, their safety is more important.

1228034903002049--.name: Please go into the $map:52010009$ and make sure my workers are okay.

1228034903002050--.name: Please go into the $map:52010009$ and make sure my workers are okay.

1228034903002051--.name: The last of the repairmen just made it out. They're being checked for injuries now.

1228034903002052--.name: Thanks to you, nobody was seriously hurt. I don't know if I can ever thank you enough.

1228034903002055--.name: I was on my home to my blessed hometown, and the train stopped... And th-then... And then!!

1228034903002056--.name: Take a deep breath and speak slowly.

1228034903002057--.name: I thought they were workers coming to help me with my bags... but they were monsters in disguise! They took all my things!

1228034903002058--.name: I've been busy lately, and I haven't had time to keep up with my parents back home. I was going to make it up to them with piles and piles of gifts, but now they're all gone…

1228034903002060--.name: R-really? You'll get my gifts back? While you're at it, teach those nasty $npcNamePlural:21000735$ and $npcNamePlural:21000732$ for stealing my precious presents!

1228034903002061--.name: I'd rather not go home at all if I can't get my stuff back. Please get the gifts back from the $npcNamePlural:21000735$ and $npcNamePlural:21000732$.

1228034903002062--.name: Th-thank you! Thank you so much! Sniff...

1228034903002096--.name: Bravo! Bravo! This is it! I've hit the jackpot!

1228034903002098--.name: Hey, come closer and I'll let you in on this once-in-a-lifetime opportunity!

1228034903002099--.name: I'm here to record the upcoming fight. But the thing is, there's not much money in these kinds of shows anymore. People want something fresh.

1228034903002100--.name: Something like... the monsters completely destroying the arena here! I already have a name in mind. "Arena Attack! A Special Seven Day Miniseries."

1228034903002101--.name: It doesn't get more real than this! We'll get ratings to die for. I promise you that.

1228034903002102--.name: We've got to hurry up or this opportunity will pass us by. Get the $itemPlural:30000482$ from the cameras around $map:02010020$. Quickly!

1228034903002103--.name: Collect the $itemPlural:30000482$ from the cameras around $map:02010020$. Hurry!

1228034903002104--.name: Now I possess all the tapes! Thanks. It's time for my star to rise at last...

1228034903002105--.name: This makes absolutely no sense! My calculations were perfect. I analyzed the last twenty bouts of both fighters. There's no way my prediction could have been wrong.

1228034903002106--.name: This match should have gone to $npcName:11001378[gender:0]$, no question. There must be something else going on here...

1228034903002107--.name: I hope you're not brushing me off. My calculations are never wrong! Somebody must have manipulated the data...

1228034903002108--.name: Let me think... The original copies of the data should be in the $map:52010010$. I'm sure of it.

1228034903002109--.name: The solution is simple, then. All you need to do is sneak into the $map:52010010$ and bring me the $item:30000483$.

1228034903002110--.name: You will do it, of course. I'm an extremely popular manager. People will notice if I go myself.

1228034903002111--.name: All you need to do is sneak into the $map:52010010$ and bring me the $item:30000483$.

1228034903002112--.name: And I was right, of course. The $item:30000483$ were in the office. I'd better hurry up and check out this data...

831174201000260--.name: $MyPCName$... I don't know what brought you here, but do you think you could help me?

831174201000262--.name: There is someone whom I owe my life. It was his final wish that I take care of his newborn son.

831174201000263--.name: From that day forward, I made it my life's mission to look after that boy. Wherever I might go, we were never apart. But one day, I received an ominous fortune from $npc:11001046[gender:0]$ of $map:02000268$.

831174201000264--.name: He said that the child would lose his life at the hands of the terrible $npc:23090005[gender:0]$... But the $npc:23090005[gender:0]$ is immortal. It can be defeated, but never destroyed.

831174201000265--.name: So where do I come into this?

831174201000266--.name: $npc:11001046[gender:0]$ told me how to seal the beast away for a time. First, he told me to obtain a $item:30000157$ in $map:02000268$. But... try as I might, I couldn't find it, despite coming all the way here.

831174201000267--.name: Please, will you help me by scouring $map:02000268$ for a $item:30000157$ while I search this place?

831174201000268--.name: If you do find a $item:30000157$</font>, bring it directly to $npc:11001046[gender:0]$!  He will surely know a way to defeat the $npc:23090005[gender:0]$!

831174201000269--.name: $npc:11001046[gender:0]$ told me how to seal the beast away for a time. First, he told me to obtain a $item:30000157$ in $map:02000268$. Please, will you help me by scouring $map:02000268$ for a $item:30000157$

831174201000271--.name: Heh. He sure is a stubborn one. He should slow down a little. It's not like a dead man can collect on his debts. Trying to repay a life-debt at any cost... Ho-hum.

831174201000272--.name: Long ago, a group of nameless swordsmen clothed adorned with simple bamboo hats sealed the $npc:23090005[gender:0]$ in the $map:02000037$. They managed to seal the temple entrance and put the $npc:23090005[gender:0]$ to sleep, but it cost them their souls.

831174201000273--.name: This $item:30000157$ was the blade wielded by one of those heroes, so many years ago. It is old and worn, yes, but it can be restored to its former glory by means of an ancient magic. One designed to undo the toll of time.

831174201000274--.name: I can restore the $item:13200028$ to its former power, so that you can it can be used to seal the $npc:23090005[gender:0]$ away once more. There may also be a way to prevent the $npc:23090005[gender:0]$ from ever awakening again. But first, give me some time to work on the blade...

831174201000277--.name: Wooo! One try! I managed to restore the $item:13200028$ in a single attempt! All of those years of Shaman training really paid off. TAKE THAT, DAD!

831174201000278--.name: I've placed the $item:13200028$ inside this $item:30000155$, please deliver it to $npc:11000144[gender:0]$. He will need it when he confronts the $npc:23090005[gender:0]$.

831174201000279--.name: There's one more thing! The $item:13200028$ alone will not be enough to defeat the $npc:23090005[gender:0]$... What we need is the power of the one who wielded it.

831174201000280--.name: The souls of the heroes rest within the grave markers in $map:02000200$. Find the $item:30000153$, and throw it into the $npcName:11000345$ which sits nearby! The heroes gave the last of their strength to ignite the $npcName:11000345$ before they fell. You can find it near the entrance of the $map:02000037$.

831174201000281--.name: From the flames, you will draw forth the $item:30000154$, which can be used to unleash the true power of the $item:13200028$. Bring it to $npcName:11000144$. Also... tell him I wish him luck.

831174201000284--.name: Nope! I just got turned around.

831174201000285--.name: What are you thinking! This is it here. You should take better care of such things!

831174201000286--.name: Didn't you put it in your bag? Maybe you should double-check.

831174201000287--.name: Your bag looks full. Maybe you should make some space.

831174201000289--.name: You're back! Did you talk to $npc:11001046[gender:0]$? What happened?

831174201000290--.name: (Hand him the $item:30000155$, and tell him about the $item:30000154$.)

831174201000291--.name: Could it be?! This is the $item:13200028$ used to seal away the $npc:23090005[gender:0]$ long ago... Using this, I'll be sure to win!

831174201000292--.name: I'm not sure how much good the $item:13200028$ is going to do me if I can't reach the $npc:23090005$ breaks free of the $map:02000037$…

831174201000294--.name: While you were in $map:02000268$, I wandered deep inside the Ant Tunnel and found the door to the $map:02000037$. However... it was shut tight and could not be opened from the outside.

831174201000295--.name: Maybe you can open the door using the $item:30000154$?

831174201000296--.name: Hmm... Perhaps. We still need to find the $item:30000153$ $npcName:11001046[gender:0]$ spoke of. The resting place of the nameless heroes... $MyPCName$, lets search the Ant Tunnel for the $item:30000153$ together. You start in the $map:02000200$ where the $map:02000037$ entrance is located.

831174201000297--.name: According to the prophecy, time is short. If you find the $item:30000153$, take it straight to the $npcName:11000345$ and place it inside. If all goes well, it should be transformed into the $item:30000154$.

831174201000298--.name: $npcName:11001046[gender:0]$ said the $npcName:11000345$ is found near the entrance to the $map:02000037$ in the $map:02000200$, right? Then there's no time to waste! Get going!

831174201000299--.name: According to the prophecy, time is short. If you find the $item:30000153$, take it straight to the $npcName:11000345$ and place it inside. If all goes well, it should be transformed into the $item:30000154$.

831174201000300--.name: You found the $npc:11000345$ burning amidst the boiling lava.

831174201000301--.name: Casting the $item:30000153$ into the $npc:11000345$ should awaken the power of the soul that sleeps within, transforming it into the $item:30000154$,

831174201000304--.name: All that remains is to throw the $item:30000153$ into the flames.

831174201000306--.name: Ah... That's the $item:30000154$! With the $item:13200028$ restored to its true power, I should be able to defeat the $npc:23090005[gender:0]$... Ugh…

831174201000308--.name:
It's no big deal... I was in a hurry, and I tripped and fell off a cliff.
Agh... It's probably just a minor internal injury…

831174201000309--.name: Uhh... You should see a doctor.

831174201000310--.name: There's no time for that! If the $npc:23090005[gender:0]$ awakens, and I'm not here to stop him...!

831174201000312--.name: Ugh... It looks like I'm in your debt yet again. I'll leave it to you, but don't try and face the $npc:23090005[gender:0]$ alone.

831174201000313--.name: Here, take the $item:13200028$. Gather the strongest warriors you can find and travel to the $map:02000037$. Ugh... I'll follow you when I can. I need to look after my wound and check in on the boy. I have to set my affairs in order, in case…

831174201000314--.name: Just beyond the Cleansing Flames in the deepest part of the $map:02000200$, you'll find the entrance to the $map:02000037$.

831174201000315--.name: Take this. I have embedded the $item:30000154$ within the $item:13200028$. Gather the strongest allies you can find... Face the$npc:23090005[gender:0]$. I'll follow as soon as I can!

It will tell you what they look like, how to fight them, when to run away... all sorts of useful facts!

1019210701000620--.name: My monster guide is going to sell like hotcakes when it's finished! I would be more than happy to credit you as a co-author if you help me with my research.

1019210701000621--.name: Of course, there's still a lot of data to gather. For instance, I know very little about mechanical monsters. I heard there are many mechanical monsters to be found near $map:2000270$... Do you think you could face them in combat and tell me what you learn?
