1224195911002067-KarkarIsland-.name: I was getting to that! She's gone missing! Since she's new, I wanted to see how she could perform on her own. So I sent her to patrol $map:02010026$... and she never came back.

1224195911002068-KarkarIsland-.name: Wouldn't it be against the rules to give solo orders like that?

1224195911002069-KarkarIsland-.name: Shh! Shh! That's a secret! Don't say that out loud! If the other meerkats tell the leader I did that, I'm done for! That's I need you to look for her in secret.

1224195911002070-KarkarIsland-.name: $MyPCName$, please search $map:02010026$ for any sign of $npcName:11001412[gender:1]$. If I go looking for her myself, it's going to raise all kinds of uncomfortable questions about why $npcName:11001412[gender:1]$ was out there alone.

1224195911002071-KarkarIsland-.name: $npcName:11001412[gender:1]$ is small but she knows how to make plenty of noise. She really likes flowers, so you might find her admiring the flowerpots out there. $map:02010026$ has tons of flowerpots, if you hadn't noticed.

1224195911002072-KarkarIsland-.name: You're back. Did you find $npcName:11001412[gender:1]$? Where is she?

1224195911002073-KarkarIsland-.name: Nope, all I found was this $item:30000496$.

1224195911002074-KarkarIsland-.name: Huh? This smell... Hm. Thank you, human. That will be all.

1224195911002075-KarkarIsland-.name: What? No, we need to go and rescue $npcName:11001412[gender:1]$!

1224195911002076-KarkarIsland-.name: There's no need for that. She's definitely safe, just laying low somewhere. I just need to figure out what to tell the leader...

1224195911002077-KarkarIsland-.name: How can you say that just from sniffing some fur?

1224195911002078-KarkarIsland-.name: Excuse me? Are you going to humansplain to me about my nose? And my ways? I know by scent that $npcName:11001412[gender:1]$ collapsed from illness, and our allies in $map:02010026$ rescued her. So, as I said, that will be all.

1224195911002079-KarkarIsland-.name: What is this, human? Stay out of our affairs. I never took you for such a nosy creature.

1224195911002080-KarkarIsland-.name: But what if $npcName:11001412[gender:1]$ was eaten by a monster?

1224195911002081-KarkarIsland-.name: Seriously? How incompetent do you think we are? If anyone ever got eaten on our watch, we'd be disbanded in an instant. I'm telling you, she's safe and sound at the base.

1224195911002082-KarkarIsland-.name: A leader who doesn't look after their followers is no leader.

1224195911002083-KarkarIsland-.name: Good thing I didn't ask you then, human. You simply don't understand our ways. But if you continue to insist on this foolishness, perhaps I can profit from it. I'll make you a bet. I bet my belt that $npcName:11001412[gender:1]$ is in $map:02010006$ right now. This is rare silk from $map:02010002$! It's really expensive!

1224195911002085-KarkarIsland-.name: Of course I'm confident. Go to $map:02010006$ and you'll see $npcName:11001412[gender:1]$, completely untouched. We've got $map:02010033$ completely under control.

1224195911002086-KarkarIsland-.name: Isn't that funny? Our all-important base, right there without anyone noticing. Just sitting there, next to a small lake in the desert, hidden beneath the three great trees...

1224195911002087-KarkarIsland-.name: A human? How did you find this place?

1224195911002088-KarkarIsland-.name: I made a bet with $npcName:11001406$, and he spilled the beans.

1224195911002089-KarkarIsland-.name: Wait, you made a bet with a meerkat? Hee hee hee, you're a funny one!

1224195911002090-KarkarIsland-.name: The mighty members of the Meerkat Patrol help keep order on Karkar Island. We gather information about current events and use that to thwart any plots which could disturb the peace.

1224195911002091-KarkarIsland-.name: Yeah, it's great! $npcName:11001406$ seems so proud of the patrol's accomplishments.

1224195911002092-KarkarIsland-.name: Now that you mention it, you made a bet with $npcName:11001406$, didn't you? What's that all about?

1224195911002093-KarkarIsland-.name: Oh, he wanted to bet that $npcName:11001412[gender:1]$ is safe and sound at base.

1224195911002094-KarkarIsland-.name: Ah. Well, $npcName:11001412[gender:1]$ collapsed in $map:02010026$. Our members found her behind a rose flowerpot and brought her back. She's not in the best shape, but she is safe now. Go see her if you're curious.

1224195911002095-KarkarIsland-.name: Honestly, I'm pretty disappointed in $npcName:11001406$ over this. Sending $npcName:11001412[gender:1]$ out alone like that isn't something a responsible leader does. I'm sure $npcName:11001412[gender:1]$ could use some sympathy after her ordeal.

1224195911002098-KarkarIsland-.name: I've definitely been better. I tried to tell the chief I was in pain, but he wouldn't listen. Said it was my duty as a meerkat to support the patrol. Didn't seem to matter that I'd been feeling bad for a week and a half...

1224195911002100-KarkarIsland-.name: It's my stomach. I don't know why, but I can't... y'know... go. To the bathroom.

1224195911002102-KarkarIsland-.name: Thanks. I hope my pipes will finally clear out soon! I should probably get some rest now. Don't be a stranger.

1225192211002158-KarkarIsland-.name: Maple Island? Never heard of it. Is the kid from there too? You know, the girl with the umbrella and the weird thing on her head.

1225192211002159-KarkarIsland-.name: Oh, you must be talking about $npcName:11000735[gender:1]$.

1225192211002160-KarkarIsland-.name: Calibre Island? Never heard of it. Is the kid from there too? You know, the girl with the umbrella and the weird thing on her head.

1225192211002161-KarkarIsland-.name: Oh, you must be talking about $npcName:11000735[gender:1]$.

1225192211002162-KarkarIsland-.name: Whoa there buddy, no need to get steamed. I'm trying to figure out where that girl is from. You know, the one with the umbrella and the weird thing on her head.

1225192211002163-KarkarIsland-.name: Oh, you must be talking about $npcName:11000735[gender:1]$.

1225192211002164-KarkarIsland-.name: So do you know where she is now? Can you get her over here? There's something I want to ask her.

1225192211002165-KarkarIsland-.name: Err, I'm not sure about that...

1225192211002166-KarkarIsland-.name: Well then what are you good for? Fine, you don't want to help, that's up to you. I just want to know more abou that golden aura I felt on her.

1225192211002168-KarkarIsland-.name: You probably already know, but I'm not from around here. I was engulfed by a blinding stream of light, and when it cleared I found myself alone in this place.

1225192211002169-KarkarIsland-.name: What's frustrating is how I can't remember anything. Not even my name. This flower is the only thing that came with me... And it reminds me of a name when I look at it. $npcName:11001430[gender:0]$... Maybe that's my name. Maybe not.

1225192211002170-KarkarIsland-.name: Even without my memories, I want to find a way back to my home. Who knows, that might be the key to remembering everything I've forgotten. And now that you know my secret, I think it's only fair that you help me.

1225192211002171-KarkarIsland-.name: (You can't help but note how sarcastic he sounds.)

1225192211002172-KarkarIsland-.name: Don't misunderstand me. I intend to help you, too. For now, let me direct you to someone even more sarcastic than me. You should talk to the sunset fox, because he was there when I appeared in this world.

1225192211002173-KarkarIsland-.name: I asked him to tell me what happened on that day, but for some reason he's holding out on me. You might have more luck, I think. If he pretends to not understand human language, call him $npcName:11001431[gender:0]$.

1225192211002174-KarkarIsland-.name: If that funky fox pretends he can't understand you, call him $npcName:11001431[gender:0]$. That should get his attention.

1225192211002175-KarkarIsland-.name: <font color="#909090">($npcName:11001431[gender:0]$ is watching you. Just as $npcName:11001430[gender:0]$ warned, he's pretending he doesn't understand you.)</font>

1225192211002177-KarkarIsland-.name: What? What is this? Did $npcName:11001430[gender:0]$ send you?

1225192211002178-KarkarIsland-.name: What a strange person he is. Why didn't he come talk himself? And what do you want?

1225192211002179-KarkarIsland-.name: What happened the day that $npcName:11001430[gender:0]$ appeared?

1225192211002180-KarkarIsland-.name: First of all, it was at night. It was a perfectly normal night, too. But then, the sky started to spin and there was a bright light. The light came down, down, down, like a shooting star.

1225192211002181-KarkarIsland-.name: I was so surprised, I couldn't move. I just stood there and stared. But then the ground started to shake, so I ran over to where the light fell. I found $npcName:11001430[gender:0]$, surrounded by a blue light.

1225192211002182-KarkarIsland-.name: Interesting. Did you notice anything else unusual?

1225192211002183-KarkarIsland-.name: Well... To be honest, everything seemed too clean. No hole, no dirt, no bits of space rock, nothing! If something fell from the night sky, it should leave a hole or bits, right? Whatever happened must have been entirely magical.

1225192211002184-KarkarIsland-.name: I told him all this already, you know. He refused to believe me, I don't know why. At least now he can hear it from someone else. And tell him not to call me that name anymore.

1225192211002185-KarkarIsland-.name: To be fair, it's a really nice name. $npcName:11001431[gender:0]$!

1225192211002186-KarkarIsland-.name: He gave me that name! We sunset foxes live free here in the desert and have no need for names.

1225192211002187-KarkarIsland-.name: There, I said my piece. Go back to $npcName:11001430[gender:0]$ and tell him to get over it already.

1225192211002188-KarkarIsland-.name: I see you're back. So, what did $npcName:11001431[gender:0]$ say?

1225192211002189-KarkarIsland-.name: You've probably heard this before, but $npcName:11001431[gender:0]$ said...

1225192211002190-KarkarIsland-.name: Well, that's more detail than what he told me. I think there might be a clue there...

1225192211002191-KarkarIsland-.name: I didn't have a mark on me that day. And there weren't any traces of whatever brought me here, either. The only clue I have is that blue light that surrounded me.

1225192211002192-KarkarIsland-.name: Something that powerful couldn't have left absolutely no trace. Perhaps the creatures in this area still bear its mark.

1225192211002193-KarkarIsland-.name: Do you see those round things? And the long ones? The round ones are $npcNamePlural:21000645$ and the long ones are $npcNamePlural:21000424$. They hold a lot of food and water in their bodies to help them survive in the desert, and that means they should still be holding clues to my arrival.

1225192211002194-KarkarIsland-.name: I need those clues if I'm ever to have a chance at getting home. Please bring me whatever you can find on those creatures. Or in, I suppose.

1225192211002195-KarkarIsland-.name: Obviously you'll need to beat those creatures down to examine them as closely as is necessary.

1225192211002197-KarkarIsland-.name: I beat up tons of those critters, and didn't find a thing.

1225192211002198-KarkarIsland-.name: That's not such a big deal. One thing I didn't mention was how those monsters stung me when I first ended up here. I was hoping you'd sort them out for me.

1225192211002199-KarkarIsland-.name: You were just using me to get petty revenge?!

1225192211002200-KarkarIsland-.name: No, not really. I'm a big believer in multi-tasking. Now, I have something to show you. A payment, of sorts.

1225192211002201-KarkarIsland-.name: There are plenty of mysteries to unravel in $map:02010047$. More than a few historians have cataloged the clues left behind, and I've gathered as many of their discoveries as I could in my research journal.

1225192211002202-KarkarIsland-.name: I'd very much like to see that.

1225192211002203-KarkarIsland-.name: Of course. I'm bringing it up because I'd like you to review it. The problem is that I've hidden it, and I can't leave this spot while I'm making observations. You'll have to find it yourself, under the table.

1225192211002205-KarkarIsland-.name: If it was that obvious, it wouldn't be hidden, would it? I think you can find something like that.

1225192211002206-KarkarIsland-.name: Just tell me where you hid it.

1225192211002207-KarkarIsland-.name: I'm getting tired of these games!

1225192211002208-KarkarIsland-.name: I have a place where I keep the materials I collect. I call it $map:02010007$. It's some distance from here. Head south and look for the entrance.

1225192211002209-KarkarIsland-.name: I don't play games. I just need to know you can keep up with me. I have a place where I keep the materials I collect. I call it $map:02010007$. It's some distance from here. Head south and look for the entrance.

1225192211002210-KarkarIsland-.name: You can't find $map:02010007$? I suppose I hid it pretty well, then. Head south and look carefully. Don't go too far, it's definitely in $map:02010047$.

1225192211002211-KarkarIsland-.name: Looks like you read it. Do you understand now?

1225192211002212-KarkarIsland-.name: I couldn't read it, let alone understand it!

1225192211002213-KarkarIsland-.name:
<font color="#909090">($npc:11001430[gender:0]$ gives you a gentle look of pity.)</font>
$MyPCName$... You can't read? Shouldn't have paid more attention in school.

1225192211002214-KarkarIsland-.name: It's in a different language, you...!

1225192211002215-KarkarIsland-.name: Oh, right... I wrote it in my language. Guess I can't blame you for that. Hehe. I'll read it to you. Give it here.

1226220411002231-KarkarIsland-.name: This passage was inscribed in an ancient language on the stones here. I witnessed many strange things in the moonlight, and I've written it all down. Are you ready?

1226235211002297-KarkarIsland-.name: "As for the relic, gift of the divine's sacrifice, a benevolent light will remain here for those who must overcome a great crisis."

1226220411002232-KarkarIsland-.name: "The great power is given only to those who are pure, just, and worthy. Those selected must first have inherited the golden memory. They must also recall the value and significance of the noble sacrifice."

1226220411002233-KarkarIsland-.name: "Second, the worthy must understand the great power if they wish to control it. If the worthy cannot nurture the seed of light to blossom in this corrupt world, then the power will be lost. When the seed blossoms, the light shall shine upon a path to another world and permit the worthy to pass on to their just reward. "

1226220411002234-KarkarIsland-.name: Brace yourself, if you dare to approach.

1226220411002235-KarkarIsland-.name: It's obviously about a relic that opens portals.

1226220411002236-KarkarIsland-.name: Spot on. That's what caught my attention when I was doing my research. And that's why I've been searching for someone with a unique wavelength. I've been on their trail, and finally narrowed it down to a certain child with a golden aura. That's $npcName:11000735[gender:1]$, the child you found.

1226220411002237-KarkarIsland-.name: The power surrounding her was entirely different from the others of our world. It might be that of the relic of light... which means if I can tap into it, I might be able to go back.

1226220411002238-KarkarIsland-.name: Since you were with $npcName:11000735[gender:1]$, I thought you would help me turn up some clues. But you turned out to be rather wary of me.

1226220411002239-KarkarIsland-.name: So why the story if you already knew?

1226220411002240-KarkarIsland-.name: I thought you could be my... friend. You have a good heart, and I thought if you heard my story, you'd care about my situation.

1226220411002241-KarkarIsland-.name: Oh! Well, we can be friends if you like.

1226220411002242-KarkarIsland-.name: Fine. Let's be friends. So, friend, can I make a request? $npcName:11001431[gender:0]$ needs a favor but I'm busy right now. If you've got the time, maybe you could help $npcName:11001431[gender:0]$ in my place?

1226220411002243-KarkarIsland-.name: It won't be hard. $npcName:11001431[gender:0]$'s favors are always really simple. But it's okay if you're busy. Just ask what it is. Thanks, friend.

1226220411002244-KarkarIsland-.name: You. Don't tell me he sent you again. What is it now?

1226220411002245-KarkarIsland-.name: I'm here to do you a favor, in place of $npcName:11001430[gender:0]$.

1226220411002247-KarkarIsland-.name: Did you have any idea what you'd be asked when you agreed to this? Did he explain anything to you, $MyPCName$?

1226220411002248-KarkarIsland-.name: He said it would be simple.

1226220411002249-KarkarIsland-.name: He's my friend, so I'm willing to help with anything.

1226220411002250-KarkarIsland-.name: Right. Well... It is simple. I need someone to water the starflowers that have bloomed all over $map:02010047$. But to do that, you'll have to prepare a few things first.

1226220411002251-KarkarIsland-.name: Start with 5 $itemPlural:30000498$. You can get it by sifting through the purple star sands scattered at the edge of $map:02010047$. Just watch your step. After that, get 10 $itemPlural:30000499$ from $npcName:21000645$ out there. You'll have to check carefully after you defeat each $npcName:21000645$... they don't all carry what we need.

1226220411002252-KarkarIsland-.name: Friend, huh... Yeah, I think I have a general idea of what he told you. Alright, all I need is for you to water the starflowers. Care for them just as you would your beloved friend... just with more water. Oh, and you'll need a few items to do it right.

1226220411002253-KarkarIsland-.name: Start with 5 $itemPlural:30000498$. You can get it by sifting through the purple star sands scattered at the edge of $map:02010047$. Just watch your step. After that, get 10 $itemPlural:30000499$ from $npcName:21000645$ out there. You'll have to check carefully after you defeat each $npcName:21000645$... they don't all carry what we need.

1226220411002254-KarkarIsland-.name: Get $itemPlural:30000498$ from the star sands on the edge of $map:02010047$. Just watch your step. After that, get $itemPlural:30000499$ from $npcName:21000645$ out there. Bring everything back to me once you're done.

1226220411002255-KarkarIsland-.name: Let's see... Yep, that's everything. Heh, is this the power of friendship? On to the next step, then.

1226220411002256-KarkarIsland-.name: Here, this is what I needed those items for. This $item:30000500$ is the perfect tool for brightening up those lonely starflowers.

1226220411002257-KarkarIsland-.name: Come back after you water five lonely starflowers. I'd like the $item:30000500$</font> back when you're done, too.

1226220411002258-KarkarIsland-.name: What's wrong? Is there a problem?

1226220411002260-KarkarIsland-.name: Where can I find these starflowers?

1226220411002261-KarkarIsland-.name: Wow... not cool. I worked hard on that, y'know? Here. I'll give you this spare one. You better not lose this one!

1226220411002262-KarkarIsland-.name: $MyPCName$... Did you check your bag? Even I can tell you still have it. Now, you have work to do.

1226220411002263-KarkarIsland-.name: You really need to straighten up your bag first. I can't give you anything if it's full.

1226220411002264-KarkarIsland-.name: Head a little ways southwest. Remember, you're looking for lonely starflowers, meaning ones that bloom alone. Not the ones in groups of four.

1226220411002265-KarkarIsland-.name: Did you see the lonely starflowers bloom? Nice, isn't it?

1226220411002266-KarkarIsland-.name: Yeah! I never thought the one starflower would become four...

1226220411002267-KarkarIsland-.name: I... what? That's... not possible. Did you do something with $npcName:11001430[gender:0]$ before coming here?

1226220411002268-KarkarIsland-.name: We just shook hands. We're good friends now.

1226220411002269-KarkarIsland-.name: So that's it. He put magic in your hands. $item:30000498$ can't be dug up by anyone, and the $item:30000500$ has an enchantment on it that makes it too heavy for most folks to lift.

1226220411002270-KarkarIsland-.name: But he has magic and can easily use the power of the stars. I told him to water the starflower, but he found a way out of it. That flower he's always holding... It's withering. Maybe because it's from a different land, but nothing could perk it up.

1226220411002271-KarkarIsland-.name: Until that flower is saved, he wasn't willing to help any of the others. I think he wants to return to his home just to save that flower. I guess he can't be that bad of a guy. He must've put the magic in your hands that helped the starflowers bloom.

1226220411002272-KarkarIsland-.name: You really are a good friend to $npcName:11001430[gender:0]$</font>, $MyPCName$. I'd like to count you as a friend as well.

1224195911002138-KarkarIsland-.name: The Meerkat Patrol is always working to improve, both individually and as a team. You see our dashing bronze fur? Underneath that is all muscle.

1224195911002139-KarkarIsland-.name: Is that all muscle in your jowls, too?

1224195911002140-KarkarIsland-.name: Oh, silly human! You still don't understand the meerkat way. Our special training gives us a strong body AND adorable cheeks! It's win-win! You can't tell me you don't want some of this.

1224195911002141-KarkarIsland-.name: Okay, you got me. What's your secret?

1224195911002142-KarkarIsland-.name: The key, as it turns out, is patience. You need the tenacity to see your goals to the end! Time to prove your steady will, human.

1224195911002143-KarkarIsland-.name: Tsk tsk, human. Where is your patience? Surely even you can complete the most basic training! Finish what you started!

1224195911002144-KarkarIsland-.name: How was that? Didn't you feel your muscles awakening? Keep at it, $MyPCName$, and you'll have the lithe body of a meerkat in no time!

1224195911002145-KarkarIsland-.name: We meerkats spend most of our time patrolling and observing from high places. That doesn't mean we're softies, mind you. When things get serious, we have to lay down some serious hurt.

1224195911002146-KarkarIsland-.name: Anyone in the patrol needs to be able to fight, and I'm pretty sure you do too! If you want to train your combat skills, go out to $map:02010033$ and battle the monsters there.

1224195911002147-KarkarIsland-.name: Human, what's taking so long? This is one of our most basic courses. If you can't do this, you can't hope to ever measure up to a meerkat!

1224195911002148-KarkarIsland-.name: Very nice, human! I'm starting to see you differently. As... useful.

1226220411002273-KarkarIsland-.name: One of the valuable skills our meerkats have to master is the art of conversation. Gathering information from the people you talk to is key, no matter who you're dealing with.

1226220411002274-KarkarIsland-.name: There's been a rumor that a ghost has shown up in $map:02010033$. $MyPCName$, I want you to find that ghost and talk to it. Find out everything you can from it. If you bring me enough info from your meeting, you pass this test.

1226220411002275-KarkarIsland-.name: Heh heh... Are you afraid of the ghost? It's fine if you are. I wouldn't expect a human to be as brave as a meerkat. And if you think I'm wrong, maybe you should find yourself a ghost.

1226220411002276-KarkarIsland-.name: Hee hee hee... You've got guts, human. Aren't you scared of me?

1226220411002277-KarkarIsland-.name: Honestly, I think you're a meerkat in a costume.

1226220411002278-KarkarIsland-.name: I'm not scared, I'm angry! Let's fight!

1226220411002279-KarkarIsland-.name: What are you talking about? I'm no meerkat! Look at me, I'm $npcName:11001407[gender:0]$! I'm the great and terrible ghost who conquered this desert, hee hee hee!

1226220411002281-KarkarIsland-.name: Hey, is that a giant eagle coming this way?

1226220411002282-KarkarIsland-.name: Fine! I accept your challenge! What game shall we play?

1226220411002283-KarkarIsland-.name: No games. I want an argument.

1226220411002285-KarkarIsland-.name: Are you even listening? I'm not a meerkat! I'm $npcName:11001407[gender:0]$! How many times do I need to remind you? Hee hee hee!

1226220411002286-KarkarIsland-.name: Hey, is that a giant eagle coming this way?

1226220411002287-KarkarIsland-.name: My, that's a tasty insect in the water there.

1226220411002288-KarkarIsland-.name:
E-eagle? No! I need to hide! Hide me!

<font color="#909090">(Yep, that's definitely a meerkat.)</font>

1226220411002289-KarkarIsland-.name: I'm pretty sure I win this round.

1226220411002290-KarkarIsland-.name: You're such a strange human. Not afraid of ghosts? Not even of a big, spooky ghost in these dark, spooky ruins?

1226220411002292-KarkarIsland-.name: One-legged fight? Hee hee hee... You messed up, human. I never skip leg day! Let's do this!

1226220411002293-KarkarIsland-.name: What exactly does a ghost do on leg day?

1226220411002294-KarkarIsland-.name: Really? Let me have it, then! Ooh, I'm so hungry.

1226220411002296-KarkarIsland-.name: Argh... You're pretty smart for a human. Alright, you got me. I'm a meerkat. And I owe you a reward.

704155711003078-Striker-.name: Wait, wait, hold the phone... Where the heck did you get this? No wonder $npcName:11001212[gender:0]$ sent you to me... do you even know what you have here? What's the story? Come on, out with it!

704155711003079-Striker-.name: Well, it all started after I beat $npcName:23090005[gender:0]$...

704155711003080-Striker-.name: Ah. Ahhhh. So. You tried to purify your prize from defeating $npcName:23090005[gender:0]$, going so far as to use $item:30000421$, but in the end all you had to show for it was cursed junk. Do I have this right?

704155711003082-Striker-.name: Ha ha ha! Well, it's a good thing you found me. 105153412001493--.name: Did you feel any weakness? Sudden bouts of despair? Terror at the horrors that will doubtless befall you?

105153412001495--.name: Just as I expected! When I saw the $item:30000419$, I felt indescribable dread in the very pit of my stomach. But there's something more to it. Something beneath the evil...

105153412001496--.name: Can you be a little more precise?

105153412001497--.name: I wish I could. All I can tell you is that this $item:30000419$ isn't normal.

105153412001498--.name: This is all beyond my area of expertise, you see. I can speculate, if you really want me to, but if you want answers, then... I'm going to have to refer you to someone else.

105153412001499--.name: Who should I ask for advice?

105153412001500--.name: I haven't met him personally, but there's one of the fairfolk who's made a name for himself in the field of life magic. I believe he may be able to solve the mysteries of this $item:30000419$.

105153412001501--.name: Where can I find that fairfolk?

105153412001502--.name: $map:2000023$ is a place of wise men and sages. I'm certain you will be able to find $npcName:11001210[gender:0]$ there.

105153412001503--.name: I thought you'd be in more of a hurry to see $npcName:11001210[gender:0]$. I wouldn't hold onto that blood any longer than you have to.

105153412001504--.name: I sense a vile presence. What have you brought me?

105153412001506--.name: $item:30000419$...? Is this the evil presence I detected?

105153412001508--.name: Incredible... All life must return to nature. That is the law of mortality that binds us all. But somehow this blood exists in defiance of that law...

105153412001509--.name: Eternal life that rejects the laws of mortality...? No. No, there's something very wrong with this…

105153412001511--.name: I am beginning to understand. The $item:30000419$ is infused with the life force of many different creatures. Somehow, that's allowing it to resist the laws of nature and mortality.

105153412001512--.name: But that's not all. There is also an intense malice in the very core of the blood. Enough malice to shatter a normal human mind.

105153412001513--.name: But there's... there's something else, buried even deeper. It's barely perceptible, but it's powerful. Frighteningly powerful...

105153412001514--.name: May I hold onto this for a moment? The power at the very core of the blood is powerful, but I sense no evil in it. If I can purify this blood of its malice, we may be able to learn the nature of this power.

105153412001515--.name: May I hold onto this for a moment? The power at the very core of the blood is powerful, but I sense no evil in it. If I can purify this blood of its malice, we may be able to learn the nature of this power.

105153412001516--.name: May I attempt to purify the $item:30000420$?

105153412001518--.name: It is said that $npcName:23190005[gender:0]$ never stops beating. I can certainly see why. The $item:30000420$ within this blood is what powers it...

105153412001519--.name: So the source of his power... isn't evil?

105153412001520--.name: That's right. Even in this small particle of $item:30000420$, I see a wonder I've never before encountered.

105153412001521--.name: If one were to gather enough of these fragments, to merge them into a complete form... Well, anything could happen. You may have the $item:30000420$ now.

105153412001522--.name: One concern I should warn you about. This $item:30000420$ is but a fragment. But were you to perfect it, it would become a whirling source of endless magic. It would be powerful, yes, but it would break the laws of nature. Would that make it good... or evil?

105153412001523--.name: What matters is how it's used.

105153412001524--.name: Hmm... When a new life is born, an old life returns to the earth. This is the balance of nature. Something like $item:30000420$, which only creates power and never consumes it... That would be like a world of birth without death. Such a thing cannot be sustained.

105153412001525--.name: Excess leads to imbalance. An ever-expanding power may be useful at first, but it could well go out of control and consume us all.

105153412001526--.name: So there's no way to safely use it?

105153412001527--.name: I don't think... Wait. Yes, perhaps Harcha could do it...

105153412001529--.name: He is a blacksmith at $map:2000203$. A friend of mine. I met him while I was researching the possibility of life regeneration through mineral... That is neither here nor there. His family has a special smithing technique that is of particular interest to us.

105153412001531--.name: He said he was studying to use this technique to imbue a weapon with potent magic. Magic more powerful than anything the enchanters of the day had. The secret was balance... His ancestors had a method of balancing powerful magic so that it wouldn't run rampant.

105153412001532--.name: We could use that balance to control this power!

105153412001533--.name: Presumably we could, but he hadn't yet perfected the technique when I last spoke to him. It seems there was a certain mineral that he couldn't find anywhere.

105153412001534--.name: That was some time ago. Maybe he's figured it out by now. Either way, I believe Harcha is your best bet at turning the $item:30000420$ to a useful purpose. Why don't you seek him out at $map:2000203$?

105153412001535--.name: I believe Harcha is your best bet at turning the $item:30000420$ to a useful purpose. Why don't you seek him out at $map:2000203$?

105153412001536--.name: Sorry. I don't do custom orders.

105153412001537--.name: Do you know where I can find Harcha?

105153412001538--.name: Do I? Harcha was my great-granddad!

105153412001539--.name: I wonder why someone'd send you to find Harcha. It's been decades since he quit smithing...

105153412001540--.name: Did he ever figure out how to balance magic in a weapon?

105153412001541--.name: Not many people knew about his research. He had theories, but the old man never did manage to make such a weapon. I've got some ideas of my own, and I even have some leads...

105153412001543--.name: There's a mineral called $item:30000421$ that's supposedly sops up unstable magic like a sponge. I hear they use it to clean curses off the land and such.

105153412001544--.name: If I had some of that, I bet I could finish my great-grandad's work.

105153412001545--.name: Problem is, you can't get it anywhere in Victoria Island. There just aren't any deposits here. And even if I did have it, $item:30000421$ is just the stabilizing agent. Without a source of power to stabilize, it's not much good.

105153412001549--.name: $npcName:23190005[gender:0]$?! W-wow! Yes, this'll... this'll do the trick!

105153412001550--.name: Wherever you got that, we need more. And the $item:30000421$, too. I need enough of both to refine and recombine into a stable form... No... No, it couldn't work, could it?

105153412001552--.name: Huh? Oh, right. So, I have good news... and twice as much bad news. What do you want first?

105153412001554--.name: Let's get the bad news out of the way.

105153412001555--.name: The good news is that the power of the $item:30000420$ should be compatible with $item:30000421$. Together, they'll make a weapon unlike anything Maple World has ever seen.

105153412001558--.name: First, the $item:30000420$ you brought me is impressive... but it's just one fragment. We'll need more if we want to show its true power.

105153412001559--.name: Second, remember how I said you can't get $item:30000421$ anywhere in Victoria Island? Without that ore, we're dead in the water. Unless the Allicari brought some with them from across the sea, but what are the odds of that?

105153412001560--.name: Is it possible they did bring some? No, no, I'm just getting my hopes up at this point. There's no way we'll get our hands on any $item:30000421$...

105153412001563--.name: I'm glad your eager, but don't get your hopes up! First, I need more $itemPlural:30000420$. There's no point in doing this in half-steps. We want a weapon that will go down in legend.

105153412001564--.name: Then, we need to get our hands on $item:30000421$ somehow. The Allicari merchants in $map:2000064$ might have some, but that's a long shot.

105153412001565--.name: If, against all odds, you can get the materials I need, I'll take care of the rest.

105153412001566--.name: Once again, I need two materials. First, I need more $itemPlural:30000420$. There's no point in doing this in half-steps. We want a weapon that will go down in legend.

105153412001567--.name: Then, we need to get our hands on $item:30000421$ somehow. The Allicari merchants in $map:2000064$ might have some, but that's a long shot.

105153412001568--.name: If, against all odds, you can get the materials I need, I'll take care of the rest.

105153412001569--.name: You actually did it! Well... Luckily for you, I already prepared a weapon mold. Give me some time to synthesize the materials you brought me...

105153412001573--.name: <font color="#909090">(He's concentrating harder than you've ever seen anyone concentrate before. It's making you a little uncomfortable.)</font>

105153412001575--.name: N-no... I infused the weapon with the $itemPlural:30000420$ and $item:30000421$, but something went wrong. Some sort of dark magic flared up from within the essences. I'm sorry…

105153412001577--.name: It's as powerful as they come, but it's basically cursed. It's not safe to use in this state.

105153412001578--.name: I've shamed my great-granddad. No matter what it takes, I swear I'll find a way to make this weapon usable!

416153812003076-Mastery05-.name: Hi, $MyPCName$, I'm $npc:11003870[gender:0]$, from Berg Island. We've finished reviewing your application, and your 50,000,000 meso payment has been processed. I've got your authorization forms right here, and I'm happy to welcome to the Berg Mining Collective.

416153812003077-Mastery05-.name: Um... I think there's been a mix-up. I didn't sign up for anything.

416153812003078-Mastery05-.name: Hahaha. Very funny. In any case, after a year-long vetting process, and a substantial investment, I'm sure you're quite eager to begin taking advantage of your exclusive access to one of the world's richest, and most varied mineral deposits ever discovered.

416153812003079-Mastery05-.name: But, I didn't pay for any of that...

416153812003080-Mastery05-.name: Uhh... You are $MyPCName$, are you not...? It's unlikely our accountants transposed an identification number, but I'd be mortified to mistakenly hand over access to hundreds of millions of mesos worth of minerals to someone who wasn't a member of the collective...

416153812003081-Mastery05-.name: H-hundreds... of millions...? Why yes, I am $MyPCName$, and I'm ready to visit Whats-Its-Name Island right away.

416153812003082-Mastery05-.name: Oh, excellent! For a moment I thought one of our employees had made a terrible, career-ending mistake. Anywho, come meet me at $map:02000424$ and I'll get you all set up!

416153812003083-Mastery05-.name: Go and meet $npc:11000454[gender:0]$ in $map:02000062$. He'll arrange your voyage.

416153812003084-Mastery05-.name: <font color="#909090">(Is this really happening? You should go to $map:02000062$ for now.)</font>

416153812003085-Mastery05-.name: Nice day for some weather, huh?

416153812003086-Mastery05-.name: So there I was in a world of trouble. Me in a leaky lifeboat bailing fast as I could, against the stormy fury of the sea...  I've had smoother journeys.

416153812003087-Mastery05-.name: Speaking of... You know, I almost married a mermaid once! I think I dodged a bullet there, but sometimes I think of those poor mermaids who missed out.

416153812003088-Mastery05-.name: <font color="#909090">(Across the room, $npcName:11000453$ rolls her eyes in disbelief.)</font>

416153812003090-Mastery05-.name: Oh, you know, cultural differences. We were from different worlds, after all!

416153812003091-Mastery05-.name: No...  The boat! What happened with the boat?

416153812003093-Mastery05-.name: Oh, ahoy there. Did you need something?

416153812003094-Mastery05-.name: I'm just looking for a ride to $map:02000424$.

416153812003095-Mastery05-.name: Ohh, I bet you're the one $npcName:11003870[gender:0]$ was talking about! The lucky new member of the Berg Mining Collective!

416153812003096-Mastery05-.name: I've already set everything up with $npc:11000981[gender:0]$ over in $map:02000062$'s southern quay. He'll book your passage to $map:02000424$.

416153812003098-Mastery05-.name: Ahaha, right! Where was I? I guess I'll start over...

416153812003099-Mastery05-.name: NO! Um, you stopped at the part where you arrived on $map:02000424$!

416153812003100-Mastery05-.name: Well then! So there I was lying on the shores of $map:02000424$, barely breathing, and without a ship to my name.

416153812003101-Mastery05-.name: Stranded on that island, all I could do was wait. But as $map:02000062$'s greatest fisherman, I at least wouldn't have to worry about going hungry.

416153812003102-Mastery05-.name: <font color="#909090">($npcName:11000455$ seems a little skeptical, but otherwise enraptured.)</font>

416153812003104-Mastery05-.name: In between wild bouts of fishing, I explored the secrets of $map:02000424$. Turns out... it's full of rocks! And not just any rocks, but minerals as far as the eye can see!

416153812003105-Mastery05-.name: Yes, I conquered $map:02000424$ all on my own, thanks to my perseverance and wit! If only I'd been the first to stake a claim, I'd be rich.

416153812003107-Mastery05-.name: Ahaha! If I had a meso for every time I heard that...

416153812003109-Mastery05-.name: Oh, you're the mining enthusiast $npc:11000454[gender:0]$ talked about. Well, it sounds like no one could appreciate $map:02000424$ like you.

416153812003110-Mastery05-.name: You'll need to take a Berg Mining Collective boat to $map:02000424$. I'll handle all the paperwork, I've got a few copies I half filled out earlier.

416153812003111-Mastery05-.name: That boat'll take you straight to $map:02000424$, no stops or layovers. Then you can find $npcName:11003870[gender:0]$, who I'm sure you can't wait to meet.

416153812003112-Mastery05-.name: Fortunately, the seas are calm today. Safe voyage!

416153812003113-Mastery05-.name: Fortunately, the seas are calm today. Safe voyage!

416153812003114-Mastery05-.name: Welcome to $map:02000424$. This island belongs to the Berg Mining Collective, and now you can count yourself a proud member. As long as you don't go over your daily allotment, you can mine as much as you like.

416153812003115-Mastery05-.name: You're lucky the weather is clear and the sea is calm. Boat rides can be perilous.

416153812003116-Mastery05-.name: After $map:02000424$ was purchased by the Berg Mining Collective, a geological survey revealed it to be one of the most mineral-diverse places on the planet.

416153812003117-Mastery05-.name: And now you, and a handful of other carefully selected individuals, can share in the profit.

416153812003118-Mastery05-.name: Anytime you need to mine some precious rocks, this is the place to do it.

416153812003119-Mastery05-.name: What makes this island so special is that there are veins of just about every ore and mineral found in Maple World right here. It's like an everything bagel, but with rocks!

416153812003120-Mastery05-.name: Hey, since you're here... You think you could help me out?

416153812003122-Mastery05-.name: It's just a small favor. Literally, it's a small object I want you to deliver. Since my job here is as the island's caretaker, it would be weird if I did it myself. So... here.

416153812003124-Mastery05-.name: Deliver this $item:30001128$ to a $npcTitle:11003871$ named $npcName:11003871[gender:0]$</font>. If you head up those steps and follow the path, you'll run into him sooner or later.

416153812003125-Mastery05-.name: I know you just got here, but to be fair this is a GREAT way to learn the lay of the land!

416153812003126-Mastery05-.name: Deliver this $item:30001128$ to a $npcTitle:11003871$ named $npcName:11003871[gender:0]$</font>. If you head up those steps and follow the path, you'll run into him sooner or later.

813141612003221-Mastery05-.name: How could you be so clumsy and lose it? Go get another one!

813141612003222-Mastery05-.name: Huh? Don't you have it already? Snap out of it!

813141612003223-Mastery05-.name: Your bag is full. Clear out your bag first.

416153812003129-Mastery05-.name: Why are you giving this to me? Where is $npcName:11003870[gender:0]$?

416153812003131-Mastery05-.name: This isn't even what I asked for. I bet $npcName:11003870[gender:0]$ couldn't get the right item and sent you so he wouldn't have to deal with it. You poor sap.

416153812003132-Mastery05-.name: Well, it's not your fault. Thanks for trying, anyway. Maybe I can find something to do with this $item:30001128$.

416153812003133-Mastery05-.name: Welp, I guess I'll head back to $npcName:11003870[gender:0]$ now...

416153812003134-Mastery05-.name: Oh, hang on! Can you help me with something since you're here?

416153812003135-Mastery05-.name: Ooh, I'd love to but I'm pretty busy...

416153812003137-Mastery05-.name: Oh, okay. That's fine. Yeah, no problem, I'll just keep working while my daughter grows up without her father, and my wife grows more distant by the day.

416153812003138-Mastery05-.name: Really, it's no trouble at all. Gives me more time to figure out what I'll tell my daughter when she's grown and asks what her dad has been doing with his life.

416153812003139-Mastery05-.name: That's just being a father for you. Yep, I don't need any help or anything, really. You go about your urgent business. I'm sure it's very important. Very. Important.

416153812003143-Mastery05-.name: Gather up the minerals you find around here and take them to $npcName:11003872[gender:0]$.

416153812003145-Mastery05-.name: Gather up the minerals you find around here and take them to $npcName:11003872[gender:0]$.

416153812003146-Mastery05-.name: Who are you, and why are you bringing me minerals? Are you licensed to be moving those around?

416153812003148-Mastery05-.name: Oh, $npc:11003871[gender:0]$ asked you to do it! I'm not surprised he's trying to pawn his work off like that... Anyway, thanks.

416153812003149-Mastery05-.name: So hey, if you're here in $map:02000424$, that must mean you're in good with the collective. You must be trustworthy. Diligent.

416153812003150-Mastery05-.name: If that's the case, I look forward to seeing you around here.

416153812003151-Mastery05-.name: Uh, yeah! Totally the case. Let's be buddies!

416153812003152-Mastery05-.name: Well said! It's been a pleasure... buddy!

416153812003154-Mastery05-.name: Fine folks like you are always welcome!

416153812003155-Mastery05-.name: Yikes, you look exhausted. How's $map:02000424$ treating you?

416153812003156-Mastery05-.name: Oh, it's great. Lots of rocks, and lots of people who... need things.

416153812003157-Mastery05-.name: Ha! Yeah, I heard you've been running all over the island. The collective definitely picked you for a reason.

416153812003158-Mastery05-.name: Well you're certainly welcome anytime! I'm convinced, and that's good enough for anyone.

416153812003161-Mastery05-.name: Although most know me as $npcName:11000005[gender:1]$, the Head Librarian of $map:02000031$, I'm also a member of the Alkimi Guild!

416153812003162-Mastery05-.name: I've contacted you because the guild has been looking for you. Don't worry, that's a good thing!

416153812003163-Mastery05-.name: The guild has recognized your incredible talent for foraging, $MyPCName$, and so they would like to invite you to $map:02000425$.

416153812003164-Mastery05-.name: Go to $map:02000069$ in $map:02000062$ and speak to a $npcTitle:11003876$ named $npcName:11003876[gender:1]$. She will arrange your voyage to $map:02000425$.

416153812003165-Mastery05-.name: That's all! I think they wanted me to tell you in person so you wouldn't think the offer was junk mail.

416153812003166-Mastery05-.name: <font color="#909090">(You should go to $map:02000062$ and meet $npc:11003876[gender:1]$ at $map:02000069$.)</font>

416153812003167-Mastery05-.name: ...I really wish books didn't get so dusty.

416153812003169-Mastery05-.name: That's me. So who are these Alkimi Guild people, and why do they want me to come to their island?

416153812003170-Mastery05-.name: You don't know? The Alkimi Guild is super into alchemy. I thought they invited you because you're some kind of herb-gathering hotshot?

416153812003171-Mastery05-.name: Not just anybody can charter a boat to $map:02000425$, y'know. It's a real honor to be invited!

416153812003172-Mastery05-.name: And it's supposed to be so beautiful there. I'm so jealous you get to go!

416153812003173-Mastery05-.name: In any case, I think they're expecting me to help you arrange a ship to get there.  I don't mind, of course. I'm at home around ships!

416153812003176-Mastery05-.name: Alright, we'll be launching from here for $map:02000425$. Just give us a second to get the ship ship-shape!

416153812003178-Mastery05-.name: You all set? We're ready to set sail!

416153812003179-Mastery05-.name: You can take the ship to $map:02000425$ whenever you want!

416153812003180-Mastery05-.name: Farewell! And bring back some pictures or something!

416153812003181-Mastery05-.name: I want to see that beautiful $map:02000425$ scenery!

416153812003182-Mastery05-.name: Farewell! And bring back some pictures or something! I want to see that beautiful scenery of $map:02000425$!

416153812003184-Mastery05-.name: I'm $npcName:11003878[gender:1]$, the caretaker of $map:02000425$. I hope the journey here was no trouble for you.

416153812003185-Mastery05-.name: This island belongs to the Alkimi Guild, and is used as an herb sanctuary. We maintain the peace and integrity of this place by limiting who may visit.

416153812003186-Mastery05-.name: You were chosen, $MyPCName$, because of your extraordinary talent and appreciation for handling such herbs.

416153812003187-Mastery05-.name: Oh, goodness, I just remembered. I was supposed to dispatch lunch to our $npcTitle:11003879$, $npcName:11003879[gender:0]$, but I'm afraid I lost track of the time.

416153812003188-Mastery05-.name: Perhaps we can help each other, then? If you deliver the packed lunch, you can tour the island while correcting my terrible oversight.

416153812003189-Mastery05-.name: This sounds a lot like busywork...

416153812003190-Mastery05-.name: Oh, dear! I would never dream of wasting your time! Let me assure you, I never ask random tasks of my associates. Ever! What favors I ask always have a clear purpose.

416153812003191-Mastery05-.name: Please deliver $item:30001130$ to $npcName:11003879[gender:0]$. I would be forever grateful!

416153812003192-Mastery05-.name: Please deliver $item:30001130$ to $npcName:11003879[gender:0]$. I would be forever grateful!

814134512003225-Mastery05-.name: Don't tell me you lost it! Do you think it's easy making a packed lunch? Don't lose it this time!

814134512003226-Mastery05-.name: Isn't that the packed lunch in your hand? You must be really exhausted.

814134512003227-Mastery05-.name: You should check your bag first. I think it's full.

416153812003194-Mastery05-.name: Hey, I've got this packed lunch for a guy named $npcName:11003879[gender:0]$?

416153812003195-Mastery05-.name: Sigh... $npcName:11003878[gender:1]$ forgot about our lunches again, didn't she?

416153812003196-Mastery05-.name: Thank you. I was getting hungry and losing faith in ever seeing this lunch. What's your name?

416153812003199-Mastery05-.name: $MyPCName$. You've obviously got a good heart. Mind doing me a favor?

416153812003200-Mastery05-.name: Since I'm on my lunch break, could you pull the <font color="#ffd200">weeds</font> around here while I eat?

416153812003201-Mastery05-.name: Couldn't you just do it after lunch?

416153812003202-Mastery05-.name: I could. If I wolf it down as quick as I can.

416153812003203-Mastery05-.name: But you saw this lunch, right? Surely you can appreciate its delectable flavors and aromas. I want to savor it while I can.

416153812003204-Mastery05-.name: Fine, fine, just stop talking. You're making me hungry.

416153812003205-Mastery05-.name: I really appreciate this. I never get to enjoy my lunches!

416153812003207-Mastery05-.name: $npc:11003879[gender:0]$ is really going at that lunch...

416153812003208-Mastery05-.name: Looks like you've finished your lunch.

416153812003209-Mastery05-.name: Mm, worth every bite! I can't thank you enough for giving me the time to relax for once.

416153812003210-Mastery05-.name: Here, I've wiped the lunch box clean. Please return it to $npc:11003878[gender:1]$ on your way back.

416153812003211-Mastery05-.name: <font color="#909090">(Looks like you're going back to $npc:11003878[gender:1]$.)</font>

416153812003212-Mastery05-.name: You're a real hero, my friend! Have a safe trip back!

416153812003213-Mastery05-.name: I'm stuffed. It's been too long since I really enjoyed a meal.

814134512003229-Mastery05-.name: It seems all I did was talk and talk, and I completely forgot to give you the $item:30001131$. Here, take it.

814134512003230-Mastery05-.name: Isn't it in your bags already?

814134512003231-Mastery05-.name: Why don't you clear out your bag first?

416153812003214-Mastery05-.name: <font color="#909090">(You return the empty lunch box to $npc:11003878[gender:1]$.)</font>

416153812003215-Mastery05-.name: So, what do you think of $map:02000425$?

416153812003216-Mastery05-.name: It's a beautiful island, isn't it?

416153812003218-Mastery05-.name: I saw you pulling weeds for $npcName:11003879[gender:0]$. I didn't expect you to be so gracious with your time. I see we chose well in inviting you to come here. Consider yourself welcome to avail yourself to the bounties of the island at any time!

416153812003219-Mastery05-.name: This isn't much, but you deserve something for your trouble. Hope you enjoy it.

107040911002340-Balrogitem3rd-.name:
Oh, isn't that $MyPCName$! Come see me for a moment.
I heard a <font color="#ffd200">strange story</font> recently and I thought I absolutely had to tell you.

107040911002342-Balrogitem3rd-.name:
It's a bit ambiguous, but... it's definitely an interesting story.
A <font color="#ffd200">shaman</font> who said he came from <font color="#ffd200">another continent</font> visited here recently.
Introducing himself as someone who researches demons, he asked the blacksmiths here
if they'd heard rumors of a <font color="#ffd200">powerful demon surrounded by scorching heat</font>.

107040911002344-Balrogitem3rd-.name:
He left for $map:02000200$ looking quite pleased.
And he left behind some very intriguing words:
<font color="#ffd200">"I will enter the demon's consciousness and find a way to break the curse."</font>

107040911002343-Balrogitem3rd-.name:
That <font color="#ffd200">$npc:23090005[gender:0]$</font> you defeated came to mind,
so I told him what I heard from you. He showed tremendous interest.
So I told him you can reach $npcName:23090005[gender:0]$'s lair from somewhere in <font color="#ffd200">$map:02000200$</font>.

107040911002347-Balrogitem3rd-.name:
If that shaman's story is true, then the <font color="#ffd200">bizarre curse</font> on your weapon
could also be lifted. What do you say? Nothing to lose... worth a try, isn't it?

107040911002346-Balrogitem3rd-.name:
According to ancient records, to defeat demons with great power,
you must <font color="#ffd200">enter the demon's consciousness</font> during the brief moment when its power weakens.
If you identify the essence of that being deep within its consciousness, you can not only discover its weakness
but also find <font color="#ffd200">a way to break its curse</font>.

107040911002349-Balrogitem3rd-.name:
You'd be better off asking the shaman directly.
He only left for <font color="#ffd200">$map:02000200$</font> recently, so hurry and go.
His name was <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11001485[gender:0]$</font>.

107040911002348-Balrogitem3rd-.name: Asks how to enter the demon's consciousness.

107040911002350-Balrogitem3rd-.name:
That shaman called <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11001485[gender:0]$</font> left for <font color="#ffd200">$map:02000200$</font>.
He wore his cloak pulled low, and there was a strange aura about him.
Go to <font color="#ffd200">$map:02000200$</font> and find him.

107040911002351-Balrogitem3rd-.name:
...I definitely heard a sound. Something seems to have changed.
Damn. If only it weren't so dark in here...!
This cursed <font color="#ffd200">night blindness</font> persists even in monster form…

107040911002352-Balrogitem3rd-.name:
This demon... <font color="#ffd200">$npc:23090005[gender:0]$</font>...
Perhaps this thing is what made me look like <font color="#ffd200">this</font>...
I can't go back like this. This isn't right...!

107040911002354-Balrogitem3rd-.name:
Huh? Someone's there?
No, more importantly—how do you know <font color="#ffd200">my name</font>?

107040911002355-Balrogitem3rd-.name:
What brings you all the way to a place this dark?
Actually, before that—how do you know my name? Are you a <font color="#ffd200">minion of the demon</font>?

107040911002356-Balrogitem3rd-.name: Holds out the $item:13200043$ and asks for help breaking the curse.

107040911002357-Balrogitem3rd-.name:
No...! What is this terrible curse?!
Could this be connected to that demon called <font color="#ffd200">$npc:23090005[gender:0]$</font>? The one that lives here?

107040911002359-Balrogitem3rd-.name:
I don't know where you heard that, but... yes. That's correct.
Ancient records say that if you enter the consciousness of the demon that cast a curse
and discover the essence of that being, you can easily break the <font color="#ffd200">demon's curse</font>.

107040911002358-Balrogitem3rd-.name: Asks if it's possible to enter $npc:23090005[gender:0]$'s consciousness and break this weapon's curse.

107040911002362-Balrogitem3rd-.name:
Lately, space-time has been distorting and rifts have been appearing throughout the world...
Somewhere around here, a passage seems to have opened into that thing's psyche.
Of course, whether you can survive in there is another matter entirely…

107040911002361-Balrogitem3rd-.name:
We're dealing with a demon of great power. It won't easily let someone infiltrate its consciousness.
Normally you'd have to wait for the <font color="#ffd200">moment its power weakens</font>. It differs for each demon—
a lunar eclipse, sharing power with a successor, extended midnight sun—you'd have to strike it down during those moments, but...

107040911002363-Balrogitem3rd-.name:
If you still plan to enter $npc:23090005[gender:0]$'s consciousness, I'd like you to describe what you see in detail.
Truth is, I was investigating ancient ruins when I suddenly turned into this grotesque form.
I think it's because of a <font color="#ffd200">demon's curse</font>, but I have no idea which demon did it.
I crossed continents to find out, but... I just keep finding more to research with no answers.

107040911002364-Balrogitem3rd-.name:
Oh, and you should keep that weapon safe.
There's no telling what form the clue to breaking a demon's curse might take.
If you don't bring the weapon, you might regret it.

107040911002365-Balrogitem3rd-.name:
If you do enter $npc:23090005[gender:0]$'s consciousness, keep it safe. That weapon, I mean.
There's no telling what form the clue to breaking a demon's curse might take.
If you don't bring the weapon, you might regret it.

107040911002366-Balrogitem3rd-.name:
Looks like you made it back in one piece!
What was it like inside $npc:23090005[gender:0]$'s consciousness?

107040911002368-Balrogitem3rd-.name:
The Immortal Flame...! You broke the curse with that scorching heat?
To have gone to such a dangerous place and back... <font color="#ffd200">$MyPCName$</font>, well done.

107040911002369-Balrogitem3rd-.name: Asks if the curse on $npcName:11001485[gender:0]$ might be related to $npc:23090005[gender:0]$.

107040911002371-Balrogitem3rd-.name:
Anyway, thanks, $MyPCName$!
If you learn of another powerful demon, please come tell me about it.

Anyway, thanks, $MyPCName$!
If you learn about another powerful demon, be sure to tell me about it.

107040911002786-Balrogitem3rd-.name:
No, I don't think so. Ever since I became like this, my whole body has always been cold.
So my curse seems to be far removed from the power of fire.
Though learning more about an interesting being called $npc:23090005[gender:0]$ is certainly a good thing.

107110822004169-EpicApocalypse02-.name:
That's... ugh, the rift.
It won't even give me a chance to explain.

107110822004168-EpicApocalypse02-.name: What do you mean the rift's power has grown stronger?

107110822004170-EpicApocalypse02-.name: You should hear the story from $npcName:11004783[gender:1]$ beside me.

107110822004172-EpicApocalypse02-.name:
$MyPCName$.
As you may have heard briefly from $npcName:11004793$...
The <font color="#ffd200">rift's power</font> has grown stronger.

107110822004173-EpicApocalypse02-.name:
And... a <font color="#ffd200">different power</font> than before can be felt from within the rift.
It seems like some kind of anomaly has occurred.

107110822004174-EpicApocalypse02-.name: It seems like some kind of anomaly has occurred.

107110822004175-EpicApocalypse02-.name:
Recently, the rift suddenly began shaking unstably,
and there was an instance where its scale grew slightly larger.

107110822004176-EpicApocalypse02-.name:
After that, <font color="#ffd200">strange laughter</font> could be heard...
and <font color="#ffd200">unidentified orbs</font> came flying out.

107110822004178-EpicApocalypse02-.name:
Ah, yes.
They were dangerous-looking orbs.
While $npcName:11004793$ and I were deliberating... we sent them to <font color="#ffd200">'that person'</font> at the Frontier Foundation.
We didn't have the capacity to deal with them ourselves.

107110822004180-EpicApocalypse02-.name:
Who do you think!
<font size='40'>It's none other than the great $npcName:11004828[gender:0]$!</font>

107110822004184-EpicApocalypse02-.name:
More importantly, now's not the time for that.
This great $npcName:11004828[gender:0]$ has finished analyzing those orbs.

107110822004183-EpicApocalypse02-.name: How long have you been there?!

107110822004182-EpicApocalypse02-.name:
Hmm~ Why so startled?
Did you do something naughty?

107110822004186-EpicApocalypse02-.name:
I took them to the lab and ran various tests, but...
As expected, they're not made of any substance from our world.
The closest match I found is that they're composed of material similar to <font color="#ffd200">'Prism Stones'</font>.

107110822004185-EpicApocalypse02-.name:
!!!
Impressive.
What kind of objects were they?

107110822004189-EpicApocalypse02-.name: Who would have guessed there was new equipment inside?!

107110822004188-EpicApocalypse02-.name: <font size='40'>Who would have guessed there was <font color="#ffd200">new equipment</font> inside?!</font>

107110822004187-EpicApocalypse02-.name:
But the amazing part starts now.
A researcher accidentally shattered the orb,
and I nearly fainted from the shock.

107110822004191-EpicApocalypse02-.name:
Yeah.
Seeing as something inside is scattering these things outside,
whatever's in there is definitely trying to <font color="#ffd200">lure</font> us in.

107110822004192-EpicApocalypse02-.name:
Either way, we need to check the interior.
To find out what's happening in there.

107110822004193-EpicApocalypse02-.name:
That's a piece of cake, but...
Do I just need to look around and come back?

107110822004194-EpicApocalypse02-.name:
As expected of our $MyPCName$!
So brave, aren't you?

107110822004196-EpicApocalypse02-.name:
It's definitely changed from before.
Has a new space appeared?

107110822004203-EpicApocalypse02-.name:
It's me, me~ $npcName:11004831$!
You look really fun!

107110822004205-EpicApocalypse02-.name:
Yep yep. $npcName:11004831$!
You're a human I haven't seen before? I saw the white bear and the woman outside the rift though... hehit.
So funny!!!

107110822004206-EpicApocalypse02-.name:
...I don't know if you're $npcName:11004831$ or Bluebean,
but stop messing around inside the rift.

107110822004209-EpicApocalypse02-.name:
I said what I said!!!
<font size='40'>Bye-bye~!!!</font>

107110822004207-EpicApocalypse02-.name:
Kikkikkik. See, I knew you'd be fun.
Hey! If you play with me, I'll give you <font color="#ffd200">something good</font>.

107110822004208-EpicApocalypse02-.name:
?!
Don't say weird things!
Stop destabilizing the rift…

107110822004210-EpicApocalypse02-.name:
...What.
Just says what it wants and leaves?

107110822004211-EpicApocalypse02-.name:
Well... for now.
I should go see $npcName:11004816[gender:0]$.

107110822004212-EpicApocalypse02-.name:
Hm? You're back sooner than expected?
What happened…

107110822004214-EpicApocalypse02-.name:
I met a strange black blob.
Its name is... $npcName:11004831$.

107110822004213-EpicApocalypse02-.name: So there really was something in there?

107110822004216-EpicApocalypse02-.name: So, what did that little black bean say to you?

107110822004217-EpicApocalypse02-.name:

With a strange laugh.

107110822004218-EpicApocalypse02-.name: Something good? It said it would give you something good?!

107110822004221-EpicApocalypse02-.name:
In times like these, it's only natural to do what's asked.
$MyPCName$! You.

107110822004224-EpicApocalypse02-.name:
You fool! It's all for your sake!
Isn't it obvious what 'something good' means?

107110822004223-EpicApocalypse02-.name:
It's only natural to do what's asked.
$MyPCName$! You.
<font size='40'>Go play with that $npcName:11004831$ thing periodically.</font>

107110822004225-EpicApocalypse02-.name: <font size='40'>Something that can make you stronger.</font>

107110822004226-EpicApocalypse02-.name:
This thing is scattering new equipment outside willy-nilly.
It surely has even better stuff inside.

107110822004227-EpicApocalypse02-.name:
Hehehe...!
It'll be new research material.

107110822004229-EpicApocalypse02-.name:
<font color="#909090">...</font>
<font color="#909090">To protect Empress $npcName:11004820$, to protect $map:02000001$... I need power.</font>

107110822004231-EpicApocalypse02-.name:
Alright.
I'll try hanging out with that little black bean.

107110822004234-EpicApocalypse02-.name:
$npcName:11001812[gender:0]$.
Why did you tell that brat the whole truth?

107110822004232-EpicApocalypse02-.name:
I knew you'd say that!
Heheh.

107110822004233-EpicApocalypse02-.name:

107110822004236-EpicApocalypse02-.name:
$npcName:11001812[gender:0]$.
Why did you tell that brat the whole truth?

107110822004235-EpicApocalypse02-.name:
$npcName:11001812[gender:0]$.
Why did you tell that brat the whole truth?

107110822004238-EpicApocalypse02-.name:

107110822004237-EpicApocalypse02-.name:
Huhuhuh...
All of this was prophesied by Him.

107110822004239-EpicApocalypse02-.name:
The anxiety born from the Empress's fall.

107110822004241-EpicApocalypse02-.name:
...Soon, all of Maple World will become your domain.
$npcName:11001812[gender:0]$.

107110822004240-EpicApocalypse02-.name: How is the <font color="#ffd200">scattering</font> of the <font color="#ffd200">dark substance</font> progressing?

325112619011064-Fame_Geo01-.name:

Thank you for making the long trip.

327150219011077-Fame_Geo01-.name:
Member <font color="#ffd200">$MyPCName$</font> is indispensable even to the <font color="#ffd200">Maple Alliance</font>.
It seems I should hear the details, but…

327150219011081-Fame_Geo01-.name:
You came, $MyPCName$.
Thank you for making the long trip.

327150219011079-Fame_Geo01-.name:
First, I think it would be best to discuss the details in my office.
Please spare a moment.

327150219011082-Fame_Geo01-.name: (Say you came after hearing Captain $npcName:11004408[gender:0]$'s words.)

327150219011090-Fame_Geo01-.name: Immediately after becoming <font color="#ffd200">allies</font>, we mainly carried out <font color="#ffd200">joint military operations</font> against hostile forces.

327150219011088-Fame_Geo01-.name:
<font size="40">Yes, we have become <font color="#ffd200">allies</font>.</font>
I think $MyPCName$ probably knows the process that led to the alliance well.

327150219011083-Fame_Geo01-.name:
Yes, I know.
The reason I called $MyPCName$$pp:를,을$ today is for <font color="#ffd200">something I want to tell you</font>...
and to <font color="#ffd200">ask for help</font>.

327150219011085-Fame_Geo01-.name: There is something I need to tell you about the <font color="#ffd200">Georg-Maple Alliance pact</font>.

327150219011098-Fame_Geo01-.name:
Recently... <font color="#ffd200">resident management in $map:02020030$</font> and <font color="#ffd200">refugee support</font>...
We have come face to face with various <font color="#ffd200">problem situations</font>.

327150219011095-Fame_Geo01-.name: In other words, <font color="#ffd200">the strategy has changed</font>.

327150219011096-Fame_Geo01-.name: <font size="40">But that is not the only thing Georg needs to pay attention to.</font>

327150219011091-Fame_Geo01-.name: But... now there has been a little <font color="#ffd200">change</font>.

327150219011093-Fame_Geo01-.name:
Yes.
The <font color="#ffd200">Maple Alliance</font> will <font color="#ffd200">check</font> <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11004430[gender:0]$'s subordinates</font>
and <font color="#ffd200">watch</font> the <font color="#ffd200">Black Legion's headquarters</font>.

327150219011099-Fame_Geo01-.name:
As you may have heard before, <font color="#ffd200">refugees</font> are those <font color="#ffd200">exiled</font> from the Kingdom of Tyren.
I do not want them to suffer as Kerbes's <font color="#ffd200">labor force</font>.

327150219011105-Fame_Geo01-.name:
The <font color="#ffd200">new data</font> and <font color="#ffd200">information</font> the Maple Alliance obtained with your help, $MyPCName$.
Georg <font color="#ffd200">desperately</font> needs them now.

327150219011100-Fame_Geo01-.name:
I judged that solving all these problems with the current <font color="#ffd200">Georg personnel</font> is <font color="#ffd200">impossible</font>.
That is why I asked you for help, $MyPCName$.

327150219011107-Fame_Geo01-.name: <font color="#909090">(I cannot refuse this request for help. If I solve problems together with $npcName:11004395[gender:1]$... somehow...)</font>

327150219011104-Fame_Geo01-.name:
<font color="#ffd200">Kritias investigation</font>, <font color="#ffd200">watching hostile forces</font>... and <font color="#ffd200">refugee support</font>.
Large tasks remain.

327150219011108-Fame_Geo01-.name:
I cannot turn away from this situation.
I will help Georg.

327150219011110-Fame_Geo01-.name:
Thank you very much, $MyPCName$.
With this, I can ease one of my worries.

327150219011114-Fame_Geo01-.name:
As the <font color="#ffd200">leader</font> of Georg,
I have a great deal of <font color="#ffd200">work</font> to do in <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020030$</font>.

327150219011111-Fame_Geo01-.name:
...Ah, and.
I forgot to mention it...
There is <font color="#ffd200">one problem</font>.

327150219011117-Fame_Geo01-.name:
Yes, I know.
That is why we at Georg thought about it a great deal.
And as a result...

327150219011120-Fame_Geo01-.name:
This <font color="#ffd200">means of transportation</font> to the right of the stairs serves to <font color="#ffd200">connect</font> <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020041$</font> and my <font color="#ffd200">office</font>.
Using it, you can move between the two places <font color="#ffd200">at any time</font>.

327150219011116-Fame_Geo01-.name: (Say that you also need to help the Maple Alliance in $map:02020041$.)

327150219011115-Fame_Geo01-.name:
As you know, there are many <font color="#ffd200">residents</font> in $map:02020030$...
and I have a <font color="#ffd200">duty</font> to protect them from the <font color="#ffd200">hostile forces</font> here.

327150219011118-Fame_Geo01-.name: We <font color="#ffd200">developed</font> a special <font color="#ffd200">means of transportation</font>.

327150219011126-Fame_Geo01-.name: The way to help me is the same as the <font color="#ffd200">method</font> you have used to carry out <font color="#ffd200">missions</font> for <font color="#ffd200">Sky Fortress</font> until now.

327150219011123-Fame_Geo01-.name: (...Say you will use it well and work hard to help both allies.)

327150219011124-Fame_Geo01-.name:
As expected, $MyPCName$$pp:는,은$ is a kind person.
To gladly accept even such an unreasonable request…

327150219011121-Fame_Geo01-.name: I think it will be very useful.

327150219011125-Fame_Geo01-.name: I am truly sorry... and grateful. $MyPCName$.

327171714003949-Event-KR.name:
Hey! Being this weak, honestly... Back in our day, that would never happen...
Instead of that, participate in our guards' traditional <font color="#ffd200">I Date Myself</font> training!
It will make you forget all useless thoughts. And that is not all. There are gifts too!

327150219011127-Fame_Geo01-.name:
If you talk to me here in <font color="#ffd200">$map:52100103$</font>,
I will give you <font color="#ffd200">Georg</font> <font color="#ffd200">missions</font>.

327150219011128-Fame_Geo01-.name: Then... please take good care of Georg.

327170419011130-Fame_Geo01-.name:
In <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020041$</font>, it has been placed here,
to the <font color="#ffd200">right</font> of <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11004412[gender:0]$</font>.

327171714003954-Event-KR.name:
The second training is to run on <font color="#ffd200">$item:50400096$</font> in your house or someone else's house.
After finishing the training, meet my colleague $npcName:11000157[gender:0]$$pp:를,을$ next.
They will guide you to the next training.

327171714003951-Event-KR.name:
Ah... It was you, $MyPCName$.
I wondered who was participating in the <font color="#ffd200">I Date Myself</font> training...

327171714003952-Event-KR.name:
The <font color="#ffd200">I Date Myself</font> training can be called "a journey to find my own coolness."
For that, you need to work on cultivating your coolest self, right?

327171714003953-Event-KR.name:
That is right. It is what Chief $npcName:11004313[gender:0]$ said. Quite cool, is it not?
And the chief said this:
If you run on <font color="#ffd200">$item:50400096$</font>, distracting thoughts, obsession, and gloom all disappear.

327171714003950-Event-KR.name:
The first training is a light warm-up.
Defeat one <font color="#ffd200">field boss</font>, then go to $npc:11000158[gender:0]$ in $map:02000118$!

327171714003956-Event-KR.name:
$MyPCName$, welcome to the <font color="#ffd200">I Date Myself</font> training.
Before I explain the contents of the third training, I will ask you one question.
What do you think <font color="#ffd200">romance</font> is?

327171714003958-Event-KR.name:
The <font color="#ffd200">third training</font> is to <font color="#ffd200">perform</font> one song using any score.
Immerse yourself in a world where only music and you exist.
After finishing the training, meet my colleague <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11000617[gender:0]$</font>$pp:를,을$ next.

327171714003957-Event-KR.name:
Your love for yourself is very wonderful, $MyPCName$. I respect it.
Then, may I talk about what I think romance is?

327171714003955-Event-KR.name:
$MyPCName$, I was waiting for you.
You finished the second training.

327171714003960-Event-KR.name:
The final training is very simple.
You only need to eat <font color="#ffd200">$item:20001312$</font>$pp:를,을$ that you received during the training so far.

327171714003963-Event-KR.name:
You finally finished it. Whew... Then, as the chief instructed... we will hold the <font color="#ffd200">completion ceremony</font>.
Training to make an even cooler self! Thank you for participating in <font color="#ffd200">I Date Myself</font>.
The chief will now say a few words.

327171714003961-Event-KR.name: Yes, that is all. That really is all.

402144014003994-Event-KR.name:

402144014003995-Event-KR.name: (Teasing the chief is surprisingly fun...) You say you want to hear it again.

402144014003998-Event-KR.name: You say you want to hear the chief's magnificent voice one more time.

402144014004001-Event-KR.name:

402144014003999-Event-KR.name:

402144014004002-Event-KR.name: You compliment him on his fine words.

402144014004003-Event-KR.name:
For your second exercise, run on a <font color="#ffd200">$item:50400096$</font> in your home or someone else's.
Once you've finished your training, meet my colleague $npcName:11000157[gender:0]$ next.

402144014004006-Event-KR.name: You answer, "I am the very embodiment of romance!"

402144014004005-Event-KR.name:
Wonderful. You're positively glowing!
Now, shall we move on to the next exercise?

402144014004008-Event-KR.name: You ask him to tell you.

402144014004007-Event-KR.name: You answer, "It has nothing to do with me..."

402144014004009-Event-KR.name:
No, $MyPCName$.
In my opinion, the way you look right now is romance itself.

402144014004010-Event-KR.name: You ask what he thinks romance really is.

402144014004011-Event-KR.name:
It is <font color="#ffd200">solitude</font>.
True romance is being alone, savoring solitude, and discovering yourself.
That's why I perform a mask dance whenever I feel gloomy.

402144014004013-Event-KR.name: You aren't sure what he means, but agree to try.

402144014004012-Event-KR.name: $MyPCName$, would you like to experience romance?

402144014004015-Event-KR.name:
Try <font color="#ffd200">performing</font> a song from any score.
Lose yourself in a world where only you and the music exist.
This is your <font color="#ffd200">third exercise</font>.

402144014004016-Event-KR.name:
Once you've finished your training, meet my colleague <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11000617[gender:0]$</font> next.

402144014004014-Event-KR.name: You say you don't want to perform a mask dance.

402144014004018-Event-KR.name: You say you'll do it, then.

402144014004017-Event-KR.name:
Ah, please don't misunderstand. That's not what I meant.
What I wanted to tell you about was your <font color="#ffd200">third exercise</font>.

402144014004021-Event-KR.name: You ask if that's really all.

402144014004020-Event-KR.name:
Ah... Ah. Welcome, $MyPCName$.
Now that you've completed your third exercise, let's move on to the final one.

402144014004022-Event-KR.name: You ask about the paper hidden behind his back.

402144014004023-Event-KR.name:
...Hah, you're far too observant for your own good.
It's the <font color="#ffd200">Charter of Black Flavor</font>. The chief gave it to me... Apparently, it's a song for those who complete their training.

402144014004026-Event-KR.name: (The chief's artistic sensibilities are...!) You say that's enough.

402144014004025-Event-KR.name:
B-black flavor. Curious, Guard... The taste of jajang that slowly melts when you take a bite.
Find the Chinese restaurant on the corner, Guard. What I love most is my lonely self…

402144014004024-Event-KR.name: You ask him to sing it.

402144014004027-Event-KR.name:
Yes. A wise choice. It's best to finish this sort of training quickly, indeed.
Eat <font color="#ffd200">$item:20001312$</font>, then return to me and I'll give you a gift.

402144014004028-Event-KR.name: You say you don't have any $item:20001312$.

402144014004029-Event-KR.name: You say you were just calling him.

402144014004030-Event-KR.name:
Sigh... Honestly. I suppose there's no other choice.
I'll give you <font color="#ffd200">the one I was eating</font>. Eat this, at least, and let's finish quickly.

402144014004031-Event-KR.name:
$MyPCName$... Look in your bag. <font color="#ffd200">You already have one.</font>
One is enough. If you get greedy, I'll tell the chief.

402144014004032-Event-KR.name:
Um... You should organize your bag before speaking to me.
I can't give you anything while it's that full.

402144014004033-Event-KR.name:
Sigh... If you have time for that, hurry up and finish your training.
Eat <font color="#ffd200">$item:20001312$</font>, then return to me and I'll give you a gift.

402153414004035-Event-KR.name:
...is what the chief asked me to tell you. Finally,
I'll give you the gift Chief $npcName:11004313[gender:0]$ prepared. Well done.

402153414004034-Event-KR.name:
<font color="#ffd200">Wasn't it rewarding to train to become an even greater, more impressive person?</font>
<font color="#ffd200">Don't languish in loneliness. For the sake of your future, devote yourself to self-improvement as though you were dating yourself!</font>
