403172422003326-Kritias_Epic02-.name: Defeat the Kerbes forces blocking entry to <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020066$</font>, and make sure the refugees are doing well.

403172422003325-Kritias_Epic02-.name:
This isn't only Chief <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11004578[gender:0]$</font>'s opinion.
Both <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11004582[gender:1]$</font> and I believe you're the right person for the task.

403172422003327-Kritias_Epic02-.name:
Who are you?
How did you get here?

403172422003329-Kritias_Epic02-.name:
You're asking where <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11004574[gender:1]$</font> is?
She's inside, so go on in.

403172422003331-Kritias_Epic02-.name:
How shameless of them to ask the very refugees they abandoned for help.
Don't bother looking confused!

403172422003330-Kritias_Epic02-.name:
I haven't seen you before.
Who are you?

403172422003332-Kritias_Epic02-.name: I can't stand the sight of you, so get out right now!!

403172422003333-Kritias_Epic02-.name:
Ho ho, judging by that expression, things didn't go well with <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11004574[gender:1]$</font>, did they?
Did you get the goods?

403172422003334-Kritias_Epic02-.name:
I heard from <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11004571[gender:0]$</font>.
He said you helped us.

403172422003335-Kritias_Epic02-.name:
You want me to describe the information merchant's house again?
The house with a glowing green crystal on its roof belongs to <font color="#ffd200">$npcTitle:11004576$</font>.
There's only one, so you'll recognize it immediately.

403172422003336-Kritias_Epic02-.name:
Nice to meet you!
I'm <font color="#ffd200">$npc:11004576$</font>, and I buy and sell everything.

403172422003337-Kritias_Epic02-.name:
Then let me welcome my customer.
Welcome to <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11004576$</font>'s shop, where everything is bought and sold!
What do you want?

403172422003338-Kritias_Epic02-.name: Defeat <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:25022602$</font> in <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020070$</font> and bring me <font color="#ffd200">$item:30001349$</font>.

403172422003340-Kritias_Epic02-.name:
All right, then~ I'll give you the information you wanted.
Listen carefully.

403172422003341-Kritias_Epic02-.name:
I have nothing more to tell you if you stay here.
Go to <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020067$</font>, then use a telescope to check for anything suspicious.

403172422003344-Kritias_Epic02-.name:
Hm? Didn't you say you would obtain information about the suspicious facility from <font color="#ffd200">$npcTitle:11004576$</font>?
Every moment counts, so hurry.

403172422003342-Kritias_Epic02-.name:
You're back, $MyPCName$.
You must be tired, but may I ask for your report right away?

403172422003346-Kritias_Epic02-.name:
It seems <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11004430[gender:0]$</font> obtained the blueprints for <font color="#ffd200">Archeon</font> in <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020035$</font>.

If you want to win the battle against <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11004430[gender:0]$</font>, you'd better move quickly.

403172422003345-Kritias_Epic02-.name:
Oh, you're back, customer.

403172422003349-Kritias_Epic02-.name: Well, shouldn't fiddling with the computer for a while take care of this?

403172422003348-Kritias_Epic02-.name: <font color="#909090">(I've made it here, but how do I get inside the factory?)</font>

403172422003347-Kritias_Epic02-.name: Go to <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020035$</font> and secure the blueprints for <font color="#ffd200">Archeon</font>.

403172422003350-Kritias_Epic02-.name: Well, shouldn't fiddling with the computer for a while take care of this?

403172422003353-Kritias_Epic02-.name: The blueprints for <font color="#ffd200">Archeon</font> can be found in the deepest part of the factory.

403172422003352-Kritias_Epic02-.name: Ask me if you need directions inside the factory.

403172422003354-Kritias_Epic02-.name:
You finally made it.
I nearly got tired of waiting and went in ahead of you.

403172422003355-Kritias_Epic02-.name: It seems you'll need the blueprints more than I will, so I'll return them.

403172422003356-Kritias_Epic02-.name:
Why are you here?
Didn't you say you were going to disable <font color="#ffd200">Archeon</font>?

403172422003359-Kritias_Epic02-.name: I'd like you to inspect the unidentified energy source with your own eyes and, while you're there, thin out the Black Legion forces in <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020070$</font>.

403172422003357-Kritias_Epic02-.name:
You returned safely.
Did you succeed in disabling <font color="#ffd200">Archeon</font>?!

403172422003358-Kritias_Epic02-.name: It seems the introductions are finished, so now I'll tell you what we've discovered.

403172422003364-Kritias_Epic02-.name:
<font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11004684$</font> was once a weapon that defended the Tyren Kingdom.
In fact, it guarded the very entrance to the kingdom and was Tyren's finest weapon.

403172422003363-Kritias_Epic02-.name:
You're back.
Did you identify the unknown energy source?

403172422003366-Kritias_Epic02-.name:
I didn't expect it to shut down obediently, but I never imagined it would escape and join <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11004430[gender:0]$</font>...
This is not good.

403172422003365-Kritias_Epic02-.name:
Afterward, <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11004684$</font> frequently ignored <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11004575[gender:1]$</font>'s orders. Displeased, <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11004575[gender:1]$</font> focused on developing a new weapon and succeeded.
As soon as testing of the new weapon was complete, <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11004684$</font> was ordered to shut down.

403172422003369-Kritias_Epic02-.name:
I trust my soldiers as well.
All units, prepare to advance!

403172422003367-Kritias_Epic02-.name:
I understand how you feel, but it's too dangerous!
As long as <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:23504001$</font> is guarding <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020071$</font>, there's no way for us to approach!!

403172422003368-Kritias_Epic02-.name: I understand how you feel, but it's too dangerous!

403172422003370-Kritias_Epic02-.name:
<font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11004684$</font> constantly maintains a defensive barrier around itself.
If you face <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11004684$</font> without preparing, you'll only waste your time and energy.

403172422003371-Kritias_Epic02-.name: $MyPCName$, would you go to <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020066$</font> and ask their leader, <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11004574[gender:1]$</font>?

403172422003372-Kritias_Epic02-.name:
Hm, you again?
What is it?

403172422003373-Kritias_Epic02-.name:
Then all that's left is to assemble it.
Just a moment.

403172422003375-Kritias_Epic02-.name:
I knew you would return safely.
Thanks to you, we all entered <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020071$</font> without incident.

403172422003379-Kritias_Epic02-.name: The more chaotic the situation, the more important it is to focus on what matters.

403172422003380-Kritias_Epic02-.name: Do you have a better plan?

403172422003381-Kritias_Epic02-.name: If you have a better plan, please propose it.

403172422003382-Kritias_Epic03-.name:
I've been waiting a long time, $MyPCName$.
At last, all preparations are complete.
You haven't been neglecting your training, have you?

403172422003386-Kritias_Epic03-.name:
Are you frightened now that it's time to leave?
But we can't avoid this forever.
Come, let's go defeat <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11004430[gender:0]$</font>.

403172422003388-Kritias_Epic03-.name:
It's been a long time, everyone.
How have you been?

403172422003389-Kritias_Epic03-.name: You're curious about what happened, aren't you?

403172422003391-Kritias_Epic03-.name:
...And that's what happened.
As soon as I heard, I rushed to where you were. Fortunately, I arrived in time.

403172422003392-Kritias_Epic03-.name: I'm glad I wasn't too late.

403172422003394-Kritias_Epic03-.name:
$MyPCName$, and Captain <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11004604[gender:1]$</font>.
Thank you sincerely for helping us drive the Black Legion from this land.

403172422003393-Kritias_Epic03-.name:
First... we need to bring the situation under control.
<font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11004430[gender:0]$</font> is dead—no, destroyed—but remnants of the Black Legion still remain.

403172422003395-Kritias_Epic03-.name: We've prepared a small gift for everyone who has helped us all this time.

403172422003397-Kritias_Epic03-.name:
This letter isn't meant for us.
You want us to deliver it to Empress <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11004390[gender:1]$</font>, correct?

403172422003398-Kritias_Epic03-.name:
If you're heading to <font color="#ffd200">$map:02000001$</font>, use the '<font color="#ffd200">Lumiwind</font>' in <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020041$</font>.
It will get you back quickly.

403172422003402-Kritias_Epic03-.name: I want to meet them at once, but we must wait until everything has been settled.

407170214000098--KR.name:
Puppies sometimes have trouble adjusting and become frightened in crowded places.

407170214000103--KR.name: You say a young puppy might struggle because there are so many people.

Now… time can flow again, right?
Let's wait with our hands together… Once I become an adult, we'll meet again!

423173514000157--KR.name:
Once time starts to flow, you'll grow faster too, $MyPCName$... Ah... 
You might grow old before you know it. Go back before you get old!

423173514000158--KR.name:
Once time starts to flow, you'll grow faster too, $MyPCName$... Ah... 
You might grow old before you know it. Go back before you get old!

424151722003514-Kritias_Epic02-.name:
You again?
I'm getting tired of this now.

424151722003516-Kritias_Epic02-.name:
A strange land suddenly appeared in the sky, and from that land came a strong energy of <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11004430[gender:0]$</font>.
While wandering around to kill that guy, I found this <font color="#ffd200">$npcTitle:11004576$</font>.

424151722003515-Kritias_Epic02-.name: (You ask what this person is doing here.)

424151722003517-Kritias_Epic02-.name: (Asks if the other Runeblades haven't come.)

424151722003519-Kritias_Epic02-.name: (Says they'll all recover, so don't worry.)

424151722003526-Kritias_Epic02-.name: (Say hello in thanks and say you will leave right away.)

424151722003529-Kritias_Epic02-.name: (Ask what the best way to do it is then.)

424151722003532-Kritias_Epic02-.name: (Thank them for the advice and say you will leave right away.)

424151722003536-Kritias_Epic02-.name: (Tells <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11004584[gender:0]$</font> that they'll share the blueprints once they obtain them.)

424151722003538-Kritias_Epic02-.name: (Says to meet in front of the suspicious facility at <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020067$</font>.)

424151722003540-Kritias_Epic02-.name: (Let's hurry to <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020035$</font> before we get caught together.)

424151722003542-Kritias_Epic02-.name: Well, shouldn't fiddling with the computer for a while take care of this?

424151722003543-Kritias_Epic02-.name:
I've done hacking errands more times than I can count, so this is nothing new~
Now then, shall we head in first?

424151722003518-Kritias_Epic02-.name:
I don't need anyone else.
...They're all injured, so they'd only get in the way.
Resting then is what would help me.

424151722003520-Kritias_Epic02-.name:
What? Who said anything about worrying?
Anyway, so you've met <font color="#ffd200">$npcTitle:11004576$</font> too. I'll have to pick up the pace on the hunt.
Who knew a brat like you would cross paths with it.

424151722003522-Kritias_Epic02-.name: We're not that kind of relationship…

424151722003537-Kritias_Epic02-.name:
Grr, I must share it!
Once this is taken care of, I'll follow right behind.

424151722003521-Kritias_Epic02-.name:
Are you two done with your greetings?
Take the rest of your talk outside.
Time is money!

424151722003523-Kritias_Epic02-.name:
Well, it seems the two of you know each other and want the same information.
Guest, have you checked <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020067$</font>?

424151722003525-Kritias_Epic02-.name:
That's where <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11004430[gender:0]$</font> is preparing to start up Arkeon.
Arkeon is Tairen Kingdom's latest weapon, and its power is incredible!

424151722003527-Kritias_Epic02-.name: <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11004574[gender:1]$</font> recommended you, and the seeds you brought last time were a big help, so I'll give you one piece of advice.

424151722003528-Kritias_Epic02-.name:
Challenging <font color="#ffd200">Arkeon</font> barehanded is a no-go.
You won't be able to handle it.

424151722003530-Kritias_Epic02-.name:
Fight strong power with strong power!
How about stealing <font color="#ffd200">Arkeon</font>?
If you get the blueprints, you'll know how to control <font color="#ffd200">Arkeon</font>.

424151722003531-Kritias_Epic02-.name: You should head down to <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020035$</font> and secure <font color="#ffd200">Arkeon</font>'s blueprints.

424151722003534-Kritias_Epic02-.name:
<font size='40'>Customer?</font>
Where are you off to?

424151722003535-Kritias_Epic02-.name:
You haven't paid the price for the information yet.
Are you trying to run away now?
If you have no money, pay with your body.

424151722003539-Kritias_Epic02-.name:
Come here quickly, guest.
There's a mountain of things I need.

424151722003545-Kritias_Epic02-.name: Asks where the <font color="#ffd200">Arkeon</font> blueprints can be found.

424151722003547-Kritias_Epic02-.name: He says he will ask about something else.

424151722003546-Kritias_Epic02-.name:
This is a robot factory managed by the Tairen Kingdom.
It is where excellent soldiers are produced for the kingdom.

424151722003548-Kritias_Epic02-.name:
<font color="#ffd200">Arkeon</font> is top secret information.
Do you have the authority to view classified information?

424151722003550-Kritias_Epic02-.name:
Understood.
You can find the blueprints for <font color="#ffd200">Arkeon</font> at the very back of the factory.

424151722003552-Kritias_Epic02-.name:
However, to move inside, you must shut down the security facility.
Enter the code to disable the security facility.

424151722003553-Kritias_Epic02-.name:
Code?
Hm, let's just go.
We can grab the blueprints and head to <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020067$</font>, right?

424151722003556-Kritias_Epic02-.name: (He says he already knows it perfectly and doesn't need it.)

424151722003560-Kritias_Epic02-.name: (You say you're working with Sky Fortress and the local force Humanitas to catch <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11004430[gender:0]$</font>, and after catching <font color="#ffd200">Arkeon</font>, you ask if <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11004584[gender:0]$</font> would also join.)

424151722003562-Kritias_Epic02-.name: (You retort, asking if they still don't know this place well, and tell them not to be so needlessly stubborn.)

424151722003564-Kritias_Epic02-.name: (You say they made a wise choice, and that you'll get on the radio.)

424151722003565-Kritias_Epic02-.name:
Let's see, tune the code... There.
Ah, can everyone hear me?

424151722003567-Kritias_Epic02-.name: (You say the facility was created by <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11004430[gender:0]$</font> to activate Tairen Kingdom's latest weapon, <font color="#ffd200">Arkeon</font>.)

424151722003569-Kritias_Epic02-.name: (You met <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11004584[gender:0]$</font> here by chance, and say you'll return with him after neutralizing <font color="#ffd200">Arkeon</font>.)

424151722003571-Kritias_Epic02-.name: (She says he was a companion she was with before...)

424151722003574-Kritias_Epic02-.name: (You say you succeeded in taking <font color="#ffd200">Arkeon</font> from <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11004430[gender:0]$</font>.)

424151722003581-Kritias_Epic02-.name: <font color="#909090">(I've never seen that expression before!)</font>

424151722003586-Kritias_Epic02-.name: (You firmly decline, insisting that it's fine.)

424151722003588-Kritias_Epic02-.name: <font color="#909090">(Were we in the same class?!)</font>

424151722003555-Kritias_Epic02-.name:
Simple structure.
I've memorized all of it.

424151722003561-Kritias_Epic02-.name:
No need to team up with those rookies.
I refuse.

424151722003563-Kritias_Epic02-.name:
…….
I'll join you just this once. There won't be a next time.

424151722003566-Kritias_Epic02-.name:
Loud and clear.
Did you find out anything about the suspicious facility?

424151722003573-Kritias_Epic02-.name:
If you're $MyPCName$'s companion, you must be trustworthy.
Very well, I'll hear the details after you neutralize <font color="#ffd200">Arkeon</font>.
We have things to tell you as well, so come back safely.

424151722003575-Kritias_Epic02-.name:
Getting loot on top of that, this is the best.
Right, now why don't you introduce me to your companion over here?

424151722003577-Kritias_Epic02-.name:
It's my first time seeing someone from Teruncalibr.
Nice to meet you. I'm the captain of the Sky Fortress, <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11004577[gender:1]$</font>.

424151722003583-Kritias_Epic02-.name: $MyPCName$, while our agents were neutralizing <font color="#ffd200">Arkeon</font>, we focused on tracking down the traces of <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11004430[gender:0]$</font>.

424151722003589-Kritias_Epic02-.name:
Let's get back to the main topic.
Just as we had located <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11004430[gender:0]$</font> and were preparing for the assault, <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11004580[gender:1]$</font> reported that an unidentified energy source was discovered at the gateway leading to <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020071$</font>.
<font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11004580[gender:1]$</font>?

424151722003568-Kritias_Epic02-.name:
<font color="#ffd200">Arkeon</font>?!
So <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11004575[gender:1]$</font> finally managed to complete it.

424151722003580-Kritias_Epic02-.name:
I've heard that someone recently took down the Black Legion and the Tairen soldiers. So it was you!
Nice to meet you.
I am the leader of Humanitas, <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11004582[gender:1]$</font>.

424151722003585-Kritias_Epic02-.name:
Ah, do you perhaps need a more detailed explanation?
You seem to have a slightly confused expression on your face right now.

424151722003590-Kritias_Epic02-.name:
Yes, I can't tell exactly what it is, but a very powerful energy source has been discovered.
We also requested an analysis of that energy source from Humanitas, but…

424151722003591-Kritias_Epic02-.name:
The energy of the Tairen Kingdom and the energy of the Black Legion are mixed together, so even we failed to identify that energy source.
It's far too risky to charge in like this.

424151722003623-Kritias_Epic02-.name: Direct combat? That's far too dangerous!

424151722003625-Kritias_Epic02-.name:
$npcName:11004582[gender:1]$ is the head of our Humanitas!
You should consider your position! Don't you know that if anything happens to <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11004582[gender:1]$</font>, Humanitas will come crumbling down!

424151722003628-Kritias_Epic02-.name:
Thank you for understanding, $MyPCName$.
Since <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11004582[gender:1]$</font> can't join us, let's instead make a device to trick <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11004684$</font>.

424151722003592-Kritias_Epic02-.name: (He says he will go and confirm it with his own eyes.)

424151722003594-Kritias_Epic02-.name: (He says that if something were to happen to him, the only one who could stop <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11004430[gender:0]$</font> is <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11004584[gender:0]$</font>, so he is against us going together.)

424151722003602-Kritias_Epic02-.name: (Shows everyone the photos taken at <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020070$</font>.)

424151722003604-Kritias_Epic02-.name: (Asks if you know what it is.)

424151722003613-Kritias_Epic02-.name: (She agrees, saying that since they've come this far, there's no backing down now.)

424151722003614-Kritias_Epic02-.name: (I say that I'll hold <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11004684$</font> off, so move to <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020071$</font> in the meantime.)

424151722003616-Kritias_Epic02-.name: (I say that I trust only the two of them, looking at <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11004584[gender:0]$</font> and <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11004577[gender:1]$</font>.)

424151722003612-Kritias_Epic02-.name:
I won't allow it!
I will surely destroy <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11004430[gender:0]$</font>.
I'll cut down anything that stands in my way.

424151722003617-Kritias_Epic02-.name: I'll move to <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11004430[gender:0]$</font> one step ahead.

424151722003601-Kritias_Epic02-.name:
Thank you, $MyPCName$.
Please be careful out there!

424151722003605-Kritias_Epic02-.name: It looks a little different, but... this is the weapon that once protected the Tairen Kingdom, <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11004684$</font>.

424151722003606-Kritias_Epic02-.name:
However, after <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11004575[gender:1]$</font> succeeded in developing new weapons, it was cast aside.
It disappeared for a while, so I thought it had been scrapped, but I guess that wasn't the case.

424151722003607-Kritias_Epic02-.name: I think <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11004684$</font> joined hands with <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11004430[gender:0]$</font> out of the resentment it felt after being abandoned by <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11004575[gender:1]$</font>.

424151722003609-Kritias_Epic02-.name:
Not everyone follows the words of <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11004575[gender:1]$</font> 100%.
In the case of <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11004684$</font>, having been the Tairen Kingdom's gatekeeper, it has a 'learning' function that allows it to upgrade itself.
<font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11004684$</font> kept learning, and ended up gaining <font color="#ffd200">self-awareness</font>.

424151722003610-Kritias_Epic02-.name:
After that, it often ignored <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11004575[gender:1]$</font>'s orders, and <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11004575[gender:1]$</font> grew displeased with <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11004684$</font>, so they focused on developing new weapons and succeeded.
The moment testing of the new weapons ended, <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11004684$</font> was ordered to power down.

424151722003611-Kritias_Epic02-.name:
The high-performance <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11004684$</font> joined hands with <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11004430[gender:0]$</font>, so it may have learned new abilities.
To think it's guarding the path to <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020071$</font>.
We may have to think about... retreating.

424151722003618-Kritias_Epic02-.name:
Sigh... All right.
Since everyone's resolve is firm, I'll place my trust in you too.

424151722003619-Kritias_Epic02-.name:
But I still oppose $MyPCName$ moving alone.
To face <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11004684$</font>, you'll need to be prepared.

424151722003620-Kritias_Epic02-.name:
But even <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11004684$</font> can't maintain that barrier in front of royalty.
Being armed at a royal's side means treason, after all.

424151722003621-Kritias_Epic02-.name:
Come with me, $MyPCName$.
If the two of us are together, we might be able to take down <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11004684$</font>.

424151722003624-Kritias_Epic02-.name:
Everyone is doing their best, <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11004583[gender:0]$</font>.
I have to do what I can too; it's not as if I never received combat training.
No problem.

424151722003629-Kritias_Epic02-.name: Ah! I didn't think of that method.

424151722003631-Kritias_Epic02-.name:
It's an Ener disruption device that makes it look like the same Ener as mine flows through $MyPCName$'s body.
If you carry that device, <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11004684$</font> will recognize you, $MyPCName$, as royalty.

424151722003632-Kritias_Epic02-.name: But to make this device, we'll need a lot of <font color="#ffd200">$item:30001350$</font>… I'm not sure we can find it here.

424151722003599-Kritias_Epic02-.name:
Then it's decided.
Ah, $MyPCName$. While you're moving, could you thin out the Black Legion troops at <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020070$</font>?
I'd like to send out some scouts.

424151722003608-Kritias_Epic02-.name:
But how could <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11004684$</font> oppose Jessica and join hands with <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11004430[gender:0]$</font>?
Aren't all robots built by the Tairen Kingdom under <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11004575[gender:1]$</font>'s control?

424151722003634-Kritias_Epic02-.name:
A good idea!
$MyPCName$, let's head over to $map:02020066$ and ask their leader <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11004574[gender:1]$</font> about it.

424151722003638-Kritias_Epic02-.name:
There, it's done.
Take this with you and you'll be able to face <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11004684$</font>.
Still, take care out there, $MyPCName$.

424151722003649-Kritias_Epic02-.name:
It's been a long time since I've heard that. 
Utopia is the reason <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11004575[gender:1]$</font> exists.

424151722003650-Kritias_Epic02-.name:
The word Utopia aside, I sense a familiar aura from that being.
How strange.

424151722003639-Kritias_Epic02-.name: (After saying farewell, says they will meet everyone in front of <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020071$</font>.)

424151722003644-Kritias_Epic02-.name: (Says I can't understand a word of what they're saying.)

425174323003445-Fame_Geo01-.name: (Say that I came to help the refugees at Humanitas' request.)

425174323003462-Fame_Geo01-.name: (You say you've defeated all of the 'Three Poing Brothers'.)

425174323003481-Fame_Geo01-.name: (I tell them we will subdue Cerbe's forces so children can no longer be abducted.)

424151722003636-Kritias_Epic02-.name:
<font color="#ffd200">$item:30001350$</font>?
That's a luxury item even among Enerne's wares, so we wouldn't have any.
What on earth do you intend to use it for?

425174323003446-Fame_Geo01-.name:
I can feel that <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11004614[gender:1]$</font> has started caring about our refugees.
It's a truly difficult situation….

425174323003448-Fame_Geo01-.name:
Have you ever lived a life where food is always in short supply?
Look around you, at this <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020067$</font>.
It's cursed land where no crops can grow.

425174323003450-Fame_Geo01-.name: If you want to help us, wipe out the mechanical creatures at <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020066$</font>, <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020067$</font>, and <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020068$</font>.

425174323003451-Fame_Geo01-.name:
You really do a clean job.
The residents who went out to hunt are coming back unharmed.

425174323003452-Fame_Geo01-.name:
With both arms full of game, no less.
Thank you, stranger.

425174323003467-Fame_Geo01-.name:
The Tairen bastards are attacking us.
Having to deal with the Cerbes is already more than enough...

425174323003468-Fame_Geo01-.name: You... Did you come to help us because you knew all along?

425174323003470-Fame_Geo01-.name:
Well... At least you have a conscience.
If Humanitas had never come here in the first place, the Tairen Kingdom wouldn't have attacked us either....

425174323003471-Fame_Geo01-.name:
Ever since we settled in <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020066$</font>, they have never once attacked us.
Not until we made contact with Humanitas.

425174323003472-Fame_Geo01-.name:
True. Will you subdue the Tairen forces?
Meanwhile, we'll strengthen the shelter's defenses.

425174323003473-Fame_Geo01-.name:
Thanks to you, we were able to protect <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020066$</font>.
We are in your debt, outsider.

425174323003474-Fame_Geo01-.name:
Now we have to repair what was destroyed, and unless you're going to help.... 
Then go back, stranger.

425174323003476-Fame_Geo01-.name:
Wait! I'm not very used to giving thanks...
.........
Thank you for saving the refugees, stranger.

425174323003478-Fame_Geo01-.name:
Damn those Cerbe scum!!!
Of the five residents who went out hunting today, only one returned.

425174323003479-Fame_Geo01-.name:
They were all kidnapped by those Cerbe fiends.
The remaining one was also taken, but they let him go on purpose.

425174323003480-Fame_Geo01-.name: It's for conveying to us just how terrifying a presence they are.

425174323003482-Fame_Geo01-.name:
Alright?
I beg of you, stranger.

424151722003640-Kritias_Epic02-.name:
Grant you luck.
Come on, let's be moving too.

424151722003641-Kritias_Epic02-.name:
Looks like the squad came through without a scratch too.
It was a fine plan.

424151722003642-Kritias_Epic02-.name:
A sudden surge of energy has been detected!!
What is it?

424151722003643-Kritias_Epic02-.name:
What just happened?
<font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11004430[gender:0]$</font>... that's right, isn't it?

424151722003645-Kritias_Epic02-.name:
Right? I'm not the only one who doesn't understand, am I?
Do you understand?

425174323003456-Fame_Geo01-.name:
Stranger, please help us.
The 'Three Poing Brothers' are killing the leshies!

425174323003461-Fame_Geo01-.name:
The 'Three Poing Brothers' are roaming around <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020068$</font> and <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020069$</font>.
Please be careful.

425174323003463-Fame_Geo01-.name:
Thank you so much.
A stranger has saved a great many leshies.

425174323003464-Fame_Geo01-.name: I, <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11004620[gender:0]$</font>, will never forget the help of the outsider.

425174323003483-Fame_Geo01-.name: Show those who took the refugees from <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020067$</font> the most terrible taste in this world.

425174323003485-Fame_Geo01-.name:
Thank you, outsider.
Those who were taken may not come back....
But at least we have avenged them.

425174323003487-Fame_Geo01-.name:
I need some time alone. 
Will you be heading back now, outsider?

425174323003484-Fame_Geo01-.name: (Says they subdued all the Cerbe forces wandering in <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020067$</font>.)

425174323003486-Fame_Geo01-.name: <font color="#909090">(I feel a little heavy-hearted. Vengeance only breeds more vengeance....)</font>

425174323003543-Fame_Geo01-.name: (Says they came after hearing that <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:25022505$</font> had burst into <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020069$</font>.)

425174323003544-Fame_Geo01-.name: (He vows to destroy the <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:25022505$</font> that has been tearing through <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020069$</font>.)

425174323003545-Fame_Geo01-.name: (He says he destroyed every <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:25022505$</font> that was tearing through <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020069$</font>.)

425174421030009-Fame_Geo01-.name: (She says the refugees' situation is far too pitiful.)

425174421030015-Fame_Geo01-.name: <font color="#909090">(I don't know if this is a compliment or if she's trying to provoke a competitive spirit.)</font>

425174421030017-Fame_Geo01-.name: <font color="#909090">(I know she's provoking my competitive spirit, yet I can't refuse.)</font>

425174421030002-Fame_Geo01-.name:
Welcome, $MyPCName$.
Your decision to help Humanitas...
Thank you once again.

425174421030004-Fame_Geo01-.name: As you know, the road was cut off by the emergence of the Black Legion, so in the past we were unable to help the residents of <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020066$</font>.

425174421030005-Fame_Geo01-.name: Now that the Maple Alliance has advanced into northern Kritias, we can finally lend them a hand.

425174421030006-Fame_Geo01-.name:
Will you head to <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020066$</font> and meet its leader, <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11004574[gender:1]$</font>?
